41304740.conclusion_quote: LPX-TI641 promotes antigen-independent immune tolerance through Tim receptor agonism and Treg expansion.
41304740.summary: In mice with EAE and in blood from people with MS, the oral drug LPX-TI641 expanded regulatory T cells, reduced disease severity and prevented relapses.

39896163.mechanism: Supplies choline and lysophosphatidylcholine as a nutrient source
39896163.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrated lysolecithin's good tolerability and potential as a new choline supplement.
39896163.summary: In a human trial of healthy adults aged 40 to 74, eight weeks of lysolecithin supplements were well tolerated and modestly raised blood choline, with no memory benefit.

40031427.mechanism: Inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome activation in hippocampus
40031427.conclusion_quote: Therefore, our study demonstrates that 1,2,4-TTB mitigates depression-like behaviors, depending on its inhibitory role in NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
40031427.summary: In mice given repeated LPS or fear conditioning, 1,2,4-Trimethoxybenzene reduced depression-like behaviors and calmed NLRP3 inflammasome activity in the hippocampus, a brain region involved in mood.

40020761.conclusion_quote: In addition, there is a significant increase in the activation and infiltration of immune cells, demyelination, and heightened protein expression of B cell chemoattractant CXCL13 within the spinal cord of mice exhibiting mechanical hypersensitivity and paralysis, compared to mice only experiencing mechanical hypersensitivity.
40020761.summary: In mice with EAE, the study compared pain sensitive animals with and without paralysis, finding similar pain but more spinal cord immune activity, demyelination, and CXCL13 in paralyzed mice.

40250717.conclusion_quote: Our results set the basis for further studies on M-MDSCs as a promising new biomarker that identify a CNS prone to new oligodendrocyte generation in response to an inflammatory insult.
40250717.summary: In mice with EAE, blood immune cells called suppressor cells were linked to more newly made oligodendrocytes, hinting they might flag repair potential.

40100796.mechanism: Blocks SARM1 enzyme that drives axon self-destruction
40100796.conclusion_quote: When tested in vivo, compound 7 showed efficacy after oral dosing in a mouse model of peripheral nerve injury by decreasing plasma neurofilament light (NfL) levels at 50 mg/kg compared with vehicle-treated control mice, holding promise for the treatment of neurodegenerative and neurological disorders.
40100796.summary: In mice with peripheral nerve injury, an oral drug called compound 7 lowered blood levels of a nerve damage marker, suggesting possible benefit for nerve disorders.

40063988.mechanism: Caveolin-1 knockout blocks CXCL10-driven T cell crossing of endothelium
40063988.conclusion_quote: Our findings establish a novel mechanism by which brain endothelial cells utilize Caveolin-1 dependent CXCL10 intracellular stores to license T cells for transcellular migration across the blood-brain barrier.
40063988.summary: In mice with EAE, removing Caveolin-1 from brain blood vessel cells reduced T cell entry into the brain, showing this protein helps immune cells cross the blood-brain barrier.

40654331.conclusion_quote: Our findings support previous observations regarding microbiome alterations in the context of EAE and suggest that evaluating microbiome dynamics would benefit from both taxonomic assessment and metabolic activity, allowing for more effective and comprehensive research strategies.
40654331.summary: Researchers reanalyzed gut microbiome data from mice with EAE, from different suppliers, predicting functional differences in amino acid, carbohydrate and lipid metabolism across disease stages.

40632337.mechanism: Blocks SPI1, lowering CXCL4 and neutrophil trap release
40632337.conclusion_quote: These results indicated that SPI1 serves as a crucial regulator of NETS in MS by regulating the CXCL4 promoter.
40632337.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the gene SPI1 reduced neutrophil activity, inflammation and harmful neutrophil traps, and helped oligodendrocyte precursor cells mature and form myelin.

40404613.conclusion_quote: Taken together, widely applicable and fast QCL-MIR imaging-based guidance of MSI ensures that more time is available for exploration and validation of new biology by default on-tissue tandem-MS analysis.
40404613.summary: A fast infrared imaging method guided mass spectrometry to map lipids in tiny tissue regions, revealing lipid changes in spinal cord lesions of mice with EAE, a model of MS.

40021945.mechanism: Activates FFAR2, altering gut microbes and fatty acids
40021945.conclusion_quote: The effects of Cpd1 on the gut microbiota and SCFA composition are relevant to the observed treatment benefit of FFAR2 agonism in the EAE model during the inductive phase of the disease.
40021945.summary: In rats with EAE, an oral drug that activates FFAR2 changed gut bacteria and fatty acid levels, easing disease when given early.

40299553.mechanism: Deleting OCA-B blocks pathogenic CD4 T-cell maturation
40299553.conclusion_quote: These results identify OCA-B as a driver of pathogenic CD4+ T cells.
40299553.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the OCA-B gene from T cells reduced brain inflammation and disease, while still allowing responses to viral infection.

39946233.mechanism: Deleting IPMK reduces Akt-mTOR signaling and Th1/Th17 cell differentiation
39946233.conclusion_quote: These findings establish IPMK as a critical regulator of Th1 and Th17 differentiation, underscoring its role in maintaining immune homeostasis.
39946233.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting IPMK in CD4 T cells reduced Th1 and Th17 responses and lessened disease.

39957272.conclusion_quote: These results highlight the imbalance of astrocyte network activity in the brain cortex during autoimmune inflammation and further support the relevance of astrocyte-based pathobiology as an underlying mechanism of cortical dysfunction in MS.
39957272.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, fiber photometry showed abnormal cortical astrocyte calcium signals that tracked the severity of neurological deficits.

40362399.mechanism: Protects oligodendrocytes and dampens microglial inflammation
40362399.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight CHI3L1 as a critical modulator of neuroinflammation and oligodendrocyte survival, positioning it as a promising therapeutic target for MS.
40362399.summary: In mice with EAE, a recombinant CHI3L1 protein reduced disease severity, demyelination and nerve damage, while protecting oligodendrocytes.

39888411.conclusion_quote: Lysophosphatidylcholine-induced aberrant adipogenesis in CF is a newly identified pathological feature in CD patients and a potential therapeutic target.
39888411.summary: In Crohn's disease patients and a mouse colitis model, lysophosphatidylcholine drove abnormal fat cell formation and weakened fat cells' ability to kill bacteria, but this is not multiple sclerosis research.

39348064.conclusion_quote: We here present a protocol for the study of glial cell activation in the spinal cord tissue of EAE mice.
39348064.summary: This protocol describes how to stain mouse spinal cord sections to measure microglia and astrocyte activation in mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis.

40643490.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
40643490.conclusion_quote: Our data demonstrate that high-resolution gait analysis provides a sensitive, non-invasive tool to monitor functional deficits in demyelinating models and may aid in evaluating therapeutic efficacy in future studies.
40643490.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to induce demyelination, high speed video gait analysis detected specific walking changes linked to myelin loss, offering a sensitive noninvasive way to track functional decline.

40900636.conclusion_quote: Our study uncovers for the first time that SARS-CoV-2 can invade the SNpc and downregulate miR-330-5p expression levels, causing an enhanced ADAM17 expression and possible neuroinflammatory signalling.
40900636.summary: In mice infected with SARS-CoV-2, the virus reached a midbrain region and lowered miR-330-5p, which raised ADAM17 and brain inflammation, with no MS focus.

40120662.mechanism: activates thyroid hormone receptor, promoting oligodendrocyte maturation
40120662.conclusion_quote: These results provide support for thyroid hormone receptor agonism as a potential novel target to promote remyelination and clinical outcomes in patients with MS.
40120662.summary: In cats with widespread demyelination caused by irradiated food, daily LL-341070 treatment improved or restored function in four of eight affected cats and promoted myelin repair.

40789037.mechanism: Knockout removes host factor needed for viral translation
40789037.conclusion_quote: Here, we demonstrate that ITAF 45 is a pervasive host factor for picornaviruses containing a Type II IRES.
40789037.summary: In human cell lines, removing the ITAF 45 gene made cells resistant to several animal viruses, showing this protein helps these viruses make their proteins.

39847587.mechanism: No treatment tested, epitope mapping method
39847587.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that DECODE can provide high-quality epitope information, improve the reproducibility of antibody-dependent experiments, diagnostics and therapeutics, and contribute to discover pathogenic epitopes from antibodies in the blood.
39847587.summary: A new method called DECODE maps antibody targets at single amino acid resolution, and in mice with EAE it identified an epitope matching the disease-inducing peptide from blood antibodies.

40332313.mechanism: Binds ENO1, blocking glycolysis and M1 microglia polarization
40332313.conclusion_quote: This study uncovers the molecular mechanism of PF in treating EAE, linking the anti-inflammatory property of PF to the glucose metabolism process, which will broaden the prospective applications of PF.
40332313.summary: In mice with EAE, the natural compound paeoniflorin eased disease symptoms by binding the ENO1 enzyme, which reduced inflammatory microglia activity.

40323426.mechanism: Reduces T-cell numbers and IL-17, boosts myelination
40323426.conclusion_quote: In summary, MD and lycopene administration positively impacted EAE scores and myelination.
40323426.summary: Mice with EAE fed a Mediterranean diet plus lycopene had milder symptoms, lower IL-17 levels, and more myelin than other groups.

40244185.mechanism: reduces inflammatory factors in central nervous system
40244185.conclusion_quote: Thus, Short-chain fatty acids, as an environmental factor in the diet, may slightly alleviate symptoms by down-regulating inflammatory factors in the central nervous system.
40244185.summary: In a Huntington's disease mouse model, daily propionate, a diet derived fatty acid, slightly reduced brain inflammation but did not improve symptoms or protect neurons.

40158900.mechanism: S1P receptor modulation limits lymphocyte brain entry
40158900.conclusion_quote: This study illustrates that fingolimod effectively ameliorates multiple pathological features of AD, highlighting its potential as a promising therapeutic candidate for the disease.
40158900.summary: In APP/PS1 mice modeling Alzheimer's disease, fingolimod reduced brain amyloid, tau changes, inflammation, and nerve loss while improving cognitive function.

40403837.conclusion_quote: Together, these results suggest that high cholesterol levels are required for myelin membrane stability and that reduced cholesterol in repaired myelin may have a profound impact on the biophysical properties of the myelin membrane.
40403837.summary: In a genetic mouse model of brain demyelination, repaired myelin had less cholesterol and formed less stable lipid films, which cholesterol supplementation improved in lab tests.

39955059.mechanism: Loss causes microglial iron overload and ferroptosis
39955059.conclusion_quote: In summary, these findings revealed that GPER1 can regulate demyelination through ferroptosis of microglia.
39955059.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, removing the GPER1 receptor worsened memory loss and myelin damage by killing microglia through ferroptosis.

39894902.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that EAE is more severe in aged mice due to a more inflammatory and neurodegenerative environment in the central nervous system.
39894902.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, older animals had more severe disease with more inflammation and nerve damage in the central nervous system, linked to aging immune cells.

39883092.conclusion_quote: Herein, we develop and demonstrate a statistically-robust analysis pipeline with which to examine and interpret axomyelin physiology and pathobiology in two disease states, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis and the rumpshaker mouse model of leukodystrophy.
39883092.summary: In mice with EAE and rumpshaker mice, researchers built a more reliable statistical method for measuring myelin thickness around nerve fibers and spotting disease-related changes.

41381488.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that the continuous myelin pattern of L5 axons not only speeds conduction but also enables precise temporal integration of sensory and cortical signals across long-range pathways.
41381488.summary: In mice with cuprizone demyelination, layer 5 brain axons conducted signals more slowly and less precisely to the thalamus, impairing sensory signal integration.

40837231.conclusion_quote: Overall, our work suggests that postlesional changes in mechanical cues regulate neuroblast mobilization and fate conversion in the adult mammalian central nervous system.
40837231.summary: In mouse brain slices and mice with chemically induced demyelination, softer tissue made progenitor cells migrate alone and become oligodendrocytes that make myelin.

39812531.conclusion_quote: This research offers vital insights that could be utilized in creating biomarkers and advancing treatments for MS.
39812531.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, Hypericum perforatum oil treatment changed brain microRNA levels, identifying candidate markers that could aid future MS diagnosis and treatment.

41007997.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that dietary supplementation with 0.05% LL improves growth performance, enhances nutrient digestibility and intestinal absorptive capacity, and positively modulates lipid metabolism in YFBs.
41007997.summary: This study tested a lysolecithin feed supplement and dietary fat levels in yellow feathered broiler chickens, finding improved growth and digestion, not a multiple sclerosis model.

40043749.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease changes only
40043749.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that CPZ exposure induces demyelination in the ACC coinciding with changes in intrinsic properties, action potentials and excitatory synaptic transmission.
40043749.summary: In male mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, brain cells in the anterior cingulate cortex became less excitable and had weaker synaptic signaling between neurons.

39586379.conclusion_quote: Meanwhile, our research indicated that curcumin may exert neuroprotective effects in CPZ-induced mice by downregulating astrocyte-mediated inflammation by AXL.
39586379.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, curcumin reduced myelin loss and calmed inflammatory astrocytes, possibly through the AXL protein.

40393245.mechanism: Inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome pyroptosis through SLC2A4-regulated autophagy
40393245.conclusion_quote: The present study demonstrated that EVO inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated microglial pyroptosis and promotes remyelination via SLC2A4-regulated autophagy during demyelinating disease, which suggests EVO as a promising drug candidate for the treatment of MS.
40393245.summary: In mice with demyelinating disease, evodiamine reduced harmful immune cell death in the brain and promoted myelin repair through a cellular cleaning process called autophagy.

40574973.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes T cell markers only
40574973.conclusion_quote: This study underscores the heterogeneity and dynamic changes of CD4+ T cells detectable by spectral flow cytometry, enhancing diagnostic resolution of CSF cells and informing more precise therapeutic strategies for MS.
40574973.summary: Researchers used flow cytometry and single cell sequencing on CD4+ T cells in mice with EAE and in cerebrospinal fluid from people with MS to find markers of disease phase.

40511293.mechanism: Reduces oxidative stress and lowers TNF and IL-1β
40511293.conclusion_quote: These results suggested, Quercetin has protective effect against CPZ-induced MS in mice.
40511293.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to model multiple sclerosis, quercetin improved motor performance and lowered blood markers of inflammation and oxidative stress.

40050112.mechanism: Reduces Th17 responses and hippocampal NLRP3 neuroinflammation
40050112.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that A. muciniphila holds promise as a probiotic for treating NLRP3-associated inflammatory disorders and cognitive impairment, including MS.
40050112.summary: In mice with EAE, a gut bacterium called A. muciniphila reduced nerve damage, lowered inflammation, and partly improved memory and thinking problems.

38315116.mechanism: Reduces inflammation and modulates gene expression in splenocytes
38315116.conclusion_quote: NAD + on DEGs attenuates disease severity in EAE.
38315116.summary: In mice with EAE, NAD+ reduced disease severity and inflammation, but did not significantly change most tested gene changes in spleen cells.

40576745.mechanism: Glycoconjugates modulate inflammation and strengthen epithelial junctions
40576745.conclusion_quote: Glycoconjugates on TcES play a significant role in mediating the immunomodulatory effects that alleviate DSS-induced colitis.
40576745.summary: In mice with chemically induced colitis, a parasite-derived glycoconjugate preparation reduced inflammation and strengthened the gut lining, but this is not an MS study.

39817476.conclusion_quote: We propose that neutrophil dysregulation in MS may contribute to dysfunctional T cell responses.
39817476.summary: Researchers compared proteins in neutrophils from people with MS and healthy donors, finding more granule proteins in MS cells, which suppressed T cell activation less effectively.

40355102.mechanism: reduces inflammatory cytokine expression in skin
40355102.conclusion_quote: Among the doses tested, 50 mcg GA administered after model induction was the most effective in reducing clinical severity and inflammatory cytokine expression.
40355102.summary: In mice with imiquimod induced psoriasis, glatiramer acetate injections reduced skin severity and inflammatory cytokines, with the 50 microgram dose after induction working best.

40592015.conclusion_quote: This list serves as a reference for researchers, veterinarians, and policymakers involved in tick diversity, vector control, and conservation efforts.
40592015.summary: This paper updates an official checklist of 110 tick species found in South Africa. It does not study multiple sclerosis or any animal model of it.

40054539.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our study provides valuable insights into the cellular sources and alterations of CCL2 in the monkey brain under normal and SIV-infected conditions, which may promote better understanding of CCL2 in related neurological processes.
40054539.summary: In healthy and SIV-infected monkeys, neurons, blood vessel cells and macrophages were found to produce the immune signal CCL2 in brain tissue.

39988657.mechanism: Removing MyD88 innate immune signaling restores synaptic facilitation
39988657.conclusion_quote: Moreover, our findings suggest a role of astrocytes, in particular Bergmann glia, as key cellular determinants of cerebellar synaptic dysfunction.
39988657.summary: In mice with toxic demyelination, removing the innate immune protein MyD88 partly restored normal synaptic signaling in the cerebellum, while demyelinating lesions looked unchanged.

42211257.conclusion_quote: Regarding the medical importance of the abundant species, the investigation of adult ecology is suggested for future studies.
42211257.summary: This study surveyed mosquito larval habitats in southwestern Iran and found many species in natural, temporary sites. It does not involve multiple sclerosis or any disease model.

39904416.mechanism: alters gut microbiota and metabolites, reducing demyelination
39904416.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that intermittent MDMA administration may alleviate demyelination in the CC of CPZ-treated mice via the gut-brain axis.
39904416.summary: In cuprizone-fed mice, repeated intermittent MDMA reduced myelin loss in the brain's corpus callosum, possibly through changes in gut bacteria and metabolites.

39672388.mechanism: Depletes gut microbiota with broad-spectrum antibiotics
39672388.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that despite effective microbiome depletion, a 4-week oral ABX regimen does not influence demyelination or remyelination in the CPZ model.
39672388.summary: Antibiotics that wipe out gut bacteria did not change demyelination or myelin repair in mice fed the cuprizone toxin diet.

41193846.conclusion_quote: Overall, this study reveals common and differential mechanisms underlying brain development and neuroinflammation, providing a rich resource for investigating brain development, function and disease.
41193846.summary: Researchers mapped gene activity and proteins across developing mouse brains and in mice given lysolecithin to cause inflammation, finding shared developmental and injury programs.

40165970.mechanism: Delivers peptides to liver cells, inducing regulatory T cells
40165970.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate that peptide-loaded nanoparticles preferentially deliver disease-relevant peptides to LSECs, thereby inducing antigen-specific immune tolerance.
40165970.summary: In mice with EAE, a liver-targeted nanoparticle carrying myelin peptides reduced disease severity and demyelination by inducing immune tolerance.

39623165.mechanism: Reduces mitochondrial calcium uptake in T cells
39623165.conclusion_quote: In summary, we demonstrate that m Ca 2+ uptake through MCU is essential for proper T-cell function and has a crucial role in autoimmunity.
39623165.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, knocking down the MCU gene in CD4 T cells reduced their mitochondrial calcium uptake and suppressed autoimmune responses.

40605058.mechanism: blocks CTLA-4 and PD-1 checkpoints, activating T cells
40605058.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that combinatorial blockade of CTLA-4 and PD-1 destabilizes neuroimmune-regulatory networks and activates microglia, contributing to long-term neurodegeneration and cognitive impairments.
40605058.summary: In mice with melanoma and in mice with EAE, combined checkpoint blockade drugs impaired memory, reduced brain myelin and activated brain microglia.

40153681.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data suggest that, in addition to retargeting RSKs toward unconventional substrates, pathogens' proteins carrying a DDVF-like motif can compete with endogenous DDVF-containing proteins for RSK binding, thereby altering the regulation of the RAS-ERK MAP kinase pathway.
40153681.summary: This study does not address multiple sclerosis. It examines how viral and bacterial proteins and human proteins bind RSK kinases to alter the ERK signaling pathway in cells.

42232584.conclusion_quote: Given the high burden of glucocorticoid exposure, premature ovarian insufficiency, and osteoporosis among individuals with autoimmune diseases, SERMs may offer dual benefit as both immunomodulatory and bone-protective agents.
42232584.summary: This review summarizes evidence that selective estrogen receptor modulators may treat autoimmune diseases, but human studies so far are small and short term.

40676712.mechanism: Reduces inflammatory mediators, adhesion molecules, and pyroptosis
40676712.conclusion_quote: This study suggests that DMF has hepatoprotective effects on septic mice via the modulation of inflammation, adhesion molecules, angiopoietin 2 and pyroptosis.
40676712.summary: In mice with sepsis from cecal ligation and puncture, dimethyl fumarate pretreatment reduced liver inflammation, injury, and pyroptosis markers.

41406153.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results highlight nucleocytoplasmic trafficking as a critical regulatory mechanism governing PKR activation.
41406153.summary: This virus study examines how cardiovirus proteins block the antiviral PKR protein by disrupting movement in and out of the cell nucleus, not an MS treatment.

39746809.conclusion_quote: These findings enhance our understanding of how demyelination affects the ACC's role in orchestrating neural activity, particularly in light of the slice-specific nature of interhemispheric communication impairments.
39746809.summary: In cuprizone-fed mice, a toxin model of demyelination, communication between brain hemispheres was impaired and regained functionally before myelin fully repaired.

39875919.mechanism: Activates NLRX1 to suppress NF-κB inflammatory signaling
39875919.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that pharmacologic NLRX1 activators have the potential to limit inflammatory neurodegeneration.
39875919.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug called LABP-66 given by mouth after paralysis began reduced damage to the optic nerve and visual pathway neurons.

39871344.conclusion_quote: Thus, marmoset EAE appears to be a clinically relevant model for the study of TSPO in immune dysregulation in human disease.
39871344.summary: Marmoset monkeys with EAE, a model of MS, showed TSPO protein in brain immune cells, with expression shifting from microglia to astrocytes in older lesions.

39880680.conclusion_quote: Overall, our findings elucidate different effects that g K downmodulation may have in cortical networks, explaining its potential role in both pathological neural dynamics and therapeutic applications.
39880680.summary: A computer model of brain cortex networks found that lowering potassium channel activity increases neuron synchrony and triggers seizure activity, with no animal or human MS work.

41382275.mechanism: Replaces APOE4 with APOE2 in microglia, improving remyelination
41382275.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that microglia-specific E2 expression, in the presence of continued E4 expression, may provide protection against myelin loss via both cell-autonomous and non-autonomous immunometabolic mechanisms.
41382275.summary: In mice with cuprizone or LPC-induced demyelination, replacing APOE4 with APOE2 only in microglia improved remyelination and reduced microglial activation.

39910805.conclusion_quote: Use of Aldh1l1-Cre/ERT2 should therefore account for recombination in both astrocytes and immune cells in disease models involving peripheral immune cell infiltration into the CNS.
39910805.summary: In mice with EAE, a widely used astrocyte-targeting Cre line also tagged spleen and spinal cord immune cells, so researchers must account for this when interpreting results.

41005574.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes glutamate dysregulation in demyelination
41005574.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings establish a mechanistic link between chronic hippocampal demyelination, glutamate dysregulation, and epileptogenesis offering potential molecular targets for therapeutic intervention in MS-associated epilepsy.
41005574.summary: Using a cuprizone diet model of demyelination, hippocampal glutamate rose and seizures became more frequent over 12 weeks, with loss of neurons and altered astrocytes.

40308584.mechanism: Blocks P2X7 receptor, reducing microglial calcium influx
40308584.conclusion_quote: The treatment of EAE mice with AFC-5128 improved acute and chronic EAE in different treatment paradigms, with positive effects on histological markers and slight modulation of microglial marker expression.
40308584.summary: In mice with EAE, a brain-penetrating P2X7 receptor blocker called AFC-5128 reduced disease scores and spinal cord damage when given early or during chronic disease.

40924614.mechanism: Blocks IL-17A binding to its receptor IL-17RA
40924614.conclusion_quote: These findings support Niraparib's potential as a therapeutic option for MS, warranting further exploration of its mechanisms and clinical relevance.
40924614.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, the approved drug niraparib reduced myelin loss, promoted remyelination, and altered immune cell profiles.

40245248.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that cox1 can be used to understand the phylogeography of D. variabilis, but more sequences are needed from individuals in other populations across geographical range of this tick species, particularly those on the Canadian prairies where D. variabilis is undergoing range expansion.
40245248.summary: Researchers studied genetic differences among American dog ticks in Manitoba, Canada, and found bacteria like Rickettsia montanensis, but this study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

40666282.mechanism: No treatment tested, descriptive gene expression only
40666282.conclusion_quote: This study confirmed a differential expression of immune, inflammatory, and neural DEGs in sensory ganglia of male and female mice undergoing CNS neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation.
40666282.summary: In a mouse model of MS caused by coronavirus infection, researchers compared gene activity in lower back nerve ganglia of male and female mice, finding sex differences in immune and nerve gene changes.

39959647.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease biology only
39959647.conclusion_quote: This study reveals the key role of SLC11A1 in AD, particularly in the context of ferroptosis and immune inflammation.
39959647.summary: Using gene data from Alzheimer's patients and mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, researchers linked the gene SLC11A1 to inflammation and ferroptosis in brain immune cells.

39506428.conclusion_quote: Adoption of dPCR testing is an opportunity to further decrease the prevalence of EqPV-H in equine biologics.
39506428.summary: This study compared two lab tests for detecting equine parvovirus-hepatitis in horse biologic products, finding digital PCR more reliable than the older method. It does not involve multiple sclerosis.

38842672.mechanism: Shifts microglia from M1 to M2 via PPARγ
38842672.conclusion_quote: HPGD is regulated by Nr4a1 and inhibits the progression of EAE through shifting the M1/M2 polarization and promoting the activation of PPARγ signaling pathway.
38842672.summary: In mice with EAE, boosting the HPGD gene eased disease by shifting brain immune cells called microglia toward a calming state.

39724786.mechanism: Microbial peptide mimics myelin antigen, triggering T cells
39724786.conclusion_quote: Our data suggests the potential involvement of a MOG 35-55 -mimic peptide derived from the gut microbiota as a molecular trigger of EAE pathogenesis.
39724786.summary: In mice with EAE, a peptide from human gut microbes that resembles the myelin protein MOG triggered immune attacks on the nerves, especially when combined with MOG.

41178751.mechanism: Reduces microglial inflammation and promotes oligodendrocyte maturation
41178751.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that TGFβ might have a positive action in remyelination by modulating microglial reactivity and promoting OPC maturation.
41178751.summary: In rats given the demyelinating toxin cuprizone, injecting TGFβ calmed brain microglia and helped oligodendrocyte precursor cells mature, supporting myelin repair.

41026781.conclusion_quote: Together, our data uncovers a critical period for juvenile myelination as an important factor in PFC PV interneuron development and brain maturation.
41026781.summary: In mice given cuprizone to demyelinate their brains during youth, parvalbumin interneurons in the prefrontal cortex matured and fired abnormally, and only partly recovered after remyelination.

41255818.conclusion_quote: Our approach offers a robust and efficient method for in vivo brain volumetry in preclinical mouse studies, facilitating the evaluation of neurodegenerative processes and therapeutic interventions.
41255818.summary: Researchers used an AI method on quick MRI scans to measure brain volume in healthy mice and in mouse models of multiple sclerosis and demyelination.

39863040.conclusion_quote: DMF improves the survival rate of BA mice and corrects the Treg/Th17 imbalance, possibly via the Nrf2/antioxidant response elements (ARE) pathway.
39863040.summary: In a mouse model of biliary atresia, a liver disease, the MS drug dimethyl fumarate restored immune balance and improved survival, possibly via the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway.

40072369.conclusion_quote: These observations highlight the crucial role of ECS transport in maintaining neurochemical homeostasis in the brain, providing new insights into the mechanisms that may underline the neuropsychiatric symptoms of MS.
40072369.summary: In an MS animal model with lysophosphatidylcholine-induced demyelination, disrupted fluid transport in the brain was linked to abnormal dopamine and other chemical levels near the lesion.

40127438.conclusion_quote: These findings underscore the complex interplay between host behaviour, environmental factors and parasite ecology in urban environments, offering insights into managing urban wildlife diseases.
40127438.summary: This study used network analysis to examine blood parasites in urban South American coatis, finding haemotropic Mycoplasma most important, and it does not involve multiple sclerosis.

39638431.conclusion_quote: [ 11 C]MeDAS PET shows the potential to quantify myelin density in the spinal cord.
39638431.summary: In rats with spinal cord damage and in people with MS, a PET scan tracer showed less myelin in damaged areas of the spinal cord.

40345851.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that in the healthy adult mouse brain, callosal OPCs primarily receive synaptic input from cortical layer V pyramidal neurons.
40345851.summary: In mice, demyelination of the corpus callosum shifted which cortical neurons connect with oligodendrocyte progenitor cells, favoring layer II/III neurons over layer V neurons.

39952179.mechanism: Not applicable: in vitro fat digestion study without MS model
39952179.conclusion_quote: These findings provide insights into emulsifier effects on lipolysis processes and in vitro lipolysis kinetics.
39952179.summary: Tested how emulsifier mixtures affect fat digestion in a lab setup mimicking the small intestine. The study does not involve multiple sclerosis or any disease model.

40998034.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes lipid changes
40998034.conclusion_quote: Lipid subclass changes emerged as reliable markers of both demyelination and remyelination in the mouse brain.
40998034.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a substance that strips myelin from brain fibers, researchers mapped lipid changes during myelin loss and natural repair, finding lipid shifts that mark both processes.

39167321.mechanism: Blocks IL-23R signaling, reducing Th17-like Treg cells
39167321.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, administration of atRA might be a way to combat the proinflammatory effects of HSD.
39167321.summary: In mice with EAE fed a high-salt diet, retinoic acid and an anti-IL-23R antibody reduced harmful inflammatory regulatory T cells and slowed disease progression.

39680254.mechanism: No treatment tested, only gene expression analysis
39680254.conclusion_quote: Two potential biomarkers, SOCS3 and FPR2, were screened out with great diagnostic value for MS and IBD.
39680254.summary: Analyzing gene data from bowel disease, mice with EAE, and patients, researchers found SOCS3 and FPR2 as possible inflammation biomarkers for MS and IBD.

40055064.mechanism: Not applicable, human genotype association study
40055064.conclusion_quote: The MBOAT7 rs641738 gene polymorphism is associated with the severity of liver fibrosis and inflammation.
40055064.summary: In 214 people with fatty liver disease, a gene variant in MBOAT7 was linked to more severe liver scarring and higher inflammation. This study did not involve multiple sclerosis.

39715470.conclusion_quote: We could distinguish between 2 outcomes of VV changes in ADEM: one in which the VV expanded but ultimately returned to normal and one in which the expansions continued after disease onset and treatment but failed to resolve.
39715470.summary: In 61 children with ADEM, brain scans showed ventricle enlargement that either resolved or persisted, with persistent cases showing greater loss of deep brain gray matter.

39522841.conclusion_quote: This study found that Cornus officinalis can improve the brain injury, motor ability and blood flow velocity of MCAO/R rats and suppress the inflammatory reaction through the AGE/RAGE/NFκB pathway to exert the therapeutic effect on ischemic stroke.
39522841.summary: In rats with an artery-blocking stroke model, the herb Cornus officinalis reduced brain injury and inflammation, improving movement and blood flow, through the AGE/RAGE/NFκB pathway.

39929343.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease changes only
39929343.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate significant changes in sensory and motor neuron populations post-demyelination, potentially contributing to dysfunction in peripheral demyelinating diseases.
39929343.summary: In rats with nerve demyelination caused by lysolecithin injection, sensory and motor neuron numbers dropped early and mostly recovered by day 28.

40066863.conclusion_quote: Identifying the risks and reducing the likelihood of exposure through preventive measures and regulations can result in financial savings and improve the quality of life for MS patients.
40066863.summary: In mice with a cuprizone-induced MS model, inhaled ambient air PM2.5 pollution increased inflammation, impaired movement, and caused demyelination compared with controls.

39821844.mechanism: Biotin bound to magnesium reduces inflammation and supports remyelination
39821844.conclusion_quote: The current data emphasize the dose-dependent beneficial effect on the remyelination process.
39821844.summary: In rats with chemically induced brain demyelination, higher doses of MgB, magnesium bound to biotin, promoted remyelination, reduced inflammation, and improved memory more than biotin alone.

39581526.mechanism: MAZ transcriptionally activates SOX2, supporting OPC survival and differentiatio
39581526.conclusion_quote: Our findings introduced MAZ as a beneficial modulator of OPC survival and differentiation, and it could serve as a potential therapeutic target for demyelination diseases.
39581526.summary: In cuprizone-fed mice with demyelination, lowering MAZ in oligodendrocyte precursor cells increased their death and blocked their maturation, while higher MAZ protected them.

41268795.mechanism: Transplanted cells rebuild myelin and reduce CSPG levels
41268795.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that the pre-activation environment, determined by the source model, differentially affects the regenerative potential of transplanted OPCs.
41268795.summary: In mice with LPS-induced demyelination, oligodendrocyte precursor cells from LPS-exposed donors migrated better and restored more myelin than cells from cuprizone-exposed donors.

40344978.mechanism: Binds TRAF6, blocking K63 ubiquitination and NF-κB signaling
40344978.conclusion_quote: Collectively, it is concluded that Rb3 alleviates demyelination and inhibits inflammation through bound to TRAF6 to prevent its K63-linked ubiquitination and subsequent activation of NF-κB.
40344978.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, ginsenoside Rb3 reduced demyelination and brain inflammation by binding a signaling protein called TRAF6 and blocking its activation.

39257292.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that C1QL1 may initiate a previously unrecognized signaling pathway to promote differentiation of OPCs into oligodendrocytes.
39257292.summary: In mice given cuprizone to strip myelin, boosting C1QL1 in progenitor cells increased new cells that make myelin, while removing it reduced them.

39422297.conclusion_quote: Although capable of driving OL differentiation, clemastine treatment in rabbits hampered progenitor pool replenishment, induced senescence, and promoted conversion of microglia/macrophages to a proinflammatory phenotype.
39422297.summary: In rabbits with demyelinated lesions, clemastine pushed progenitor cells to become myelin producing cells but depleted the progenitor pool and caused cell aging.

39441987.conclusion_quote: Our results show that both cortical and dopaminergic organoids cultured in LEO had lower levels of genes associated with cell proliferation and higher levels of maturation-associated genes, suggesting that the cells matured more quickly in LEO.
39441987.summary: Human brain organoids made from cells of people with progressive MS or Parkinson's grew on the International Space Station, where their cells matured faster than on Earth.

39595111.conclusion_quote: Our data illustrate early alterations of the EAAT5 glutamate transporter in the early pre-clinical phase of EAE/MS and suggest an involvement of EAAT5 in the previously observed early synaptic changes at photoreceptor synapses.
39595111.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the glutamate transporter EAAT5 was reduced at light sensing retina synapses early in disease, before symptoms appeared.

38880527.mechanism: Not applicable: no treatment or genetic change tested
38880527.conclusion_quote: For all these reasons, the EAE model plays a key role in improving the understanding of MS.
38880527.summary: This review describes experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, an animal model of multiple sclerosis, and explains how it is induced and used to study the disease.

39795896.mechanism: Food-derived peptides reduce inflammation and oxidative stress
39795896.conclusion_quote: For the first time, we demonstrated that prophylactic administration of LPH reduces the severity of MS, suggesting a potential nutraceutical or new functional foods in neuroinflammation.
39795896.summary: In female mice with EAE, a lupin protein hydrolysate given from the start of the study lessened disease severity, but giving it after symptoms began did not help.

38542433.mechanism: Depletes platelets, reducing viral antigen cells and shifting antibody responses
38542433.conclusion_quote: Thus, platelets may play roles in TMEV infection, such as gene expression, viral clearance, and anti-viral antibody isotype responses.
38542433.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a model of multiple sclerosis, removing platelets with antibodies reduced viral presence and somewhat lessened brain and heart disease.

39402114.mechanism: No treatment tested, disease progression described
39402114.conclusion_quote: Early inflammatory demyelination and functional deficits of the visual pathway, if untreated, may lead to severe irrecoverable axon damage in EAE.
39402114.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers tracked visual pathway changes across early, peak and late disease, finding early demyelination and inflammation before later nerve thinning and functional deficits.

39199407.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate a sex difference in the response of the HPA axis at the adrenal level, with male rats showing a more pronounced induction during EAE.
39199407.summary: In male and female Dark Agouti rats with EAE, stress hormone signaling changed, and males showed stronger activation of the adrenal glands than females.

39696356.mechanism: reduces immune infiltration and glial reactivity
39696356.conclusion_quote: PBMT may therefore represent a new valuable therapeutic option to treat MS symptoms.
39696356.summary: Daily infrared light therapy applied across the back reduced inflammation and improved movement and sensation problems in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

39487537.mechanism: BCL2-family inhibitor clears senescent microglia and macrophages
39487537.conclusion_quote: Depleting microglia and macrophages using a senolytic results in robust improvement in EAE disease severity, including across measures of neurodegeneration, inflammation, and demyelination, and may therefore represent a novel strategy to address disease progression in multiple sclerosis.
39487537.summary: In mice with EAE, a senolytic drug called Navitoclax removed senescent microglia and macrophages, reducing motor symptoms, improving vision, and lessening inflammation.

39260333.mechanism: inhibits microglial ferroptosis and reduces inflammation
39260333.conclusion_quote: Together, our results indicate that ferroptosis/inflammation plays an important role in the pathogenesis of CNS autoimmunity, and inhibiting ferroptosis-induced microglial activation/inflammation could be a novel mechanism underlying the therapeutic effects of MAT on CNS inflammatory demyelination in EAE.
39260333.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, matrine treatment reduced disease severity and demyelination by limiting microglial ferroptosis and inflammation in the central nervous system.

38307349.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that this model recapitulates lymph follicle formation, a disease hallmark of progressive MS, and fibrosis, a feature complicating the pathogenesis of MS in the chronic phase.
38307349.summary: In mice with NOD-EAE, a progressive MS model, researchers found fibrosis and lymph follicle formation in the chronic phase, similar to human progressive MS.

37952208.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes Mott cell immunoglobulin inclusions
37952208.conclusion_quote: The presence of Russell bodies implies an excessive production of immunoglobulins in EAE, thus further emphasizing the role of B cells, and among them Mott cells, in the pathogenesis of this animal model of multiple sclerosis.
37952208.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, researchers found Mott cells, plasma cells packed with immunoglobulin inclusions, in lymph nodes, suggesting B cells contribute to disease.

39423660.mechanism: Inhibits dendritic cell maturation and CCR7-mediated migration
39423660.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings suggest that application of exogenous sPD-L1 has a marked suppressive effect on the maturation and migration of DCs in EAE.
39423660.summary: In mice with EAE, a soluble PD-L1 protein treatment eased clinical symptoms and calmed immune dendritic cells that drive inflammation.

37890574.mechanism: Reduces inflammation, microglia numbers and dysmyelination
37890574.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal that metformin administration can improve EAE outcomes when administered before symptom onset in both sexes.
37890574.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, metformin given before symptoms began improved functional outcomes and reduced inflammation and myelin damage, but later treatment did not help.

39009690.conclusion_quote: Our study highlights the need to consider microbial community networks and host-specific bidirectional interactions when aiming to predict severity of neuroinflammation.
39009690.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, gut bacteria levels alone did not predict disease severity, but IgA antibody coating of certain bacteria before onset did.

39444001.conclusion_quote: Our study highlights an early and persistent impairment of spinal CSF flow and suggests it as a sensitive imaging biomarker for pathological changes within the leptomeninges.
39444001.summary: Researchers imaged spinal fluid flow in an animal model of MS called EAE and found it was impaired before immune cells entered, suggesting an early marker.

37984728.mechanism: Inhibits macrophage inflammation, blocking T cell activation
37984728.conclusion_quote: In all, we found that LLDT-8 could be a potential treatment for MS.
37984728.summary: In mice with EAE, a Chinese medicine extract called LLDT-8 eased symptoms by calming macrophages, which reduced harmful T cell activation and growth.

38973276.mechanism: Treadmill running raises serum sex hormone levels
38973276.conclusion_quote: Aerobic exercise could improve the level of sex hormones in the cuprizone rat model of MS and may be used to attenuate sexual dysfunction in patients with MS.
38973276.summary: In rats with cuprizone-induced MS, treadmill exercise before or during disease raised testosterone, FSH and LH levels that the disease had lowered.

39191254.conclusion_quote: Thus, iPSC-derived MS models provide a unique platform for dissecting glial contributions to disease phenotypes independent of the peripheral immune system and identify potential glia-specific targets for therapeutic intervention.
39191254.summary: Researchers grew human stem cell models from people with MS and found their glial cells had fewer oligodendrocytes and more immune gene activity.

39241524.mechanism: Removing S100A4 reduces microglial inflammation via TLR4 and NF-κB signaling
39241524.conclusion_quote: Thus, S100A4 may participate in the regulation of neuroinflammation at least partly through regulating the inflammation of microglia.
39241524.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the S100A4 gene reduced spinal cord inflammation, demyelination, and symptom severity.

39500329.mechanism: Host metabolite reshapes gut microbiota, reducing Th17 activation
39500329.conclusion_quote: Thus, diet alters the immunomodulatory potential of the gut microbiota by shifting host metabolism, emphasizing the utility of taking a more integrative approach to study diet-host-microbiome interactions.
39500329.summary: In mice with EAE, a ketogenic diet and its host metabolite βHB protected against disease by reshaping gut bacteria and calming harmful immune activity.

38742374.mechanism: Antagonizes TLR4 to reduce inflammation and aid remyelination
38742374.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal a new therapeutic approach for the treatment of inflammatory and demyelinating diseases such as MS.
38742374.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, the TLR4-blocking aptamer ApTOLL reduced symptoms and helped preserve and restore myelin and oligodendrocytes.

38765015.mechanism: Induces regulatory T cells and anti-inflammatory cytokines
38765015.conclusion_quote: We provide evidence that DMF induces a gradual anti-inflammatory response in the gut draining lymph nodes, which might contribute to the reduction of both intestinal discomfort and the inflammatory response of EAE.
38765015.summary: In mice with EAE, dimethyl fumarate reduced disease severity and gradually increased regulatory T cells and calming signals in lymph nodes that drain the gut.

39040539.mechanism: Boosts myelin basic protein transcription and remyelination
39040539.conclusion_quote: These findings collectively suggest a crucial role for IL-22 in the pathophysiology of MS, particularly in supporting the process of remyelination.
39040539.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, IL-22 treatment improved motor performance and promoted myelin repair in the corpus callosum.

38450807.conclusion_quote: The results obtained provide a clinically relevant experimental platform that may be pivotal for the elucidation of the key mechanisms of accumulation of irreversible disability, as well as the development of innovative therapies for MS.
38450807.summary: In an EAE model of MS, resting-state brain MRI tracked connectivity changes over time, showing early increases and later reductions in cerebellar connections.

38849434.conclusion_quote: This study overall provides evidence of Th17 cell reprogramming of astrocytes, which may drive changes in the astrocytic responsiveness to cytokines during autoimmune neuroinflammation.
38849434.summary: In mice with EAE, immune cells called Th17 cells were found to reprogram nearby brain support cells called astrocytes, changing their inflammatory signals and receptors.

39164165.mechanism: Copper-modulating compound restores cuproenzyme function in CNS
39164165.conclusion_quote: These findings support targeting copper perturbations as a therapeutic strategy for MS with Cu II (atsm) showing initial promise.
39164165.summary: In mice with EAE and in human MS spinal cord tissue, a copper-modulating compound restored copper enzyme function, improved myelination, and protected nerves.

38876197.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
38876197.conclusion_quote: Our study confirms that this automated video tracking system can reliably track the progression of TMEV-IDD for 9 months.
38876197.summary: In two mouse strains infected with TMEV, a video tracking system tracked movement, gait and behavior for nine months, showing SJL mice declined earlier and more severely than SWR mice.

38892024.conclusion_quote: We found elevated serum GH levels in association with low IGF-1 concentration and downregulated Ghr and Igf1r expression in the liver, indicating a condition resembling GH resistance.
38892024.summary: In female rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, blood growth hormone rose while IGF-1 fell, suggesting growth hormone resistance at the disease peak.

39684720.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes cuprizone demyelination and recovery
39684720.conclusion_quote: Significant changes in the CC structure and the number of APLNR and NG2-positive cells were observed during de- and remyelination, suggesting that NG2-positive cells expressing APLNR may play a key role in remyelination.
39684720.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that strips myelin, the brain's corpus callosum shrank and APLNR and NG2 cell counts shifted, then recovered after the toxin was stopped.

38834505.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings suggest that the increased OPN level in lungs of EAE mice led to inflammation; concurrent increases in proinflammatory factors (OPN and galectin-3) caused pulmonary impairment.
38834505.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, lungs showed inflammation and collagen buildup, linked to higher osteopontin and galectin-3 levels.

38732169.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that the protective effect of LDV infection against EAE development is mediated by a suppression of myelin antigen presentation by a specific DC subset to autoreactive T lymphocytes.
38732169.summary: In mice with EAE, a virus infection called LDV protected against paralysis by blocking dendritic cells from presenting myelin protein to attacking T cells.

38566526.mechanism: Absence reduces immune cell infiltration into spinal cord
38566526.conclusion_quote: In summary, JAM-A plays a role in immune cell infiltration and clinical disease progression in aEAE.
38566526.summary: Mice lacking the JAM-A gene had milder experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, an MS model, with fewer immune cells entering the spinal cord.

38877291.mechanism: Knocks down cytotoxicity-associated network genes in myeloid cells
38877291.conclusion_quote: This research implicates a cytotoxicity-associated gene network in myeloid cells in the pathogenesis of MS.
38877291.summary: Researchers found a gene network tied to cell cytotoxicity was lower in monocytes of people with MS. Knocking down these genes changed disease in mice with EAE.

38215654.mechanism: Suppresses immune cell infiltration and inflammatory mediators
38215654.conclusion_quote: Eugenol alleviates neuroinflammation in the spinal cords of EAE-induced mice, primarily through anti-inflammatory action.
38215654.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, daily oral eugenol from clove oil reduced paralysis and spinal cord inflammation and demyelination.

38841204.mechanism: Modulates PKC activity, calming innate immune cell inflammation
38841204.conclusion_quote: This study identifies a new structural class of PKC modulators, which can therapeutically target CNS innate immunity as a strategy to treat neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative disorders.
38841204.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the PKC modulator TPPB reduced brain inflammation and supported nerve tissue regeneration and repair.

38302802.mechanism: Shifts T-cell cytokines from inflammatory to anti-inflammatory profile
38302802.conclusion_quote: These findings showed that Thymoquinone could decrease both disease incidence and severity.
38302802.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, thymoquinone given alongside disease induction prevented symptoms and reduced inflammatory immune signals and leukocyte infiltration in the spinal cord.

38314770.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes immune cell roles
38314770.conclusion_quote: However, both Th1 and Th17 cells contribute to the relapse stage, and the immunosuppressive function of regulatory T (Treg) cells was inhibited during the EAE pathological process.
38314770.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers mapped which CD4 T cell types drive first attacks and relapses, finding Th1 and Th17 cells involved in relapse.

38249123.mechanism: suppresses key inflammatory gene expression and reduces microglial activation
38249123.conclusion_quote: Together, these results suggest that the ameliorative effect of eugenol against EAE uveitis is associated with the suppression of key proinflammatory genes, which may represent targets for the treatment of uveitis.
38249123.summary: In mice with EAE, eugenol reduced eye and spinal cord inflammation and microglial activity, improved hindlimb paralysis, and lowered key inflammatory genes.

39093706.conclusion_quote: Here, we present a detailed protocol for the induction of cuprizone demyelinated mice to assess the cognitive function and explore the precise mechanisms underlying cognitive deficits in demyelinated hippocampus.
39093706.summary: In mice given cuprizone to induce demyelination, this protocol describes how to test memory and learning and examine how brain cell birth in the hippocampus is affected.

38767415.mechanism: Thymic SKI loss dampens T cell responses
38767415.conclusion_quote: Overall, our findings suggest that SKI signaling in the thymus regulates mTEC differentiation and function as well as downstream peripheral T cell responses and provide evidence for targeting SKI in T cell-driven autoimmune diseases such as multiple sclerosis.
38767415.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, deleting the SKI gene in the thymus weakened T cell responses and protected the mice from developing disease.

37931715.mechanism: Low RelB expression makes dendritic cells tolerogenic
37931715.conclusion_quote: RelB plays a key role in the antigen presenting function of DCs, and tDCs with low RelB expression is a potential treatment for EAE and MS.
37931715.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, received dendritic immune cells with lowered RelB, which reduced symptoms, immune cell infiltration and demyelination.

38619745.conclusion_quote: Thus, the presence of specialized astroglia and intrinsic differences in adenosinergic signaling may play a critical role in the differential regional susceptibility to EAE inflammation.
38619745.summary: Researchers compared enzymes and receptors that handle adenosine in brain regions of mice with EAE, finding that the cerebellum responded differently from the brainstem to inflammation.

38822334.mechanism: induces tolerogenic splenic myeloid cells that expand Tregs
38822334.conclusion_quote: These results reveal a novel cellular and molecular mechanism whereby IFN-γ promotes beneficial effects in EAE by endowing splenic CD11b + myeloid cells with tolerogenic and therapeutic activities.
38822334.summary: In mice with EAE, IFN-γ treatment increased spleen immune cells that calm inflammation, and moving these cells into untreated mice eased symptoms and reduced brain and spinal cord immune cell infiltration.

39720700.mechanism: Aptamers bind neuronal cell surfaces and trigger biological responses
39720700.conclusion_quote: This demonstrates a proof-of-concept workflow to identify biologically active aptamers by cycles of cell selection.
39720700.summary: Researchers selected DNA aptamers that bind and affect human neuroblastoma and stem-cell-derived neurons, but the study does not test disease in MS models.

39682726.mechanism: antiviral that blocks herpes virus replication
39682726.conclusion_quote: Collectively, this study provides tissue-specific insights into the molecular effects of inflammation in AD and T1D.
39682726.summary: Human brain organoids and stem-cell pancreatic islets were infected with herpes virus and treated with acyclovir. The virus changed gene activity linked to Alzheimer's and autoimmune diseases, and acyclovir corrected these changes only partly.

38233686.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results suggest that transcriptomic analysis of the olfactory bulb of EAE mice can provide insight into olfactory dysfunction and reveal therapeutic targets for olfactory impairment.
38233686.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers analyzed gene activity in the olfactory bulb and found changed immune and nerve related genes linked to smell loss.

38100739.conclusion_quote: Distinct differences in expression profiles suggest that mELT rather than SLOs is a key driver of CNS inflammation in spontaneous EAE.
38100739.summary: Researchers used single-cell RNA sequencing on immune cells from meningeal lymphoid tissue versus lymph nodes in mice with spontaneous chronic EAE, finding meningeal tissue more inflammatory.

38215583.mechanism: improves myelin proteins and reduces axonal injury
38215583.conclusion_quote: Treadmill training improved myelin sheath structural proteins and axonal injury in cerebellar tissue in a rat model of CPZ-induced toxic demyelination.
38215583.summary: In rats fed cuprizone to induce demyelination, treadmill exercise before and during the toxin raised myelin proteins and reduced cerebellar axonal injury.

38232539.mechanism: Silencing reduces M1 microglia polarization via STAT1 and NF-kB
38232539.conclusion_quote: In summary, our findings suggest that IFIT3 selectively intensified microglia polarization towards the pro-inflammatory M1 phenotype, and may contribute to the progression of MS.
38232539.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, turning off the IFIT3 gene reduced harmful inflammation, demyelination, and disease worsening by calming the brain's immune cells called microglia.

39139401.conclusion_quote: Overall, our study shows that olfactory dysfunction and altered social and cognitive behavior in EAE are associated with increased adenosine signaling via A 1 R, A 2B R, and A 3 R.
39139401.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, smell function and social behavior were impaired, alongside brain inflammation and increased adenosine signaling in the olfactory bulb.

38819698.mechanism: Blocks ACKR3, reducing inflammation and speeding myelin repair
38819698.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that ACKR3 antagonism significantly reduces the severity of experimental demyelinating diseases, even when treatment is initiated therapeutically, after the occurrence of lesions.
38819698.summary: In animal models of MS, a drug blocking the ACKR3 receptor reduced disease severity and speeded myelin repair when given after lesions had already formed.

38838376.mechanism: Lowers RORγt promoter activity, reducing Th17 cell differentiation
38838376.conclusion_quote: Hed regulates Th17 differentiation by reducing RORγt promoter activity, which reduces nerve injury and alleviates EAE.
38838376.summary: In mice with EAE, a compound called hederagenol reduced Th17 immune cells and nerve damage by lowering RORγt activity, easing disease severity.

39352675.conclusion_quote: The obtained results suggest a possible role of CSF-1 in the pathogenesis and progression of EAE/multiple sclerosis.
39352675.summary: In mice with acute and chronic EAE, researchers measured CSF-1 and IL-34 levels and found CSF-1 increased in the spinal cord, with high CSF-1 in motoneurons.

38804500.conclusion_quote: Our data showed that the myelin degeneration in CC occurs throughout the lifespan, and LTD induced by CPZ accelerates the aging process which may explain the impairment of myelin repair in patients with progressive MS.
38804500.summary: In mice fed a cuprizone diet, myelin loss in the brain's corpus callosum grew with age, and the diet-induced demyelination mimicked and sped up aging changes.

39034395.conclusion_quote: We here report that the double-site LPC injections treatment evoke a complex MS-like mice model.
39034395.summary: Researchers injected lysolecithin into the corpus callosum and cerebellum of mice, creating a model with demyelination and motor, urinary, cardiac and breathing problems resembling multiple sclerosis.

38364057.summary: This erratum only adds an author affiliation to a study of mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, and tests no treatment.

38824594.mechanism: Not applicable: no treatment or genetic change tested
38824594.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings suggest that the tissue environment, rather than pathogenesis or antigen specificity, is the primary determinant of the tissue-specific properties of Tregs.
38824594.summary: In mice with EAE and stroke, brain and spinal cord regulatory T cells differed mainly because of their tissue environment rather than disease type or antigen targeting.

38363046.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
38363046.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our data indicate that the myelin repair process following transient demyelination does not allow the complete recovery of the initial myelin properties in cortical structures.
38363046.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause transient demyelination, myelin repair was incomplete, leaving lasting memory deficits, hyperactivity, and disrupted brain network timing.

37866699.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease process only
37866699.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate a modified T cell development in EAE/MS, providing valuable insights into the potential of modulating thymic function as a targeted therapeutic approach to MS/EAE.
37866699.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found that T cell development in the thymus is altered, with more regulatory T cells and disrupted early maturation steps.

39737164.mechanism: Boosts regulatory T cells, dampens T cell priming
39737164.conclusion_quote: Pd lysate prevents severe forms of EAE by triggering a T regulatory response and modulating T cell priming to autoantigens.
39737164.summary: In mice with EAE, a lysate of the gut bacterium Parabacteroides distasonis given before disease onset delayed and reduced severity by boosting regulatory T cells.

38544672.conclusion_quote: Chronic demyelination induced by CPZ intoxication, maybe through damage to the hypothalamus arcuate nucleus, leads to the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis disturbance and damage to the testis and spermatogenesis subsequently.
38544672.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, long-term myelin loss was linked to lower testosterone, reduced sperm quality, and testis damage.

38852766.mechanism: not applicable, descriptive model study only
38852766.conclusion_quote: The result showed an unexpected early death of mature OLs and response of OL progenitor cells (OPCs) in vivo upon CPZ challenge, and a prolonged upregulation of myelin-forming OLs compared to the intact control even 4 weeks after CPZ withdrawal.
38852766.summary: In animals given the toxin cuprizone, researchers tracked how myelin producing cells die, respond, and recover during demyelination and recovery over several weeks.

39576623.mechanism: Not a treatment, describes cuprizone-induced demyelination model
39576623.conclusion_quote: These data reveal that interpreting VEP latency solely as a marker for ON demyelination is incomplete.
39576623.summary: In mice fed the cuprizone diet to cause demyelination, visual evoked potential delays reflected myelin loss beyond the optic nerve, including brain visual areas.

38607051.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes glial protein expression during disease
38607051.conclusion_quote: These results strongly suggest that gal-3 regulates NLRP3 signaling in microglia/macrophages and neuroinflammatory demyelination in ON.
38607051.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found galectin 3 rises in glial cells of the visual pathway during peak disease and may drive inflammation linked to optic neuritis.

38247842.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or gene change tested
38247842.conclusion_quote: Together, chronic inflammation induced by CFA/PTx treatment and EAE immunization has lasting effects on circadian rhythms in peripheral immune cells.
38247842.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, T cell internal clocks were disrupted by chronic inflammation, while daily behavior rhythms stayed intact.

37927164.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we demonstrate that the application of the cuprizone model in aged mice mimics the impaired regeneration ability seen in human pathogenesis more accurately than commonly used protocols with young mice and therefore provides an urgently needed animal model for the investigation of remyelination failure and remyelination-enhancing therapies.
37927164.summary: In aged mice given the cuprizone model of demyelination, gray matter in the hippocampus and cortex recovered only partially after myelin loss, with synapse and microglia changes persisting.

39287045.mechanism: Shifts gut microbiota, raises butyrate, reduces Th17 cells
39287045.conclusion_quote: These results confirmed that the attenuation of inulin on Th17 cells and inflammatory demyelination in EAE mice was dependent on its modulation on gut microbiota and metabolites.
39287045.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the prebiotic fiber inulin reduced inflammation and nerve damage by changing gut bacteria and raising butyrate levels.

41383442.conclusion_quote: The degree of pathogenicity of Tc17 cells in EAE is lower than that of Th17 cells.
41383442.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, immune cells called Tc17 caused milder disease than Th17 cells when transferred to other mice.

38743490.mechanism: Loss of FBLN2 restores oligodendrocyte maturation and remyelination
38743490.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings implicate FBLN2 as a hitherto unrecognized injury-elevated ECM, and a therapeutic target, that impairs oligodendrocyte maturation and myelin repair.
38743490.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting FBLN2 genetically or only in astrocytes improved oligodendrocyte numbers, functional recovery, and new myelin formation.

39400556.conclusion_quote: These results all suggest the need for multiple metrics and further studies at early and late time points of demyelination.
39400556.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that damages myelin, researchers used high field MRI scans to track early and late white matter damage and found different scan measures track damage differently.

39215106.mechanism: Immunomodulation plus cardiomyocyte protection and enhanced angiogenesis
39215106.conclusion_quote: Overall, these findings highlight the potential repurposing of GA as a future therapy for a myriad of heart diseases.
39215106.summary: In mice and rats with heart attack or ischemic heart failure, short-term treatment with glatiramer acetate, an MS drug, improved heart function and reduced scarring.

39707547.mechanism: selectively activates retinoid X receptor to promote myelin repair
39707547.conclusion_quote: These results inform the discovery of restorative neural therapeutics for MS by demonstrating that selective RXR agonism is sufficient for effective myelin repair.
39707547.summary: In mice with EAE, the selective RXR activator IRX4204 improved walking gait, increased myelin repair and axon survival, and reduced spinal cord inflammation.

39185426.mechanism: galactose-induced AGEs increase oligodendrocyte and neuron death
39185426.conclusion_quote: These results imply that galactose-induced oligodendrocyte and myelin damage during neuroinflammation may be mediated by AGEs, thereby identifying galactose and its reactive products as potential dietary risk factors for neuroinflammatory diseases such as MS.
39185426.summary: In mice with EAE, a galactose-rich diet worsened symptoms and myelin loss, likely through harmful advanced glycation end products that killed nerve and oligodendrocyte cells.

39273423.mechanism: activates ERK1/2 signaling pathway to reduce cell death
39273423.conclusion_quote: The findings of this study suggest that EPO treatment reduces cellular death in EAE-induced rats by regulating the ERK pathway.
39273423.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of paralysis-causing demyelination, erythropoietin treatment reduced cell death in the spinal cord and optic nerve by activating the ERK pathway.

38937968.mechanism: Removes lysosomal enzyme, causing myelin debris buildup and worse demyelination
38937968.conclusion_quote: We conclude that Galc expression in adult oligodendrocytes is crucial for the maintenance of adult central myelin and to decrease vulnerability to additional demyelinating insults.
38937968.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the GALC enzyme from adult oligodendrocytes worsened inflammation and myelin damage, leading to lethal disease.

38369641.conclusion_quote: Our results unveil a new noncanonical role of complement in the CNS of EAE mice relevant to disease progression and central synaptopathy that suggests new therapeutic targets for the management of MS.
38369641.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, complement proteins were found to alter glutamate release from nerve endings and astrocytes, supporting synaptic impairment in the brain cortex.

39682762.mechanism: removes GABA B receptors from precursor cells
39682762.conclusion_quote: The genetic downregulation of OPC-GABA B receptors protects against demyelination and oligodendrocyte loss.
39682762.summary: In mice with cuprizone or lysolecithin demyelination, deleting GABA B receptors from spinal oligodendrocyte precursor cells protected against myelin loss and cell death.

38823456.mechanism: Inhibits dendritic cell activation via STAT4 targeting
38823456.conclusion_quote: The experimental results suggest that the cellular basis for QU's function is to inhibit the activation of DCs while modulating the Th17 cell differentiation in the co-culture system.
38823456.summary: In mice with EAE, quercetin reduced inflammation and protected nerves by blocking dendritic cell activation through the STAT4 pathway.

39229522.mechanism: reduces IL-17 and calcium signaling, blocks Th17 cell differentiation
39229522.conclusion_quote: Thus, these results demonstrate that FSK may have the potential to treat MS clinically.
39229522.summary: Forskolin, a plant compound, reduced inflammation and iron imbalance and slowed disease progression in mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis.

38885894.mechanism: Blocks JAK2/STAT3, cutting Th17 cells and restoring autophagy
38885894.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate the potential of AG490 as a candidate anti-MS therapeutic.
38885894.summary: In mice with EAE, the JAK2/STAT3 inhibitor AG490 reduced disease severity by lowering Th17 immune cell formation and restoring autophagy, a cell cleanup process.

39578444.mechanism: inhibits BTK kinase in B cells and microglia
39578444.conclusion_quote: Our data provide rationale for targeting BTK in the CNS to diminish neuroinflammation and disability accumulation.
39578444.summary: In mouse models of MS and in human stem-cell-derived brain cells, a brain-penetrating BTK inhibitor reduced inflammation-related changes, supporting BTK as a possible MS target.

39273069.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes microRNA changes only
39273069.conclusion_quote: Further studies are needed to reveal their impact on EAE and possible applications as drug targets and biomarkers.
39273069.summary: Researchers measured microRNA levels in mice with EAE, a model of MS, finding miR-223 raised in the acute phase and miR-146a and miR-193a lower in the chronic phase.

38701782.mechanism: Inhibits epigenetic silencing, triggering SREBP condensation and lipid synthesis
38701782.conclusion_quote: Our study highlights the potential of targeting epigenetic silencing to enable CNS myelin regeneration in demyelinating diseases and aging.
38701782.summary: In mice with demyelination and in human brain organoids, a small molecule that reverses epigenetic silencing boosted myelin production and repair.

38443998.mechanism: Parasite infection raises eosinophils and IFN gamma, worsening symptoms
38443998.conclusion_quote: Our research indicates that the combination of increased eosinophil numbers and production of IFN- γ tends to worsen the EAE symptoms.
38443998.summary: In mice with EAE, infection with the parasite T. regenti tended to worsen symptoms and increased eosinophils and inflammatory IFN gamma without improving tissue repair.

36576232.conclusion_quote: The underlying mechanism by which NaCl causes these effects could involve the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS), which is blocked by high doses of salt.
36576232.summary: In rats with EAE, a daily salt supplement improved clinical scores and reduced oxidative stress, inflammation, and gut dysbiosis.

39383730.mechanism: Upregulates ETS1, inhibiting endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition and protectin
39383730.conclusion_quote: Collectively, APS treatment could protect BBB integrity by inhibiting EndoMT, which might be associated with upregulating ETS1 expression.
39383730.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, Astragalus polysaccharides reduced blood brain barrier leakage by boosting ETS1 and blocking harmful endothelial changes.

38246987.mechanism: Blocks miR-615-5p so MYRF can promote oligodendrocyte maturation
38246987.conclusion_quote: This study identifies miR-615-5p/MYRF as a new target for the therapy of demyelinating diseases.
38246987.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone diet induced demyelination, a viral vector blocking a microRNA in microglia reduced disease and promoted myelin repair.

38491084.mechanism: suppresses autoimmune inflammation with regulatory T cells
38491084.conclusion_quote: The results of this preclinical study further support the therapeutic potential of this ACT approach in the treatment of MS.
38491084.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, cell therapy using antigen-specific regulatory T cells reduced disease severity, spinal cord inflammation, and demyelination.

38976012.mechanism: Raises tryptophan-derived AhR ligands, reducing astrocyte activation
38976012.conclusion_quote: Together, SCFAs potentially suppresses astrocyte activation by amplifying Trp-AhR-AQP4 signaling in EAE mice.
38976012.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, adding short-chain fatty acids made from gut bacteria calmed overactive astrocytes and improved symptoms through the AhR pathway.

38323310.mechanism: Mid1 loss reduces T-cell migration via mTOR/microtubule pathway
38323310.conclusion_quote: Our data suggests that Mid1 regulates effector T cell migration to the central nervous system via mTOR/microtubule pathway in EAE, and thus may serve as a potential therapeutic target for the treatment of MS.
38323310.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Mid1 gene from T cells reduced their migration into the spinal cord and lessened disease symptoms.

38894951.mechanism: inhibits histone deacetylases and boosts antioxidant response
