38894951.conclusion_quote: We found that recovery of damaged neurites is induced by propionic acid and butyric acid.
38894951.summary: In neurons made from stem cells of people with MS, propionic acid and butyric acid helped damaged nerve fibers recover.

39002520.mechanism: Degrades BRD4, suppressing PI3K/AKT, MAPK/ERK and NF-kB pathways
39002520.conclusion_quote: In summary, our data strongly suggests that dBET1 is a promising treatment option for MS.
39002520.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug called dBET1 that breaks down the BRD4 protein reduced demyelination, inflammation and blood-brain barrier damage, and improved symptoms.

38508497.conclusion_quote: These data support CFA-free EAE in DA rats as a useful model for multiple sclerosis research.
38508497.summary: In rats with EAE induced by spinal cord homogenate without adjuvant, immune cells infiltrated several brain regions and the rats showed increased anxiety-like behavior.

38928437.mechanism: Antibody blocks IL-6 signaling, reducing inflammatory cytokine activity
38928437.conclusion_quote: The blockade of IL-6 signaling did not improve the clinical course of EAE in an aging context.
38928437.summary: In aged mice with EAE, an anti-IL-6 antibody did not improve disease course but increased immunosuppressive immune cell responses in the blood.

38433209.conclusion_quote: iPericytes express pericyte-associated genes and proteins and, exhibit an appropriate physiological response upon exposure to a key endogenous mitogen or vasoactive mediators.
38433209.summary: Human stem cell derived pericytes, blood vessel support cells, were found to respond to growth and blood vessel signals much like native human pericytes, but the study did not test MS.

38927422.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes brain signaling only
38927422.conclusion_quote: In comparing canonical pathways from our mouse mild EAE brains with a human MS atlas, EAE shared the most pathways with active and inactive lesions.
38927422.summary: In mice with mild EAE induced without pertussis toxin, brain gene analysis showed signaling pathways similar to active and inactive lesions in human MS.

interventions: inducible knockout of the IL-7Rα gene in CD4 + T cells
39380064.mechanism: Loss of IL-7Rα cuts CD4 T-cell numbers and activity
39380064.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrates that IL-7Rα on peripheral CD4 + T cells is essential for their maintenance, immune response, and EAE pathogenesis.
39380064.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the IL-7 receptor from CD4 immune cells after tamoxifen treatment reduced those cells and prevented the mice from developing disease.

37860913.mechanism: EV-delivered transferrin promotes oligodendrocyte progenitor maturation
37860913.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these findings unveil EVs as functional nanocarriers of Tf to induce remyelination.
37860913.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, nasally delivered transferrin-loaded vesicles reached the brain, helped oligodendrocyte progenitors mature, and accelerated myelin repair.

38128309.mechanism: Activates PPARγ, shifting microglia to calmer, immunoregulatory state
38128309.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our data propose SAN as a promising candidate adding to the preclinical therapeutic arsenal for regulating microglial function and promoting myelin repair in CNS demyelinating diseases such as MS.
38128309.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, the natural compound sanguinarine calmed microglia, reduced inflammation and helped myelin recover.

39278849.mechanism: Rebalances Th17 and Treg cells, reducing inflammation
39278849.conclusion_quote: Regulating the balance between Th17 and Treg may represent a therapeutic mechanism for simvastatin in treating EAE.
39278849.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, simvastatin reduced inflammation and improved neurological symptoms by rebalancing immune cells called Th17 and Treg cells.

39087931.mechanism: No treatment tested, measurement study only
39087931.conclusion_quote: Therefore we conclude that visual outcomes are well suited as a direct assessment of optic nerve involvement in this EAE model of MS while also being indicative of motor impairment.
39087931.summary: In mice with EAE, the researchers found that vision tests and retinal scans correlated with motor impairment scores, suggesting they could serve as more objective outcome measures.

38279130.mechanism: Deletes IKKβ, reducing NF-κB activity in macrophages
38279130.conclusion_quote: IKKβ-mediated activation of NF-κΒ in myeloid cells has opposing roles in EAE depending on the cell type and the disease stage.
38279130.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the IKKβ inflammation switch from brain immune cells worsened disease and nerve signaling, while removing it from peripheral immune cells reduced severity.

interventions: A selective agonist of free fatty acid receptor type 2 (Ffar2)
38238790.mechanism: Activates FFAR2 receptor, boosting gut ILC3 regulatory activity
38238790.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that different clinical outcomes in DA rats are under determinative influence of intestinal ILC3 activity during the inductive phase of EAE.
38238790.summary: In rats with EAE, an oral Ffar2 agonist given during early immunization shifted disease toward milder forms by boosting gut ILC3 regulatory cells.

38810588.mechanism: destabilizes sperm plasma and acrosomal membranes before injection
38810588.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, lysolecithin pre-treatment is not necessary when using ICSI to produce equine embryos in vitro.
38810588.summary: In horses, researchers tested treating sperm with lysolecithin before egg injection, and found the treatment was not needed to produce equine embryos.

38634287.mechanism: miRNAs block TGF-β signaling, reducing regulatory T cells
38634287.conclusion_quote: These findings demonstrate that increased levels of TGF-β-associated miRNAs impede the development of a diverse Treg population, leading to enhanced effector cell activity, and contributing to an increased susceptibility to CNS autoimmunity.
38634287.summary: Giving newborn mice extra microRNAs that suppress a key immune-calming signal made them more likely to develop experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model of MS.

38465945.conclusion_quote: Thus, it is important to complement clinical scoring with histological scoring of EAE, which also provides a means to study the underlying mechanisms of cellular injury in the central nervous system (CNS).
38465945.summary: A protocol for scoring inflammation, demyelination and axon injury in spinal cord sections of mice with EAE, a model of MS.

39374260.conclusion_quote: The cuprizone diet-induced locomotion and cognitive disorders were amplified by the mild burn injury in mice, which is associated with muscle intracellular signal alterations.
39374260.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, a mild burn worsened movement but did not reduce muscle weight or strength.

38153198.mechanism: Removing TRAF6 from T cells reduces EAE severity
38153198.conclusion_quote: Collectively, TRAF6 signaling in T cells contributes to the pathogenesis of EAE by regulating the pathogenicity and autoantigen reactivity of Th17 cells.
38153198.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting TRAF6 from T cells made the disease milder, with fewer infiltrating immune cells and less demyelination, even though more Th17 cells formed.

38128499.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes thymic and nerve changes
38128499.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our data suggest that the thymic-CNS neuroimmune bidirectional axis is compromised in EAE.
38128499.summary: In EAE, an animal model of MS, the thymus changed in structure and cell makeup, T-cell development was altered, and nerve signaling from the brain to the thymus was disrupted.

37725245.mechanism: Removes Egr-1, weakening BDNF and TGFβ1 signaling
37725245.conclusion_quote: Our results revealed that Egr-1 is a crucial regulator of neuronal survival in EAE by regulating TGFβ 1-mediated signaling activation, implicating the important role of Egr-1 in the pathogenesis of multiple sclerosis as a potential novel therapy target.
37725245.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Egr-1 gene worsened disease and nerve cell death, weakening pathways that help neurons survive.

35912879.mechanism: Reduces free radicals and raises myelin-related gene expression
35912879.conclusion_quote: ALC improved balance and motor coordination in the demyelinated mouse model.
35912879.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, acetyl-L-carnitine improved balance, gait, and myelin repair in the brain's corpus callosum.

37702910.mechanism: Blocks NLRP3 inflammasome, curbing glial activation, M1 microglia
37702910.conclusion_quote: Our work indicates that inhibition of NLRP3 inflammasome has the therapeutic effects of neuroprotection through immunomodulation and is a promising therapeutic strategy for MS.
37702910.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug MCC950 calmed brain inflammation, reducing nerve damage, loss of myelin and loss of myelin-producing cells.

39603278.mechanism: blocks neutrophil recruitment to the spinal cord
39603278.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, neutrophils represent promising candidates for both disease treatment and prognosis evaluation in MS.
39603278.summary: In mice with EAE, a CXCR2 inhibitor blocked neutrophil entry into the spinal cord, reducing white matter damage and physical disability.

39702430.mechanism: NSAID that reduces pain and inflammation
39702430.conclusion_quote: In summary, perioperative analgesia did not compromise key outcome measures such as seizure frequency, inflammation, and neurodegeneration or -regeneration in the TMEV model.
39702430.summary: In mice infected with a virus that causes seizures, the pain reliever meloxicam did not change seizures, inflammation, or nerve damage, and gave little added benefit to well-being.

38574736.conclusion_quote: In summary, monitoring synaptic injury is a biologically relevant approach that reflects a potential driver of progression.
38574736.summary: In an animal model of chronic MS and in over 800 patients, thinning of the retina's inner plexiform layer came before disability progression, suggesting it could serve as a biomarker.

38552924.conclusion_quote: Our finding of diffuse destabilizing effects of neuroinflammation on excitatory synapses across cortical neurons may have significant functional consequences since normal dendritic spine dynamics and clustering are essential for learning and memory.
38552924.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers watched brain synapses over time and found they were unstable and repeatedly changed, though mostly not lost.

39312028.mechanism: improves nutrient digestion and antioxidant status
39312028.conclusion_quote: Therefore, dietary lysolecithin could be supplemented up to 400 g /100 kg without compromising performance, nutrient retention, haemato-biochemistry, and oxidative status in finisher broiler diets.
39312028.summary: In broiler chickens, adding lysolecithin to feed improved weight gain and antioxidant levels, but no multiple sclerosis model was studied.

38183947.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease mechanism without treatment
38183947.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings elucidate cell types that may be contributing to elevated serum ATX levels in MS patients and identify potential drivers of sustained expression in encephalitogenic T cells.
38183947.summary: Researchers studied immune cells from people with MS and found autotaxin rises after activation, with IL-23 driving sustained expression through STAT3/STAT4 signaling.

39876841.conclusion_quote: In summary, our findings demonstrate that viral infection rapidly depletes neuronal progenitor cells and causes aberrant migration of the remaining ones, potentially contributing to hyperexcitability.
39876841.summary: In TMEV-infected mice with virus-induced seizures, neural progenitor cells in the hippocampus rapidly declined and migrated abnormally, while astrocyte production rose.

39100489.mechanism: Not specified, reduces epileptiform discharges and increases myelin content
39100489.conclusion_quote: Antiaris africana extract inhibits seizures induced by chronic demyelination and has beneficial effects on motor coordination.
39100489.summary: In mice with chronic demyelination caused by cuprizone, an Antiaris africana plant extract reduced seizure-like brain discharges, increased myelin, and improved motor coordination.

38226682.mechanism: Loss boosts myeloid cell inflammatory activity
38226682.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that GPR141 functions as a negative regulator of immune responses by controlling the functions of monocytes and dendritic cells and that targeting GPR141 may be a possible therapeutic intervention for modulating chronic inflammatory diseases.
38226682.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Gpr141 gene worsened disease and spinal cord inflammation, showing this receptor normally restrains immune responses.

39742273.mechanism: enhances macrophage phagocytosis and lipid droplet formation
39742273.conclusion_quote: Our findings highlight a crucial role for macrophages and microglia in enabling ABA to enhance the remyelination process.
39742273.summary: In mice with brain demyelination, the plant hormone abscisic acid boosted myelin repair, likely by helping immune cells clear debris and calming inflammation.

39325545.conclusion_quote: This work expands the EAE phenotypic repertoire and identifies potentially novel loci controlling unique EAE phenotypes, supporting the hypothesis that heterogeneity in MS disease course is driven by genetic variation.
39325545.summary: In genetically diverse mice with EAE, researchers found many disease patterns and linked genetic regions to severity and rotary symptoms, suggesting genes drive MS course differences.

38537720.mechanism: Inhibits ER stress, lowering pro-inflammatory cytokine mRNA expression
38537720.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data indicate that ER stress response in immune cells might be an important pathogenetic factor and a valid therapeutic target in the inflammatory damage of the CNS.
38537720.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, blocking endoplasmic reticulum stress with ursodeoxycholic acid reduced clinical signs and inflammatory cytokine levels.

38543019.mechanism: Not applicable: antibody phosphatase activity studied
38543019.conclusion_quote: All data show that IgG phosphatase activity could be essential in EAE pathogenesis.
38543019.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, blood antibodies with phosphatase activity rose during disease, suggesting these antibodies may contribute to disease development.

38783990.mechanism: Not applicable: imaging method tested, no treatment given
38783990.conclusion_quote: 3D IR-UTE MRI was sensitive to cuprizone-induced demyelination in the mouse brain, and is a promising noninvasive method for measuring brain myelin content.
38783990.summary: Researchers tested a special MRI scan in mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that strips myelin from nerves. The scan detected myelin loss in white matter that matched lab staining.

38899723.mechanism: Activates kappa opioid receptor, promoting oligodendrocyte maturation
38899723.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these data highlight the potential of nalfurafine as a remyelination-promoting therapeutic.
38899723.summary: In mice with cuprizone and rapamycin-induced demyelination, nalfurafine partly restored myelin-producing cells and improved motor performance during recovery.

39125778.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte proliferation via MAPK/ERK pathway
39125778.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our results demonstrate that clemastine is a potential compound for the treatment of hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy, with a clear neuroprotective effect on white matter injury by promoting oligodendrogenesis.
39125778.summary: In neonatal rats with brain injury from oxygen deprivation, six days of clemastine treatment reduced white matter loss and increased the number of oligodendrocytes.

39098102.mechanism: Not applicable, viral infection is an exposure rather than a treatment
39098102.conclusion_quote: Single cell RNA sequencing identified the emergence of a population of B cells that express genes associated with antigen presentation and costimulation, indicating that gammaherpesvirus infection drives a distinct, pro-inflammatory transcriptional program in B cells that may promote autoreactive T cell responses in MS.
39098102.summary: In mice engineered to attack myelin, infection with an EBV-like virus caused more neurological symptoms and created a distinct inflammatory B cell population.

38692426.mechanism: Downregulates RANKL-induced MAPK and NF-κB signaling in osteoclasts
38692426.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results suggest that Siponimod could serve as an alternative therapeutic agent for the treatment of osteoporosis.
38692426.summary: This study tested siponimod, an approved MS drug, in mouse bone cells and ovariectomized mice, finding it reduced bone-breaking cells and prevented bone loss.

39029934.mechanism: Loss of CBX5 impairs Integrator activity and splicing
39029934.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our observations suggested a major contribution of the Integrator complex in safeguarding against transcriptional anomalies characteristic of MS, with HP1α/CBX5 emerging as an unexpected regulator of this complex's activity.
39029934.summary: Mice without the Cbx5 gene developed worse EAE, and a subset of MS patients with low CBX5 showed defective RNA processing.

38522141.mechanism: Scavenges mitochondrial ROS and blocks NLRP3 inflammasome assembly
38522141.conclusion_quote: Thus, our results suggest that AP is a potential therapeutic combating NLRP3-driven diseases.
38522141.summary: In an animal model of MS called EAE, the vitamin C derivative ascorbyl palmitate reduced inflammation more than ascorbic acid by blocking the NLRP3 inflammasome.

37949321.conclusion_quote: We suggest that the MAPK and PI3K-Akt signaling pathways may be associated with demyelination and cognitive impairments, respectively.
37949321.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, gene analysis linked MAPK and PI3K Akt pathway changes to myelin loss and memory problems.

38787497.mechanism: raises BDNF, lowers IL-1β and TNF-α, aids remyelination
38787497.conclusion_quote: According to the findings, injecting MSCs intraventricularly versus cell-conditioned medium can be a more effective approach to improving chronic demyelination in degenerative diseases like MS.
38787497.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, injected stem cells and their conditioned medium improved myelin repair and reduced inflammation, with the whole cells working better.

38656399.mechanism: Blocks BTK, calms microglia, clears myelin debris
38656399.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight that BTK inhibition has the potential to counteract underlying chronic progression of MS.
38656399.summary: In mice with chronic EAE and toxin-induced demyelination, the drug evobrutinib calmed inflammatory microglia and helped the brain clear myelin debris and remyelinate faster.

39164311.mechanism: suppresses T cell glycolysis and effector differentiation
39164311.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that propofol may reduce tumor and infectious immunity by suppressing the T cell function and T cell-dependent immune responses while improving the pathogenesis and prognosis of chronic inflammatory diseases by suppressing inflammation.
39164311.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, propofol reduced T cell activity and improved inflammation, while also weakening immune responses against tumors and infections.

38739106.mechanism: blocks microglial CD22, promoting M1 polarization
38739106.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our study indicates that CD22 may be protective against EAE and may play a critical role in the maintenance of immune homeostasis in EAE mice.
38739106.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the CD22 protein made disease worse and pushed brain immune cells called microglia toward an inflammatory state.

39270454.mechanism: activates PPARδ receptor to reduce inflammation
39270454.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight compound 11 as a potent and promising therapeutic candidate for the treatment of acute inflammatory diseases and warrant further investigation to explore various biological roles.
39270454.summary: A new compound activating the PPARδ receptor reduced macrophage buildup and paw swelling in animal inflammation tests, but multiple sclerosis was not studied.

39537633.mechanism: Promotes oligodendrocyte differentiation, shifts microglia to pro-regenerative s
39537633.conclusion_quote: These findings support the repurposing of leucovorin and dyclonine for clinical trials targeting myelin disorders, offering potential therapeutic avenues for PBI and MS.
39537633.summary: In mice with focal brain demyelination, the drugs leucovorin and dyclonine improved myelin repair by helping oligodendrocyte precursor cells mature and clearing myelin debris.

38900149.mechanism: No treatment tested, model characterization only
38900149.conclusion_quote: These results show that PBMC humanized mice represent promising research tools for investigating MS immunopathology in a patient-specific approach.
38900149.summary: In humanized immune system mice given immune cells from people with MS, researchers observed human T cell attacks in the brain and spinal cord, mirroring some features of the disease.

39220229.mechanism: shifts microglia to M2 anti-inflammatory phenotype via ST2
39220229.conclusion_quote: IL-33 may be a novel insight useful for further developing NMOSD-targeted therapy and drug development.
39220229.summary: In mice with an NMOSD model, pretreatment with IL-33 protected neurons and shifted microglia toward a healing state via the ST2 pathway.

38401393.mechanism: Prolongs survival of transplanted stem cells in brain
38401393.conclusion_quote: We conclude that Granagard may prolong the activity of stem cell transplantation in neurological diseases.
38401393.summary: In mice with EAE, a pomegranate seed oil supplement called Granagard kept transplanted human stem cells alive in the brain for 60 days.

38142841.conclusion_quote: Data corroborate the key role of mitochondriogenesis to treatment of MS progression, and for the first time disclose the translational potential of mTOR inhibitors in PMS therapy.
38142841.summary: In mice with a progressive MS model, rapamycin and everolimus slowed disease and extended survival by boosting mitochondria, unlike dexamethasone and fingolimod.

39262855.mechanism: Loss reduces immune infiltration and microglial activation
39262855.conclusion_quote: These cumulative results suggest that CYP7B1 can regulate neuroinflammation, thus providing potential new targets for therapeutic intervention.
39262855.summary: In mice lacking the CYP7B1 gene, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis was milder, with less immune cell infiltration and reduced microglia activation.

38513664.conclusion_quote: By establishing a spatial resource of mouse and human MS neuropathology at a single-cell resolution, our study unveils the intricate cellular dynamics underlying MS.
38513664.summary: In mice with EAE and human MS spinal cords, researchers mapped individual cells in lesions and found disease associated glia appear independently of lesions and change over time.

38778296.mechanism: Reduces oxidative stress and lipid peroxidation in testis
38778296.conclusion_quote: This study proposes that CUR-n could be a therapeutic agent for decreasing the adverse effects of MS on testis.
38778296.summary: In mice fed a cuprizone diet to model multiple sclerosis, a curcumin nanomicelle diet improved testis structure, sperm quality, hormone levels and reduced oxidative stress.

38899045.mechanism: Alters gut microbiota composition, increasing Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium
38899045.conclusion_quote: The anti-depressant effects of Ven might be related to the regulation of gut microbiota in the CPZ-treated mice.
38899045.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to model demyelination, venlafaxine reduced depressive-like behaviors and shifted gut bacteria toward more Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium.

38291338.mechanism: Binds Smad3, boosting Treg induction at Foxp3 CNS1
38291338.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate an indispensable role of Dleu2-17aa in maintaining immune homeostasis and suggest therapeutic applications for this peptide in treating autoimmune diseases.
38291338.summary: In mice with EAE, a tiny peptide made from the lncRNA Dleu2 boosted regulatory T cells and eased disease when given as a supplement, while removing it worsened disease.

38754045.mechanism: Inhibits PI3Kδ, blocking AKT/mTOR signaling and T-cell proliferation
38754045.conclusion_quote: Overall, this work provides a new structural PI3Kδ inhibitor and a new vision for MS therapy.
38754045.summary: In the EAE model of MS, a new PI3Kδ inhibitor called compound 31 eased symptoms comparably to dexamethasone and reduced T-cell proliferation.

39145444.mechanism: Deleting neuronal Vgf blocks glycolysis driven neuron death
39145444.conclusion_quote: These findings underscore the detrimental effect of a persistent metabolic shift driven by excitatory activity as a fundamental mechanism in inflammation-induced neurodegeneration.
39145444.summary: In mice with an MS model, deleting the Vgf gene only in neurons protected nerve cells from inflammation-driven damage. People with MS also had higher VGF levels.

39475792.mechanism: No treatment tested, maps inflammatory gene activity
39475792.conclusion_quote: This work contributes a valuable data resource to the field, provides the first detailed spatial transcriptomic characterization in a model of meningeal inflammation, and highlights several candidate pathways in the pathogenesis of gray matter pathology.
39475792.summary: In mice with autoimmune meningeal inflammation, researchers mapped gene activity in inflamed membranes and nearby brain tissue, finding immune signals such as complement that only partly reach the brain.

39032542.conclusion_quote: Overall, our data identify astrocyte-neuronal network dysfunctions as key pathological features of gray matter inflammation in multiple sclerosis and potentially additional neuroimmunological disorders.
39032542.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, cortical astrocytes became abnormally active and enhanced signals to neurons, impairing synaptic plasticity.

39271020.mechanism: Suppresses intestinal iNOS and tau hyperphosphorylation
39271020.conclusion_quote: LPC70 may be valuable as a functional food component in preventing HS-induced cognitive impairment.
39271020.summary: In mice given high-salt drinking water, a soy lysolecithin supplement prevented high blood pressure and memory decline by reducing intestinal inflammation.

38704362.mechanism: inhibits T-cell glycolysis, reducing proliferation and Th1 Th17 cells
38704362.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these results show that CPT-11 is a promising immunosuppressive drug for autoimmune disease treatment.
38704362.summary: In mice with EAE, the chemotherapy drug CPT-11 reduced harmful T cell activity and eased disease without weakening long-term cancer immune defense.

38341852.mechanism: Deleting SERTAD1 reduces NLRP3 polyubiquitination, lowering inflammasome activat
38341852.conclusion_quote: Thus, our findings uncover a function of SERTAD1 that specifically reduces Cullin1-mediated NLRP3 polyubiquitination via direct binding to NLRP3, eventually acting as a crucial factor to regulate the initiation of NLRP3-mediated inflammasome activation.
38341852.summary: In mice lacking SERTAD1, which is a protein that helps control inflammation, EAE, a mouse model of MS, was less severe than in normal mice.

38968104.mechanism: Modulates inflammatory reflex via vagus nerve signaling
38968104.conclusion_quote: Together, these data indicate that neuroimmune modulation via VNS may be a promising approach to treat MS, that not only ameliorates symptoms but potentially also promotes myelin repair (remyelination).
38968104.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, electrical stimulation of the vagus nerve reduced disease severity, inflammation, and myelin damage while supporting myelin repair.

38965360.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that asymptomatic HSV-1 brain infection and EAE associate with a significant expression of senescence biomarkers in the CNS.
38965360.summary: In mice with EAE and silent HSV-1 brain infection, researchers found more markers of cellular aging in the brain and spinal cord, especially when both conditions were present.

39519233.mechanism: Overexpression lowers M1 macrophages and IL-17 T cells
39519233.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results indicate that SRG3 plays a vital role in maintaining immune homeostasis within adipose tissues.
39519233.summary: In healthy B10.PL mice overexpressing SRG3, fat tissue had smaller fat cells, fewer inflammatory immune cells, and better glucose tolerance, with no MS model tested.

37524220.conclusion_quote: The findings also suggest an increase in p25 amplitude before motor deficits appear, indicating SEP as a predictive marker for disease progression.
37524220.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found a new sensory nerve signal that rises before movement problems appear and was reduced by morphine.

38470227.mechanism: inhibits EBP sterol isomerase to boost oligodendrocyte formation
38470227.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, compound 11 enhanced the formation of oligodendrocytes in human cortical organoids, providing additional support for our therapeutic hypothesis.
38470227.summary: A brain-penetrant drug called EBP inhibitor 11 increased formation of myelin-making oligodendrocytes in human brain organoids and reached the brain in rodents.

38561491.mechanism: Serine-linked butyrate prodrug boosts absorption, modulates immune cells
38561491.conclusion_quote: SerBut may become a promising therapeutic for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.
38561491.summary: In mice with EAE, a mouth-absorbed butyrate prodrug called SerBut reduced disease severity and calmed harmful immune responses without weakening vaccine responses.

38234370.conclusion_quote: The outcomes demonstrate enhanced myelin content during recovery in the intermittent demyelination model which is in association with reshaping macrophage polarity and modification of glial and endothelial cells.
38234370.summary: In mice fed cuprizone in repeated cycles, with recovery periods between, myelin repair improved alongside shifts in macrophage activity and changes in glial and blood vessel cells.

38851724.conclusion_quote: These results show that EVs provide snapshots of crucial disease processes such as CNS-compartmentalized inflammation, re/de-myelination, and synaptic pathology, and might also mediate these processes.
38851724.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers characterized spinal cord vesicles and found changes in inflammatory, glial, and synaptic proteins over the course of disease.

38695469.mechanism: Inhibits IRAK4 kinase, reducing pro-inflammatory cytokine production
38695469.conclusion_quote: BIO-8169 ( 2 ) reduced the in vivo production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, was well tolerated in safety studies in rodents and dog at margins well above the predicted efficacious exposure and showed promising results in a mouse model for multiple sclerosis.
38695469.summary: A new brain-penetrant drug, BIO-8169, blocks the IRAK4 inflammation signal, lowered inflammatory cytokines, and showed promising results in mice with an MS model.

39409029.mechanism: Loss of PARK2 worsens inflammation and EAE severity
39409029.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight the role of EBV in exacerbating inflammation, particularly in the context of mitochondrial deficiencies.
39409029.summary: In mice lacking the PARK2 gene, immunization with an Epstein-Barr virus protein fragment or with EAE induction caused more severe inflammation and disease symptoms than in normal mice.

39083422.mechanism: Blocks M1 receptor, promoting oligodendrocyte differentiation
39083422.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings support targeting M1R for remyelination and support further development of PIPE-307 for clinical studies.
39083422.summary: In mice with EAE, the brain-penetrant drug PIPE-307 blocks the M1 receptor, promoting myelin repair and improving disability and visual nerve responses.

38070090.conclusion_quote: Here, we describe protocols for three EAE variants, successfully generated in our laboratory, and provide additional information as to how to maintain their unique features and reproducibility.
38070090.summary: Describes how to induce three versions of an experimental model of multiple sclerosis in common laboratory mice, with tips for reproducible results.

39386804.mechanism: Blocks Card9 signaling, cutting pathogenic Th17 priming
39386804.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that avoiding the activation of Card9 signaling during vaccination with mycobacteria-containing vaccines may mitigate the risk of detrimental type 3 immune responses, while preserving type 1 immune responses that are effective against intracellular pathogens and cancers.
39386804.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Card9 gene reduced harmful Th17 immune cells and disease severity while leaving antibody and type 1 immune responses intact.

39061841.mechanism: Disturbs antioxidant function, altering mitochondrial metabolism and ROS product
39061841.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data support the concept that the DMF-mediated antiproliferative effect on VSMCs is linked to disturbed antioxidative functions resulting in altered mitochondrial metabolism.
39061841.summary: In mice with cerebral aneurysms, dimethyl fumarate treatment disrupted antioxidant defenses in artery muscle cells, impairing mitochondrial function and increasing cell death.

38733741.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease changes only
38733741.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our results corroborate the dysfunction of the neuroendocrine system as a major pathological event of autoimmune demyelination and highlight the crosstalk between the CNS and the periphery in mediating such disease phenotypes.
38733741.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers profiled gene activity in adrenal glands and ovaries, finding altered fat and cholesterol pathways alongside changes in brain hypothalamus signaling.

39565845.mechanism: STK40 drives FOXO degradation, enabling Th1/Th17 differentiation
39565845.conclusion_quote: Together, our data suggest a crucial role of STK40 in T H 1 and T H 17 cell differentiation, thereby enabling better understanding of the molecular regulatory network of CD4 + T cell differentiation and providing effective targets for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
39565845.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting STK40 from T cells reduced inflammatory T cell formation and lessened disease symptoms.

38692897.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that the combination of a small amount of lysolecithin and canola oil modulated the increase in postprandial blood glucose levels induced by the intake of cooked japonica rice in adult men with BMI ≥ 22.
38692897.summary: Healthy Japanese men ate rice with or without lysolecithin and canola oil, the mixture slightly reduced blood sugar rise in men with higher body mass index.

38363533.conclusion_quote: Combined with bioinformatic analysis and experimental data, Becn1 showed obvious expression abnormalities suggesting that this gene has vital functions in autophagy and MD engulfed by OPCs.
38363533.summary: In a study using mice with EAE and cultured oligodendrocyte precursor cells, researchers found the autophagy gene Becn1 showed abnormal expression linked to clearing myelin debris.

38657065.mechanism: Less sphingolipid synthesis lowers ROS and glycolysis
38657065.conclusion_quote: Our results thus show a critical role for de novo sphingolipid biosynthetic pathway in shaping adaptive immune responses with implications in autoimmune diseases.
38657065.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the SPTLC1 gene reduced inflammatory Th17 immune cell activity and protected the mice from developing disease.

38146224.mechanism: Removing aggrecan reduces negatively charged CSPGs, lowering neuronal excitabili
38146224.conclusion_quote: These results show increased expression of CSPGs in the DG and amygdala as one of the causal factors for TMEV-induced acute seizures.
38146224.summary: In mice with virus-induced seizures, deleting the protein aggrecan in the dentate gyrus and amygdala reduced seizure burden and overexcitability of brain neurons.

39489278.mechanism: activates astrocyte Nrf2 pathway, reducing oxidative stress
39489278.conclusion_quote: This study suggested that calycosin might exert neuroprotection by inhibiting oxidative stress and reducing demyelination via the activation of astrocyte Nrf2 signaling.
39489278.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, calycosin reduced demyelination and oxidative stress by activating the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway in astrocytes.

38007361.conclusion_quote: While EBV emerges as an important, possibly essential trigger of MS, more mechanistic insights into this connection are required to understand if targeting of EBV infection itself or of cross-reactive immune responses that recognize both viral and autoantigens might prevent or even allow to treat MS.
38007361.summary: This review discusses how Epstein Barr virus infection may trigger multiple sclerosis, and notes EBV is less controlled in a mouse model carrying the main MS risk gene.

39302418.mechanism: Overexpresses deubiquitinating enzyme CYLD in microglia
39302418.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that CYLD overexpression does not alter microglial function, and thus does not represent a viable therapeutic strategy in neuroinflammatory conditions.
39302418.summary: Mice that overexpress the enzyme CYLD only in microglia showed no change in microglia numbers, shape, or disease severity in EAE, a mouse model of MS.

38692923.mechanism: Not applicable, review of STAP-2 signaling
38692923.conclusion_quote: Here, detailed functions of STAP-2 in TCR-mediated T cell activation, and how STAP-2 affects the pathogenesis of T cell-mediated inflammation and immune diseases, are reviewed.
38692923.summary: This review summarizes how the STAP-2 protein helps control T cell activation and inflammation, including findings from mice with EAE, a model of MS.

interventions: continuous activation of VLM CA neurons
38182836.mechanism: Neuron activation redirects T cells via CXCR4
38182836.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our study demonstrates neuronal control of inflammation and T cell distribution, suggesting a neural mechanism underlying fasting-mediated immune regulation.
38182836.summary: In mice with EAE, continuously activating fasting-linked neurons in the brainstem reduced T cell activity and eased disease symptoms.

38474322.mechanism: not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
38474322.conclusion_quote: We conclude that in acute optic neuritis, the optic nerves are hypoxic and come under oxidative and nitrative stress and damage.
38474322.summary: In rats with experimental optic neuritis, a model linked to MS, the optic nerves were found to have low oxygen and show oxidative damage.

38745307.mechanism: Enhances microglial TREM2 and reduces TNF signaling
38745307.conclusion_quote: The data presented in this work highlight IL-9 as a critical neuroprotective molecule capable of interfering with inflammatory synaptopathy in EAE.
38745307.summary: Injecting interleukin-9 into the body or brain of mice with EAE, a model of MS, improved disability, reduced inflammation, and protected synapses from damage.

38957253.conclusion_quote: TNF-α, IFN-γ, IL17, and TGF-β serum levels are criteria for evaluating immune inflammatory activity during relapse and remission periods.
38957253.summary: Blood tests in 46 people with relapsing MS and 40 healthy controls found immune imbalance during relapse and remission, with cytokine levels tied to disease activity.

39330967.mechanism: Depletes B cells, restoring T cell epitope reactivity
39330967.conclusion_quote: Ultimately, this study reveals that anti-CD20 treatment can influence T cell epitopes found in the CNS during demyelinating disease.
39330967.summary: In mice with demyelinating disease induced by full-length MOG protein, anti-CD20 B-cell depletion changed which myelin-targeting T cell epitopes were found in the central nervous system.

38359295.mechanism: Setd2 loss unbalances Th17 and Treg cells
38359295.conclusion_quote: Overall, our data reveal that Setd2 acts as an epigenetic brake for T cell-mediated autoimmunity through phospholipid remodeling, suggesting potential targets for treating neuroinflammatory diseases.
38359295.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Setd2 gene from T cells worsened brain inflammation and myelin damage by upsetting the balance of Th17 and Treg immune cells.

38182045.mechanism: Describes S1PR1 expression changes, no treatment tested
38182045.conclusion_quote: This study shows that S1PR1s are expressed in normal brain tissues and leukocytes in inflammatory lesions, and demonstrates the upregulation of S1PR1 expression on nervous system cells in inflammatory lesions of MUE and EAE.
38182045.summary: In dogs with brain inflammation and in dogs with EAE, a model of MS, the S1PR1 receptor rose on brain cells compared with healthy brains.

38326613.mechanism: Describes anatomical routes for fluid and cell exchange
38326613.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our results indicate that ACE points are a critical part of the anatomy of neuroimmune communication in both mice and humans that link the central nervous system with the dura and its immunological diversity and waste clearance systems.
38326613.summary: Researchers found tiny openings where veins cross the arachnoid barrier that let fluid, molecules and immune cells pass between the brain and dura in mice with EAE.

38256254.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that the GMF may be involved in the pathogenesis of PDD.
38256254.summary: In postmortem brains from people with Parkinson's dementia, the inflammatory protein GMF was found in abundant reactive astrocytes near dying dopamine neurons, suggesting a role in disease.

38607022.mechanism: Depletes plasma Reelin, reducing endothelial leukocyte adhesion
38607022.conclusion_quote: These findings underscore the promising role of peripheral anti-Reelin therapeutic strategies for autoimmune diseases and conditions where endothelial function is compromised, offering a novel approach that may avoid the immunosuppressive side effects associated with conventional anti-inflammatory therapies.
38607022.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody that removes blood Reelin reduced immune cell entry into the nervous system while sparing brain function.

39640595.conclusion_quote: These findings elucidate the mechanism underlying hyperalgesia from the perspective of lipid metabolite LPC and PNNs and provide potential strategies for the treatment of hyperalgesia.
39640595.summary: In mice with nerve injury, fat tissue transplantation raised the lipid LPC in the brain's anterior cingulate cortex, which disrupted protective nets around neurons and increased pain sensitivity.

39053824.mechanism: Corticosteroid reduces inflammation and promotes remyelination
39053824.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the elaborated biopolymer-integrating nanocarrier succeeded in remyelination with 6.6 folds reduction in CP dose compared to previous studies.
39053824.summary: In mice with demyelination caused by cuprizone, a nasal nanocarrier loaded with clobetasol improved movement and memory and promoted myelin repair at a lower dose.

38178091.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings corroborate the central role of hypothalamic dysfunction in CNS autoimmunity.
38178091.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers tracked hypothalamus gene activity over time and found calming inflammation signals, altered brain peptides, and weakened hormone production.

39465429.mechanism: Blocks BTK, reducing Fc receptor activated microglial inflammation
39465429.conclusion_quote: Our study enhances the understanding of BTK functions in human microglial signaling that are relevant to MS pathogenesis and suggests that fenebrutinib could attenuate detrimental microglial activity associated with FcγR activation in people with MS.
39465429.summary: In human microglia and brain organoids, the drug fenebrutinib reduced harmful antibody-triggered inflammation, chemical signals, and nerve damage, but did not affect myelin clearing.

38886527.mechanism: potentiates GABA A receptors in oligodendrocytes
38886527.conclusion_quote: Thus, the promyelinating character of β-CCB was confirmed in a generalized demyelination model, strengthening the idea that it has clinical potential as a therapeutic drug.
38886527.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, the drug β-CCB given systemically promoted myelin repair in several brain white matter areas.

39082294.conclusion_quote: Overall, the retina is an excellent model to investigate neurodegeneration in MS, and possibly, loss of cells in the GCL could be used as an early indicator of neurodegeneration in MS and to identify novel therapeutic agents to treat the disease.
39082294.summary: In mice with EAE, retinal nerve cell loss and thinning appeared early, suggesting retinal changes could signal early nerve damage in MS.

38414125.conclusion_quote: We found no evidence of BCG vaccination or latent tuberculosis infection in young adulthood being linked to MS risk.
38414125.summary: In a Norwegian population cohort of nearly 800,000 people, BCG vaccination in early adulthood was not linked to a lower chance of developing multiple sclerosis.

38469353.mechanism: Removes HCN2 ion channel from oligodendrocytes
38469353.conclusion_quote: We conclude that HCN2 channels in OLG may play a role in regulating metabolism.
38469353.summary: In mice, removing the HCN2 ion channel from myelin-forming cells led to motor problems that appeared faster in an MS-like model (EAE).

38878831.conclusion_quote: Consequently, CD8 + CXCR5 + T cells may play a role in CNS demyelination through heightening humoral immune responses.
38878831.summary: In people with MS and in mice with EAE, a type of follicular CD8 T cell was increased and helped B cells make antibodies that may contribute to nerve damage.

38604270.mechanism: No treatment tested, imaging study only
38604270.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these data unveil a crosstalk between intestinal and central inflammation in EAE and support the use of molecular MRI of intestinal MAdCAM-1 as a new biomarker for prognostic in MS patients.
38604270.summary: In mice with EAE, an MRI scan of gut MAdCAM-1 signal tracked disease severity and predicted later disease onset and progression, suggesting it could be a prognostic marker.

39383661.mechanism: restores zinc, lowers oxidative stress and IL-6
39383661.conclusion_quote: The findings of the current study suggest that zinc supplementation in addition to treatment for MS may be beneficial in reducing the severity of the disease.
39383661.summary: In rats given cuprizone to mimic MS, zinc sulfate supplementation prevented spinal cord damage and returned zinc transporter, IL-6 and antioxidant levels to normal.

38326664.mechanism: Not applicable, describes lipid changes only
38326664.conclusion_quote: A clear difference in lipid signature was observed between the lesion front and the epicentre, where the damage was maximized.
38326664.summary: In mice with chemically induced demyelination, researchers mapped spinal cord lipids and found distinct patterns at the lesion front versus its center.

38522839.conclusion_quote: Putative RNA biomarkers were identified that accurately distinguish NMO from RRMS and healthy individuals.
38522839.summary: Researchers analyzed blood RNA from people with neuromyelitis optica, relapsing MS, and healthy controls, using machine learning to find biomarkers that distinguish the diseases.

38509600.mechanism: computational drug ranking from single-cell network models
38509600.conclusion_quote: We propose a computational framework, scDrugPrio, for drug prioritisation based on scRNA-seq of IMID disease.
38509600.summary: A computer method called scDrugPrio used single-cell gene activity data from people with MS and other immune diseases to rank drugs that might help each patient.

38062135.mechanism: Lower oleic acid boosts Treg cell differentiation
38062135.conclusion_quote: Therefore, OA availability is critical for preprogramming thymocytes with T reg cell differentiation propensities in the periphery.
38062135.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Scd1 gene in the thymus produced more regulatory T cells and reduced disease development.

39090252.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, limiting immune infiltration and damage
39090252.conclusion_quote: Siponimod exerts both anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects, partially related to BDNF-expression.
39090252.summary: Siponimod reduced clinical signs and spinal cord inflammation in mice with EAE, with the anti-inflammatory effect partly independent of immune cell BDNF.

38395617.conclusion_quote: Thus, oligodendrocyte maturation plays a key role in determining the mechanism of death a cell undergoes in response to the same insult.
38395617.summary: In mice, oligodendrocytes died at different speeds and by different mechanisms depending on their maturation stage when exposed to cuprizone or cell injury.

38682309.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that extracellular vesicles released by C. acnes localized in renal cell carcinoma tissues act in a tumor-promoting manner.
38682309.summary: Researchers found Cutibacterium acnes bacterial vesicles in kidney cancer patients' blood and tumors, and in mice with kidney cancer grafts these vesicles promoted tumor growth.

38218078.mechanism: Exosomes deliver Sox10 to promote oligodendrocyte differentiation
38218078.conclusion_quote: This endogenously loaded technology holds promise as a strategy for protein-based drugs in the treatment of demyelinating diseases.
38218078.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, exosomes carrying extra Sox10 helped progenitor cells mature into myelin-making cells and reduced myelin damage.

39337388.mechanism: Compares immune changes across mouse strains
39337388.conclusion_quote: Several factors may play an essential role in the acceleration of EAE in 2D2/Th mice.
39337388.summary: In mice with EAE, a hybrid strain of 2D2 and Th mice developed faster and more severe disease, linked to autoantibodies that break down self proteins.

38308301.mechanism: Loss of NLRP3 lowers ROS-driven NET formation
38308301.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings suggest that NLRP3-supported NETs may be an etiological factor in EAE pathogenesis, primarily in the brain.
38308301.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the NLRP3 gene reduced harmful neutrophil trap formation in the brain and lessened disease severity.

39450167.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease induction only
39450167.conclusion_quote: We propose that this is the first report of an autoimmune disease in an animal model triggered by colocalization of intranasal PTx and autoantigen.
39450167.summary: In mice given intranasal pertussis toxin and a myelin peptide, patchy hair loss resembling alopecia areata developed, while the planned EAE disease did not appear.

38979727.mechanism: Inhibits Wnt/β-catenin pathway to promote remyelination
38979727.conclusion_quote: HIIT promotes remyelination by inhibiting the Wnt/β-catenin pathway and is a promising rehabilitation training for demyelinating diseases.
38979727.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice with demyelination, high-intensity interval training after a recovery period improved myelin repair and memory, partly by inhibiting the Wnt/β-catenin pathway.

37935896.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the aminosteroids U73122 and U73343 promote OPC-to-OL generation and myelin formation by regulating cholesterol biosynthesis pathway.
37935896.summary: In mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, the drug U73122 helped precursor cells mature into oligodendrocytes and repaired myelin, apparently by boosting cholesterol production.

38648972.mechanism: modulates microglia and astrocytes, enhances remyelination
38648972.conclusion_quote: cVNS improved remyelination of an LPC-induced lesion.
38648972.summary: In rats given a lysolecithin brain injury, stimulating the vagus nerve reduced inflammation and improved myelin repair.

37801218.mechanism: removes SELENBP1, worsening oxidative stress and inflammation
37801218.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that SELENBP1 might be involved in the regulation of neurogenesis in mice with depression and could be served as a potential target for diagnosing and treating depression.
37801218.summary: In mice with stress-induced depression, deleting the SELENBP1 gene worsened depressive behavior and reduced the growth of new brain cells.

38643194.mechanism: Blocks CSF1R signaling, depleting microglia and myeloid cells
38643194.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that CSF1R activity modulates the cellular composition of immune cells both in the periphery and within the CNS, and affects lesion localization during the early EAE stages.
38643194.summary: In mice with EAE, a diet containing the CSF1R-blocking drug PLX5622 milder symptoms in most mice but shifted immune cell infiltration and demyelination to the cerebellum.

38123002.mechanism: Blocks M3 receptor, inhibiting Wnt/β-catenin signaling
38123002.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, Sol may promote the differentiation of OPCs by inhibiting the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway, making it a potential therapeutic option for central nervous system demyelinating diseases.
38123002.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, the drug solifenacin improved myelin repair and helped precursor cells mature by blocking the Wnt/β-catenin pathway.

39231098.mechanism: Inhibits PAK1, reducing motor neuron spine abnormalities
39231098.conclusion_quote: This study provides compelling evidence that romidepsin may be a promising therapeutic approach for attenuating SCI-induced spasticity.
39231098.summary: In mice with spinal cord injury, the drug romidepsin reduced abnormal reflex spasms and nerve cell spine changes when given after injury.

38973196.mechanism: remodels gut microbiota, reduces peripheral inflammation and neuroinflammation
38973196.conclusion_quote: GV-971 attenuates the progression of NMOSD in murine models and reduces neuroinflammation and injury, likely through its effects on remodeling gut microbiota and peripheral inflammation and metabolic disorders.
38973196.summary: In mice with an NMOSD-like disease, the Alzheimer's drug GV-971 reduced disease incidence, eased symptoms, prolonged survival, and restored healthy gut bacteria.

38409259.conclusion_quote: Altogether, we identify astrocyte-derived HB-EGF and its epigenetic regulation as a modulator of autoimmune CNS inflammation and potential therapeutic target in MS.
38409259.summary: Researchers gave intranasal HB-EGF, a growth factor made by astrocytes, to mice with EAE, which reduced inflammation and attenuated disease.

38175305.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our study shows that neuroinflammation (i) critically affects the integrity of PNNs in cortical brain tissue, in a reversible process that correlates with disease disability in EAE, (ii) reduces the mechanical integrity of brain tissue rather than leading to water accumulation, and (iii) shows similar spatial patterns in humans and mice.
38175305.summary: In mice with EAE and in a few people with MS, MR elastography showed reversible brain softening in the cortex linked to changes in perineuronal nets around neurons.

39133566.mechanism: none tested, describes glial proliferation enabling viral spread
39133566.conclusion_quote: Together, these data suggest that JCV propagation in progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy might be accelerated by glial cell division.
39133566.summary: In mice with humanized glial cells and cuprizone-induced demyelination, dividing human glia let JC virus spread faster, increasing death of myelin-making cells.

38252396.mechanism: Reduces inflammation and oxidative stress in nerves
38252396.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that glatiramer acetate can alleviate the peripheral neuropathy induced by paclitaxel.
38252396.summary: In rats with chemotherapy-induced nerve damage, the multiple sclerosis drug glatiramer acetate reduced pain sensitivity, inflammation, and damage to the sciatic nerve.

37610146.conclusion_quote: The present study demonstrates the dysregulation of lncRNAs TUG1 and NRON in spinal cord tissue lesions of EAE and activated macrophages, pointing to their potential role in the pathogenesis of EAE.
37610146.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers measured two long noncoding RNAs, NRON and TUG1, which were reduced in spinal cord lesions and activated macrophages.

38306899.conclusion_quote: We validated our minipig model of demyelinating brain diseases by employing human diagnostic tools and comparing it with biopsy data from patients with cerebral demyelination.
38306899.summary: Minipigs were given repeated injections of a chemical to create reversible brain demyelination, and scans and tissue tests matched human disease patterns.

38016520.mechanism: Protects oligodendrocytes, preserving myelin protein under cuprizone
38016520.conclusion_quote: These findings collectively indicate that IL-33 possesses the capability to mitigate CPZ-induced damage and bolster OL homeostasis.
38016520.summary: In mice fed cuprizone and in cultured oligodendrocytes, boosting IL-33 levels reduced damage to myelin-producing cells and preserved myelin protein, suggesting possible help for remyelination.

37955284.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that short-chain fatty acid producers may be important contributors to multiple sclerosis onset.
37955284.summary: In a human study of children with early multiple sclerosis, gut bacteria that produce short-chain fatty acids were linked to whether the disease was present.

38177566.mechanism: Activates Nrf2/HO-1 antioxidant and blocks TLR4/NF-κB inflammation
38177566.conclusion_quote: Our results strongly suggest that ICA may be used as a potential agent to treat demyelination via regulating Nrf2/HO-1-mediated antioxidative stress and TLR4/NF-κB-mediated inflammatory responses.
38177566.summary: In a cuprizone model of demyelination, the natural compound icariin reduced oxidative stress and inflammation, improved behavior, and increased myelin staining.

39519809.mechanism: Observational plasma lipid association study, no treatment tested
39519809.conclusion_quote: There are significant changes in the lipidome profiles of healthy subjects compared to euthyroid HT patients treated with L-thyroxine, which are related to the type of hypothyroidism and non-occupational exposure to toxic elements.
39519809.summary: In unexposed adults, researchers measured blood lipids and toxic metals in hypothyroidism patients and healthy controls, finding lipid changes linked to thyroid disease type and metal exposure.

39242990.conclusion_quote: This cutting-edge resource plays a crucial role in deciphering the complex interplay between usage patterns and embryonic development, offering valuable insights into variation across diverse tissues, strains, and stages.
39242990.summary: This study builds a free website showing how genetic code usage varies across mouse embryo tissues, strains, and developmental stages, not multiple sclerosis.

38128553.mechanism: removing p38γ MAPK speeds oligodendrocyte precursor maturation and myelin repair
38128553.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that p38γ could be targeted to improve myelin repair in multiple sclerosis.
38128553.summary: In mice lacking p38γ MAPK in oligodendrocyte precursor cells, myelin formed faster and remyelination after cuprizone-induced damage was quicker, and the protein was abundant in MS lesions.

38572807.mechanism: Activates Tyro3 receptor, boosting oligodendrocyte numbers and remyelination
38572807.conclusion_quote: This work therefore establishes that the remyelinative activity of GAS6 is dependent on Tyro3 and includes potentiation of oligodendrocyte numbers.
38572807.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, brain infusion of GAS6 increased myelinated nerve fibres and mature oligodendrocytes, but this benefit was lost in mice lacking Tyro3.

38157790.mechanism: emulsifies dietary fats to improve digestion
38157790.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, feeding broilers a combination of lysophospholipids, a synthetic emulsifier and monoglycerides resulted in improved bird performance.
38157790.summary: In broiler chickens fed low energy diets, a feed additive improved growth, litter dryness, and footpad health, but this has no link to multiple sclerosis.

38662794.conclusion_quote: Taken together, we demonstrate that cellular stress pathways involving the kinases PKR and P38 are modulated by the activity of non-structural viral proteins to increase the release EV-enclosed viruses during picornavirus infections.
38662794.summary: This study of picornavirus infection in cultured cells found viral proteins boost release of virus carrying vesicles by acting on stress kinases PKR and P38, with no MS model.

38988661.conclusion_quote: Our ex vivo organotypic spinal cord slice culture system provides a platform to model demyelination and endogenous remyelination long-term, mimicking that observed in LPC-induced rodent models of demyelination.
38988661.summary: Rat spinal cord slice cultures kept alive in a dish showed strong myelin loss and some natural repair after lysolecithin, but not after LPS.

38374296.mechanism: Not applicable, industrial oil processing study
38374296.conclusion_quote: The benefit of using enzymatic degumming of vegetable oils rather than traditional chemical refining is that the enzymatic degumming process reduces total oil loss.
38374296.summary: This study tested enzymatic degumming of soybean oil at an industrial plant, which is unrelated to multiple sclerosis, animal models, or human cell models.

38091274.mechanism: Dietary lysophosphatidylcholine alters intake, gut bacteria and fat
38091274.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, soya lecithin at a dose of 0.5% increased feed intake and energy storage in adipocytes and improved the fatty acid profile of periovarian fat.
38091274.summary: In female rabbits before mating, dietary soya lecithin raised feed intake and changed gut bacteria and body fat, with no MS model used.

38909243.mechanism: miR-223 suppresses CTSB, boosting autophagy and lipid clearance
38909243.conclusion_quote: By inhibiting CTSB, miR-223 promotes selective LD degradation, thereby reducing the lipid burden and inflammatory phenotype in LDAM.
38909243.summary: In mice with lysolecithin-induced demyelination and in microglia cells, boosting the microRNA miR-223 reduced fat droplet buildup and inflammation by lowering CTSB.

38042217.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we have cloned the LPCAT1 gene on fish successfully and find the augmented gene response of LPCAT1 in hepatocytes under PA treatment first.
38042217.summary: In large yellow croaker fish, researchers cloned the LPCAT1 gene and found it responded to palmitic acid in liver cells.

37865962.conclusion_quote: Results of this study indicate that although inflammation intensity subsides in the chronic phase of EAE, the neurodestructive processes: demyelination and axonal damage continue in that phase.
37865962.summary: This study examined spinal cords of mice with EAE at different disease stages, finding inflammation faded later while demyelination and axonal damage continued.

37621667.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates that urine may be a good source of biomarkers for the early detection of multiple sclerosis.
37621667.summary: In rats with EAE, an MS model, early methylprednisolone treatment reduced encephalomyelitis incidence to one in thirteen, and urine showed early protein changes.

36797038.summary: This erratum notice corrects the citation for a rat study using PET imaging to measure myelin in a lysolecithin demyelination model, and reports no new findings.

38107502.mechanism: Delivers steroid to lesions, reducing glial activation
38107502.conclusion_quote: CAQK seems a potential targeting peptide for delivering drugs or other biologically active chemicals/reagents to the CNS of patients with multiple sclerosis.
38107502.summary: In mice with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, a low dose of steroid carried by nanoparticles coated with CAQK peptide reduced brain inflammation, while the same dose of free steroid did not.

37400000.mechanism: not applicable, describes disease changes only
37400000.conclusion_quote: Among these processes, demyelination and especially axonal loss most effectively decrease the stiffness of the optic nerve.
37400000.summary: In mice with EAE, optic nerve stiffness fell, with axonal loss and demyelination causing most of the drop, while blood neurofilament levels rose early.

38106635.mechanism: Antioxidant effect boosts myelin and Olig2 gene expression
38106635.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggested that administration of ginger essential oil prevented demyelination and improved remyelination of rats` corpus callusom and can be used as an effective substance in the prevention of MS.
38106635.summary: In a cuprizone-induced rat model of MS, ginger essential oil helped prevent myelin loss in the corpus callosum and improved remyelination.

37364516.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate a great potential of nanopore sequencing in identifying genomic DNA methylation in EAE and provide important guidance for future studies investigating the MS/EAE pathology.
37364516.summary: Researchers used nanopore DNA sequencing to map methylation in brains of mice with EAE, finding 490 genes with altered promoter methylation linked to immune and metabolic processes.

38064339.mechanism: Sphingosine analog delivered via TCN2-CD320 in astrocytes
38064339.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the B 12 -TCN2-CD320 pathway is essential for the mechanism of action of FTY720.
38064339.summary: In mice with EAE, the MS drug FTY720 reduced inflammation by working through vitamin B12 transport and the CD320 receptor in astrocytes.

37517520.mechanism: Removes adipose-derived LCN2, reducing macrophage inflammation and lipolysis
37517520.conclusion_quote: Overall data highlighted a role LCN2 in exacerbating inflammatory phenotype in EAE model, suggesting a pathogenic role of dysfunctional AT in MS.
37517520.summary: In mice with EAE, removing LCN2 only from fat tissue reduced weight loss and inflammatory immune cell infiltration in the spinal cord.

36744877.conclusion_quote: Our findings show that the genetic background of a patient can directly alter stem cell function, provides new insights on the innate cellular dysregulation in MS and identifies p21 pathway as a new potential target for therapeutic strategies in MS.
36744877.summary: Researchers grew human cerebral organoids from stem cells of MS patients and healthy people, finding that progressive MS organoids had fewer stem cells and fewer oligodendrocytes, linked to reduced p21.

37314416.mechanism: activates PPARβ to protect regulatory T cells and reduce nitric oxide
37314416.conclusion_quote: These results describe a novel anti-autoimmune property of HMB that may be beneficial in the treatment of MS and other autoimmune disorders.
37314416.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, oral HMB, a muscle-building supplement, reduced symptoms, inflammation, and myelin loss.

36626985.mechanism: reduces Th1 and Th17 T-cell polarization
36626985.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these data indicate that DHEA and their downstream metabolites reduce the disease severity in the RR-EAE model of MS and can be potential dietary adjuvants to existing MS therapeutics.
36626985.summary: In mice with relapsing EAE, daily docosahexaenoyl ethanolamide delayed disease onset, reduced relapses and severity, and dampened inflammatory T-cell development.

36527746.mechanism: removes CCL20 or CCR6 chemokine signaling
36527746.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that CCL20/CCR6-mediated cell migration is not necessarily required for the onset of EAE, and may be compensated for by other chemokine signals.
36527746.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, knocking out the CCL20 or CCR6 immune signals did not reduce disease or change CNS inflammation or demyelination.

37431183.mechanism: binds MIF, blocking MIF-CD74 interaction and favoring M2 microglia
37431183.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our research indicates that 5-HMF promotes microglial M2 polarization by inhibiting the MIF-CD74 interaction, thereby attenuating inflammation and demyelination in EAE mice.
37431183.summary: In mice with EAE, the compound 5-HMF reduced inflammation and demyelination by blocking the MIF-CD74 pathway in brain immune cells called microglia.

35467295.conclusion_quote: We further describe how females exhibit more robust myelin-specific T helper (Th) 1 immunity in MS and EAE and how this sex bias in Th cells is conveyed by sex hormone effects on the T cells, antigen presenting cells, regulatory T cells, and innate lymphoid cell populations.
35467295.summary: This review explains how immune cells and sex hormones cause women to get multiple sclerosis more often than men, using mouse EAE models for comparison.

36738672.mechanism: activates TLR7, reduces inflammation, microglia activation
36738672.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that Vesatolimod exhibits protective effects on EAE mice and is promising for treatment of MS.
36738672.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug called Vesatolimod that activates an immune sensor started at symptom onset eased symptoms, reduced inflammation and demyelination, and calmed microglia.

37808551.conclusion_quote: This study provides novel molecular evidence for visual impairments in EAE and indicates directions for further research to elucidate the mechanisms of these visual impairments in MS.
37808551.summary: Researchers compared retinal gene activity in mice with EAE, finding 345 upregulated immune genes that may help explain visual impairment.

37741298.mechanism: Alters gut microbiota and metabolites, dampening inflammation
37741298.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, naringenin has potential immunomodulatory effects that are influenced to some extent by the gut microbiome.
37741298.summary: In mice with EAE, a naringenin-enriched diet reduced disease severity and changed gut bacteria and brain metabolites, with gut microbes partly mediating the benefit.

36680977.mechanism: No treatment tested, only describes EAE features
36680977.conclusion_quote: Our results show that EAE mice develop severe bone loss, anxiety-like moods, and intestinal inflammation in addition to clinical phenomena such as inflammatory infiltration and demyelination of the spinal cord.
36680977.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers identified new indicators showing severe bone loss, anxiety-like behavior, and intestinal inflammation alongside spinal cord damage.

37686031.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these data demonstrate that activation of autophagy occurs in the neurons of the hippocampus in this experimental model.
37686031.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers measured autophagy proteins in the hippocampus and found signs that autophagy was activated in brain neurons.

37895046.conclusion_quote: The results suggest calprotectin as a good biomarker of gastrointestinal inflammation in EAE and the potential of this model as a useful animal model for IBS.
37895046.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, fecal calprotectin rose before symptoms along with gut neutrophils and goblet cells, suggesting it may track gut inflammation.

37122101.mechanism: Not applicable: imaging biomarkers of disease changes
37122101.conclusion_quote: This study identified changes in MRI biomarker signatures that can be useful for evaluating the efficacy of novel drugs using EAE models in vivo.
37122101.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, MRI scans of the lower spinal cord showed lower neuron markers, altered water diffusion, and changes that tracked disease severity.

37745672.mechanism: Inhibits microglial activity, reducing microglial proliferation in corpus callos
37745672.conclusion_quote: These data indicate sex-specific effects of inhibiting microglia on the early changes leading to demyelination in an MS model and suggest microglia may play a key role in myelin stability in males but not in females.
37745672.summary: In rats fed cuprizone to model MS, the antibiotic minocycline, which blocks microglia, worsened early myelin loss in males but had no effect in females.

38139284.mechanism: Blocks connexin 43 hemichannels, reducing inflammasome activation
38139284.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that clinical trial phase IIb-ready tonabersat may merit further investigation as a promising candidate for MS treatment.
38139284.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug tonabersat reduced brain inflammation and protected myelin, and treated mice behaved closer to normal.

37647680.mechanism: increases neural, hematopoietic and mesenchymal stem cell proportions
37647680.conclusion_quote: Our study suggested that EA at ST36 acupoint was an effective nonpharmacological therapeutic protocol that not only reduced the CNS demyelination and inflammatory cell infiltration in EAE disease but also increased the proportions of various stem cells.
37647680.summary: Electroacupuncture at the ST36 acupoint in mice with EAE reduced demyelination and inflammation, eased symptoms, and increased several types of stem cells.

37302366.mechanism: Induces apoptosis of activated and MOG-specific T cells
37302366.conclusion_quote: Overall, our findings indicated that CA plays a protective role in the initiation and progression of EAE and has the potential to be a novel drug in the treatment of MS.
37302366.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the cancer drug carboplatin reduced spinal cord inflammation and demyelination by causing pathogenic T cells to die.

37832863.mechanism: blocks MAP kinase, shifting T-cell subsets toward regulatory
37832863.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that PD98059 corrects immune dysfunction in EAE mice, which is concurrent with the modulation of multiple signaling pathways.
37832863.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the drug PD98059 reduced inflammatory T cells and increased regulatory T cells in the spleen and brain.

36744792.mechanism: Not applicable: imaging method, no treatment tested
36744792.conclusion_quote: Described here are optimized techniques to detect and quantify CD19 + B cells in the brain and spinal cord using in vivo PET imaging.
36744792.summary: Researchers developed a PET imaging method to detect and count human CD19 B cells in the brain and spinal cord of mice with EAE, a model of MS.

36710351.mechanism: Shifts microglia to anti-inflammatory state, reduces oxidative stress
36710351.conclusion_quote: Therefore, nanoparticulate MgH 2 may be a promising therapeutic drug for psychiatric comorbidities of MS.
36710351.summary: In mice with EAE, a nanoparticle form of magnesium hydride eased anxiety and depression-like behaviors and reduced inflammation and nerve damage.

37657612.conclusion_quote: Histone lysine demethlyases thus represent intriguing targets for the treatment of T cell-driven autoimmune disorders.
37657612.summary: This mainly review article examines sex chromosome genes in mouse EAE and reports that blocking KDM5 proteins lowers interferon-gamma from male T cells.

37264368.conclusion_quote: Our data underscore the important role of the ChP as CNS immune cell entry site in the context of autoimmune neuroinflammation.
37264368.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, immune cells gathered in the choroid plexus before disease onset, pointing to it as a brain entry site.

37491119.mechanism: Inhibits Erk1/2 kinase pathway, improving DNA damage repair
37491119.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate clear associations between Erk1/2 activation, DNA damage/repair, and MS pathology, and further suggest that PD therapy may be a promising adjuvant therapeutic strategy.
37491119.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug PD98059 blocked Erk1/2 signaling, reduced DNA strand breaks and sped up DNA repair.

37427716.conclusion_quote: Thus this study offers a list of genes expressed in the spleen that might play a key role in the pathogenesis of EAE.
37427716.summary: In mice with EAE, a reanalysis of existing spleen gene datasets found immune pathways and genes such as SLC43A1 and SOX6 that may drive disease.

37246522.mechanism: reduces inflammatory cytokines and increases regulatory T cells
37246522.conclusion_quote: The present study indicated that ginger extract could effectively reduce inflammatory mediators and modulate immune responses in EAE.
37246522.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, daily injections of ginger extract reduced symptom severity and inflammatory signals while increasing regulatory T cells.

38139072.mechanism: Reduces T-cell CNS infiltration and inflammatory cytokines
38139072.conclusion_quote: Using PEPITEM alleviated the severity of the symptoms in the EAE model.
38139072.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, PEPITEM given after symptoms began reduced disease severity, immune cell entry into the nervous system, and myelin damage.

36446612.conclusion_quote: However, differential gene expression analysis presented more transcriptomic alterations on the venous side of the axis, suggesting a prominent role of venous ECs in neuroinflammation.
36446612.summary: In mice with EAE, sequencing of individual cells from brain blood vessels showed venous endothelial cells change most during inflammation, suggesting they help immune cells enter the brain.

37734623.mechanism: Increases glutamate clearance, reducing neuron excitotoxicity
37734623.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our study highlights the neuroprotective role of glutamate transporters in the EAE retina and provides a characterization of tonic glutamate-currents of αRGCs.
37734623.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, boosting the glutamate transporter GLAST in the retina protected retinal nerve cells from degeneration.

37371605.mechanism: Blocks CCR5, reducing Notch and NF-κB inflammatory signaling
37371605.conclusion_quote: This study showed that DAPTA has significant neuroprotective potential in EAE via the downregulation of inflammatory mediators and NF-κB/Notch signaling.
37371605.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the CCR5 blocker DAPTA reduced inflammatory signals and Notch and NF-κB pathway activity, suggesting neuroprotection.

38067113.mechanism: Not applicable: no treatment or genetic change tested
