33918331.conclusion_quote: Although over-the-counter availability of citicoline may impede its formal translation to the clinic of MS, evaluation of its efficacy for supporting remyelination in this disease is strongly indicated.
33918331.summary: This review describes citicoline, a neuroprotective drug that improved outcomes in mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced myelin damage, and argues it should be tested for myelin repair in people with MS.

33083995.mechanism: Suppresses glial activation and p38-driven TNF-alpha production
33083995.conclusion_quote: We conclude that GJG attenuates inflammation of the CNS by suppressing glial cell activation, followed by a decrease in the production of TNF-α via p38-TNF signaling.
33083995.summary: In mice with EAE and in MPTP-treated Parkinson's mice, a traditional Japanese herbal medicine calmed brain immune cells, reduced TNF inflammation signals, and eased disease symptoms.

33553777.mechanism: Not applicable, measures kynurenic acid levels only
33553777.conclusion_quote: This is the first evidence of marked reduction in KYNA levels in a non-immune mediated model of MS.
33553777.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that causes myelin loss, researchers found kynurenic acid levels dropped in brain and blood, suggesting tryptophan pathway involvement in MS.

34616106.mechanism: suppresses Th17 cell differentiation and IL-17A production
34616106.conclusion_quote: The results suggest that nobiletin attenuates experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis severity through modulation of Th17 cell differentiation.
34616106.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, oral nobiletin, a citrus flavonoid, reduced disease severity and lowered inflammatory IL-17A production by blocking Th17 cell development.

33992861.mechanism: Inhibits glutamate release to reduce excitotoxicity
33992861.conclusion_quote: Prophylactic+chronic RIL reduced the presence of inflammatory infiltrates, altered GFAP and Foxp3, and attenuated disease severity.
33992861.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, oral riluzole given before disease onset reduced immune cell infiltration and the severity of symptoms.

33704933.conclusion_quote: A high QSM signal outlining the lesion rim but not punctate signal in the center is a biomarker for chronic inflammation in white matter lesions.
33704933.summary: Brain slices from people with MS and human stem cell derived microglia were studied, showing a bright MRI rim signal marks chronic inflammation.

34745138.mechanism: Not applicable, describes an imaging method
34745138.conclusion_quote: We present a semi-automatic step-by-step protocol with a balance between fast data evaluation and adequate accuracy, which is optimized by the option to manually adapt the contrast threshold.
34745138.summary: Researchers developed an automated retinal imaging method that tracks microglia in mice with EAE, distinguishing sick animals from healthy ones using cell counts and microglial area.

34428306.conclusion_quote: Irisin may be involved in the pathological process of MS/EAE.
34428306.summary: Researchers measured irisin, a hormone released by muscle, in blood and spinal fluid of people with multiple sclerosis and in mice with EAE, finding levels that changed as disease progressed.

34870897.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease induction method
34870897.conclusion_quote: This article details the materials and methods required for both active induction and adoptive transfer of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) in the SJL mouse strain using intact proteins or peptides from the two major myelin proteins: proteolipid protein (PLP) and myelin basic protein (MBP).
34870897.summary: This methods guide explains how to trigger EAE, a mouse model of MS, using myelin proteins or peptides in SJL and C57BL/6 mice.

33568552.mechanism: describes splicing control of IL7R exon 6
33568552.conclusion_quote: These observations provide the first explanation for the stronger silencing of IL7R exon 6 with the disease-associated C allele at rs6897932.
33568552.summary: Using human cells and primate samples, researchers found that the protein U2AF2 binds the IL7R gene and silences exon 6 more strongly with an MS-linked genetic variant.

33804060.mechanism: Methods protocol for isolating brain cell types, not a treatment
33804060.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this new protocol for the simultaneous isolation of all major CNS-resident cell types from one CNS offers a sophisticated and comprehensive way to investigate complex cellular networks ex vivo and simultaneously reduce mice numbers to be sacrificed.
33804060.summary: This paper describes a method to separate all main brain cell types from healthy and EAE mice, the animal model of MS, using one brain and spinal cord sample.

33549942.mechanism: Altered light cycle raises corticosterone, suppressing immune response
33549942.conclusion_quote: Upregulation of internal steroid secretion might act as an immunosuppressive and ameliorate EAE.
33549942.summary: In mice with EAE, housing them under constant light or constant dark instead of a 12-hour cycle raised corticosterone levels and eased disease symptoms.

34663621.mechanism: Deleting DOCK8 limits migratory dendritic cell T-cell priming
34663621.conclusion_quote: Therefore, our data suggest that limiting migratory DCs through DOCK8 deletion and possibly other mechanisms could limit the development of CNS autoimmunity.
34663621.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting DOCK8 from dendritic cells reduced disease by limiting migratory immune cells that activate harmful T cells.

34487221.mechanism: Removing C3 from astrocytes reduces ganglion cell loss
34487221.conclusion_quote: These data implicate astrocyte C3 expression as a critical mediator of retinal neuronal pathology in EAE and MS, and are consistent with recent studies showing C3 gene variants are associated with faster rates of retinal neurodegeneration in human disease.
34487221.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the complement gene C3 from astrocytes protected retinal nerve cells from loss, suggesting astrocyte C3 drives nerve damage in MS.

33940233.mechanism: modulates S1P1 receptor, shifting Th1/Th17/Treg balance
33940233.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that ponesimod modulates the Th1/Th17/Treg balance and regulates the mTOR pathway.
33940233.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug ponesimod reduced disease and inflammation by balancing several types of immune T cells.

33489124.mechanism: Activates kappa opioid receptors, reducing inflammation
33489124.conclusion_quote: Overall, our findings support the potential of nalfurafine to promote recovery and remyelination and highlight its promise for clinical use in MS.
33489124.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, the drug nalfurafine reduced immune cell entry into the brain and promoted myelin repair, with better results than U50,488.

34127819.mechanism: Delivers self-antigen to MHCII molecules, inducing antigen-specific tolerance
34127819.conclusion_quote: This approach may represent a means of treating autoimmune conditions.
34127819.summary: In mice with EAE, a nanobody carrying a self-antigen to immune presenting molecules induced lasting protection, and with dexamethasone it halted established disease.

34099564.mechanism: inhibits autophagy, reducing mitochondrial clearance and improving myelination
34099564.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that autophagy has a causal role in MS; its inhibition strongly attenuates behavioral signs in an experimental model of the disease.
34099564.summary: In an experimental cuprizone model of MS, the antipsychotic drugs haloperidol and clozapine, which block autophagy, improved motor impairment.

33953734.summary: This correction notice fixes errors in an animal model of multiple sclerosis study and reports no new experiments.

34134453.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that miR-25-3p expression is likely induced by inflammatory mediators during autoimmune neuroinflammation.
34134453.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, levels of the microRNA miR-25-3p rose with inflammation, while its target genes Pten and Klf4 dropped.

34497486.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that multifrequency MRE is sensitive to differentiate between local inflammatory processes with a strong immune cell infiltrate that lead to VSOP accumulation, from disseminated inflammation and BBB leakage visualized by GBCA.
34497486.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, elasticity imaging detected brain softening and distinguished immune cell buildup from general barrier leakage.

34768809.conclusion_quote: These alleles demonstrated pleiotropy and epigenetic (miRNA) regulation in long-term TMEV infection, with particular relevance for resilient mouse strains.
34768809.summary: In genetically diverse mice infected with a virus that causes demyelination, researchers found three response types, including a resilient group, and identified candidate genes linked to how mice responded over time.

33902624.mechanism: Allosterically activates α7 nicotinic receptor, reducing pro-inflammatory cytoki
33902624.conclusion_quote: Our results show that GAT107 can be a useful molecule for harnessing the cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway for long-lasting and wide-ranging modulation and downregulation of neuroinflammation in EAE.
33902624.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the drug GAT107 activated the α7 receptor, cutting disease severity by 70 percent and lowering inflammation.

34363030.mechanism: circRNA sponges miR-30a to promote Th17 cell differentiation
34363030.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that circINPP4B plays an important role in promoting Th17 differentiation and progression of EAE by targeting miR-30a, which provides a potential diagnostic and therapeutic target for Th17-mediated MS.
34363030.summary: Silencing a circular RNA called circINPP4B in mice with EAE reduced Th17 immune cell formation, lessened spinal cord demyelination, and eased disease severity.

34799634.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these data suggest that demyelinating disease pathology is modelled more effectively with cuprizone pellets than powder at 3 weeks.
34799634.summary: In mice fed a cuprizone diet, pellet feed caused more demyelinating damage than powder feed after three weeks, with only pellets producing detectable demyelination.

33595155.mechanism: Blocks CXCR7, cutting immune entry, aiding oligodendrocyte maturation
33595155.conclusion_quote: These results provide evidence that ACT-1004-1239 both reduces neuroinflammation and enhances myelin repair substantiating the rationale to explore its therapeutic potential in a clinical setting.
33595155.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, an oral CXCR7 blocker reduced immune attacks and increased myelin-producing cells, supporting further study in patients.

33765502.mechanism: No treatment tested, compares EAE immunization methods
33765502.conclusion_quote: This CFA-free EAE is a reliable multiple sclerosis model.
33765502.summary: In Dark Agouti rats with EAE, leaving out Freund's adjuvant caused earlier signs and higher clinical scores than the standard method.

33558376.conclusion_quote: This disease-suppressing CD8 T cell subpopulation provides better insights into functional regulatory mechanisms, and targeted enhancement of this subset could represent a novel immunotherapeutic approach for MS.
33558376.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers identified a subset of CD8 T cells that suppresses disease and is marked by CXCR3, interferon gamma and interleukin 10 production.

33190849.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest EAE disease severity is governed not only by the degree of CNS infiltration and demyelination, but also by the balance of pro-inflammatory vs. regulatory cell types and their secreted cytokines and chemokines.
33190849.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, males showed stronger immune responses in the spleen but less spinal cord inflammation, yet disease severity matched females.

interventions: IgG Fc fragments bearing regRF epitopes
34731688.mechanism: Stimulates regRF production, lowering CD4 T cells
34731688.conclusion_quote: RegRF is a promising biotarget in MS, and Fc fragments bearing regRF epitopes are a potential therapeutic agent for MS.
34731688.summary: In rats with EAE, an MS-like model, immunization with IgG Fc fragments bearing regRF epitopes boosted regRF antibody production and eased disease symptoms.

34111646.mechanism: induces Th17 cell responses with less injection inflammation
34111646.conclusion_quote: We posit that use of GPs provides an alternative means for inducing EAE that results in comparable disease, but less discomfort to animals.
34111646.summary: Researchers tested glucan particles as a gentler alternative to standard adjuvant for inducing EAE in mice, finding comparable disease with less injection site inflammation.

33313801.mechanism: Reduces monocyte infiltration, promotes regulatory reparative immune phenotypes
33313801.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our new findings in multiple sclerosis and experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis have uncovered a novel regulatory role for Nrg-1β1 early in the disease course and suggest its potential as a specific therapeutic target to ameliorate disease progression and severity.
33313801.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, restoring the protein neuregulin-1 beta 1 delayed symptoms and reduced disease burden, with benefit whether given early or later in disease.

35027891.mechanism: blocks ryanodine receptor calcium release channels
35027891.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates that RyRs play a significant role in EAE pathogenesis and suggests that inhibition of RyRs with low doses of dantrolene may have a protective effect against autoimmunity and inflammation in humans.
35027891.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the RyR inhibitor dantrolene reduced disease severity and spinal cord inflammation, while a mutation that boosts RYR1 activity worsened disease.

33473108.mechanism: Deleting enhancer reduces RORγt expression and Th17 differentiation
33473108.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data highlight a molecular mechanism for the regulation of Th17 differentiation and functions, which may represent a new intervening clue for Th17-related diseases.
33473108.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting a newly found RORγt enhancer, RORCE2, reduced Th17 immune cells and lowered disease severity.

34485270.conclusion_quote: These results show that exosomes secreted by microglia during early TMEV infection contain viral RNA and can activate uninfected bystander CNS cells to promote an inflammatory immune response.
34485270.summary: Researchers found that brain immune cells infected with a virus release tiny vesicles carrying viral RNA that trigger inflammation in nearby healthy cells in mice with TMEV infection, a model of MS.

34400521.mechanism: B-cell CCR6 loss alters germinal centers, not EAE
34400521.conclusion_quote: These data, to our knowledge, provide new information on the role of B cell-intrinsic CCR6 expression in a B cell-dependent model of neuroinflammation.
34400521.summary: In mice with EAE, removing CCR6 from B cells changed the germinal center immune response but did not alter disease symptoms or how the nervous system was damaged.

33629939.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that the use of filter paper placed on the interior floor of empty mouse cages and exposed to soiled bedding is efficient in detecting bacteria, endoparasites, and most of the common mouse viruses included in an animal health monitoring program.
33629939.summary: Tests whether filter paper in mouse cages can detect common infections as well as sentinel mice. This is a lab animal health monitoring study, not about multiple sclerosis.

33482151.mechanism: activates FXR receptor, reduces inflammation, boosts remyelination
33482151.conclusion_quote: Thus, GAA is a novel and potential therapeutic agent that can rescue MS neuroimmune imbalance and remyelination through an FXR receptor-dependent mechanism.
33482151.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination and EAE, ganoderic acid A enhanced myelin repair and improved motor function through the FXR receptor.

34242705.conclusion_quote: This work sheds light on the factors associated with rapid NSC differentiation into glial cells.
34242705.summary: Researchers mapped gene activity changes as human stem cells turn into astrocytes and built a faster method to make these brain support cells within 28 days for MS research.

33528367.conclusion_quote: Many of the other veterinarians at the faculty were sent to Switzerland to obtain further qualification or to obtain the degree of Dr. med. vet. and thus continued the successful cooperation started by Theiler.
33528367.summary: This historical article describes how Arnold Theiler, a veterinarian in South Africa, built a lasting working relationship with Swiss veterinarians. It does not test any treatment for multiple sclerosis.

33781828.mechanism: Blocks JAK1/2 and STAT3, shifting Th17 toward Tregs
33781828.conclusion_quote: Our results show that ruxolitinib may be a promising therapeutic strategy for multiple sclerosis.
33781828.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS-like model, the JAK inhibitor ruxolitinib reduced disease severity and inflammatory Th17 cells while increasing regulatory T cells.

34751406.mechanism: not applicable, no MS treatment tested
34751406.conclusion_quote: These experiments provide unparalleled detail of the molecular mechanisms underpinning Theilovirus protein-stimulated frameshifting.
34751406.summary: Studies how a viral protein triggers ribosome frameshifting in Theiler's virus infected cells. It does not study multiple sclerosis or use an MS model.

34504258.conclusion_quote: This method has been demonstrated to be suitable for its intended use and has been successfully applied to the quantification of low levels of cuprizone in chow formulations.
34504258.summary: This paper describes a laboratory method for measuring small amounts of cuprizone, a chemical used to induce demyelination in mice, in animal feed. No animals or treatments were tested.

33788130.mechanism: inhibits Th1 and Th17 cell differentiation
33788130.conclusion_quote: This research revealed that ADART could be a great promising avenue among current therapies for MS.
33788130.summary: In mice with EAE, a compound derived from artemisinin reduced harmful immune cells and lowered inflammatory signals in the blood and central nervous system.

34415947.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes infection-driven lesions by genetic background
34415947.conclusion_quote: Together, these results indicate that the genetic background influences the type and severity of clinical phenotypes, phenotypic resilience to TMEV, and the lesion distribution across strains.
34415947.summary: In genetically diverse mice infected with Theiler's virus, researchers mapped how brain and spinal cord lesions and symptoms varied by genetic background over 90 days.

34707482.mechanism: Overexpresses NAD+-synthesis enzyme in retinal ganglion cells
34707482.conclusion_quote: Our studies suggest that a different degenerative mechanism than Wallerian degeneration is involved in autoimmune inflammatory axonopathy and that NMNAT2 may not be a major contributor to this mechanism.
34707482.summary: In mice with EAE optic neuritis, boosting the NMNAT2 enzyme in retinal nerve cells did not meaningfully protect vision or nerve cells.

33522362.mechanism: Removes ATG5 from microglia, testing autophagy role in autoimmunity
33522362.conclusion_quote: These data indicate that, basal autophagy, identified to be essential for the survival and function of neuronal cells, is not required to maintain CNS homeostasis if absent in adult microglia and ATG5 expression is dispensable for the development of autoimmune neuroinflammation.
33522362.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the ATG5 gene from microglia did not change brain health, learning, or disease severity, showing it is not essential for autoimmune inflammation.

33931700.mechanism: Vaccine adjuvants trigger innate inflammation without worsening disease
33931700.conclusion_quote: These observations provide evidence for the safety of HPV vaccines.
33931700.summary: In mice with EAE, HPV vaccination did not worsen disease, whereas higher levels of extracellular vesicle miR-451a and high glucose intake did.

33873097.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes metabolic changes
33873097.conclusion_quote: From these findings, it can be concluded that changes in unsaturated fatty acid and tryptophan metabolism contributed to the development of EAE, whereas changes in sphingolipid and tyrosine metabolism, which corresponded to age, were additional risk factors that influenced the incidence and severity of EAE.
33873097.summary: Mice with EAE of two ages showed different plasma metabolic changes, with older mice having stronger changes in tyrosine and sphingolipid pathways.

34639129.conclusion_quote: Thus, multiple endocytic pathways in photoreceptor synapse are differentially affected in early EAE and likely contribute to the observed synapse pathology in early EAE.
34639129.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, retinal photoreceptor synapses showed smaller ribbons, weaker exocytosis, and altered endocytosis, even early in disease.

34231271.conclusion_quote: The exploratory study confirms previous observations in the model and provides an extensive list of new immunologic parameters potentially contributing to different outcomes of viral encephalitis in two mouse strains.
34231271.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's murine virus, the strain prone to demyelination had weaker, delayed early immune responses and failed to clear the virus.

interventions: bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BM-MSCs) transplantation
33319488.mechanism: increases oligodendrocyte lineage cells for myelin regeneration
33319488.conclusion_quote: MSCs treatment can increase cells expression in oligodendrocyte lineage, which laying a solid foundation for myelin regeneration.
33319488.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, transplanted bone marrow stem cells increased oligodendrocyte lineage cells in the brain, supporting possible myelin regeneration.

33321294.mechanism: modulates cytokine levels in serum and brain tissue
33321294.conclusion_quote: However, treatment with the antigen was able to cause a decrease in proinflammatory cytokines (IL-6, IL-17A, and TNF-α) in nervous tissue that could establish a future preventive scenario for myelin damage.
33321294.summary: In mice with EAE, a parasite larval antigen worsened clinical signs and brought earlier onset, yet it lowered inflammatory cytokines in the brain.

34566948.mechanism: Blocks CSF1R signaling, depleting microglia in the CNS
34566948.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate strain-specific effects of the CSF1R-microglia axis in the context of neurotropic viral infection as well as inherent differences in microglial antigen presentation and subsequent T cell crosstalk that contribute to susceptibility to neurotropic picornavirus infection.
34566948.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, blocking the CSF1R pathway to deplete microglia caused fatal brain inflammation in one mouse strain and worsened demyelination in another.

33679788.conclusion_quote: These findings support the notion that a previous exposure to HSV-1 can accelerate and enhance EAE, which suggests a potential contribution of asymptomatic HSV-1 to the onset and severity of MS.
33679788.summary: In mice with EAE, earlier asymptomatic brain infection with herpes simplex virus type 1 led to earlier and more severe disease, suggesting the virus may contribute to MS.

34095120.mechanism: Not applicable: describes an injury model only
34095120.conclusion_quote: We have developed and characterized a lysolecithin injection model in zebrafish that allows us to investigate myelin damage in a living, vertebrate organism.
34095120.summary: Researchers injected lysolecithin into larval zebrafish spinal cords to create a demyelination model and watched damage develop live over time.

34354703.mechanism: Reduces inflammatory cytokines and shifts response toward IL-10
34354703.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these results indicate that DZ is a potent immunomodulator capable of controlling undesired innate and adaptive immune responses, both at the beginning of these responses and also once they have started.
34354703.summary: In mice with EAE, diazepam given before or after symptoms appeared eased disease signs, lowered inflammatory cytokines, and prevented nerve fiber damage.

33035669.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
33035669.conclusion_quote: Overall, these results demonstrate, for the first time experimentally and in vivo, that a computational model learned from simulations can reliably estimate microstructure parameters, including the axonal permeability .
33035669.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, a machine learning MRI model found lower axonal permeability in damaged brain regions.

34589768.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes behavioral changes
34589768.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, testing these additional modalities during EAE helps to unveil other signs and symptoms that could be used to determine the efficacy of a drug or treatment in the modulation of a MS-like behavior.
34589768.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, showed that sex and strain changed muscle strength, balance, pain sensitivity, and social behavior.

33648591.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes neuronal silencing in demyelination
33648591.conclusion_quote: We establish that CA1 neurons projecting demyelinated axons silence their dendritic spines and hibernate in a state that may protect the demyelinated axon and facilitates functional recovery following remyelination.
33648591.summary: In mice given cuprizone to strip myelin from the hippocampus, nerve cell signaling and memory related learning were impaired, and nerve cells went quiet, recovering partly after remyelination.

34938813.mechanism: Shifts gut microbes, lowers spinal inflammatory gene expression
34938813.conclusion_quote: Altogether, FMT may selectively regulate gene expression to improve inflammation and maintain the stability of the intestinal environment in a gut microbiota-dependent manner.
34938813.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, fecal microbiota transplant lowered disease scores and inflammatory gene activity in the spinal cord.

33595783.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes immune changes
33595783.conclusion_quote: Despite some differences in changes in the analyzed parameters, in general, the spontaneous development of EAE in male and female mice occurs to some extent in a comparable way.
33595783.summary: In mice with spontaneous EAE, bone marrow blood cell development, lymphocyte growth, and antibody levels changed over time, with male and female mice showing broadly similar patterns.

33998867.mechanism: Removing CB1 receptor changes IFN-gamma and T-cell responses
33998867.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest a duality to the CB 1 receptor's effects on the peripheral immune response, which varies based on the specific cell types stimulated.
33998867.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CB1 receptor gene worsened disease and had mixed effects on interferon-gamma production by immune cells.

34012440.mechanism: Regulates microglia function, reduces IL-6 release and iron deposition
34012440.conclusion_quote: Clozapine regulates microglial function and attenuates chronic EAE, even in a therapeutic treatment paradigm.
34012440.summary: In mice with chronic EAE, the antipsychotic clozapine reduced clinical signs, demyelination and spinal cord iron buildup, and still helped when started after symptoms began.

34054860.mechanism: Not applicable, descriptive transcriptome profiling only
34054860.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, transcriptome profiling allowed us to identify expression of GPCRs that may contribute to brain (patho)physiology and have diagnostic and therapeutic potential in human microglia.
34054860.summary: Researchers analyzed public gene activity data from human brain microglia, including tissue from people with multiple sclerosis, to map which receptor genes these immune cells express.

33614166.mechanism: Not applicable, commentary on another study
33614166.conclusion_quote: These results warrant further consideration of PKM2 modulators to treat Th17 cell-mediated autoimmunity.
33614166.summary: This commentary discusses a study showing that changing the enzyme PKM2 alters but does not improve disease in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

33868265.mechanism: Removes Nox2 oxidase, lowering oxidative stress and inflammation
33868265.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results provide new insights into the critical functions performed by microglial Nox2 during the EAE pathogenesis, suggesting that Nox2 inhibition may represent an important therapeutic target for MS.
33868265.summary: Mice lacking the Nox2 enzyme had milder experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, with less nerve damage, demyelination, and inflammation in the central nervous system than normal mice.

34924851.conclusion_quote: In this review, we highlight the contributions of the TMEV model to our current understanding of the relationship between viral infection, inflammation, and seizures.
34924851.summary: This review describes how the Theiler's murine encephalomyelitis virus mouse model helps explain how viral infection causes inflammation and seizures.

34312583.summary: This correction notice amends a 2021 study of rat brain demyelination imaging, and it reports no new experiments or results.

34612525.mechanism: blocks CD71 iron uptake, reducing Th17 cell differentiation
34612525.conclusion_quote: In sum, the findings reveal that iron plays a pivotal role in regulating T H 17 cell differentiation and function in autoimmune diseases.
34612525.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody blocking the CD71 iron-entry receptor eased disease and weakened inflammatory Th17 immune cells that need iron to develop.

34693048.conclusion_quote: In vitro measurements of spinal cord bioenergetics show conservation of the mitochondrial function in mice with EAE.
34693048.summary: In mice with EAE, spinal cord oxygen consumption and ATP levels matched healthy controls, suggesting that mitochondrial energy function is largely preserved in this model.

33779783.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results show that in response to meningeal inflammation, microglia acquire two distinct phenotypes that differentially associate with neurodegeneration in the progressive MS cortex.
33779783.summary: In postmortem MS brain tissue and a rat model of chronic meningeal inflammation, microglia developed two distinct phenotypes linked to different patterns of neuron loss and synapse removal.

34089931.conclusion_quote: In summary, lysolecithin supplementation in a diet formulated with soybean oil caused no morphological changes but upregulated a number of genes in the jejunum.
34089931.summary: In broiler chickens, adding lysolecithin to a soybean oil diet did not change intestinal shape but increased expression of 36 genes.

33910137.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease course
33910137.conclusion_quote: Thus, late chronic Biozzi EAE recapitulates essential features of progressive MS, and is suitable for developing disease modifying and regenerative therapies.
33910137.summary: In mice with EAE, chronic disease in Biozzi mice showed relapses, meningeal lymphoid tissue, and a shift from T cell to B cell involvement, resembling progressive MS.

33200288.mechanism: Silences HuR, reducing inflammatory microglia and NF-κB activation
33200288.conclusion_quote: Targeting HuR might represent an innovative and promising perspective to control neurological disturbances in MS patients.
33200288.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, an antisense drug that silences the HuR protein reduced spinal inflammation and improved motor problems and pain.

33713300.mechanism: Antioxidant that reduces oxidative stress in brain
33713300.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that the microinjection of CUR in its synthetic form Lino-CUR significantly ameliorated spatial memory, through the reduction of oxidative stress markers in the brain of studied animals as a rat model of MS.
33713300.summary: In rats with ethidium bromide induced demyelination, curcumin and a linoleic acid curcumin form improved spatial memory and reduced brain oxidative stress.

33916567.conclusion_quote: All data show that IgGs' redox activities can play an important role in the protection of mice from toxic compounds and oxidative stress.
33916567.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, antibodies that oxidize other compounds became more active as disease developed, most strongly after immunization.

34417330.mechanism: Deleting mTOR in precursor cells slows myelin production
34417330.conclusion_quote: Together, our results support the conclusion that mTOR signaling in OPCs is required to overcome the metabolic dysfunction in the cuprizone-demyelinated adult brain.
34417330.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, deleting mTOR from adult oligodendrocyte precursor cells made new myelin thinner and delayed repair, though lesion-based repair was unaffected.

34168483.mechanism: Binds HER2 receptor, cutting brain inflammation
34168483.conclusion_quote: These novel findings show that Herceptin ameliorates the clinical score in EAE mice and are the first to investigate in detail the differential gene expression post-treatment with the drug.
34168483.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the breast cancer drug Herceptin reduced disease severity, inflammation and T cells while increasing myelin repair.

33541127.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, EAE increases inflammatory factor expression and aggravates cardiac dysfunction in male mice compared with female mice, which may contribute to different cardiac outcome in EAE mice.
33541127.summary: In mice with EAE, male mice showed worse heart dysfunction, more inflammation and fibrosis than females, suggesting sex affects cardiac damage in this model.

34818879.mechanism: Reduces paw swelling through anti-inflammatory effect
34818879.conclusion_quote: This research indicates that the MS14 possesses an anti-inflammatory effect after intra-peritoneal administration.
34818879.summary: In rats with formalin-induced paw swelling, a herbal-marine extract called MS14 reduced inflammation, but the model does not represent multiple sclerosis.

34391881.mechanism: shifts microglia from inflammatory M1 to M2 phenotype
34391881.conclusion_quote: Cumulatively, it can be concluded that caloric restriction was able to counteract MS symptoms through alleviating inflammatory responses.
34391881.summary: In mice given the demyelinating drug cuprizone, a calorie-restricted diet reduced myelin loss and improved balance and movement, apparently by calming inflammatory microglia.

32539629.conclusion_quote: Several lines of evidence suggest an association between inflammasome activation and MS.
32539629.summary: This review summarizes studies linking inflammasome activation to multiple sclerosis in animal models and patients, and discusses inflammasome inhibitor drugs.

33253822.conclusion_quote: Here we report that under normal physiological conditions there is a low basal expression of TG2 in the nucleus of neurons, however following EAE or MS, robust induction of cytoplasmic TG2 occurs in most neurons surrounding perivascular lesion sites.
33253822.summary: In rodent models of EAE and in MS tissue, the enzyme TG2 was strongly induced in neurons near lesions and in blood vessel cells. No treatment was tested.

32915417.conclusion_quote: Meanwhile, as a result of oxidative stress enhancement due to stress exposure, oligodendrocyte becomes the main victim indicating the increased level of metabolite ratios.
32915417.summary: In female rats with cuprizone demyelination, prior stress shifted brain metabolite levels measured by MRS, with stressed rats showing higher levels than unstressed demyelinated rats.

34687652.mechanism: Lowers monocyte MHCII, suppressing autoreactive T cell priming
34687652.conclusion_quote: These findings provide a mechanistic link between environmental temperature and neuroinflammation and suggest competition between cold-induced metabolic adaptations and autoimmunity as energetic trade-off beneficial for the immune-mediated diseases.
34687652.summary: In mice with EAE, cold exposure reduced monocyte MHCII, suppressed T cell priming and pathogenicity, and markedly ameliorated disease.

34924956.summary: Correction notice for a study showing cannabidiol resembles antipsychotic drugs in human oligodendrocyte cells exposed to cuprizone.

34177891.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, reducing hippocampal inflammation
34177891.conclusion_quote: These data illustrate a hitherto undescribed complexity of S1PR response to FTY720 in the hippocampus, independent of drug effect on effector immune cells, but simultaneously emphasize the need to explore novel treatment strategies to specifically address mood disorders in MS.
34177891.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug FTY720 reduced inflammation in the hippocampus but did not reduce anxiety-like behavior.

33454553.mechanism: Activates gut mucosal immunity and pro-inflammatory cytokine production
33454553.conclusion_quote: Here we reported that oral administration of MAP activates the mucosal immunity and exacerbates active experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) in C57BL/6J mice, modulating the immune cell traffic from secondary lymphoid organs to central nervous system.
33454553.summary: In mice with EAE, oral doses of heat-killed bacteria linked to MS boosted gut immunity and worsened the disease.

34702761.conclusion_quote: This work highlights both the relevance of identifying highly susceptible patient populations and expands the growing body of literature that host immune status at the time of septic insult is a potent mortality determinant.
34702761.summary: Researchers found that people with multiple sclerosis got sepsis more often, and mice with EAE, a model of MS, died more from sepsis with stronger inflammation.

33189793.conclusion_quote: Reducing the reagent dosages used for EAE induction, without attenuating the disease, can give a truer and less artificial perspective of MS.
33189793.summary: Researchers tested much lower doses of MOG peptide, adjuvant and pertussis toxin in mice with EAE, a model of MS, and still got reliable disease with typical nerve damage.

33468194.mechanism: Blimp1 loss converts Tregs into inflammatory effector cells
33468194.conclusion_quote: Blimp1 is essential for the maintenance of T FR cells and Ab responses in EAE.
33468194.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Blimp1 from regulatory T cells made disease severe and prevented recovery, along with more antibodies and inflammatory immune cells in the brain and spinal cord.

33841391.mechanism: Binds FcγR2B on dendritic cells, weakening antigen presentation to T cells
33841391.conclusion_quote: Ultimately, we perfected and enriched the mechanism studies of CRP in EAE remission, so we are more convinced that CRP plays a key role in protecting against EAE development, which may be a potential therapeutic target for the treatment of MS in human.
33841391.summary: In mice with EAE, a single injection of C-reactive protein reduced harmful Th17 immune responses by weakening dendritic cell antigen presentation through the FcγR2B receptor.

33245604.mechanism: reduces T cell infiltration into the demyelinated brain
33245604.conclusion_quote: Overall, this study provides strong evidence that toxic demyelination is a sufficient trigger for T cells to infiltrate the demyelinated CNS.
33245604.summary: In mice given the copper chelator cuprizone to cause demyelination, laquinimod treatment significantly reduced the number of T cells that entered the central nervous system.

34091810.mechanism: Activates mTOR phosphorylation, promoting OPC differentiation and maturation
34091810.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results demonstrated that pinocembrin promotes OPC differentiation and remyelination through the phosphorylated mTOR pathway, and suggest a novel therapeutic prospect for this natural flavonoid product in treating demyelinating diseases.
34091810.summary: In animal models of EAE and demyelination, pinocembrin, a natural flavonoid, promoted myelin repair and eased disease progression through mTOR signaling.

33724342.mechanism: blocks BTK enzyme, reducing B-cell and myeloid inflammation
33724342.conclusion_quote: We used ultra-high field MRI to identify areas of meningeal inflammation and to track them over time in SJL/J mice with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, and then used this model to identify BTK inhibition as a novel therapeutic approach to target meningeal inflammation.
33724342.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug evobrutinib reduced inflammation over the brain surface seen on MRI scans.

34461265.mechanism: Promotes cholesterol biosynthesis in neural cells
34461265.conclusion_quote: These data identify an important role of VPA in the hippocampal demyelination process and the hippocampal demyelination-related behavior deficit via regulation of cholesterol biosynthesis, which provides new insights into the mechanisms of VPA as a protective agent against CNS demyelination.
34461265.summary: In a mouse cuprizone model of demyelination, valproic acid reduced hippocampal myelin loss and anxiety-like behavior by boosting cholesterol production.

34481107.mechanism: Gene deletion alters peripheral T cell physiology
34481107.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings indicate that LXR isoforms play functionally non-redundant roles in autoimmunity, potentially having broad implications for the development of LXR-based therapeutic strategies aimed at dampening autoimmunity and neuroinflammation.
34481107.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the LXR beta gene reduced disease severity by changing T cells, while removing the LXR alpha gene made disease worse.

33589594.mechanism: Blocks RGMa, reducing neuron loss and microglial inflammation
33589594.conclusion_quote: Our observations suggest that the upregulation of RGMa is associated with the PD pathology; furthermore, inhibitory RGMa antibodies are a potential therapeutic option.
33589594.summary: In mice given the neurotoxin MPTP to mimic Parkinson's disease, an antibody blocking RGMa protected dopamine neurons and reduced brain inflammation.

33184094.mechanism: Not applicable, literature-based drug selection process
33184094.conclusion_quote: We report a standardised approach for the identification of candidate drugs for repurposing in the treatment of progressive MS.
33184094.summary: This paper reviewed published studies and expert input to shortlist licensed drugs for possible testing in people with progressive multiple sclerosis, without testing any drug itself.

34145920.mechanism: Removing EBI2 receptor signalling slows myelin recovery
34145920.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings demonstrate the involvement of EBI2 signalling in the recovery from demyelination rather than in demyelination and as such warrant further research into the role of EBI2 in remyelination.
34145920.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, removing the EBI2 gene slowed myelin recovery, while human MS brain lesions showed EBI2 in glial cells.

34742744.conclusion_quote: Taken together, pharmacological compound or drug-induced defective EB development from hiPSCs could potentially be used as a suitable in vitro platform for embryotoxicity screening.
34742744.summary: Human stem-cell clumps were exposed to four common drugs to test embryo toxicity, and multiple sclerosis was mentioned only as a disorder linked to affected genes.

34815397.mechanism: Removing P2Y10 reduces chemokine-driven CD4 T cell migration and RhoA activation
34815397.conclusion_quote: Taken together, P2Y10 mediates RhoA activation in CD4 T cells in response to auto-/paracrine-acting mediators such as LysoPS and ATP, thereby facilitating chemokine-induced migration and, consecutively, T cell-mediated diseases.
34815397.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the P2Y10 receptor from CD4 T cells reduced disease severity by limiting how well these immune cells migrate.

32372528.conclusion_quote: Our results show that translational touchscreen operant tests and fear conditioning paradigms can reliably detect cognitive consequences of cuprizone treatment.
32372528.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone, a model of multiple sclerosis, touchscreen and fear tests detected slower responses, more errors and reduced fear memory, plus brain imaging changes.

34305946.mechanism: Blocks TNFR1 signaling, sparing TNFR2 signaling
34305946.conclusion_quote: Collectively, we demonstrate the therapeutic potential of the human TNFR1 antagonist Atrosimab for treatment of chronic inflammatory diseases.
34305946.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the antibody Atrosimab blocks the TNFR1 inflammation receptor while sparing TNFR2, and it improved disease.

33422763.mechanism: activates thyroid receptor-beta, protecting oligodendrocytes from death
33422763.conclusion_quote: Thyromimetics thus might protect against oligodendrocyte death, demyelination and axonal degeneration as well as stimulate remyelination in multiple sclerosis.
33422763.summary: In mice with EAE, thyroid hormone and thyroid-like drugs reduced disease, nerve damage and loss of myelin-producing cells.

33650828.mechanism: Reduces myelin loss and inflammation, mechanism not established
33650828.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest metformin for combination therapy for patients suffering from the myelin degenerative diseases, especially multiple sclerosis; however, additional mechanistic studies are required.
33650828.summary: In mice with lysophosphatidylcholine-induced demyelination of the optic chiasm, metformin reduced myelin loss and inflammation and preserved visual nerve signal conduction.

33212299.mechanism: Selectively degrades antigen-specific antibodies via liver cells
33212299.conclusion_quote: Our results show that Seldegs can ameliorate disease mediated by MOG-specific antibodies and indicate that this approach also has the potential to treat other autoimmune diseases where the specific clearance of antibodies is required.
33212299.summary: In mice with antibody-driven EAE, Seldegs removed only the harmful MOG-specific antibodies and reduced disease severity while leaving other antibodies intact.

34919442.conclusion_quote: These studies demonstrate that VelociT mice mount clinically relevant T cell responses to both MHC-I– and MHC-II–restricted antigens, providing a powerful new model for analyzing T cell function in human disease.
34919442.summary: Mice with humanized T cell immune genes mounted normal immune responses, could develop EAE, a mouse model of MS, and helped identify a human tumor-targeting T cell receptor.

34009357.mechanism: Enzyme inserts artificial 7-deazaguanine analogues into tRNA
34009357.conclusion_quote: Our data highlight the broad scope and therapeutic potential of exploiting the queuosine incorporation pathway to intentionally engineer chemical diversity into the transfer RNA anticodon.
34009357.summary: Lab study of the purified human enzyme showed it accepts many artificial molecules but inserts them only into specific transfer RNAs, and no MS models were used.

33972740.mechanism: Covalently binds NLRP3, blocking its interaction with NEK7
33972740.conclusion_quote: Thus, our study identifies RRx-001 as a new potential therapeutic agent for NLRP3-driven diseases.
33972740.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug RRx-001 reduced inflammation by blocking the NLRP3 inflammasome, an immune alarm system that drives harmful swelling.

34323699.mechanism: Activates AMPK, reducing lipid peroxidation and improving neuronal activity
34323699.conclusion_quote: These observations show that increase of neuronal activity, sensory-motor coordination, and improvement of spatial memory in MS rats treated with Met appears via an increment of AMPK.
34323699.summary: In rats with ethidium bromide-induced MS-like damage to the hippocampus, metformin improved spatial memory, restored brain cell firing, and reduced lipid peroxidation.

34274854.mechanism: Blocks CSF1R, reducing microglia and increasing oligodendrocytes
34274854.conclusion_quote: According to the results, the administration of PLX for 21 days enhanced remyelination by increasing oligodendrocytes in the chronic demyelination model.
34274854.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to demyelinate their brains, a CSF1R inhibitor that removes microglia for 21 days improved myelin repair and increased oligodendrocytes.

34100385.conclusion_quote: Using noninvasive in vivo retinal imaging of experimental autoimmune encephalitis (EAE) in CX3CR1GFP/+-knock-in mice followed by transcriptional profiling, we are able to show 2 distinct waves separated by a marked reduction in the number of innate immune cells and change in cell morphology.
34100385.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, retinal imaging showed two waves of innate immune cell activity, with the first wave linked to loss of nerve cells.

34831386.conclusion_quote: Most importantly, BASHY's presence was also found within demyelinated areas of EAE mice, essentially co-localizing with lesion-associated Iba1 + cells, evidencing BASHY's potential for the in vivo bioimaging of myelin clearance and myelin-carrying microglia in regions of active demyelination.
34831386.summary: A fluorescent dye that binds fatty myelin debris labeled microglia clearing myelin in mice with EAE and in laboratory grown brain tissue, supporting imaging of demyelination.

32268825.mechanism: Loss of PIK3C3 impairs T cell metabolism and activity
32268825.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our studies have revealed a critical role of PIK3C3 in T cell metabolism and the pathogenicity of these cells during EAE.
32268825.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Pik3c3 in T cells reduced their metabolism and harmful autoimmune activity, making the animals resistant to disease.

33724064.mechanism: Not applicable, imaging study of demyelination and remyelination
33724064.conclusion_quote: Significant amide proton transfer-weighted (APT w ) metric changes coupled with the histologic characteristics of the demyelination and remyelination processes indicate the potential usefulness of APT w 7-T MRI to monitor earlier myelination processes.
33724064.summary: In rats given cuprizone to induce demyelination, a 7 tesla MRI technique detected amide proton signal changes that tracked myelin loss and early repair in the corpus callosum.

33836594.conclusion_quote: Overall, our results indicate that granzyme B-expressing Eomes + T helper cells are involved in the pathogenesis of SPMS, with significant implications for SPMS biomarkers and therapeutic targets.
33836594.summary: Study of people with secondary progressive MS found a cytotoxic helper T cell type increased in blood and brain, which may predict disease worsening.

33735314.mechanism: Lacking arginase 2 reduces inflammation and nerve damage
33735314.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate a critical involvement of arginase 2 in mediating neuroinflammation in optic neuritis and suggest the potential of A2 blockade as a targeted therapy for MS-induced optic neuritis.
33735314.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the arginase 2 gene reduced immune cell buildup, nerve fiber damage, myelin loss and scarring in the optic nerve.

33454374.conclusion_quote: The results show that muscle activity affects both growth plate and mineralized regions, especially during early embryonic development.
33454374.summary: In mouse embryos lacking skeletal muscles, bone mineralization and growth plate cells were reduced, showing muscle activity shapes early bone formation. This is not an MS study.

33732230.mechanism: Removing microglial PPAR-delta increases axonal injury and tissue loss
33732230.conclusion_quote: Our results therefore suggest that PPAR-δ has an important role in microglia in limiting bystander tissue damage during neuroinflammation.
33732230.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the PPAR-delta gene only in microglia, the brain's immune cells, worsened the disease, nerve fiber damage and brain tissue loss.

34899715.conclusion_quote: The present study provides the first direct in vivo evidence for the role of peripheral EBV infection in CNS pathology, and highlights a unique model to dissect viral mechanisms contributing to the development of MS.
34899715.summary: In rabbits injected with EBV, the virus spread to the brain and spinal cord and triggered inflammatory clusters resembling those seen in multiple sclerosis.

33691111.mechanism: represses pathogenic Th17 cell IFNγ production and disease severity
33691111.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate that male sex chromosomal complement critically regulates Th17 cell pathogenicity.
33691111.summary: In mice with EAE, male Th17 immune cells caused more severe disease than female cells, and the gene Jarid1c helped limit this harm.

34119597.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the novel mouse model induced by the combination of cuprizone and MK-801 showed comprehensive behavioral and neurobiological changes, which might make it a suitable animal model for schizophrenia.
34119597.summary: Researchers combined cuprizone, which damages myelin, with an NMDA receptor blocker in mice to create a possible schizophrenia model showing memory deficits and white matter damage.

33238133.mechanism: Blocks mitochondrial protein synthesis, weakening T cell energy
33238133.conclusion_quote: In accordance, mice lacking mEF-G1 in T cells were protected from experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, demonstrating that this pathway is crucial in maintaining T cell function and pathogenicity.
33238133.summary: In mice with EAE, the antibiotic linezolid and genetic loss of mitochondrial protein synthesis in T cells reduced immune attack by weakening T cell energy production.

34416238.mechanism: modulates Nrf2 and NF-kB signaling, reducing demyelination
34416238.conclusion_quote: TF can to reduce the harmful effects of CPZ by reducing the demyelination and modulating the Nrf2 and NF-kB signaling pathways.
34416238.summary: In mice fed a cuprizone diet to mimic demyelination, trifluoperazine improved motor coordination and reduced myelin damage by modulating Nrf2 and NF-kB pathways.

34006329.mechanism: Removing VISTA alters microglia activation and myelin uptake
34006329.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates that VISTA is involved in microglia function, which likely affects healthy CNS homeostasis and neuroinflammation.
34006329.summary: In mice, deleting VISTA from microglia made them more activated and reduced myelin uptake, but did not change EAE disease progression.

33949123.mechanism: blocks interferon gamma cytokine activity in the brain
33949123.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings reveal synaptic instability and failure to form new synapses after learning as early brain pathology of EAE, which may contribute to cognitive and behavioral deficits seen in autoimmune diseases.
33949123.summary: In mice with spontaneous EAE, brain synapses were unstable and failed to form new connections after motor learning. An antibody blocking interferon gamma reduced synapse loss in the cortex.

33421362.mechanism: Blocks Activin A and ALK4 signaling in T cells, reducing pathogenic Th17 differe
33421362.conclusion_quote: Thus, Activin-A drives pathogenic Th17 cell differentiation, implicating the Activin-A-ALK4-ERK axis as a therapeutic target for Th17 cell-related diseases.
33421362.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Activin A or its receptor ALK4 in T cells reduced the harmful Th17 immune cells that drive inflammation.

34455897.conclusion_quote: These findings indicated that direct exposure to this mixture leads to multiple alterations in T-cell subsets and that these alterations differ between sexes.
34455897.summary: In mice with EAE, drinking water containing a mix of 23 oil and gas chemicals increased disease severity in females but not males.

34925346.mechanism: Binds MET receptor and activates it like HGF
34925346.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these results suggest that engineered RDO24 antibody may be beneficial in multiple sclerosis and possibly other types of inflammatory disorders.
34925346.summary: In mice with EAE, an engineered antibody called RDO24 that activates the MET receptor delayed disease onset, eased early symptoms, and reduced inflammatory immune cell infiltrates.

33667382.mechanism: Blocks ZAK kinase, dampening AKT and mTOR activation
33667382.conclusion_quote: Overall, these findings demonstrate a KU-mediated cytoplasmic DNA-sensing pathway in CD4 + T cells that potentiates aging-related autoimmunity.
33667382.summary: In aged mice with EAE, a newly developed ZAK inhibitor reduced disease by blocking a DNA-sensing pathway that drives T cell activation.

33911034.mechanism: Cleaves latency peptide to activate TGF-β1, promoting Th17 cells
33911034.conclusion_quote: These findings revealed that ADAM9 as a proteinase provides Th17 cells with an ability to activate transforming growth factor β1 and accelerates its differentiation, resulting in aberrant autoimmunity.
33911034.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the ADAM9 gene reduced disease, showing that ADAM9 helps immune cells become inflammatory Th17 cells.

33432356.mechanism: increases mitochondrial gene expression and function
33432356.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these results support the idea of using fumarate-based molecules to treat FA or other mitochondrial diseases.
33432356.summary: In mice modeling Friedreich's ataxia, dimethyl fumarate raised mitochondrial activity and frataxin levels in brain and muscle, though this study is not about multiple sclerosis.

34170374.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease mechanism
34170374.conclusion_quote: Together, our findings identify CA2 as a critical circuit in demyelinated intrahippocampal lesions and memory dysfunctions in MS.
34170374.summary: In MS brain tissue and mice given cuprizone to strip myelin, complement deposits marked lost inhibitory connections in the CA2 hippocampal region, impairing social memory.

34274460.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes microglial dynamics
34274460.conclusion_quote: Profiling of microglia using specific morphological and motility parameters revealed region-specific heterogeneity of microglial responses in the grey matter that might serve as sensitive indicators of progression in CNS demyelinating diseases.
34274460.summary: In a cuprizone-induced demyelination model in mice, researchers tracked microglia across three brain grey matter regions and found distinct regional patterns of activation and movement.

34403862.mechanism: Blocks FoxO1, favoring Treg over Th1 cell differentiation
34403862.conclusion_quote: These data illustrate an important role of FoxO1 signaling in CNS autoimmunity via regulating autoreactive Teff and Treg balance.
34403862.summary: In mice with EAE and in T cells from MS patients, a FoxO1 inhibitor reduced harmful Th1 cells, encouraged regulatory T cells, and made transferred disease-causing cells less harmful.

33277355.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes immune cell aggregation
33277355.conclusion_quote: The present findings suggest that a special immune response develops in the meninges during various neurological pathologies in the CNS, a possible reflection of its immune privileged nature.
33277355.summary: In mice with spinal cord injury, ALS, and EAE, immune cells gather in the protective membranes around the spinal cord, forming structures resembling lymph node clusters.

34218792.mechanism: activates Nrf2 via autophagy and AMPK, degrading Keap1
34218792.conclusion_quote: This study opens future perspectives for phloretin as a therapeutic strategy for neuroinflammatory disorders such as MS.
34218792.summary: In mice with EAE and in macrophage cells, phloretin, an apple flavonoid, reduced inflammation by activating the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway.

34359880.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, dysregulation of TNF and TNF-R1/2 pathways associates with specific clinical/MRI profiles and can be identified at a very early stage in MS patients, at the time of diagnosis, contributing to the prediction of the disease outcome.
34359880.summary: In 122 newly diagnosed MS patients, cerebrospinal fluid levels of TNF and its receptors were raised and linked to disease activity and outcome at diagnosis.

34642824.mechanism: raises muscle carnosine levels, supporting contraction and fatigue resistance
34642824.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, EAE mice display significant, yet time-dependent, muscular alterations, and carnosine intervention does not improve muscle function in EAE.
34642824.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, oral carnosine raised muscle carnosine levels but did not improve muscle strength or function.

34243102.mechanism: not applicable, imaging study without a treatment
34243102.conclusion_quote: Venous alterations are detected before the onset of motor disability in some EAE mice using SWI which may relate to inflammation and/or tissue hypoxia.
34243102.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a special MRI scan detected changes in spinal cord veins often before movement problems began, peaking near maximum disability.

33045061.mechanism: Reduces PI3K-AKT signaling, boosting regulatory T cell suppression
33045061.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate that cell-intrinsic PD-1 restraint of T reg cells is a significant mechanism by which PD-1 inhibitory signals regulate T cell tolerance and autoimmunity.
33045061.summary: In mice with EAE, removing PD-1 only from regulatory T cells made these immune-calming cells suppress inflammation more strongly and lessened the disease.

32986812.mechanism: Prevents NFATc1 SUMOylation, raising IL-2 and Treg expansion
32986812.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these data demonstrate that prevention of NFATc1 SUMOylation fine-tunes T cell responses toward lasting tolerance.
32986812.summary: In mice with EAE, a genetic change that prevents NFATc1 SUMOylation reduced autoimmune disease by boosting regulatory T cells.

33619215.mechanism: Silences retrovirus elements, limiting inflammatory T cell priming
33619215.conclusion_quote: We propose that gene silencing through repressive histone modification by TRIM28 plays a role in maintaining the integrity of precise gene regulation in DCs, which prevents aberrant T cell priming to inflammatory effector T cells.
33619215.summary: In mice with EAE, removing TRIM28 from dendritic cells worsened disease by allowing excess inflammatory T cell activation.

33411696.mechanism: Inhibits STAT3, suppressing Th17 cells and favoring Tregs
33411696.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that selective inhibition of STAT3 by the small molecule LLL12b recalibrates the effector and regulatory arms of CD4+ T responses, representing a potentially clinically translatable therapeutic strategy for MS.
33411696.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug LLL12b, which blocks STAT3, slowed disease progression and relapses by shifting immune cells toward calming Tregs.

34149350.mechanism: activates TLR9 and NOD2 innate immune receptors
34149350.conclusion_quote: This study contributes to an increased understanding of how innate immune responses can play a protective role, which in turn may lead to additional therapeutic strategies for the prevention and treatment of demyelinating pathologies.
34149350.summary: In mice with a focal EAE model of MS-like disease, intrathecal MIS416, a bispecific innate immune stimulant, reduced demyelinating lesions in the corpus callosum.

34077725.mechanism: Dampens Th1 and Th17 T cell effector functions
34077725.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings provide mechanistic insight into LXA 4 -mediated amelioration of neuro-inflammation and highlight the potential clinical application of LXA 4 for MS.
34077725.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the natural lipid lipoxin A4 eased symptoms and reduced immune cell entry into the central nervous system.

34071825.mechanism: no treatment tested, describes IL-16 expression
34071825.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest cytokine IL-16 is closely involved in EAE pathology as evidenced by its increased expression in the glial and infiltrating immune cells, which impacts the recruitment and activation of CD4 + immune cells in the neuroinflammation.
34071825.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, IL-16 levels rose in the brain and spinal cord, mainly in immune cells and support cells of the nervous system.

34021057.mechanism: depletes B cells by targeting CD20 on their surface
34021057.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that, in CNS autoimmune disease, meningeal inflammatory infiltrates may form and persist in the absence of B cells.
34021057.summary: In mice with spontaneous chronic EAE, an anti-CD20 antibody removed meningeal B cells but did not change disease course or stop immune clusters forming.

33811383.mechanism: Activates astrocyte mGluR5, increasing BDNF release aiding myelination
33811383.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the data suggest that the mGluR agonist CHPG may be a potential therapeutic strategy for treating demyelinating diseases and that it works by enhancing the release of BDNF from astrocytes.
33811383.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice, an injected drug called CHPG boosted brain-derived neurotrophic factor and myelin repair and improved behavior by acting on astrocytes.

34193510.conclusion_quote: Compared with manual g -ratio quantification, using MyelTracer produces consistent results across multiple tissues and animal ages, as well as in remyelination after optic nerve crush, and reduces total quantification time by 40-60%.
34193510.summary: Researchers created free software that measures myelin thickness in electron microscope images faster than manual methods, tested in mice with optic nerve injury.

34233173.conclusion_quote: Our results do not favour the use of DMF as treatment for AD.
34233173.summary: In APPPS1 mice, a model of Alzheimer's disease, dimethyl fumarate given before or after onset did not improve memory, amyloid buildup, or brain inflammation.

34052286.mechanism: Not applicable, diagnostic imaging method only
34052286.conclusion_quote: Birefringence imaging provides a rapid, label-free method of analyzing the myelin content and nanostructural status in longitudinal white matter structures, being sensitive to subtle myelin changes that precede overt pathological damage.
34052286.summary: This study used light polarization imaging to detect myelin changes in mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, finding abnormalities before visible myelin loss.

33480101.conclusion_quote: Additionally, mIns and tCho diffusion showed, respectively, strong and moderate correlations with histological measures of astrocytic and microglial area fractions, confirming DW-MRS as a promising tool for specific detection of glial changes under pathological conditions.
33480101.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination and inflammation, a brain scan detected raised myo-inositol and choline diffusion that tracked astrocyte and microglia changes.

33408169.mechanism: Activates AHR in astrocytes, reducing inflammation
33408169.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings suggest that AHR activation by clinically relevant AHR agonists may represent a novel therapeutic approach for the treatment of MS.
33408169.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug laquinimod activated a receptor in astrocytes, calming brain inflammation and easing disease.

33979589.mechanism: removes LDHA, cutting glycolytic ATP and PI3K signaling
33979589.conclusion_quote: Thus, Warburg metabolism augments glycolytic ATP production, fueling a PI3K-centered positive feedback regulatory circuit that drives effector T cell responses.
33979589.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the LDHA enzyme from CD4 T cells reduced disease and weakened the T helper 17 cell response.

33332631.conclusion_quote: The local brain environment proved key in establishing different transcriptional programs in astrocyte subtypes.
33332631.summary: Researchers sorted astrocytes from the forebrain, hindbrain and spinal cord of mice with EAE and found that spinal cord astrocytes showed the strongest inflammatory gene response.

34280479.mechanism: blocks TRPA1 channel and reduces oxidative stress
34280479.conclusion_quote: TRPA1 plays a fundamental role in depression- and anxiety-like behaviors in a PMS-EAE model; thus, it could be a possible pharmacological target for treating these symptoms in PMS.
34280479.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of progressive MS, blocking the TRPA1 channel or giving antioxidants reduced depression and anxiety like behaviors.

33931568.mechanism: blocks BRISC-mediated NLRP3 deubiquitination and activation
33931568.conclusion_quote: Our study validates that posttranslational modification of NLRP3 can be pharmacologically targeted to prevent or treat NLRP3-associated inflammatory diseases.
33931568.summary: In mice, the drug thiolutin blocked the NLRP3 inflammation pathway and eased several inflammatory diseases, including experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, an MS-like model.

34260395.conclusion_quote: Our data add to the recently identified importance of the skin as a storage compartment of sodium and may further represent an important organ for future investigations on salt as a proinflammatory agent driving autoimmune neuroinflammation such as that in MS.
34260395.summary: Mice with EAE and men with relapsing remitting MS had higher skin sodium measured by MRI, while muscle sodium stayed unchanged.

34452891.mechanism: expands Treg cells and reduces Th17 cells
34452891.conclusion_quote: Conclusion Low-dose IL-2 is a potential therapeutic strategy for EAE and MS.
34452891.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, low dose IL-2 treatment eased disease severity by lowering harmful Th17 immune cells and increasing calming Treg cells.

33374005.mechanism: Inhibits NEDD8 activating enzyme, blocking neddylation
33374005.conclusion_quote: Our findings provide novel insights into multiple sclerosis-associated gene regulation unravelling neddylation as a crucial pathway in multiple sclerosis pathogenesis with implications for the development of tailored disease-modifying agents.
33374005.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug called pevonedistat that blocks the NEDD8 enzyme reduced disease severity, after profiling immune cells from people with MS.

34575795.mechanism: Not applicable, infection exposure rather than a treatment
34575795.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our results demonstrate that although C. tropicalis infection reduces the prevalence and severity of EAE, partially due to the sequestration of leukocytes by the inflamed renal tissue, this effect is associated with a poor disease outcome.
34575795.summary: In mice with EAE, a prior Candida tropicalis fungal infection reduced disease prevalence and severity but led to deaths and kidney immune cell buildup.

33621930.mechanism: Deletion reduces T cell adhesion and tissue homing
33621930.conclusion_quote: Our data reveal that HDAC1 controls T cell-mediated autoimmunity via the regulation of CD4 + T cell trafficking into the CNS and intestinal tissues.
33621930.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting HDAC1 from T cells reduced immune cell movement into the brain and gut, protecting the animals from disease.

33557054.mechanism: Chromatin remodeler overexpression boosts Th2 responses
33557054.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our results have identified that modulation of SRG3 function can be applied as one of the options to control AD pathogenesis.
33557054.summary: In mice with atopic dermatitis, extra SRG3 gene activity worsened skin inflammation by boosting allergic immune responses, with no multiple sclerosis model used.

34740381.mechanism: Quenches reactive acrolein aldehyde, reducing inflammation and protein damage
34740381.conclusion_quote: Our results identify carbonyl (particularly acrolein) quenching by carnosine as a therapeutic strategy to counter inflammation and macromolecular damage in MS.
34740381.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS-like model, oral carnosine raised spinal cord levels, reduced harmful acrolein damage, lowered inflammation and eased disease severity.

34740969.mechanism: Plasma membrane targeting near infrared fluorescent probe
34740969.conclusion_quote: Together, this work provides an important tool for high-quality myelin visualization across scales, which may greatly contribute to the study of myelin-related diseases.
34740969.summary: This study developed a near infrared fluorescent probe that lights up myelin in sciatic nerves and brain tissue, and tested it in mice with an MS model.

33814408.mechanism: Regulates myelin synthesis via thyroid-sensitive nuclear receptors
33814408.conclusion_quote: Results of the study show effectiveness of thyroid hormones for myelin and axon protection.
33814408.summary: In rats given cuprizone to damage myelin, thyroid hormones protected myelin and nerve axons, with less damage when thyroid hormone levels were normal rather than low.

33598777.mechanism: blocks PD-1 and PDL1 inhibitory signaling, increasing immune activation
33598777.conclusion_quote: In summary, PD-1 may protect against AP in mice and act as a potential target for the prevention of AP in the future.
33598777.summary: In mice with acute pancreatitis, removing PD-1 or blocking PD-1 and PDL1 with antibodies worsened pancreatic and lung injury and increased inflammatory cytokines.

34827770.mechanism: Emulsifies fats to aid digestion in low-energy diets
34827770.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates that supplementation of LEX to a low-energy diet without added oil improved performance, carcass weight and yield, reduced abdominal fat deposition, and improved intestinal morphology in broiler chickens.
34827770.summary: In broiler chickens fed low-energy diets, a blend of lysolecithin and emulsifiers improved growth, carcass yield, and gut structure. No multiple sclerosis model was used.

33932559.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease mechanism
33932559.conclusion_quote: These results support the hypothesis that chronic microglia/macrophages driven tissue injury represents a key aspect of progressive neurodegeneration and functional decline in MS.
33932559.summary: In mice given a cuprizone diet to cause demyelination, one lesion led to lasting axon damage, immune cell activation and subtle gait changes months later.

34712419.mechanism: blocks LINGO-1, freeing oligodendrocytes to make myelin
34712419.conclusion_quote: These results provide evidence that LINGO-1 antibody can improve remyelination and neurobehavioral deficit.
34712419.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, an antibody blocking LINGO-1 improved myelin repair and motor performance.

34124070.mechanism: suppresses Th17 cells and M1 macrophage polarization
34124070.conclusion_quote: These experiments provided a preliminary theoretical basis for the clinical application of metformin in the treatment of HT.
34124070.summary: In mice with Hashimoto's thyroiditis, metformin reduced thyroid antibodies and lymphocyte infiltration and suppressed Th17 cells and M1 macrophages.

33838256.mechanism: Rho kinase inhibition boosts microglia myelin debris clearance
33838256.conclusion_quote: Our results showed that Fasudil targeted the phagocytic function of microglia, effectively clearing myelin debris produced during pathological process possibly by upregulating TREM2/DAP12 pathway, accompanied by increased expression of BDNF and GDNF.
33838256.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice with demyelination, fasudil helped microglia clear myelin debris and increased neurotrophic factors, supporting oligodendrocyte precursor maturation and myelin repair.

33518672.conclusion_quote: These observations suggest ONO-4641 may delay the onset and progression of type 1 diabetes mellitus.
33518672.summary: In mice prone to type 1 diabetes, an S1P receptor drug prevented diabetes and reduced it after onset, suggesting possible use for this autoimmune disease.

33618261.conclusion_quote: In this work we propose for the first time, a paper-based test strip to analyse Cu 2+ content in sugar cane spirits, which, due to its simplicity, high portability and fast analytical response (3 min), can be easily applied to in situ analyses by producers.
33618261.summary: A smartphone-read paper test strip coated with cuprizone measured copper in sugar cane spirits. This analytical chemistry study used no MS model or human cells.

32620788.mechanism: Fusion protein inhibits T cell and macrophage responses
32620788.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that therapeutic interaction with the ERMAP inhibitory pathway may represent a novel strategy for treating patients with autoimmune disease or cancer.
32620788.summary: In mice with EAE, an animal model of MS, a fusion protein called ERMAP-Ig calmed immune T cells and reduced autoimmune disease.

32882086.mechanism: Inhibits caspase-1 to reduce inflammation and demyelination
32882086.conclusion_quote: Intranasal delivery of an anti-caspase-1 therapy represents a promising therapeutic approach for progressive MS and other neuro-inflammatory diseases.
32882086.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, nasal delivery of the caspase-1 blocker VX-765 reduced inflammation, preserved myelin and nerve fibers, and restored brain glucose use.

33341737.mechanism: Shifts Th17/Treg balance by inhibiting mevalonate synthesis
33341737.conclusion_quote: Thus, our data show the potential anti-inflammatory effect of pitavastatin on the pathogenesis of the experimental neuroinflammation by modulating the Th17/Treg axis.
33341737.summary: In mice with EAE, the cholesterol drug pitavastatin reduced disease severity and inflammation by shifting immune cells toward calming Treg cells and away from inflammatory Th17 cells.

33656113.conclusion_quote: Blood-CSF and blood-brain barrier dysfunctions are an expression of reduced CSF or ISF flow rate.
33656113.summary: This analysis of cerebrospinal fluid protein data argues that barrier dysfunction reflects slower fluid flow rather than leaking barriers, without testing any treatment in animals.

34274431.mechanism: Preserves myelin proteins and modulates glial cell numbers
34274431.conclusion_quote: Treatment with ICA significantly mitigated or abrogated the toxic demyelination of CPZ by preserving MBP and BDNF proteins and modulating the numbers of Ols, OPCs, microglia and astrocytes in the brain of mice.
34274431.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause brain demyelination, the plant flavonoid icariin reduced myelin loss and protected key brain proteins and cell populations.

33876477.mechanism: Reduces IL-17-producing gamma delta T cells
33876477.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, elevated Akkermansia in MS may be a compensatory beneficial response in the MS microbiome.
