31499065.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that this shift towards excitatory signaling is achieved through different mechanisms in males and females.
31499065.summary: In mice with an MS-like disease called EAE, females got motor symptoms earlier than males, and synapse changes differed by sex.

32696738.mechanism: inhibits NF-κB pathway, reducing T-cell proliferation and cytokines
32696738.conclusion_quote: Oridonin can ameliorate EAE by inhibiting the activation of NF-κB signaling pathway, thereby the proliferation and differentiation of T cells and the secretion of inflammatory factors are inhibited.
32696738.summary: In mice with EAE, the natural compound oridonin reduced disease severity and delayed onset by blocking NF-κB signaling in T cells.

33228381.mechanism: sustained ERK1/2 activation increases regulatory B10 cell activation
33228381.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data support the conclusion that sustained ERK1/2 activation in B-cells suppresses immune-mediated demyelination via increasing activation of regulatory B10 cells.
33228381.summary: In mice with EAE, a constantly active MEK1 gene in the myelin-cell lineage and some immune cells reduced disease severity by boosting regulatory B cells.

31755578.conclusion_quote: These findings recapitulate the SG and RBP biology and markers of neurodegeneration in MS tissues and suggest that altered SG and RBP biology contribute to the neurodegeneration in EAE, which might also apply to the pathogenesis of MS.
31755578.summary: In mice with EAE, stress granules formed and the protein hnRNP A1 moved out of nerve cell nuclei, alongside nerve cell loss and more T cells in the spinal cord.

33233304.mechanism: Not applicable, in vitro food digestion model
33233304.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that food emulsion behavior in the human gut may be influenced by the nature of the emulsifier employed, which is important knowledge when creating functional food and beverage products.
33233304.summary: This in vitro study used a simulated digestive model to test how five food emulsifiers affect fat digestion and carotene release, with no MS model involved.

32178525.mechanism: improves lipid digestion and absorption in chick gut
32178525.conclusion_quote: The results of these studies showed that, in contrast to lecithin, lysolecithin was able to significantly improve the digestibility and energy values of feed in young broilers.
32178525.summary: In young broiler chickens, lysolecithin improved fat digestion and feed energy value, unlike lecithin. This poultry nutrition study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

31678601.mechanism: Copper chelation inhibits mitochondrial complex IV
31678601.summary: In mice fed the toxin cuprizone, which causes demyelination, cerebellar Purkinje neurons lost mitochondrial complex IV, an energy producing enzyme.

32214838.mechanism: Blocks B-cell activity, reducing brain inflammation and demyelination
32214838.conclusion_quote: We observed that combinatorial regimens resulted in further reduction of inflammation, T and B cell extravasation into the brains of EAE mice and improved the re-myelination.
32214838.summary: In mice with EAE, rituximab given before disease onset reduced symptoms and brain inflammation, and combining it with other schedules further improved remyelination.

32921392.mechanism: Raises IGF-1 levels in demyelinating lesions
32921392.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that UA might be therapeutically useful for demyelination in MS.
32921392.summary: In mice given cuprizone to induce demyelination, oral ursolic acid reduced myelin loss and motor problems by raising IGF-1 levels.

32351356.mechanism: Enhances vascular integrity and suppresses microglial activation
32351356.conclusion_quote: These findings build on the work of others in demonstrating strong therapeutic potential for APC in the treatment of inflammatory demyelinating disease and suggest that enhancement of vascular integrity and suppression of microglial activation may be important mediators of this protection.
32351356.summary: In mice with EAE, a chronic model of MS, activated protein C slowed disease progression, reduced immune cell infiltration and demyelination, and preserved blood vessel integrity.

33272299.conclusion_quote: NG2 cells acquire a reactive phenotype and proliferate in response to TMEV infection.
33272299.summary: Mice infected with a virus that causes seizures showed reactive NG2 glial cells that multiplied more in the hippocampus, but not in the cortex.

31484905.mechanism: Suppresses AQP4, reducing immune cell entry into CNS
31484905.conclusion_quote: Goreisan prevented the disease activity of EAE by inhibiting the migration of pathogenic cells into the CNS by suppressing the AQP4 expression in the CNS.
31484905.summary: In mice with EAE, an herbal formula called Goreisan reduced disease severity by limiting immune cell entry into the central nervous system.

32453422.mechanism: deletes NKG2D receptor from T cells, reducing inflammatory activity
32453422.conclusion_quote: indicating that NKG2D is an important target for the amelioration of Th1- and Th17-mediated chronic inflammatory diseases.
32453422.summary: In mice with EAE and arthritis, removing the NKG2D receptor from T cells reduced their ability to drive inflammation.

32927995.mechanism: Deletes TrkB receptor from oligodendrocytes, reducing myelin recovery
32927995.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate that following a demyelinating lesion, TrkB in OLGs positively regulates myelin protein expression, myelin itself, and remyelination.
32927995.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing the TrkB receptor from myelin-forming cells worsened myelin loss and delayed myelin recovery.

32697823.mechanism: Removing PKM2 lowers STAT3 activation, reducing Th17 cell differentiation
32697823.conclusion_quote: Thus, PKM2 acts as a critical nonmetabolic regulator that fine-tunes Th17 cell differentiation and function in autoimmune-mediated inflammation.
32697823.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting PKM2 in T cells reduced Th17 cell inflammation and demyelination, easing disease symptoms.

32462797.conclusion_quote: The retraction has been agreed due to major overlap with a previously published article from the same group of authors.
32462797.summary: This retraction notice concerns a study of fasudil and remyelination after cuprizone demyelination, withdrawn due to major overlap with an earlier paper by the same authors.

31634539.mechanism: Scavenges peroxynitrite, suppressing excessive mitophagy and inflammation
31634539.conclusion_quote: Taken together, Acteoside could be a potential therapeutic agent for multiple sclerosis treatment.
31634539.summary: In mice with EAE, a plant compound called Acteoside reduced disease severity and delayed onset by limiting damaging peroxynitrite and excessive mitophagy.

31709534.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings suggest that a combination of subunit displacement and reduced Nrf1 expression may be responsible for c-20S impairment in EAE.
31709534.summary: In mice with EAE, an animal model of MS, standard proteasomes fell in the spinal cord, likely from swapped subunits and reduced Nrf1 signaling.

31571492.mechanism: improves nutrient availability and feed efficiency
31571492.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this study showed that the addition of lysolecithin at levels of 125 g/t and above to broiler diets consistently improved feed efficiency across a range of basal dietary ingredients and fat sources.
31571492.summary: A meta-analysis of 33 broiler chicken trials found that adding lysolecithin to feed improved feed efficiency, with no link to multiple sclerosis.

33297722.conclusion_quote: Together, these data suggest that hippocampal astrocytes from MS+S patients display regional differences in expression of molecules associated with glutamate buffering and water homeostasis that could exacerbate neuronal hyperexcitability.
33297722.summary: Studying postmortem hippocampal tissue from people with MS, with or without seizures, researchers found altered astrocyte water channels and glutamate transporters in the brain region involved in memory.

33191915.conclusion_quote: Thus, broad impairment of antigenic responses, including autoantigens, is a hallmark of sepsis-induced immunoparalysis.
33191915.summary: In mice with EAE, induced sepsis delayed and softened disease by lowering the number of myelin-targeting CD4 T cells and their naive precursors.

31969447.mechanism: Downregulates S1P receptor, suppresses astrocyte NF-κB signaling
31969447.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results demonstrate that intrathecally administered FTY720 attenuates mechanical allodynia in the chronic stage of the CRPS mouse model.
31969447.summary: In a mouse model of chronic complex regional pain syndrome, intrathecal FTY720, a multiple sclerosis drug, reduced pain sensitivity by calming spinal astrocytes.

32111885.mechanism: Reprograms Th17 metabolism, triggering amino acid starvation response
32111885.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that the small molecule FGIN-1-27 can be re-purposed to relieve autoimmunity by metabolic reprogramming of pathogenic Th17 cells.
32111885.summary: In mice with EAE, the anxiety drug FGIN-1-27 reduced harmful Th17 immune cells by changing their metabolism, acting independently of its known target.

32697822.mechanism: Removes STAT3, reducing Th17 proliferation and cytokine production
32697822.conclusion_quote: Thus, early transcriptional roles of STAT3 in developing Th17 cells are later complimented by noncanonical STAT3 functions that sustain pathogenic Th17 cell proliferation and cytokine production.
32697822.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting STAT3 from effector Th17 immune cells made mice resistant to disease, reducing cell growth and inflammatory cytokine production.

32065972.conclusion_quote: This study highlights potentially significant contributions from the oligodendrocyte lineage population concerning the biological integration and long-term functional performance of neural interfacing technology.
32065972.summary: In mice given cuprizone to destroy myelin cells, implanted brain electrodes recorded poorly, suggesting oligodendrocyte loss contributes to device failure.

32971260.mechanism: binds myelin lipids for brain imaging
32971260.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that [ 123 I]21 shows potential as a single photon emission computed tomography probe targeting myelin.
32971260.summary: Researchers tested eight radioactive imaging probes for myelin, finding two bound myelin well in normal mouse brains and one showed lower spinal cord signal in mice with EAE.

33004854.mechanism: Loss of B-cell STAT3 increases pathogenic lymphocytes
33004854.conclusion_quote: Taken together, STAT3 exerts diametrically opposite effects in lymphocytes, with loss of STAT3 in B cells exacerbating uveitis whereas Stat3 deletion in T cells confers protection.
33004854.summary: In mice lacking STAT3 in B cells, experimental autoimmune encephalitis and uveitis became more severe, with more pathogenic T cells and fewer regulatory cells.

32905942.mechanism: Modulates brain lipid composition, normalizing cuprizone-induced lipid changes
32905942.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data suggest that Que may rescue cognitive behavioral changes from CPZ-induced demyelination through modulation of the brain lipidome, providing new insights into the pharmacological mechanism of Que for schizophrenia.
32905942.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, quetiapine improved cognitive impairment and partly restored brain lipid levels that the toxin had disrupted.

31837111.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte lineage cell proliferation and differentiation
31837111.conclusion_quote: Our results support the hypothesis that regardless of the presence of VitD deficiency, treatment with VitD may contribute to remyelination by promoting the proliferation of oligodendrocyte precursor cells.
31837111.summary: In rats with lysolecithin-induced demyelination of the corpus callosum, vitamin D treatment increased stem cell growth, oligodendrocyte cell formation, and myelin repair.

33551721.mechanism: reduces inflammation and protects axons temporarily
33551721.conclusion_quote: Our findings in mice further support that corticosteroid treatment alone is not sufficient to prevent eventual axonal loss in ON, and strongly support the potential of DBSI as an in vivo imaging outcome measure to assess optic nerve pathology.
33551721.summary: In mice with EAE optic neuritis, transient dexamethasone reduced inflammation and protected nerve fibers, but axonal loss matched untreated mice two months later.

32433967.mechanism: transplanted cells differentiate into myelinating oligodendrocytes
32433967.conclusion_quote: These data indicate the ability of transplanted hGPCs to disperse throughout the adult CNS, to broadly myelinate regions of dysmyelination, and also to be recruited as myelinogenic oligodendrocytes later in life, upon demyelination-associated demand.
32433967.summary: In adult shiverer mice and mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, transplanted human glial progenitor cells spread through the brain, formed new myelin, and improved movement and nerve signaling.

33424854.mechanism: Expands and stabilizes regulatory T cells
33424854.conclusion_quote: Mobilized MPPs may thus be worth considering for cell therapy of MS either per se or for enrichment of HSC grafts in autologous bone marrow transplantation already implemented in patients with severe refractory multiple sclerosis.
33424854.summary: In mice with EAE, transferring a small number of mobilized blood progenitor cells expanded protective regulatory T cells and reduced disease and relapse.

32801146.mechanism: removes Reelin, reducing leukocyte adhesion to blood vessels
32801146.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest Reelin depletion as a therapeutic approach with an inherent good safety margin for the treatment of MS and other diseases where leukocyte extravasation is a major driver of pathogenicity.
32801146.summary: In mice with EAE, removing Reelin with an antibody or through gene knockout reduced immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord and lessened neurological symptoms.

32516999.mechanism: Modulates immune and CNS resident cells, reducing inflammation
32516999.conclusion_quote: Overall, our results show a panoramic view of the cellular components that are affect by CQ and provide further evidence that drug repurposing of CQ will be beneficial to MS patients.
32516999.summary: In mice with EAE, chloroquine reduced inflammatory markers in immune cells and changed astrocytes, oligodendrocytes and microglia in the central nervous system.

32143718.mechanism: Perturbs gut bacteria, reducing disease susceptibility
32143718.conclusion_quote: These results reveal that the perturbation of gut bacteria alters disease susceptibility but has minimal impact on the ongoing neurological disease.
32143718.summary: In mice with spontaneous EAE, antibiotics given before disease onset reduced how often disease appeared, but antibiotics started after symptoms began did not meaningfully improve ongoing disease.

33255764.mechanism: Reduces neuroinflammation in microglia and astrocytes
33255764.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that fingolimod, when applied after onset of disease symptoms in an APP/PS1 mouse model, rescues synaptic pathology that is believed to underlie memory deficits in AD mice, and that this beneficial effect is mediated via anti-neuroinflammatory actions of the drug on microglia and astrocytes.
33255764.summary: In an Alzheimer's disease mouse model, the multiple sclerosis drug fingolimod started after symptoms began restored synapses and memory-related brain function by calming brain inflammation.

33235306.conclusion_quote: Overall, our study emphasizes diverse, non-static roles of Tfh cells during autoimmune neuroinflammation.
33235306.summary: In mice with EAE, follicular T helper cell levels in the central nervous system and dura mater rose or fell over the course of disease, depending on mouse strain and model.

32926612.conclusion_quote: The results of this study can be utilized to identify potential myelin-repair mechanisms and in the design of therapeutic strategies to enhance myelin repair.
32926612.summary: In mice with lysolecithin-induced spinal cord demyelination, imaging showed how lipid levels changed at the injury site during damage and later repair.

33437177.mechanism: Regulatory T cells lacking CCR6 reduce disease severity
33437177.conclusion_quote: This observation suggests that CCR6 on Tregs may be a potential target for future therapeutic interventions in MS.
33437177.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, regulatory T cells lacking the CCR6 receptor caused less severe disease, suggesting CCR6 could become a future treatment target.

32750189.mechanism: Promotes oligodendrocyte generation from progenitor and stem cells
32750189.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that DNC has significant beneficial effects in demyelinating conditions, either as mono-therapy or as being paired with transplantation approaches.
32750189.summary: In an animal model of demyelination, a curcumin nanoformulation increased new myelin-forming cells and myelin repair, alone or alongside transplanted stem cells.

32780728.mechanism: reduces microglial nitric oxide and oxidative stress
32780728.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that electroconvulsive therapy targets the CNS innate immune system to reduce neuroinflammation by attenuating microglial neurotoxicity.
32780728.summary: In mice with chronic relapsing EAE, electroconvulsive seizures reduced spinal immune cell infiltration, nerve damage, and clinical decline by calming brain microglia.

33488389.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, reducing lymphocyte trafficking
33488389.conclusion_quote: These results, contrasting with those of previous studies of fingolimod in experimental ICH, emphasize the importance of rigorous testing of this agent in models more representative of the clinical situation.
33488389.summary: In mice with brain bleeds, fingolimod given after injury did not improve movement tests or brain damage measures at two weeks.

32846891.mechanism: No treatment tested, observational gene expression study
32846891.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that astrocytes and microglia responses to autoimmune demyelination involve alterations in the expression of multiple endocannabinoid signaling-associated genes and suggest that this system may regulate the induction of neurotoxic and pro-inflammatory transcriptional programs in both cell types during MS.
32846891.summary: In female mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers measured endocannabinoid signaling gene activity in astrocytes and microglia, finding widespread changes during disease.

33250722.mechanism: Reduces microglial activation and proinflammatory cytokine levels
33250722.conclusion_quote: These data provided experimental evidence for the beneficial effects of deep rTMS in CPZ-fed mice and revealed a neurobiological mechanism of the modality.
33250722.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to model demyelination, deep magnetic brain stimulation reduced behavior problems, myelin loss, and brain inflammation by calming microglia.

32272486.mechanism: Describes protein changes without testing any treatment
32272486.conclusion_quote: Proteomic analysis seems more informative for remyelination than demyelination in the cuprizone model.
32272486.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, researchers mapped protein changes in the brain's corpus callosum during demyelination and recovery, finding remyelination revealed more informative protein patterns.

33291536.conclusion_quote: Our study is the first to provide evidence that the STING/IFN-β-axis is downregulated in RRMS patients, meriting further intensified research to understand its role in the pathophysiology of MS and potential translational applications.
33291536.summary: In mice with EAE and in people with relapsing remitting MS, the STING interferon beta pathway was found to be lower in patients during active disease phases.

33240262.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates CD137 expression by activated B cells, enhancement of the inflammatory activity of B cells upon CD137 engagement, and provides evidence for a pathogenic role of CD137 + B cells in MS.
33240262.summary: This study examined CD137 on immune cells in MS brain tissue and in lab-grown human B cells, finding that CD137 boosts B cell inflammatory signals.

33193325.conclusion_quote: Taken together, PSA responding cells display an unusual mixture of pro-inflammatory cytokines and anti-inflammatory surface receptors, consistent with the ability to both cause and inhibit inflammatory disease.
33193325.summary: In mice and immune cells, a gut bacterial sugar triggered a mix of inflammatory signals and checkpoint markers, rather than testing any treatment for MS.

32484801.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, reducing macrophage phagocytosis
32484801.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that FTY720 reactivates cryptococcosis from the granuloma through a S1P receptor 3-mediated mechanism and support the rationale for development of more-specific receptor modulators for therapeutic use of MS.
32484801.summary: In mice infected with cryptococcus, the MS drug FTY720 worsened fungal infection by acting on S1P receptor 3 on macrophages, unlike the more selective BAF312.

32388861.mechanism: depletes lymphocytes then drives repopulation by new and double-negative T cells
32388861.conclusion_quote: Thus, the rapid repopulation of lymphocytes from central lymphoid organs post anti-CD52 may limit further disease.
32388861.summary: In mice with EAE, an anti-CD52 antibody depleted immune cells, and the immune system then regenerated with newly made T cells and double negative T cells, which helped limit disease.

31934627.mechanism: Blocks glutamate-driven calcium influx in oligodendrocytes
31934627.conclusion_quote: These data link AMPAR signaling in mature oligodendrocytes to the pathophysiology of myelinated axons, demonstrating glutamate regulation as a potential neuroprotective strategy in MS.
31934627.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the GluA4 glutamate receptor from mature myelin-making cells reduced loss of myelinated nerve fibers and lessened disease.

32532336.conclusion_quote: Taken together, we illustrate the histological basis for the MRI-driven network responses to demyelination, where increased modularity leads to evolving damage and abnormal behavior in MS.
32532336.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to induce demyelination, MRI brain network changes tracked myelin loss and recovery and linked to memory and anxiety problems.

33389890.conclusion_quote: I briefly outline different aspects of immune principles related to the immune response to a self-antigen myelin basic protein (MBP) that induces experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a prototype for multiple sclerosis, and how a coordinated interactive network of regulatory T cells (Tregs) CD4+ (CD4 Tregs) and CD8+ (CD8 Tregs) control the anti-MBP response to maintain immune homeostasis.
33389890.summary: This personal review describes how regulatory T cells control immune responses to myelin protein in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model of multiple sclerosis.

32799373.conclusion_quote: Therefore, Ca 2+ signals may mediate a rapid astroglial response to the autoreactive immune cells in their local environment.
32799373.summary: In rats with EAE, immune cells from the central nervous system triggered calcium rises in astrocytes by releasing ATP, acting mainly through the P2X7 receptor.

32714402.mechanism: enhances TAM receptor expression to clear myelin debris
32714402.conclusion_quote: Overall, our data demonstrate that electroacupuncture could mitigate the progression of demyelination by enhancing the TAM receptor expression to facilitate the clearance of myelin debris.
32714402.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, electroacupuncture improved motor coordination and myelin repair by increasing the Axl and MerTK receptors that help clear myelin debris.

32091410.mechanism: Blocks cholesterol synthesis needed for Th17 cell differentiation
32091410.conclusion_quote: This work demonstrates that PRMT5 expression in recently activated T cells is necessary for the cholesterol biosynthesis metabolic gene expression program that generates RORγt agonistic activity and promotes Th17 differentiation and EAE.
32091410.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the PRMT5 gene from helper T cells reduced cholesterol production and Th17 cell formation, protecting mice from disease.

31761564.mechanism: Activates PKM2 to curb T cell glycolysis
31761564.conclusion_quote: Overall, our results suggest that pharmacological targeting of PKM2 may represent a valuable therapeutic approach in T cell-mediated inflammation and autoimmunity.
31761564.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug called TEPP-46 that activates the PKM2 enzyme reduced harmful T cell activity and eased disease symptoms.

32149735.mechanism: Blocks Ang2, cutting leukocyte entry and microglial inflammation
32149735.conclusion_quote: Thus, Ang2 targeting may serve as a therapeutic option for the treatment of CNS autoimmune disease.
32149735.summary: In mice with EAE, antibodies that block the Ang2 protein reduced immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord, limiting demyelination and protecting the blood-brain barrier.

32294406.mechanism: Removing IGF1R from T cells reduces Th17 inflammation
32294406.conclusion_quote: Thus, the IGF system represents a previously unappreciated pathway by which type 3 immunity is modulated and immune-mediated pathogenesis controlled.
32294406.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, removing the IGF1R receptor from T cells prevented full disease, showing IGF signaling drives inflammatory Th17 cells.

32236600.conclusion_quote: The authors regret this error in the presentation of these addresses, and apologize for any inconvenience caused.
32236600.summary: This is a correction notice fixing author affiliation addresses in a 2019 study of tuftsin in mice with EAE, not a new study.

32184341.mechanism: shifts B cells toward regulatory, less inflammatory activity
32184341.conclusion_quote: GA immune modulates B-cell function in EAE and MS and efficiently interferes with pathogenic B cell-T cell interaction.
32184341.summary: In people with MS and in mice with EAE, glatiramer acetate calmed inflammatory B cells and encouraged regulatory T cells, which may reduce harmful immune activity.

32335359.mechanism: Releases carbon monoxide and activates Nrf2 antioxidant pathway
32335359.conclusion_quote: Our results clearly confirm that HYCOs possess a dual mode of action highlighting the notion that simultaneous Nrf2 targeting and CO delivery could be a clinically relevant application to combat inflammation.
32335359.summary: In a mouse model of multiple sclerosis, an oral hybrid molecule that releases carbon monoxide and activates Nrf2 improved motor problems and reduced inflammation.

32733354.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, we discuss evidence indicating that, in MS patients, inflammatory synaptopathy could be present since the early phases, could specifically characterize relapses, and could progressively increase during the disease course.
32733354.summary: This perspective article reviews how brain stimulation measures of excitability may reflect inflammation affecting nerve signaling in multiple sclerosis patients.

33569008.mechanism: activates aryl hydrocarbon receptor, reducing Th17 cells
33569008.conclusion_quote: Together, the current study demonstrates for the first time that tryptamine administration attenuates EAE by activating AHR and suppressing neuroinflammation.
33569008.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, tryptamine reduced paralysis and inflammation by activating a receptor on immune T cells.

32517808.mechanism: Transplanted cells differentiate into glia, supporting oligodendrocyte repair
32517808.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate the applicability of neuroimaging and functional assessments for pre-clinical interventional trials during chronic demyelination and detect improved function from iNSC transplantation.
32517808.summary: In mice with chronic demyelination caused by a cuprizone diet, transplanted induced neural stem cells improved running coordination and increased host oligodendrocytes, though the cells did not form myelin.

32094172.mechanism: Blocks myeloid antigen presentation to myelin reactive T cells
32094172.conclusion_quote: This study identifies a previously unrecognized requisite for myeloid cell STAT3 in the activation of myelin-reactive T cells and suggests myeloid STAT3 as a potential therapeutic target for autoimmune demyelinating disease.
32094172.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Stat3 from myeloid immune cells prevented disease, reduced inflammation and demyelination, and weakened T cell responses against myelin.

32363773.mechanism: Raises SOX10 levels, promoting oligodendrocyte-driven remyelination
32363773.conclusion_quote: Overexpression of Sox10 promotes hippocampal remyelination after CPZ-induced acute demyelination.
32363773.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, boosting the gene Sox10 in the hippocampus improved behavior, restored myelin structure, and promoted remyelination.

31821174.mechanism: Blocks S1P receptor signalling, trapping T cells
31821174.conclusion_quote: We conclude that sustained subpial cortical injury is associated with the capacity for brain-resident T cells to produce Th17 cytokines, and this pathological process occurs in an S1P receptor1,5-dependent manner.
31821174.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug siponimod reduced damage to the outer brain cortex and lowered inflammatory Th17 signals made by T cells in the brain.

31605645.mechanism: Parasite infection reduces arthritis without needing Th2 cytokine signalling
31605645.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that the anti-arthritic effects of Ts do not require host Th2 signals.
31605645.summary: In mice with collagen-induced arthritis, infection with a parasitic worm reduced joint disease even when the STAT6 immune pathway was absent.

33374217.mechanism: Bacterial mimotope activates myelin specific T cells
33374217.conclusion_quote: This study suggests that a unique strain of C. difficile possesses an encephalitogenic mimotope of MBP that activates autoreactive, myelin-specific T cells.
33374217.summary: In mice with EAE, a protein from a C. difficile strain activated myelin specific T cells and caused nerve inflammation after immunization.

32356274.mechanism: blocks ryanodine receptor calcium channel activity
32356274.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest blocking the activity of the ryanodine receptor can attenuate the valvular mineralization caused by LPC.
32356274.summary: In porcine aortic valve cells exposed to an oxidized fat, blocking the ryanodine receptor reduced calcific nodule formation. This study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

32188741.conclusion_quote: Therefore, we hypothesize that Nurr1 is activated in an early phase of the disease as a protective endogenous anti-inflammatory mechanism, although not sufficient to reverse disease progression.
32188741.summary: In mice with an ALS model, the protein Nurr1 rose early in disease, but the study concerns ALS rather than multiple sclerosis and tests no treatment.

32983109.mechanism: Removing CD226 boosts regulatory T cell proliferation
32983109.conclusion_quote: These findings collectively indicate that CD226 is a key molecule regulating the Treg-mediated suppression of autoimmune responses by inhibiting Treg proliferation.
32983109.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CD226 gene reduced disease by increasing regulatory T cells that calm the immune system.

31511643.mechanism: REGγ loss boosts dendritic cell TGF-β1 activation
31511643.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings delineate a previously unknown mechanism by which REGγ-mediated protein degradation in DCs controls the differentiation of Th17 cells and the onset of an experimental autoimmune disease.
31511643.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the REGγ protein made dendritic immune cells drive more harmful Th17 cells and worsened inflammation.

32690659.mechanism: Deleting VHL impairs Th17 differentiation and glycolysis
32690659.conclusion_quote: Unexpectedly, we found that VHL promotes Th17 differentiation.
32690659.summary: In mice lacking VHL in their T cells, EAE was reduced and Th17 inflammatory cell development was impaired, showing VHL promotes these cells.

42960836.mechanism: Activates mitochondrial reductase CYB5R3, which suppresses Notch signaling
42960836.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrates for the first time that modulation of mitochondrial redox signaling promotes neuroregeneration and remyelination without causing severe adverse effects.
42960836.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a compound called furapyrrodole given after disease peak improved motor function and boosted nerve cell and myelin repair.

42782765.mechanism: Loss of IgA worsens inflammation and demyelination
42782765.conclusion_quote: Thus, IgA could play a protective role in the TMEV model in WT mice; IgA deficiency-mediated gut dysbiosis may contribute to enhanced immunopathology in IgA KO mice.
42782765.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a model of MS, removing IgA made neurological signs, inflammation and nerve damage worse.

42136296.mechanism: Suppresses inflammatory cytokines, boosts Tregs and neurotrophic factors
42136296.conclusion_quote: Curcumin appears to be a promising adjunctive therapy for MS, requiring further clinical research to optimize its application in MS care.
42136296.summary: This review summarizes studies suggesting curcumin, a turmeric compound, reduces inflammation and protects nerves in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

42756075.mechanism: limits ROS and NO generation in CD4+CD11bc+ cells
42756075.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these data indicate that beneficial effects of minocycline in EAE is primarily based on its ability to limit the generation of ROS and NO in CNS CD4 + CD11bc + cells and that its overall effect on EAE is Nrf2-independent.
42756075.summary: In mice with EAE, minocycline given at disease peak eased symptoms by limiting harmful reactive oxygen and nitric oxide production in CD4 immune cells, independent of Nrf2.

41875735.mechanism: CB2 receptor signalling reduces microglial neuroinflammation and demyelination
41875735.conclusion_quote: Intranasal EO alleviates EAE symptoms and comorbidities through a CB2-mediated attenuation of neuroinflammation and demyelination.
41875735.summary: In mice with EAE, a nasally delivered cannabis essential oil eased pain, movement problems and mood symptoms, calming brain inflammation through the CB2 receptor.

41456906.mechanism: Intermittent low oxygen promotes remyelination and immune repair
41456906.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal that AIH has comparable, albeit slightly less robust beneficial therapeutic effects in male as was previously shown in female EAE mice.
41456906.summary: In male mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, brief cycles of low oxygen improved clinical scores, reduced inflammation, and increased myelin repair.

41938660.conclusion_quote: Inflammation, damaged mitochondria, hypoxia, and inefficient energy production could exacerbate gray matter pathology in multiple sclerosis.
41938660.summary: In mice with EAE, a multimodal brain imaging study found reduced blood flow and oxygen in the cortex and altered mitochondria, while overall oxygen use stayed normal.

42329180.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte progenitor differentiation into myelinating cells
42329180.conclusion_quote: These findings identify GDF11 as a circulating regulator of oligodendrocyte maturation and CNS myelin formation and repair, highlighting its therapeutic potential for demyelinating diseases.
42329180.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination and EAE, systemic GDF11 helped oligodendrocytes mature and sped up myelin repair, reduced inflammation, and recovery of function.

42879060.conclusion_quote: Leukotriene inhibition may exert pleiotropic effects across both peripheral immune responses and the CNS microenvironment.
42879060.summary: A review of five animal studies testing drugs that block leukotriene inflammation signals in MS models, suggesting possible benefit that still needs human trials.

41517956.mechanism: Binds neurons and protects them from death
41517956.conclusion_quote: This study identified a patient-derived neuron-binding autoantibody that crosses the BBB in mice and reduces neuron loss in a mouse model of MS.
41517956.summary: In mice with EAE, a human antibody from an MS patient crossed the blood-brain barrier, reduced disease severity, and improved neuron survival.

41585377.mechanism: Unfermented fibre triggers gut immune activation and demyelination
41585377.conclusion_quote: The gut microbiota of individuals with paediatric-onset multiple sclerosis showed reduced fibre fermenting properties, and our animal findings suggest that unfermented β-fructans can worsen demyelination and promote gut-brain axis immune activation.
41585377.summary: Germ-free mice with EAE fed unfermented beta fructans, a prebiotic fibre, had worse symptoms, gut immune activation and spinal cord demyelination than mice on a control diet.

41754498.mechanism: Lipid A adjuvant boosts antigen-specific immune responses
41754498.conclusion_quote: Therefore, ALA injections could be safe for use in immune-mediated diseases, whose immunopathology has been associated with IgA and Th17 responses.
41754498.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a model of multiple sclerosis, Alcaligenes lipid A injections did not worsen disease, viral persistence, or IgA and Th17 responses, though gut bacteria shifted.

42102606.mechanism: Blocks SUMOylation, reducing NF-κB inflammatory signaling
42102606.conclusion_quote: The ability of AA to inhibit NF-κB-driven inflammatory response and CNS inflammation after autoreactive T cells are already primed and circulating suggests that AA may have therapeutic potential in established Th1/Th17-mediated inflammatory diseases.
42102606.summary: Anacardic acid, which blocks a protein tagging process called SUMOylation, reduced paralysis and CNS inflammation in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

42936164.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings demonstrate pronounced age- and region-dependent effects of cuprizone and identify the cerebellar nuclei as a sensitive target of demyelination across the lifespan.
42936164.summary: In mice fed the toxin cuprizone, the cerebellar nuclei stayed vulnerable to myelin loss at all ages, while forebrain white matter responded mainly in younger mice.

42422215.mechanism: Removes neuronal MHC I display to CD8 T cells
42422215.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these findings identify neuronal MHC I-dependent antigen presentation as a driver of both the immune surveillance of neuronal antigens and neuronal injury during demyelination.
42422215.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing the MHC I gene β2M from neurons reduced harmful CD8 T cell attacks on neurons and improved clinical disease.

42634171.mechanism: regulates leukocyte trafficking, reduces apoptosis-associated tissue injury
42634171.conclusion_quote: PEPITEM treatment was associated with reduced Annexin V immunoreactivity in EAE spinal cord sections, suggesting reduced apoptosis-associated tissue injury.
42634171.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, PEPITEM reduced markers of cell death in spinal cord tissue when given before or after symptoms began.

41866764.conclusion_quote: Unlike previous rodent studies, these findings indicate that fibrinogen has a lineage-dependent effect, where it may be inhibitory earlier in the lineage while promoting OL function in later stages.
41866764.summary: In human stem cell derived and primary oligodendrocytes, fibrinogen blocked maturation of early cells but boosted myelin wrapping by mature cells, linked to BMP signaling.

41547159.mechanism: Deletion lowers zinc levels, reducing pathogenic Th17 cell survival
41547159.conclusion_quote: ZIP3 is essential for the encephalitogenic function of pTh17 cells and promoting EAE, likely by regulating cytosolic Zn 2+ levels.
41547159.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the zinc transporter ZIP3 from pathogenic Th17 immune cells reduced their survival in the nervous system and lessened disease severity.

42071235.mechanism: Stress granules trap ApoE mRNA, calming microglia
42071235.conclusion_quote: These findings uncover a previously unrecognized neuroprotective mechanism wherein TIA1-mediated SGs in microglia dynamically restrain neuroinflammation via post-transcriptional control of ApoE, revealing a new therapeutic avenue for MS.
42071235.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the TIA1 gene from microglia worsened inflammation, demyelination and disability, suggesting TIA1 normally protects the nervous system.

41187810.mechanism: promotes inflammation resolution and tissue regeneration
41187810.conclusion_quote: RvD1 may serve as a biomarker for both diagnosing GBS and monitoring disease severity.
41187810.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, and EAN, a nerve-inflammation model, resolvin D1 treatment reduced disease severity and autoimmune responses.

42905519.mechanism: removing TCF-1 unleashes pathogenic Th17 conversion
42905519.conclusion_quote: Thus, the TCF-1-E-protein axis sustains TCF-1 expression and prevents pathogenic conversion.
42905519.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the TCF1 gene from interleukin 17 producing immune cells made them lose their protective traits and worsened disease.

41247417.mechanism: reduces MHC-II antigen presentation and shifts microglia toward anti-inflammator
41247417.conclusion_quote: Our data provide mechanistic insight into the immune tolerance induced via systemic administration of 2 different microbial strain antigens in the context of CNS autoimmunity, possibly via the modulation of antigen-presentation via non-myelin peptide-specific mechanisms.
41247417.summary: In mice with EAE, injections of Helicobacter pylori or E coli antigens before disease onset reduced disease incidence and severity by lowering antigen presentation.

42179347.mechanism: Blocks CD4 T cells needed for CD8 infiltration
42179347.conclusion_quote: Our data provide insight into the interplay of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells in CNS autoimmunity.
42179347.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking CD4 T cells stopped CD8 T cells from entering the central nervous system and prevented disease in Tc17 recipients.

42561936.mechanism: ILC2s present myelin antigen to activate T cells
42561936.conclusion_quote: These findings revealed a role of ILC2s in neuroinflammation via instructing myelin-reactive T cells, implying targeting ILC2s may be an avenue to restrict CNS inflammation and autoimmunity.
42561936.summary: In mice with EAE, removing group 2 innate lymphoid cells or their MHC class II gene reduced spinal and brain inflammation and loss of myelin.

42304380.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings establish a human iPSC-derived platform for studying inflammatory neuronal HLA class I antigen presentation and antigen-dependent CD8 + T cell engagement.
42304380.summary: Researchers grew human neural clusters from stem cells and treated them with interferon gamma, finding that neurons can display peptides that activate killer T cells.

42031150.conclusion_quote: Summarized, the upregulation of pro-apoptotic molecules in TMEV-IDD without apoptotic neurons suggests an incomplete apoptosis, while their reduction in EtBr-injected mice may indicate a reversible neuronal damage.
42031150.summary: In mice with lesions caused by a virus or by a toxin, researchers found changes in cell death and nerve signalling proteins, including reduced synaptophysin in both models.

42922362.mechanism: Presents MOG antigen on B cells for tolerance
42922362.conclusion_quote: This work demonstrates the role of polymer properties in B cell binding and outcomes as an antigen-specific therapeutic vaccine.
42922362.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, B cells coated with antigen-loaded acetalated dextran microparticles and transferred into the animals significantly lowered clinical disease scores.

42858944.mechanism: Acts through PPARα receptor to boost hippocampal plasticity
42858944.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that oral GTB may have therapeutic importance for improving hippocampal functions in AD patients.
42858944.summary: In 5xFAD Alzheimer's mice, oral glyceryl tribenzoate improved memory, hippocampal plasticity and reduced plaques, acting through the PPARα receptor.

41111357.mechanism: activates regulatory T and suppressor cells via TLR-4
41111357.conclusion_quote: The results indicate a potential role of Acr1 against autoimmune diseases.
41111357.summary: In mice with EAE, a protein from tuberculosis bacteria expanded suppressive immune cells and regulatory T cells, reduced Th17 inflammatory cells, and prevented disease onset.

41698841.conclusion_quote: Collectively our results suggest that following TMEV infection, microglial response to novel damage signals, as well as the production of proinflammatory cytokines, varies as a function of the brain region.
41698841.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a model of seizures and MS like disease, cortical microglia responded normally to damage signals, while inflammatory cytokines and purinergic receptors varied by brain region.

42270907.conclusion_quote: Nevertheless, none of the sentinel mice exposed to soiled bedding from infected animals exhibited seroconversion, indicating that the viral particles are either present at levels below the minimum infectious dose or represent residual, non-infectious material rather than active, transmission-competent virus.
42270907.summary: Mice injected with Theiler's virus shed viral RNA in feces, but sentinel mice exposed to their bedding did not become infected.

42737576.mechanism: Disrupts Upf1 binding to Gas5, blocking NMD turnover
42737576.conclusion_quote: The study demonstrates the potential of selectively stabilizing NMD-target lncRNA Gas5 levels to alleviate early neurodegenerative pathology in tauopathy.
42737576.summary: In PS19 mice with human mutant tau, intranasal NPC86 stabilized lncRNA Gas5, reducing tau phosphorylation and brain neuroinflammation.

42704518.mechanism: Rho kinase inhibitor shifts astrocytes to repair state
42704518.conclusion_quote: This work identifies FSD as a promising therapeutic candidate for inhibiting demyelination through the regulation of AST polarization via specific signaling mechanism.
42704518.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, the drug fasudil pushed astrocytes toward a repair-supporting state, reducing inflammation and helping myelin recover.

41707920.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes microRNA changes only
41707920.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that miR-155-5p and its targets, are promising candidates for future functional studies aimed to improving both, treatment and diagnosis of virus-induced complications like seizures.
41707920.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a model of MS-like disease, the brain's hippocampus showed raised levels of the microRNA miR-155-5p, which may matter for virus-related seizures.

41549297.mechanism: Preserves LPCAT1 expression, restoring lipid remodeling and insulin secretion
41549297.conclusion_quote: These findings reveal tissue-specific lysolecithin reprogramming in T2DM development and identify LPCAT1-mediated lysolecithin remodeling as a mechanism involved in T2DM-related endothelial and metabolic dysfunction.
41549297.summary: In diabetic mice fed a high-fat diet and given streptozotocin, an orally taken Spirulina-derived peptide called SP6 preserved LPCAT1 levels, insulin secretion and blood sugar control.

42106839.mechanism: Blocks fatty acid beta-oxidation in lung T cells
42106839.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these findings demonstrate that β-oxidation-mediated differentiation of effector CD4⁺ T cells in the lung exacerbates neuroinflammation, highlighting the lung-brain axis as a potential therapeutic target for MS.
42106839.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking fatty acid burning in the lungs reduced disease severity and lowered the number of immune cells reaching the brain.

42309468.mechanism: Releases itaconate, cutting inflammatory cytokines and Th17 cells
42309468.conclusion_quote: Together, this work advances a biomaterials-based strategy that overcomes hurdles to metabolite delivery and expands opportunities for intervention during autoimmunity and inflammation.
42309468.summary: In a mouse model of multiple sclerosis, itaconate-based microparticles released the metabolite, lowered inflammatory signals, and reduced the inflammatory protein IL-6 in the blood.

41077782.mechanism: modulates unfolded protein response stress pathways
41077782.conclusion_quote: Altogether, we show that UPR modulation with C-MANF is a promising new therapeutic approach for treating neuroinflammatory demyelination.
41077782.summary: In mice with autoimmune demyelination, a subcutaneous MANF fragment called C-MANF improved motor recovery, reduced inflammation, and helped oligodendrocytes and myelin recover.

42212231.mechanism: Lower eIF3d reduces integrated stress response activation
42212231.conclusion_quote: These findings demonstrate that eIF3d selectively modulates nociceptive plasticity under defined stress conditions and suggests a context dependent role in the regulation of inflammatory and central pain sensitization.
42212231.summary: In mice with a partial eIF3d gene knockout, pain hypersensitivity was reduced under inflammatory stress, but mice with EAE showed no change in motor signs or pain.

41516369.mechanism: Modulates BDNF and TrkB neurotrophin signaling in striatum
41516369.conclusion_quote: Thus, the effects of fingolimod striatal BDNF-TrkB signaling and motor behavior in HD are complex and vary with disease stage.
41516369.summary: In a Huntington's disease mouse model, fingolimod did not improve movement when given early, and its effects on brain growth-factor signaling depended on disease stage.

41832842.mechanism: Bile acid derivatives, mechanism not described in abstract
41832842.conclusion_quote: Bile acid derivatives, particularly UDCA, are biologically plausible candidates meriting further investigation in the context of MS.
41832842.summary: In an EAE model of MS, UDCA lowered clinical scores at peak and late disease, while obeticholic acid showed only a non-significant trend toward improvement.

42586488.conclusion_quote: Overall, the assay shows high sensitivity to various experimental manipulations, supporting the utility of the terrestrial jumping assay as a fast, low-cost and single-trial behavioral paradigm to assess both motor phenotypes and affective-like responses in zebrafish.
42586488.summary: In adult zebrafish, a terrestrial jumping test detected behavioral changes from drugs, toxins, and predator cues, suggesting a quick tool for studying motor and mood effects.

41185389.mechanism: Blocks PDE4 enzymes, reducing neutrophil activation and infiltration
41185389.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our research provides evidence for a potential role of prophylactic, but not acute PDE4 and PDE4B inhibition in ischemic stroke treatment, especially for patients at risk of recurrent stroke.
41185389.summary: In mice with a simulated stroke, drugs blocking PDE4 and PDE4B before the stroke shrank brain damage and reduced immune cell buildup, while giving them afterward had no effect.

42770133.mechanism: reduces inflammatory cytokines and oxidative stress, protecting myelin
42770133.conclusion_quote: Alcoholic frankincense extract ameliorated EAE-associated inflammation and oxidative stress and exerted a protective effect on myelin integrity, suggesting its potential as a complementary therapeutic approach for MS.
42770133.summary: In mice with EAE, an oral frankincense extract reduced inflammatory signals and oxidative stress, and protected myelin in the brain.

42151131.conclusion_quote: These results provide a cross-model, cross-species atlas of glial states and offer a framework to strategically leverage mouse models to study myelin injury and repair.
42151131.summary: Researchers compared single cell gene activity in two mouse demyelination models with human multiple sclerosis lesions, finding that cuprizone mice show a stressed oligodendrocyte state resembling MS.

41731491.mechanism: activates TREM2 signaling while preserving receptor shedding
41731491.conclusion_quote: Unlike stalk-binding anti-TREM2 agonist antibodies, 03O05 preserves ectodomain shedding, leading to transient receptor activation and increased sTREM2 levels.
41731491.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination and Alzheimer's models, an antibody that activates TREM2 improved microglial clearance, reduced amyloid plaques, and supported myelin repair.

41916480.mechanism: Reduces JNK/Sp1/PAD4 signaling and macrophage extracellular trap formation
41916480.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these findings suggest that quercetin alleviates AS and that suppression of LPC-induced METs formation via modulation of the JNK/Sp1/PAD4 pathway may represent 1 potential mechanism underlying its protective effects.
41916480.summary: In high-fat diet-fed mice and macrophage cells, quercetin reduced harmful macrophage traps and atherosclerotic plaques, suggesting protection against artery disease.

41972458.mechanism: Reduces microglial density and proliferation, preserving myelin
41972458.conclusion_quote: Teriflunomide exerts beneficial effects on myelin preservation and remyelination in an ex vivo demyelination model, potentially through modulation of glial cell dynamics rather than direct effects on oligodendroglial cells.
41972458.summary: In mouse cerebellar brain slice cultures with induced demyelination, the MS drug teriflunomide preserved myelin and improved remyelination, mainly by changing how glial support cells behaved.

41169930.mechanism: Blocks CGRP receptor signaling from pain nerve fibers
41169930.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that targeting peptidergic nociceptors and CGRP signaling, specifically in female patients, may be a viable strategy to relieve and possibly reverse pain in female patients with MS.
41169930.summary: In mice with EAE, a CGRP receptor blocker reversed spontaneous pain in females, who also showed changes in pain-sensing nerve fibers and increased CGRP staining.

38801498.conclusion_quote: We have devised a cryovial culture strategy that enables organoids to be maintained through space travel and onboard the International Space Station (ISS) without the need for medium or carbon dioxide exchange.
38801498.summary: Researchers describe how to grow human brain organoids with immune microglia, including lines from people with multiple sclerosis, and send them to the space station to study microgravity.

41265623.mechanism: Activates STING/TBK1/IRF3 pathway, boosting microglial IFN-beta production
41265623.conclusion_quote: Oxymatrine promotes IFN-β production in microglia by upregulating the STING/TBK1/IRF3 signaling pathway, thereby alleviating the neurological dysfunction of EAE and reducing pathological and inflammatory events.
41265623.summary: In mice with EAE, the natural compound oxymatrine reduced nerve symptoms, demyelination and inflammation by boosting interferon-beta production from brain immune cells called microglia.

39871825.mechanism: blocks estrogen synthesis in lymph nodes
39871825.conclusion_quote: These findings underscore LNs as crucial sites of de novo 17β-estradiol production, potentially contributing to nonremitting EAE phenotypes.
39871825.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking estrogen production in lymph nodes with an aromatase inhibitor caused a nonremitting disease course and loss of gray matter in the spinal cord.

40397883.conclusion_quote: The proposed data-driven algorithm provides a reliable tool for mapping myelin content on preclinical scanners, allowing precise classification between healthy and demyelinated tissues in cuprizone mouse model of multiple sclerosis.
40397883.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, a new MRI analysis method measured myelin content accurately and distinguished healthy from damaged brain tissue.

40649727.mechanism: Removing astrocytic S100B reduces TNFα and glial inflammation
40649727.conclusion_quote: The present results further individuate astrocytic S100B as a key factor and as a potential therapeutic target for EAE neuroinflammatory processes.
40649727.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the S100B gene lessened disease symptoms and reduced inflammatory TNFα in glial cells.

40214860.mechanism: Attenuates oxidative stress and inflammation, promoting remyelination
40214860.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, ghrelin treatment showed neuroprotective and antioxidant properties and reduced demyelination in the CPZ-induced rat model of multiple sclerosis.
40214860.summary: In rats with cuprizone-induced MS-like demyelination, ghrelin treatment reduced oxidative stress and inflammation and improved myelin repair.

40030030.mechanism: raises gut inflammation, lowers Bifidobacterium-Akkermansia ratio
40030030.conclusion_quote: Thus, our findings highlight the BA:AM ratio as a potential gut microbial marker in PwMS, opening avenues for microbiome-based diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy in MS.
40030030.summary: In mice with EAE, giving Blautia wexlerae before disease induction worsened gut inflammation and disease severity, linked to a lower Bifidobacterium to Akkermansia ratio.

40678478.conclusion_quote: These findings proved that the network perturbation modeling is a promising avenue for drug repurposing of MS.
40678478.summary: Researchers used computer network modeling to predict drugs for multiple sclerosis, then found the serotonin receptor HTR2B reduced in the cortex of mice fed cuprizone.

40001492.mechanism: Uncouples mitochondria, lowering oxidative stress and restoring calcium balance
40001492.conclusion_quote: Current studies show DNP treatment promotes increased RGC survival, but continued inflammation and demyelination likely reduce visual function, suggesting future studies examining combination therapy of DNP with anti-inflammatory agents may be warranted.
40001492.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug DNP given after disease onset reduced paralysis and eye nerve cell loss but did not improve vision.

39933126.conclusion_quote: Yet, a significantly elevated antibody response against the membrane protein modulator of VRAC current 1 (MLC1) was noted in B-cell culture supernatants and serum samples of patients with MS.
39933126.summary: Researchers found that people with multiple sclerosis had higher antibody levels against the MLC1 protein, and injecting these antibodies into mice with EAE caused strong brain binding and deaths.

39905182.mechanism: Sphingosine-1-phosphate modulator, supports oligodendrocyte recovery and remyeli
39905182.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that Siponimod has modest pro-regenerative capacities, partly explaining the amelioration of disease progression in secondary progressive MS patients.
39905182.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, starting siponimod in the middle of the damage period modestly increased myelin proteins and restored oligodendrocyte cells.

41057395.mechanism: Edits intron 1 regions to test enhancer activity
41057395.conclusion_quote: Through gene editing, with functional genomic readouts including the assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (ATAC-Seq), chromatin immunoprecipitation with sequencing (ChIP-Seq), and RNA-Seq to assess the consequences of these edits, we present evidence for an enhancer of TNFRSF1A contained within an intron of the gene.
41057395.summary: Researchers used CRISPR gene editing in human stem cell derived macrophages and found that the TNFRSF1A gene has an enhancer inside one of its introns, not directly about multiple sclerosis.

40717793.mechanism: Gangliosides normalize cytokines, apoptosis markers and glycosphingolipid levels
40717793.conclusion_quote: Administration of the ganglioside-containing drug in vivo led to the normalization of the levels of the studied factors, demonstrating a neuroprotective effect.
40717793.summary: In animals with EAE, a ganglioside drug called Cronassial brought inflammatory and cell-death markers back to normal, suggesting it protects the nervous system.

40598580.mechanism: Secreted Klotho reduces BBB leakage and inflammatory signaling
40598580.conclusion_quote: Our study highlighted the significantly greater therapeutic power of SKL-MSCs compared with MSCs in attenuating EAE disease severity and reducing neuroinflammation, which might be mediated through a more marked reduction in the BBB permeability and BBB-associated factors expression levels in the brain of animals.
40598580.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, received stem cells engineered to release Klotho, which reduced disease severity and brain inflammation more than regular stem cells.

41207930.mechanism: Reduces inflammation, oxidative stress, and demyelination, boosts antioxidant ge
41207930.conclusion_quote: The combined treatment of melatonin and curcumin significantly improved neurological function, reduced inflammation and oxidative stress, and enhanced remyelination in EAE mice.
41207930.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, melatonin combined with curcumin reduced inflammation, oxidative stress, and demyelination more than either compound alone.

39756479.mechanism: PPARγ activation drives GPNMB, promoting oligodendrocyte differentiation
39756479.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our evidence reveals that PPARγ is a positive regulator of endogenous OPC differentiation and CNS myelination/remyelination and suggests that PPARγ and/or its downstream sensor (GPNMB) might be a candidate pharmacological target for regenerative therapy in the CNS.
39756479.summary: In mice with cuprizone- and lysophosphatidylcholine-induced demyelination, drugs that activate PPARγ helped precursor cells mature into myelin-forming cells and increased myelin repair.

39804990.mechanism: Lowers IL-31RA, boosting autophagy and reducing NF-κB signaling
39804990.conclusion_quote: These findings reveal an unrecognized role of TIA1-mediated SGs in promoting neuroinflammation and demyelination, offering novel therapeutic targets for MS.
39804990.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the TIA1 gene from the nervous system reduced inflammation, nerve damage and myelin loss by lowering IL-31RA signaling.

40765112.mechanism: Blocks NF-κB, suppressing Th1 and Th17 cell differentiation
40765112.conclusion_quote: Quinazoline derivative QNZ could suppress neuroinflammation, alleviate the progression of EAE and be associated with reduced Th1 and Th17 immunity.
40765112.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug QNZ given early reduced harmful Th1 and Th17 immune cells, lessened spinal cord demyelination, and slowed the disease.

40063200.mechanism: Loss of IL-33 raises HMGB1 acetylation and release
40063200.conclusion_quote: These findings underscore the potential of IL-33-associated signaling pathways as a therapeutic target for EAE treatment.
40063200.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, removing IL-33 increased release of the inflammatory protein HMGB1 from astrocytes, which are support cells in the brain and spinal cord.

40481479.mechanism: Blocks NEK2, cutting B-cell costimulation and B-T interactions
40481479.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these findings underscore an immunomodulatory function for NEK2 and highlight its potential as a therapeutic target in the treatment of multiple sclerosis.
40481479.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the NEK2 inhibitor INH1 improved neurological symptoms, reduced demyelination and lowered immune cell entry into the central nervous system.

40170858.conclusion_quote: Our findings elucidate, for the first time, how P. gingivalis infection promotes central nervous system inflammation by driving Th1 cell differentiation via peripheral ZAP70/NF-κB pathway activation.
40170858.summary: In mice with EAE, infection with the gum bacterium P. gingivalis increased Th1 immune cells and worsened brain inflammation and myelin damage.

40197319.mechanism: Senolytic drugs clear senescent myeloid cells
40197319.conclusion_quote: However, their reduction through DQ does not significantly impact inflammation or recovery, suggesting that the therapeutic potential of senolytics as disease-modifying drugs in MS may be limited.
40197319.summary: In mice with EAE, a senolytic drug combination cleared senescent immune cells but did not improve disease severity or nerve damage.

41006740.mechanism: Antioxidant effects reduce oxidative stress and support myelin restoration
41006740.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that tomato extract exerts neuroprotective effects against cuprizone-induced demyelination through potent antioxidant mechanisms, offering potential therapeutic applications for demyelinating disorders.
41006740.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, tomato extract given after the damage improved myelin recovery in the corpus callosum, reduced oxidative stress, and lessened brain cell death.

38987201.conclusion_quote: Our findings emphasized the importance of MOG 35-55 peptide dosage and composition in modulating EAE development, offering insights into the mechanisms of autoimmunity and tolerance.
38987201.summary: In an EAE animal model, researchers found BCG can induce disease like standard adjuvant, and that MOG peptide dose and salt form change disease severity.

40983615.mechanism: loss of astrocyte NR3C1 primes exaggerated immune responses
40983615.conclusion_quote: Notably, only NR3C1 depletion during early, but not late, astrocyte development induces long-lasting epigenetic reprogramming that primes astrocytic immune responses.
40983615.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the NR3C1 gene from astrocytes early in development made immune attacks on the brain worse in adulthood.

40227512.mechanism: Removing S100B reduces gliosis and inflammatory markers
40227512.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight the exacerbating role of age and elevated S100B in MS progression, underscoring the importance of identifying age-specific MS markers and therapeutic targets.
40227512.summary: In mice with EAE, knocking out the S100B gene reduced gliosis and inflammation at every age tested, while older mice had more severe disease.

41361922.mechanism: CEMIP generates hyaluronan fragments that block progenitor maturation
41361922.conclusion_quote: These data indicate that CEMIP blocks remyelination by generating bioactive HA fragments that inhibit OPC maturation.
41361922.summary: In mice with EAE and in MS patient lesions, the enzyme CEMIP was raised and produced fragments of hyaluronan that stopped progenitor cells from becoming myelin-making cells.

41050684.mechanism: Blocks FAK, reducing NF-κB signaling and Th17 differentiation
41050684.conclusion_quote: Thus, FAK plays an essential role in Th17 cell differentiation by stimulating NF-κB signaling.
41050684.summary: Researchers found that removing or blocking focal adhesion kinase in immune T cells reduced harmful Th17 cells and eased symptoms in mice with EAE.

41199250.mechanism: Loss activates cholesterol synthesis, boosting precursor cell proliferation
41199250.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that PTS is a negative regulator of OPC proliferation, and its disinhibition could offer a potential therapeutic target for MS.
41199250.summary: Researchers deleted the Pts gene in oligodendrocyte precursor cells of mice with EAE, a model of MS. This reduced disease severity, limited demyelination, and boosted myelin repair.

41032626.mechanism: Not applicable, imaging study of synapse loss
41032626.conclusion_quote: SV2A-PET imaging thus unmasked clinically relevant cortical pathology in MS thereby providing a promising tool to detect and monitor disease progression.
41032626.summary: Researchers used a PET scan tracer that binds the synapse marker SV2A to detect synapse loss in cortical lesions in a mouse model and in 31 people with MS.

41266817.mechanism: binds ASC, blocking NLRP3 inflammasome assembly
41266817.conclusion_quote: Our findings establish sTIM-3 as a promising therapeutic candidate for mitigating inflammation caused by excessive NLRP3 inflammasome activation, providing novel insights into potential interventions for various inflammatory diseases.
41266817.summary: In mice with EAE and septic shock, soluble TIM-3 reduced disease by blocking NLRP3 inflammasome assembly through binding to the ASC protein.

40471423.mechanism: Reduces microglial activation, raises myelin basic protein
40471423.conclusion_quote: Although low-intensity exercise promoted remyelination and modulated neuroinflammation in the cuprizone-induced demyelination model, it did not significantly counteract the cuprizone-induced reduction in proliferating cells and immature neurons in the subgranular zone of the dentate gyrus.
40471423.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone, forced wheel running raised myelin protein and reduced microglia activation but did not boost neurogenesis.

39936997.conclusion_quote: We observed a decreased expression of many functionally relevant proteins in the synaptic mitochondria of EAE photoreceptors at an early stage, suggesting that early mitochondrial dysfunctions play an important role in the early synapse pathology.
39936997.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, researchers found early drops in key energy proteins inside photoreceptor synaptic mitochondria, but not in other mitochondria in the same cells.

39937858.mechanism: reduces CC chemokine signaling while delivering antigen
39937858.conclusion_quote: This report demonstrates proof of principle of a biomaterial scaffold as a diseased tissue surrogate that can monitor immune function, identify potential drug targets, and guide the development of a therapeutic.
39937858.summary: In mice with a chronic progressive MS model, antigen-loaded nanoparticles that reduce harmful immune chemical signaling lessened disease, even when given after symptoms began.

41459533.mechanism: Loss of MMP9 alters dural immune cell composition
41459533.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that MMP-9 regulates immune cell composition and activation within the dura during neuroinflammation.
41459533.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the MMP9 enzyme delayed disease onset but worsened peak severity and increased dural neutrophils.

39907797.mechanism: binds TSPO to enable PET imaging of inflammation
39907797.conclusion_quote: We have developed two novel PET tracers that display indiscriminately high binding affinity to both common isoforms of human TSPO, show favourable metabolic stability and brain penetration in rats, and significantly higher uptake in the spinal cord of a neuroinflammatory rat model of multiple sclerosis.
39907797.summary: New PET scan tracers were built to detect brain and spinal cord inflammation regardless of a common TSPO gene variant, and they showed higher uptake in rats with EAE.

40616615.mechanism: Intranasally delivered stem cells regenerate cerebellar tissue and restore balan
40616615.conclusion_quote: Intranasal administration of BMSCs leads to significantly improved motor behavior and histological regeneration of the cerebellum, including cortex and white matter as well as Purkinje cells compared to SD-BMSCs in a cuprizone model of multiple sclerosis.
40616615.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced MS-like demyelination, nasal delivery of healthy stem cells improved balance and cerebellar tissue recovery more than sleep-deprived stem cells did.

39662275.mechanism: Induces tolerogenic dendritic cells and regulatory T cells
39662275.conclusion_quote: The tolerogenic nanovaccine prevented MS development in the early therapeutic setup and exhibited an enhanced recovery from complete paralysis in the late therapeutic model.
39662275.summary: Researchers tested a nanoparticle vaccine carrying MS-related autoantigens in mice with MS-like disease, finding it prevented disease and helped recovery from paralysis.

41184903.mechanism: Reduces oxidative stress and inflammation, boosts antioxidant enzymes
41184903.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that combination therapy with EXOs and KMP improves myelin repair by targeting oxidative stress and neuroinflammation in a CPZ-induced demyelination model.
41184903.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, combining stem cell-derived exosomes with kaempferol improved memory, movement and myelin repair more than either treatment alone.

40649945.conclusion_quote: Targeting Siglecs on DC subsets in vivo represents a novel way of improving transplant survival.
40649945.summary: In mice receiving skin transplants, a sugar-modified donor antigen was directed to recipient immune cells, which prolonged graft survival. The study did not use an MS model.

39738812.mechanism: Blocks PIKFYVE lipid kinase, reducing Th17 cell differentiation
39738812.conclusion_quote: Our findings identify molecular mechanisms by which PIKFYVE promotes Th17 differentiation and suggest that PIKFYVE is a potential therapeutic target in Th17-driven autoimmune diseases.
39738812.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, blocking the PIKFYVE enzyme or deleting it in CD4 T cells reduced harmful Th17 immune cells and autoimmune damage.

40164048.mechanism: Boosts stem cell survival and CXCR4 homing receptor
40164048.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that VPA preconditioning enhances the therapeutic efficacy of BM-MSCs when applied to cuprizone induced demyelination model.
40164048.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, stem cells pretreated with valproic acid homed better to the brain and promoted more myelin repair than untreated cells.

40818658.mechanism: Pan-HDAC inhibitor that raises SIRT1 transcription
40818658.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that SIRT1 up-regulators originated from this HTS assay might become new drug candidates for the treatment of neurodegenerative disease, which provides an approach to repositioning approved drugs through HTS assay.
40818658.summary: Belinostat, an approved cancer drug, raised SIRT1 gene and protein levels in the spinal cords of mice with EAE, a model of MS.

40326762.mechanism: Removing gene reduces immune cell activity driving EAE
40326762.conclusion_quote: By combining detailed immunophenotyping and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), we demonstrate that ADAP1/CentA1 is necessary for mounting a sufficient autoimmune response for EAE initiation and progression.
40326762.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the ADAP1 gene made the mice partly resistant to the disease by weakening immune cell responses.

interventions: intraspinal adeno-associated virus (AAV)/Olig001-mediated expression of the self-antigen NDUFA1p
39786996.mechanism: Self-antigen expression expands regulatory T cells, restoring immune tolerance
39786996.conclusion_quote: Thus, Ecm29/proteasome-controlled, neuroglia-derived self-antigens modulate CNS immune tolerance.
39786996.summary: In mice with EAE, a gene therapy delivering a self-antigen from brain support cells reduced disease and expanded protective regulatory T cells.

40607415.mechanism: Inhibits BTK kinase in monocytes and macrophages
40607415.conclusion_quote: This functional evidence questions the real contribution of BTK expressing myeloid cells to experimental MS.
40607415.summary: In mice with EAE, the BTK inhibitor evobrutinib eased disease and reduced inflammatory macrophages, but deleting BTK from myeloid cells did not help.

40475771.mechanism: Ketones as fuel, possible anti-inflammatory neuroprotection
40475771.conclusion_quote: We propose that the anti-inflammatory neuroprotective benefits of a KD are limited when saturated, long-chain fatty acids are used, and that chain length and fat saturation should be taken into account when utilizing KD as a treatment.
40475771.summary: In mice with EAE, a ketogenic diet high in long saturated fats did not improve vision, and starting it early worsened movement and vision deficits.

41163520.mechanism: PiT-2 loss boosts Th17 cell brain infiltration
41163520.conclusion_quote: The results indicated no direct demyelination in the brains of Slc20a2-HO mice, but an increased susceptibility to demyelination under the induction of oligodendrocyte-toxic cuprizone (CPZ).
41163520.summary: Mice lacking the Slc20a2 gene showed no spontaneous demyelination but were more prone to myelin damage from cuprizone, with more Th17 immune cells in the brain.

41090416.mechanism: Transplanted cells replace progenitors to remyelinate axons
41090416.conclusion_quote: This approach did not show long-term viability following direct injection of OPCs in the optic nerve of EAE rats.
41090416.summary: In rats with EAE, transplanted human oligodendrocyte progenitor cells died within 90 days and did not improve myelin or nerve integrity in the optic nerve.

40381228.mechanism: Activates Nrf2, suppresses NF-κB inflammation signaling
40381228.conclusion_quote: Our study supports DMF as a repurposing candidate for DMD, especially for patients who cannot tolerate chronic glucocorticoid treatment.
40381228.summary: In a mouse model of Duchenne muscular dystrophy, dimethyl fumarate reduced muscle inflammation and fibrosis, matching prednisone, with added anti-fibrotic benefit.

40191085.conclusion_quote: Despite the co-localization of dsRNA with virus antigen for some RNA viruses, anti-dsRNA antibodies were unreliable as markers for unknown virus infections.
40191085.summary: In animals with various viral encephalitis, antibodies targeting double stranded RNA were tested on tissue samples and proved unreliable for detecting unknown virus infections.

39934927.conclusion_quote: Therefore, we conclude that antigen-specific T cells dictate the localization of NMOSD-lesions in the CNS.
39934927.summary: In mice with a model of NMOSD, researchers found that immune cells targeting the water channel AQP4 determine where brain, eye, and spinal cord lesions form.

40059514.mechanism: Deleting MMP7 enzyme, which degrades fibronectin and laminin
40059514.conclusion_quote: Overall, these results indicate that MMP7 is not essential for remyelination in the cuprizone model and point to an unexpected complexity in how MMP7 deficiency influences fibronectin and hyaluronan levels in chronic demyelination.
40059514.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing the MMP7 enzyme did not prevent myelin repair, showing it is not essential for remyelination.

40024707.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that ASK1 might be a promising therapeutic target for reducing neuroinflammation including optic neuritis.
40024707.summary: This review summarizes the authors' earlier work on BDNF-TrkB signaling in glaucoma and on ASK1 in glial cells driving neuroinflammation in mouse models of optic neuritis.

39828227.mechanism: Protects blood vessels and limits inflammatory cell infiltration, easing steroid
