35073561.conclusion_quote: Our results provide a mechanistic link for the association between MS and EBV and could guide the development of new MS therapies.
35073561.summary: Researchers found that B cells in MS patients recognize both an EBV protein and a brain protein, and that EBV immunization worsened disease in mice with EAE.

35940876.mechanism: Restores peroxisomes and limits NLRP3-driven inflammation in macrophages
35940876.conclusion_quote: Peroxisome injury in CNS-associated macrophages contributed to neuroinflammation and demyelination that was prevented by 4-PBA treatment.
35940876.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice and human immune cells, the drug 4-phenylbutyrate protected peroxisomes in macrophages, reducing inflammation, myelin loss and nerve damage.

36761164.mechanism: Removes GPR52 receptor controlling T-cell cAMP levels
36761164.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that a modulation of cAMP levels in T cells does not inevitably result in altered T cell function.
36761164.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the GPR52 receptor raised T-cell cAMP but did not change T-cell function or the course of paralysis.

35749506.mechanism: Lowers eIF4E activity, blocking TFH cell gene translation
35749506.conclusion_quote: TFH cell development and its role in autoimmune pathogenesis involve selective mRNA translation that is highly druggable.
35749506.summary: In mice with EAE, a small-molecule inhibitor or short hairpin RN that lowers eIF4E activity reduced helper T cells, blocked disease, and promoted spinal cord remyelination.

35912553.mechanism: blocks Bruton tyrosine kinase activity in B cells
35912553.conclusion_quote: Tyrosine kinases are actively involved in the epigenetic regulation of the pathological process in MS with the participation of a microRNA network and thus attract attention as a target for the development of new ways for the treatment of MS.
35912553.summary: This review describes how tyrosine kinases, especially Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors, may become future multiple sclerosis treatments, based on animal and early human studies.

35222374.mechanism: Removing IFN-beta worsens viral infection and demyelination
35222374.conclusion_quote: Consequently, IFN-β produced by neuroectodermal cells does not seem to play a critical role in the resistance of C57BL/6 mice against fatal and demyelinating disease induced by TMEV strains.
35222374.summary: In C57BL/6 mice infected with Theiler's virus, removing the IFN-beta gene led to fatal or demyelinating disease, while removing it only from brain cells did not.

36490282.conclusion_quote: Siglec1 and Zbp1 were the only genes significantly upregulated in both tissues, suggesting a common transcriptomic link between neuroinflammation in the CNS and neurogenic changes in the UB of CIE mice.
36490282.summary: Mice infected with a coronavirus causing MS-like disease showed altered gene activity in the spinal cord and bladder, with Siglec1 and Zbp1 changed in both tissues.

35347285.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight a previously unknown function of local meningeal lymphatics in regulating immunity that has only previously been characterized in draining lymph nodes.
35347285.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, meningeal lymphatic vessels near the skull base changed to present antigens and regulate immune cells, creating an immune regulating niche.

36206195.mechanism: Deletes dblGATA enhancer, reducing GATA1 expression
36206195.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data show that GATA1 regulates the number of HSPCs and that reduced GATA1 expression due to dblGATA deletion results in a diminished immune response following the inflammatory challenge.
36206195.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing a GATA1 gene enhancer reduced blood stem cell numbers and made mice resistant to disease.

35189344.mechanism: Antisense silences CD40 in activated microglia and macrophages
35189344.conclusion_quote: Overall, our findings demonstrate the therapeutic potency of systemically administered Chol-HDO to regulate activated Mg/Mφ in neuroinflammation.
35189344.summary: In mice with EAE, a cholesterol-linked antisense molecule given by injection reached spinal cord lesions, lowered CD40 in immune cells, and improved symptoms.

35250572.mechanism: Blocks NEK7-NLRP3 interaction, halting inflammasome assembly
35250572.conclusion_quote: Thus, our results indicate that 149-01 is a potential lead for developing therapeutic agent for NLRP3-related inflammatory diseases.
35250572.summary: In mice with EAE, a new compound called 149-01 that blocks the NLRP3 inflammasome reduced disease severity, along with other inflammatory conditions tested.

36419137.mechanism: Human apoE isoforms change microglial lipid handling and remyelination
36419137.conclusion_quote: Our findings provide critical mechanistic insights into how apoE isoforms differentially regulate microglial function and the maintenance of myelin dynamics, which may inform novel therapeutic avenues for targeting microglial dysfunctions in neurodegenerative diseases.
36419137.summary: In mice fed a demyelinating cuprizone diet, the apoE2 version boosted microglial cleanup and remyelination, while apoE4 impaired lipid handling and repair compared with apoE3.

35890315.mechanism: inhibits KDM1A epigenetic enzyme, reducing inflammatory gene expression
35890315.conclusion_quote: These results pointed to ORY-2001 as a promising CNS epigenetic drug able to target neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases and provided preclinical support for the subsequent design of early-stage clinical trials.
35890315.summary: In mice with EAE and virus-induced encephalomyelitis, the oral drug ORY-2001 reduced immune cell entry into the spinal cord, prevented demyelination, and protected nerve cells.

36179859.mechanism: induces IL-10 producing regulatory B cells
36179859.conclusion_quote: Together these data show that TCDD can induce regulatory functions in B cells, although it was not obvious simply by examining the expression of regulatory markers but by assessing function by cytokine production or mixed lymphocyte responses.
36179859.summary: In mice with EAE, the environmental chemical TCDD modestly reduced inflammatory T cell cytokines and increased regulatory B cells in the spinal cord.

35217583.mechanism: Blocks ORAI1-driven Ca2+ entry in T cells
35217583.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings suggest that the pathogenic effector T cell response demands sustained Ca 2+ entry supported by ORAI1 trafficking.
35217583.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Nkd2 gene reduced harmful effector T cell responses in the central nervous system and eased clinical symptoms.

36287356.mechanism: Reduces STAT3 activation, microgliosis, and IL-23/IL-17 signaling
36287356.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that CuB may have a wide-ranging effect on autoimmune responses in MS via a reduction in STAT3 activation, microgliosis, and adaptation of the IL-23/IL-17 axis.
36287356.summary: In mice with EAE, an animal model of MS, cucurbitacin B given from the start of disease induction reduced inflammation and microglial activity and improved motor function.

36555093.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that DMF, due to its beneficial effect on the formation of new neurons and BDNF-related neuroprotection, may be considered as a promising new therapeutic agent in human sAD.
36555093.summary: In rats with a streptozotocin-induced model of sporadic Alzheimer's disease, dimethyl fumarate improved new neuron formation and memory, suggesting possible use against the disease.

34453694.mechanism: suppresses dendritic cell activation and Th1/Th17 cells
34453694.conclusion_quote: Taken together, here evidenced the potential of htMSCs as an alternative for the treatment of inflammatory, autoimmune or neurodegenerative diseases.
34453694.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, human tubal stem cells reduced harmful immune cells entering the spinal cord and lessened disease severity.

35704583.mechanism: deleting SRC2 reduces Treg differentiation via Nr4a2
35704583.conclusion_quote: Members of SRC family coactivators thus play distinct roles in T reg differentiation and are potential drug targets for controlling immune tolerance.
35704583.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting SRC2 from regulatory T cells worsened disease, showing this coactivator helps these cells form and control inflammation.

35676093.mechanism: none, studies disease state effect on stroke
35676093.conclusion_quote: CNS autoantigen-specific autoimmunity has a protective influence on primary tissue damage after experimental stroke, indicating a very early involvement of CNS antigen-specific, myeloid cell-associated anti-inflammatory immune mechanisms that mitigate ischemic injury in the acute EAE phase.
35676093.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, strokes caused less brain damage during the acute disease phase, linked to calming myeloid immune cells.

35353146.mechanism: Raises BDNF and phosphorylated Fyn, activating downstream signaling
35353146.conclusion_quote: Our results provide an experimental basis for the development of DHF-7 as a novel therapeutic agent for schizophrenia.
35353146.summary: In mice with a schizophrenia-like model combining cuprizone demyelination and MK-801, DHF-7 improved behavior and white matter damage by raising BDNF and Fyn activity.

36289122.mechanism: Raises anti-inflammatory fatty acids, lowers inflammatory lipids
36289122.conclusion_quote: Isoflavone consumption alters the systemic metabolic landscape through concurrent increases in monounsaturated fatty acids and beneficial polyunsaturated fatty acids plus reduction in pro-inflammatory metabolites and pathways.
36289122.summary: In mice in an MS animal model fed isoflavones, blood metabolite profiling showed more anti-inflammatory fats and fewer inflammatory lipids and phenylalanine breakdown products.

36403026.mechanism: Blocks lymphocyte exit from lymph nodes
36403026.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate that M-MDSCs might be a useful predictive biomarker of the response of MS patients to fingolimod.
36403026.summary: In mice with EAE and in MS patients, fingolimod worked better when patients and mice had more circulating M-MDSC immune cells before treatment, suggesting a predictive marker.

35980256.mechanism: activates GABA B receptors to enhance OPC differentiation
35980256.conclusion_quote: Thus, our results suggest that Bac repurposing should be considered as a potential therapeutic strategy to stimulate remyelination in patients with MS.
35980256.summary: In mice with spinal cord demyelination, the approved spasticity drug baclofen increased new myelin production and helped repair the protective coating around nerves.

interventions: Glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP)-thymidine-kinase transgenic SJL
35714111.mechanism: ablates astrocytes via thymidine kinase activation
35714111.conclusion_quote: The reduction of the investigated ECM-molecules demonstrates that astrocytes play a key role in the production of ECM-molecules.
35714111.summary: In mice with Theiler virus infection, depleting astrocytes during the progressive phase reduced key matrix molecules and worsened symptoms.

36156798.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, Gg can serve as a novel brain imaging tool in glycobiology and report glycoprotein formation and alterations in the CNS node of Ranvier.
36156798.summary: Researchers developed a lectin probe that marks sugar structures at nodes of Ranvier in mouse brains, and found these sugars were disrupted when mice were given cuprizone to cause demyelination.

35769484.mechanism: activates TNFR2 to expand regulatory T cells
35769484.conclusion_quote: NewSTAR2 represents a next generation ligand-based TNFR2 agonist, which is efficiently produced, exhibits improved pharmacokinetic properties and high serum retention with superior in vivo activity exerting powerful protective effects against acute GvHD.
35769484.summary: In mice with graft-versus-host disease, a new long-lasting TNFR2-activating protein boosted protective regulatory T cells and reduced acute disease. The study did not test an MS model.

35707627.mechanism: competitively blocks LPC binding to CD1d on NKT cells
35707627.conclusion_quote: This study shows that ChCl attenuates the allergic response by inhibiting the LPC induced- NKT cell mediated AHR, inflammation and oxidative stress by competitive inhibition to LPC in binding to CD1d.
35707627.summary: In mice with allergic airway disease caused by cockroach extract, choline chloride reduced airway inflammation and hyperresponsiveness by blocking lysophosphatidylcholine effects.

35007691.mechanism: Promotes oligodendrocyte precursor differentiation and myelination
35007691.conclusion_quote: We concluded that clemastine rescues cognitive function damage caused by chemotherapy through improving white matter integrity.
35007691.summary: In mice given chemotherapy, oral clemastine improved memory and learning and repaired myelin, the protective coating around nerve fibers.

35156232.mechanism: Phosphorylation of Olig2 by c-Abl drives precursor proliferation
35156232.conclusion_quote: Thus, we identified the important role of c-Abl in OLs during developmental myelination and remyelination in a disease model.
35156232.summary: In mice, removing c-Abl from oligodendrocytes reduced precursor cell growth and remyelination after cuprizone-induced demyelination, and nilotinib lowered myelin protein and motor coordination.

34103690.mechanism: Inhibits CXCL10 signaling, reducing NF-κB-driven glial activation
34103690.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, CXCL10 mediates the protective role of Rg1 in CPZ-induced demyelination mouse model.
34103690.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone to damage myelin, ginsenoside Rg1 reduced demyelination and nerve injury and improved movement, partly by blocking the inflammatory protein CXCL10.

35682964.conclusion_quote: We conclude that HCN channels are not directly modulated by trace metals and divalent cation chelators but are subject to modulation by different MS-related cytokines.
35682964.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, thalamic HCN ion channel activity changed over time, and inflammatory cytokines altered it while metal chelators did not.

34948217.mechanism: Reduces axonal damage and glutamate excess
34948217.conclusion_quote: GA applied as a therapeutic regimen to mice with apparent clinical symptoms significantly reduces the pathological manifestations, namely apoptotic cell death, NFL leakage, histological tissue damage, and glutamate excess, thus corroborating the neuroprotective consequences of this treatment.
34948217.summary: In mice with EAE, glatiramer acetate started after symptoms appeared reduced nerve damage markers, nerve cell death, and harmful glutamate buildup.

34391933.mechanism: Blocks NAAA enzyme, cutting immune cell infiltration
34391933.conclusion_quote: We found that preventive chronic treatment with ARN16186 was efficacious in slowing disease progression and preserving locomotor activity in EAE mice.
34391933.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a drug that blocks the NAAA enzyme slowed disease, preserved movement, and reduced immune cells entering the spinal cord.

33846226.mechanism: Deletes histamine-synthesizing enzyme in specific cell types
33846226.conclusion_quote: In summary, this study refutes the role of histamine in EAE, unveils a role for neutrophil-derived histamine in IgE-mediated anaphylaxis, and establishes a new mouse model to re-explore the inflammatory and neurologic roles of histamine.
33846226.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, removing the histamine producing enzyme in all cells or specific cell types did not change disease course.

34608221.mechanism: Deletes RelB in T cells, lowering CNS GM-CSF
34608221.conclusion_quote: Our data reveal a discrete role for RelB in the pathogenic function of Tconv cells during EAE, and highlight this transcription factor as a putative therapeutic target in MS.
34608221.summary: In mice whose T cells lacked RelB, the EAE model of MS was much milder, with reduced GM-CSF production in the central nervous system.

33953873.mechanism: increases myelin protein expression, reduces NOGO-A expression
33953873.conclusion_quote: The obtained results indicated it could be concluded that curcumin was able to improve EAE by increasing the amount of MBP gene expression and reducing the intensity of NOGO-A expression.
33953873.summary: Researchers gave curcumin, a turmeric compound, to rats with EAE, a model of MS. It increased myelin basic protein gene expression and reduced NOGO-A, improving the disease.

34244137.mechanism: Gut bacteria convert isoflavones to equol, reshaping microbiome
34244137.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our study provides evidence that dietary-induced gut microbial changes alleviate disease severity and may contribute to MS pathogenesis.
34244137.summary: In mice with EAE, an isoflavone diet changed gut bacteria to make equol, which reduced disease severity and mirrored healthy human microbiomes.

33903635.conclusion_quote: Together, our results are consistent with the hypothesis that impaired testicular steroidogenesis originates upstream of the testes and that low serum LH is the main cause of decreased testosterone levels during EAE.
33903635.summary: In male rats with EAE, an MS model, testis enzymes that make testosterone were reduced, and hormone injections restored them, suggesting low LH is the cause.

34091117.mechanism: Downregulates miR-155, upregulates POMC, shifts T-cell balance
34091117.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the alleviation of EAE by EA is characterized by reduced proportions of Th1/Th17 cells and increased proportions of Th2 cells, POMC upregulation, and miR-155 downregulation, while miR-155 itself can suppress POMC expression.
34091117.summary: In mice with EAE, electroacupuncture at the ST36 acupoint reduced disease scores and spinal cord demyelination by lowering microRNA-155 and raising POMC levels.

34260042.mechanism: Activates GLP-1 receptor, reducing immune activation and chemokines
34260042.conclusion_quote: GLP-1R agonists may have dual efficacy in MS by suppressing peripheral and CNS inflammation, thereby limiting neuronal loss.
34260042.summary: In mice with EAE, a GLP-1 receptor drug called NLY01 delayed disease onset, reduced immune attack and nerve cell loss, and lessened relapses.

34832936.mechanism: Supplies phosphatidylcholine precursor for myelin membrane regeneration
34832936.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, CDP-choline could become a promising regenerative substance for patients with multiple sclerosis and should be tested in a clinical trial.
34832936.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, low doses of CDP-choline enhanced early myelin regeneration and increased the number of oligodendrocytes.

34220419.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes HPA axis changes
34220419.conclusion_quote: The results obtained from this study may help in understanding the mechanisms and possible pharmacological modulation in MS and demonstrate an effect of oxidative stress exposure in the HPA activation during the course of EAE.
34220419.summary: In experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, an animal model of MS, the stress hormone system in the pituitary and adrenal glands showed rising oxidative stress at the disease peak.

33450316.mechanism: Scavenges ROS, inhibiting dendritic cell maturation and Th17 differentiation
33450316.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that BRNPs have the potential to be used as a new therapeutic nanomedicine for treatment of various CD4 + T cell-associated autoimmune diseases.
33450316.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, bilirubin nanoparticles given by injection delayed disease onset and reduced severity by calming immune cells.

34576080.mechanism: Platelet inhibition lowers thromboxane A2 and CNS inflammation
34576080.conclusion_quote: Overall, we demonstrate that low-dose ASA could ameliorate the platelet-dependent neuroinflammatory response in vivo, thus indicating a potential treatment approach for MS.
34576080.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, low-dose aspirin reduced symptoms, immune cell infiltration and demyelination by inhibiting platelets.

33947942.mechanism: Reduces inflammation and promotes Akt-mediated antiapoptotic Bcl-2/Bax balance
33947942.conclusion_quote: Taken as a whole, our results demonstrate that MAT attenuated inflammation, demyelination and axonal loss in the optic nerve, and protected RGCs from inflammation-induced cell death.
33947942.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, matrine given from disease onset reduced optic nerve inflammation and demyelination and protected retinal nerve cells from dying.

34270117.mechanism: Regulates oligodendrocyte differentiation and myelin basic protein expression
34270117.conclusion_quote: These results provide a novel therapeutic option for demyelinating diseases by modulating DDAH1 activity.
34270117.summary: In mice, reducing the DDAH1 gene slowed myelin repair after cuprizone-induced damage, while boosting it enhanced repair in mice with EAE.

33862148.mechanism: Blocks histone deacetylases, reducing lymphocyte proliferation
33862148.conclusion_quote: When put into a clinical context, for the first time data cast doubt on the relevance of HDACi to treatment of progressive MS (PMS).
33862148.summary: In NOD mice with progressive experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, three HDAC inhibitors given after disease onset reduced immune responses but did not slow disease or reduce deaths.

34399014.mechanism: Loss raises toxic sphingosine and ceramide levels
34399014.conclusion_quote: These results provide the first evidence that SphK2, the dominant enzyme catalyzing S1P synthesis in the adult brain, is essential for remyelination following a demyelinating insult and myelin maintenance with aging.
34399014.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice, removing the SphK2 enzyme caused more oligodendrocyte loss and prevented myelin repair after the toxin was withdrawn.

34233878.mechanism: Piezo1 loss expands regulatory T cells via TGF-beta
34233878.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that Piezo1 selectively restrains T reg cells, without influencing activation events or effector T cell functions.
34233878.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Piezo1 channel from T cells reduced disease severity by expanding regulatory T cells without affecting inflammatory T cell responses.

33235386.mechanism: Blocks PIK3C3 kinase, cutting myeloid IL-1β production
33235386.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our studies establish PIK3C3 as an important regulator of macrophage functions and myeloid cell-mediated regulation of EAE.
33235386.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, deleting Pik3c3 in myeloid immune cells reduced disease severity, and a PIK3C3 inhibitor delayed progression.

33587955.mechanism: not applicable, environmental exposure rather than a treatment
33587955.conclusion_quote: These findings support the view that exposure to fine PM can contribute to demyelinating pathologies by targeting the endogenous regenerative capability of the CNS tissue.
33587955.summary: In mice with white matter damage from lysolecithin, exposure to fine air pollution particles after injury slowed myelin repair and changed glial cell activity.

39355638.mechanism: Covalently binds BTK for PET imaging
39355638.conclusion_quote: Preliminary PET/magnetic resonance imaging with [ 11 C]ibrutinib in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) mice showed a 49% higher radioactivity accumulation in the spinal cord of mice with EAE scores of 2.5 vs. sham mice.
39355638.summary: Researchers developed a radioactive ibrutinib tracer for PET scans, finding more tracer in the spinal cord of mice with EAE than sham mice.

34445401.mechanism: Lowers T cell IFN-γ and IL-17A secretion
34445401.conclusion_quote: Our data show a lower incidence of MOG-induced EAE in mature p110αΔT mice linked to altered T cell homeostasis and lower secretion of inflammatory cytokines.
34445401.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the p110α gene from T cells lowered disease incidence and inflammatory cytokines in older mice.

33456555.mechanism: blocks DHODH, reducing pyrimidine synthesis in lymphocytes
33456555.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates the feasibility of 19 F MR methods to detect TF during neuroinflammation in vivo .
33456555.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers used a fluorine-based MRI scan to detect the drug teriflunomide in the brain and body and track its levels.

33155932.mechanism: Multikinase inhibitor blocking FLT3, ABL and Aurora A kinases
33155932.conclusion_quote: The KW-2449, aging as a multi-kinase inhibitor, modulates the inflammatory responses of cytokine cascades either in the brain or in plasma and reduces EAE pathogenesis manifestation.
33155932.summary: In mice with EAE, an experimental multikinase inhibitor called KW-2449 reduced clinical signs, brain inflammation, demyelination, and inflammatory cytokine levels.

34493542.mechanism: inhibits CD38 enzyme, restoring NAD+ levels and reducing astrocyte inflammation
34493542.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that a high-fat diet impairs oligodendrocyte survival and differentiation through astrocyte-linked mechanisms mediated by the NAD + ase CD38 and highlights CD38 inhibitors as potential therapeutic candidates to improve myelin regeneration.
34493542.summary: In mice with spinal cord demyelination, an oral drug blocking the CD38 enzyme increased oligodendrocytes and remyelinated nerve fibers, while a high fat diet worsened these effects.

34349758.mechanism: limits neuronal hyperactivity, calcium influx and excitotoxicity
34349758.conclusion_quote: What is more, arctigenin exerts neuroprotective effect by limiting hyperactivity at preclinical stage and ameliorates EAE symptoms, indicating that arctigenin could be a potential therapeutic drug for neuroprotection in MS-related neuropsychological disorders.
34349758.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, arctigenin calmed overactive brain cells and eased symptoms, suggesting it may protect nerves.

35546974.mechanism: raises IL-27 and reduces brain inflammatory cells
35546974.conclusion_quote: Based on the results obtained in the present study, BV may be a suitable candidate for the treatment of inflammatory diseases, such as MS.
35546974.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, honey bee venom given after symptoms began raised IL-27 levels and reduced inflammatory cells in the brain.

34853467.mechanism: blocks antigen presentation by inflammatory ILC3 cells
34853467.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data define a population of inflammatory ILC3s that is essential for directly promoting T-cell-dependent neuroinflammation in the CNS and reveal the potential of harnessing peripheral tissue-resident ILC3s for the prevention of autoimmune disease.
34853467.summary: In mice with an MS-like disease, removing the ability of inflammatory immune cells called ILC3s to present myelin antigen reduced harmful T cell activity in the brain and spinal cord and prevented disease.

34917987.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes immune responses and paralysis
34917987.conclusion_quote: Overall, these findings provide insight into the complex roles of immune response in the pathogenesis of virus-associated neurological diseases influenced by host genetic background.
34917987.summary: In Collaborative Cross mice infected with Theiler's virus, researchers measured immune molecules and paralysis, finding immune responses vary by genetic background and affect limb paralysis.

34925309.mechanism: Deficiency of CTRP3 increases Th17 differentiation via AdipoR2
34925309.conclusion_quote: These results show that CTRP3 is an endogenous regulator of Th17 differentiation, suggesting that the CTRP3-AdipoR2 axis is a good target for the treatment of Th17 cell-mediated diseases.
34925309.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, deleting the C1qtnf3 gene increased Th17 immune cells and worsened disease, showing that the CTRP3 protein normally restrains these cells.

34450375.mechanism: Loss of Parkin alters immune cells and neuroinflammation
34450375.conclusion_quote: Our study sheds light on the role of PARKIN protein in modulating peripheral immune cells-mediated immunity during EAE, highlighting its importance in neuroinflammation, and thus elucidating its potential in the development of novel neuroprotective therapies.
34450375.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Parkin gene caused earlier and more severe disease, with more immune cells and inflammation in the brain and spinal cord.

33410109.mechanism: Blocks microglia activation and oxidative stress damage
33410109.conclusion_quote: Our study supports the combination of indapamide and HCQ as a new treatment strategy targeting multiple facets of progressive MS.
33410109.summary: In mice with a spinal cord lesion, combining hydroxychloroquine and indapamide reduced activated microglia, axonal injury, and lipid peroxidation, while either drug alone did not.

33390832.mechanism: Lowers JNK signaling, raises Eomes, suppresses Th17 cells
33390832.conclusion_quote: These results provided the therapeutic potential of GK treatment in EAE, and further suggested that Eomes expression in CD4 + T cells might be essential in this process.
33390832.summary: In mice with EAE, the plant compound Ginkgolide K eased disease by reducing Th17 immune cells, and this benefit depended on the Eomes gene in CD4 T cells.

32543727.conclusion_quote: Our data collectively suggest that EBV-mediated proliferation of B lymphocytes may be a risk factor for the exacerbation of MS, which are associated with gut microbiome changes and BBB modulations.
32543727.summary: In mice with EAE, injected EBV immortalized human B cells worsened disease, caused relapse, changed gut bacteria, and tightened the blood brain barrier.

34893671.mechanism: Removing DCIR boosts antiviral CD8 T-cell activation and reduces brain virus and
34893671.conclusion_quote: Results suggest that DCIR deficiency has a supportive influence on antiviral immune mechanisms, facilitating virus control in the brain and ameliorates neuropathology during acute neurotropic virus infection.
34893671.summary: In mice infected with a neurotropic virus, deleting the DCIR gene reduced brain virus levels, inflammation, and hippocampal damage while strengthening antiviral T-cell responses.

34679893.mechanism: Dietary fiber alters growth, immunity and gut structure in ducks
34679893.conclusion_quote: Thus, it could be concluded that ducks fed on soybean hulls containing a diet at the level of 4.5% and providing 3.8% fiber level with or without lysolecithin showed the best performance.
34679893.summary: In growing ducks, adding soybean hull fiber and lysolecithin to feed changed growth, immune response and gut structure. The study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

34324186.mechanism: overexpresses transcription factor driving rapid oligodendrocyte differentiation
34324186.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we provide a fast and efficient oligodendrocyte differentiation protocol allowing both in vitro human disease modeling and a high-throughput co-culture system for drug discovery.
34324186.summary: Researchers used patient-derived human stem cells and added SOX10 to make oligodendrocytes, the myelin-producing cells, in about three weeks for disease modeling and drug screening.

33217488.mechanism: Suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome and pyroptosis, reducing neuroinflammation and dem
33217488.conclusion_quote: Taken together, ellagic acid can decrease severity of EAE via amelioration of astrogliosis, astrocyte activation, demyelination, neuroinflammation and axonal damage that is partly related to its effects on NLRP3 inflammasome and pyroptotic pathway.
33217488.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, ellagic acid given after symptoms began reduced disease severity, demyelination and inflammation, partly by acting on the NLRP3 pathway.

33530002.mechanism: Targets AhR, dampening dendritic cell and Th17 activity
33530002.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our study offers new evidence that URA, as a human microbial metabolite, is valuable to use as a prospective therapeutic candidate for autoimmune diseases.
33530002.summary: In mice with EAE, oral urolithin A, a gut-microbe product, reduced disease, inflammation and demyelination by acting on the AhR receptor.

34355492.conclusion_quote: Our study supports the need of new or adapted pharmacological strategies for MS elderly patients.
34355492.summary: In aged mice with the viral TMEV model of progressive MS, immune cell responses were altered, microglia showed higher PD-L1, and infected mice had age-related axon loss.

33540247.mechanism: removal impairs activation of pathogenic CD4 T cells
33540247.conclusion_quote: Thus, for the first time, our study provided the direct in vivo evidence that CtsL was involved in CD4 T cells acquiring pathogenicity in the autoimmune disease.
33540247.summary: In mice with EAE, removing cathepsin L from immune cells reduced harmful CD4 T cells making inflammatory signals and their buildup in the spinal cord.

35046956.mechanism: reduces pro-inflammatory signaling in astrocytes and microglia
35046956.conclusion_quote: Finally, we show that intranasal administration of PTN during the late phase of EAE successfully reduces disease severity, making it a potential therapeutic candidate for the treatment of progressive MS, for which existing therapies are limited.
35046956.summary: In mice with EAE, astrocyte-made pleiotrophin limits chronic brain inflammation, and intranasal pleiotrophin given late in disease reduces severity.

34174704.mechanism: Activates SIRT1 signaling, reducing inflammation and cell death
34174704.conclusion_quote: This study shows the potential of NAD + to be used as a drug in preventing and treating MS-related ON.
34174704.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the molecule NAD+ reduced optic nerve inflammation, nerve damage and retinal cell death when given before or after disease onset.

35069527.mechanism: Removing phosphatase activates mTORC2 and metabolism, driving DC inflammation
35069527.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings demonstrate that PP2Cδ has an essential role in controlling DCs activation and function, which is critical for prevention of autoimmunity.
35069527.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the PP2Cδ gene in dendritic cells made the disease worse by overactivating the mTORC2 pathway and immune signaling.

33403844.mechanism: raises serum IL-27 and reduces CNS inflammatory cells
33403844.conclusion_quote: Based on results obtained in the present study, it may be concluded that Naja naja oxiana snake venom is a potential immunomodulatory agent that can be effective in the treatment of MS.
33403844.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, cobra venom reduced inflammatory cells in nervous tissue and raised blood levels of IL-27.

34130726.mechanism: B-cell depletion reduces microglial activation and cell death
34130726.conclusion_quote: These findings might pave the way for further research on the mode of action of B-cells and therefore help to improve therapeutic options for progressive MS.
34130726.summary: In rats with widespread cortical demyelination, anti-CD20 antibody treatment reduced brain inflammation and cell death while preserving more neurons.

34050263.mechanism: Loss of Th17 autocrine TGF-β1 promotes IFN-γ production
34050263.conclusion_quote: Thus, TGF-β1 production by Th17 cells provides an essential autocrine signal for maintaining the stability and regulating the pathogenicity of Th17 cells in vivo.
34050263.summary: In mice with EAE, removing TGF-β1 from Th17 immune cells made them more likely to become inflammatory IFN-γ producers and worsened inflammation.

34039371.mechanism: Blocks miR-20a, raising Map3k9, boosting Treg cells
34039371.conclusion_quote: miR-20a antagomirs alleviate EAE, suggesting a new therapy for EAE and CNS inflammatory demyelinating diseases.
34039371.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the microRNA miR-20a with antagomirs reduced disease severity and increased regulatory T cells, which help calm the immune attack.

34209576.mechanism: removing gene increases neuroinflammation and hippocampal neuron loss
34209576.conclusion_quote: The present study indicates that CARD9 is dispensable for the initiation of early antiviral responses and TMEV elimination but may contribute to the modulation of neuroinflammation, thereby reducing hippocampal injury following neurotropic virus infection.
34209576.summary: In mice infected with the Theiler's virus model of demyelination, deleting the CARD9 gene worsened hippocampal brain injury and neuron loss without affecting virus clearance.

34192530.mechanism: Enforced Ipcef1 expression abolishes TLR2-driven Th17 cell migration
34192530.conclusion_quote: This study establishes the importance of the TLR2 signaling pathway in inducing Th17 cell pathogenicity and driving autoimmune inflammation.
34192530.summary: In mice with EAE, forcing Th17 cells to express Ipcef1 blocked their TLR2-driven migration and weakened their ability to cause disease.

33669652.mechanism: Reduces inflammatory macrophages, reactive astrocytes and complement C3 depositi
33669652.conclusion_quote: This study suggests that the beneficial effects of DMF involve the suppression of iNOS + pro-inflammatory macrophages, C3 + astrocytes, and deposition of C3 in the CNS.
33669652.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, dimethyl fumarate reduced inflammatory macrophages, complement C3 and reactive astrocytes, which lessened myelin loss and nerve damage.

33257316.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors to alter cell trafficking
33257316.conclusion_quote: These observations indicate, for the first time, that S1P receptor modulators demonstrate efficacy in the mouse model of aplastic anemia and suggest that treatment with ONO-4641 might delay the progression of aplastic anemia.
33257316.summary: In mice with immune mediated aplastic anemia, the S1P receptor modulator ONO-4641 improved blood and bone marrow cell counts and reduced T cell infiltration of the bone marrow.

34362845.mechanism: Blocks IFP35 proteins, reducing microglia and T-cell overactivation
34362845.conclusion_quote: Together, our findings reveal a hitherto unknown mechanism by which IFP35 family proteins facilitate overactivation of both T cells and microglia and propose avenues to study the pathogenesis of MS.
34362845.summary: Removing IFP35 and NMI genes, or blocking IFP35 with antibodies, reduced immune cell invasion and nerve coating loss in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

33938620.mechanism: blocks T-cell proliferation, activation and cytokine production
33938620.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that therapeutic intervention of the TAPBPL inhibitory pathway may represent a new strategy to modulate T cell-mediated immunity for the treatment of cancer, infections, autoimmune diseases, and transplant rejection.
33938620.summary: In mice with EAE, a soluble protein that suppresses T cells, called hTAPBPL-Ig, reduced disease, suggesting a new way to calm harmful immune responses.

34040112.mechanism: MeCP2 loss shifts cytokine balance toward inflammation
34040112.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that MeCP2 acts intrinsically upon immune activation, affecting neuroimmune homeostasis by regulating the pro-inflammatory/anti-inflammatory balance in vivo.
34040112.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, loss of the MeCP2 gene made disease more likely and worsened inflammation in the spinal cord.

33953162.mechanism: blocks CXCR2 receptor, inhibiting neutrophil chemotaxis
33953162.conclusion_quote: The antibody strongly inhibits IL-8-induced and CXCR2-mediated neutrophil chemotaxis in vitro and alleviates hCXCR2-dependent experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis symptoms in mice.
33953162.summary: In mice with EAE, a selected antibody that blocks the CXCR2 receptor on neutrophils reduced disease symptoms.

33692135.mechanism: Triggers T cell apoptosis, restoring regulatory T cells
33692135.conclusion_quote: Thus, IHMs may be an efficient therapeutic strategy for autoimmune diseases through induction of apoptosis and reestablishment of tolerant immune responses.
33692135.summary: In mice with EAE and other autoimmune models, engineered microparticles caused harmful immune cells to self-destruct and restored calming regulatory T cells, reducing disease.

34134995.mechanism: Deletion raises m6A on IFN-γ and CXCL2 mRNA
34134995.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal an unexpected specific role of ALKBH5 as an m 6 A eraser in controlling the pathogenicity of CD4 + T cells during autoimmunity.
34134995.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the ALKBH5 gene from T immune cells protected against disease by reducing their inflammatory signals.

34335176.mechanism: Modulates brain lipids, partially normalizing cuprizone-induced changes
34335176.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data suggest that rTMS may reverse cognitive behavioral changes caused by CPZ-induced demyelination by modulating the brain lipidome, providing new insights into the therapeutic mechanism of rTMS.
34335176.summary: In mice given the cuprizone diet that damages myelin, repetitive magnetic brain stimulation improved memory and thinking tests and partly corrected changes in brain fats.

33478569.mechanism: Gene loss changes B cell receptor signaling
33478569.conclusion_quote: Importantly, we show that in this sub-population Atxn1 regulates immunoglobulin gene transcription and signaling through the B cell receptor (BCR).
33478569.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Atxn1 gene worsened disease and changed how certain B cells respond through their receptors.

33953866.mechanism: Activates hippocampal AKT, BDNF and CREB proteins
33953866.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrated that vit B12 and estradiol benzoate, especially in combination therapy, can be helpful in treatment of memory problems and MS-induced dysfunction through activation of the hippocampal AKT, BDNF, and CREB proteins.
33953866.summary: In rats with hippocampal damage modeling MS, vitamin B12 and estradiol benzoate, alone and combined, improved memory and restored levels of key brain signaling proteins.

33361206.mechanism: binds immune cells, reducing Th1 and Th17 cell proliferation
33361206.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that inhibition of Th1 and Th17 development provides effective suppression of EAE and suggests the feasibility of a clinical approach based on the use of ILT3.Fc for treatment of MS.
33361206.summary: In mice with EAE, a human ILT3.Fc protein reduced harmful immune cells and inflammation, delayed disease onset, and lowered brain and spinal cord damage.

34677413.mechanism: Mutant enzyme shifts arachidonic acid oxidation to 15-lipoxygenation
34677413.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data indicate that these mutant Alox5 -KI mice respond differently in two models of experimental inflammation than Alox5 -/- animals tested previously in similar experimental setups.
34677413.summary: In mice with EAE, a genetically altered version of the Alox5 enzyme caused earlier disease onset and more affected animals than normal mice.

33805762.mechanism: inhibits chemokine-driven migration of pathogenic Th17 cells
33805762.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this study shows that PTX inhibits the migration of pathogenic Th17 cells, while promoting the accumulation of pathogenic B cells in the CNS during Th17-EAE.
33805762.summary: Pertussis toxin treatment reduced disease in mice with Th17-driven EAE by blocking harmful T cells from reaching the brain and spinal cord, while letting more B cells accumulate there.

33686135.mechanism: Activates immune-cell GABA-A receptors, limiting T cell autoreactivity
33686135.conclusion_quote: The ability of homotaurine treatment to limit epitope spreading within the CNS, along with its safety record, makes it an excellent candidate to help treat MS and other inflammatory disorders of the CNS.
33686135.summary: In mice with EAE, an oral drug called homotaurine that reaches the brain reduced the spread of harmful immune attacks within the nervous system and eased disease, unlike plain GABA.

33637789.mechanism: Primed pDC precursors secrete TGF-β and IL-27
33637789.conclusion_quote: These results reveal that pDC precursors are conferred stable therapeutic properties by early innate activation within the BM.
33637789.summary: In mice with EAE, bone marrow precursor cells activated with CpG and given after onset halted disease progression by calming spinal cord inflammation.

34926318.mechanism: alters gut microbiota, reduces CNS neuroinflammation
34926318.conclusion_quote: Therefore, CMG administration could alter the gut microbiota at the three different sites differentially in not only the overall gut microbiome compositions but also the abundance of individual bacteria, each of which was associated with modulation of neuroinflammation.
34926318.summary: In mice with EAE, a curcumin prodrug improved clinical and tissue signs of disease while shifting gut bacteria in feces and the intestine.

33406093.mechanism: Secreted growth factors and cytokines protect nerve cells
33406093.conclusion_quote: Demyelination attenuation was partially associated with the lower molecular weight ST266 fraction, but removal of higher molecular weight biomolecules from ST266 diminishes its neuroprotective effects, suggesting at least some high molecular weight proteins play a role in ST266-mediated neuroprotection.
33406093.summary: In mice with EAE, intranasal ST266, a mix of proteins secreted by amniotic cells, protected retinal nerve cells and reduced optic nerve damage, with larger proteins contributing most to the benefit.

34933669.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes leukocyte claudin-5 acquisition
34933669.conclusion_quote: Several leukocyte subtypes variably acquire CLN-5 in blood before they enter the CNS, an event that may represent a novel mechanism to guide leukocytes to sites for paracellular diapedesis across the BBB.
34933669.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, immune cells in the blood and brain were found to pick up the tight junction protein claudin-5 before entering the brain.

34396578.mechanism: deletes glutamine synthetase gene in oligodendrocytes
34396578.conclusion_quote: These findings provide evidence towards OL-encoded GS function in spinal cord sensorimotor axis, which is dysregulated in chronic neurological diseases.
34396578.summary: In mice, deleting the glutamine synthetase gene from myelin-making cells in the spinal cord caused only a brief drop in peak force, while SOD1 ALS mice and some MS patient tissue showed raised enzyme levels.

33560578.conclusion_quote: Our study is the first showing that depending on the antigen, the relative amount of harmful auto-Abs without and abzymes with low or high catalytic activities may be produced only at onset and in acute or remission phases of EAE.
33560578.summary: In mice prone to EAE, immunizing with different antigens changed the mix of harmful antibodies and enzyme-like antibodies at each disease phase, and the antigen affected how fast EAE developed.

34073506.mechanism: causes heart toxicity through inflammation and oxidative stress
34073506.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, clinically relevant doses of MTX caused dissimilar responses in adult and infant mice, being that inflammation may be an important trigger to MTX-induced cardiotoxicity.
34073506.summary: In mice of different ages, the MS and cancer drug mitoxantrone caused heart damage, with inflammation possibly driving the harm, more so in adults.

33067748.mechanism: Secreted factors cut inflammation and protect nerve cells
33067748.conclusion_quote: Protective effects of systemically administered AMP cells suggest they may serve as a potential novel treatment for multiple sclerosis.
33067748.summary: In mice with EAE, intravenous or intraperitoneal injections of amnion derived progenitor cells reduced paralysis and vision loss and protected retinal nerve cells.

33398468.mechanism: MSCs deliver kinase inhibitor that suppresses T-cell proliferation
33398468.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results identify MSC-based drug delivery as a potential therapeutic strategy for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
33398468.summary: In mice with EAE, stem cells carrying a kinase inhibitor eased disease more than cells alone or the free drug.

34925335.mechanism: inhibits p38 MAPK/NFAT5 signaling, reduces myeloid activation
34925335.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, dietary salt restriction ameliorates CIA and STIA, indicating a beneficial role of LS diet during both the immunization and effector phase of immune-mediated arthritides by predominantly modulating the humoral immunity and the activation status of myeloid lineage cells.
34925335.summary: In mice with collagen-induced and serum-transfer arthritis, a low-salt diet reduced joint inflammation and damage. The study did not examine multiple sclerosis or demyelination.

34707603.mechanism: deleting p38α in microglia or myeloid cells changes autoimmune inflammation by s
34707603.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these results reveal a p38α-dependent sex-specific molecular pathway in microglia that is protective in CNS autoimmunity in males, suggesting that autoimmunity in males and females is driven by distinct cellular and molecular pathways, thus suggesting design of future sex-specific therapeutic approaches.
34707603.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the p38α gene from microglia worsened disease in males but not females, while removing it from peripheral myeloid cells protected both sexes.

34600695.mechanism: Omega-3 ALA reduces inflammation and pain signaling
34600695.conclusion_quote: On the EAE model, chia oil preventively administered attenuated EAE-induced motor deficits and mechanical hyperalgesia in mice, suggesting a valuable effect of chia oil supplementation in regulating inflammatory responses and some immune functions during immune-mediated inflammatory disorders (IMID).
34600695.summary: In mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, preventive chia oil supplementation reduced motor deficits and pain sensitivity, suggesting benefit for inflammatory disease.

34920747.mechanism: Loss of DRD3 alters B-cell CNS homing
34920747.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate that DRD3 in B cells exerts a dual role in CNS-autoimmunity, favouring CNS-tropism of pro-inflammatory B cells with APC-function and promoting CNS-homing of B cells with anti-inflammatory features.
34920747.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the dopamine receptor D3 from B cells blocked disease in one model but worsened it in another.

33625929.conclusion_quote: These results identify an additional role of p110α in EC and reveal for the first time a specific role of p110δ in EC, providing a foundation for subsequent in vivo studies to investigate the impact of p110 isoform inhibition on arterial healing after injury.
33625929.summary: In endothelial cells from blood vessels, reducing the PI3K p110α and p110δ enzymes improved cell migration, but the study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

34526998.mechanism: blocks antigen presentation to CD8 T cells
34526998.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that CNS-myeloid cells are key APCs mediating CD8 T cell brain infiltration.
34526998.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a model of MS-like disease, removing a key antigen display gene from brain immune cells reduced harmful T cell entry and brain shrinkage.

34087164.conclusion_quote: Overall, these results demonstrate that, in addition to their cell replacement capacity, endogenous progenitors have immunomodulatory properties, highlighting a new role for endogenous SVZdNPs in myelin regeneration.
34087164.summary: In mice with myelin damage from cuprizone, researchers found that neural progenitor cells interact with immune cells called microglia and help clear myelin debris.

33620118.conclusion_quote: Together, these studies indicate activated microglia are required for and can drive demyelination directly and implicate CSF1 signaling in these events.
33620118.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, depleting microglia with the drug PLX3397 greatly reduced demyelination and oligodendrocyte loss, showing activated microglia drive myelin damage.

32401602.mechanism: Blocks NOX2-driven antigen presentation to encephalitogenic T cells
32401602.conclusion_quote: These data indicate that CYBB-regulated MOG-antigen processing and LAP in cDCs licenses encephalitogenic T H cells to initiate and sustain autoimmune neuroinflammation.
32401602.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Cybb gene in dendritic cells reduced harmful T cell entry into the brain and eased disease symptoms.

33380901.mechanism: Modulates Treg/Th17 balance and reduces IL-6 and IL-17 inflammation
33380901.conclusion_quote: Based on this study, we hypothesize that Ginsenoside Rd could be a potential and promising agent for the treatment of MS.
33380901.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, ginsenoside Rd reduced disease severity and inflammation by rebalancing immune T cells.

32637820.mechanism: phospholipid binding competes with MBP deimination
32637820.conclusion_quote: We show that lysophosphatidylcholine 18:1 provides a robust competitive effect against hyper-deimination.
32637820.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers found four phospholipids that bind myelin basic protein, with lysophosphatidylcholine 18:1 best blocking excess protein deimination.

32860610.mechanism: Alters miR-155-3p and miR-219 expression, reducing microglial activity
32860610.conclusion_quote: Based on the obtained results of this study, HCQ can decrease microglial activity and increase oligodendrocye production by altering the expression of disease-associated miRNAs.
32860610.summary: In a cuprizone mouse model of multiple sclerosis, hydroxychloroquine lowered harmful miR-155-3p levels, raised miR-219, and improved myelin recovery.

32023844.mechanism: Deletes IL-6 production from neurons, astrocytes, or microglia
32023844.conclusion_quote: The combined results reveal a minor role for Il6 expression in both astrocytes and microglia for symptomatology and neuropathology of EAE, whereas neuronal Il6 expression was not relevant for the variables analyzed.
32023844.summary: In mice with EAE, removing IL-6 from astrocytes or microglia had only a minor effect on disease, while removing it from neurons made no difference.

34589873.mechanism: Loss of Ido1 enzyme worsens autoimmune inflammation
34589873.conclusion_quote: These results confirm a protective role for Ido1 , on the pathogenesis of MOG 35-55 -induced EAE in C57BL/6J mice.
34589873.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Ido1 gene made symptoms worse, while removing the Ido2 gene had no effect on disease.

33066323.mechanism: antigen-specific tolerance via mannan-linked MOG peptide
33066323.conclusion_quote: To conclude, mannan conjugated with a deamidated product did not affect the efficacy of the parent peptide.
33066323.summary: In mice with EAE, a mannan-linked myelin peptide, both the original and a chemically altered form, reduced neurological symptoms and spinal cord inflammation and demyelination.

32172400.mechanism: Boosts IDO1, lowers IL-17A and TNF-α
32172400.conclusion_quote: In sum, our study highlights a great clinical potential of IFN-γ-hUCMSCs for multiple sclerosis (MS) treatment.
32172400.summary: In mice with EAE, umbilical cord stem cells primed with interferon gamma reduced weight loss, symptoms, and inflammatory cytokines more than unprimed cells.

31713152.mechanism: Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory, reduces oxidative stress
31713152.conclusion_quote: These results suggest a complex interaction involving exogenous melatonin, remyelination, and endogenous female sex hormones.
31713152.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, melatonin reduced inflammation and oxidative stress and improved movement, but helped remyelination only in male mice.

33148622.mechanism: Induces suppressive monocytes and kills autoreactive T cells
33148622.conclusion_quote: These findings introduce an approach for suppressing central nervous system (CNS) autoimmunity in a myelin Ag-specific manner, without the need to identify the target Ag.
33148622.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS-like disease, intravenous vesicles released by oligodendrocytes reduced disease both before and after symptoms began by restoring immune tolerance to myelin.

32917785.conclusion_quote: These findings, while shedding light on the intricacies underlying ETP lineage commitment, reveal a novel, to our knowledge, function by which IL-4 and IL-13 cytokines condition thymic microenvironment to rheostat T cell selection and fine-tune central tolerance.
32917785.summary: In mice with EAE, thymic dendritic cells that arise from IL-4 and IL-13 responsive progenitors delete myelin reactive T cells, which helps protect against disease.

31506900.mechanism: Antioxidant and immunomodulatory ethanolamine plasmalogen derivative
31506900.conclusion_quote: Altogether, the present results suggest a protective role of EAP in the CR-EAE rat hippocampus.
31506900.summary: In rats with a chronic relapsing model of MS, pretreatment with an ethanolamine phosphate salt delayed symptom onset and reduced hippocampal inflammation and oxidative stress.

32207050.mechanism: Less alpha-Synuclein dampens immune responses and late demyelination
32207050.conclusion_quote: These data provide further evidence for aSyn as regulator of peripheral immune responses under neuroinflammatory conditions, thereby also modulating degenerative events in late-stage demyelinating disease.
32207050.summary: In mice lacking alpha-Synuclein, EAE caused less inflammation and myelin loss late in disease, but cuprizone demyelination and repair were unchanged.

32193439.mechanism: Tests B-cell role in EAE via antigen presentation
32193439.conclusion_quote: These results establish a novel, efficient B cell-dependent EAE model.
32193439.summary: In mice with EAE, a longer myelin protein fragment caused disease only when B cells were present, suggesting B cells help present the antigen to other immune cells.

33240038.conclusion_quote: We report a qualitative study on central nervous system (CNS) damage that demonstrates the ability of X-ray phase contrast tomography (XPCT) to confirm data obtained with standard 2D methodology and permits the description of additional features that are not detected with 2D or other 3D techniques.
33240038.summary: Using a 3D X-ray imaging method without contrast dyes, researchers viewed brain and blood vessel damage in mice with EAE, an MS model, and in Alzheimer's mice.

31589901.mechanism: Reduces ER stress, oxidative stress and inflammation in hippocampus
31589901.conclusion_quote: According to our findings, Ac-SDKP showed beneficial effects against ER stress and oxidative stress in addition to inflammation in the hippocampus of EAE mice.
31589901.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the peptide Ac-SDKP reduced cell stress, oxidative damage and inflammation in the hippocampus, a memory region of the brain, protecting nerve cells.

32477069.mechanism: blocks virus-cell fusion and viral replication
32477069.conclusion_quote: Conclusively, A. indica bark extract may directly bind to the virus-host attachment Spike glycoprotein and suppresses MHV-induced neuroinflammation and neuropathogenesis by inhibiting cell-to-cell fusion and viral replication.
32477069.summary: In mice infected with a demyelinating coronavirus, a neem bark extract given with the virus reduced brain inflammation, nerve damage, and chronic myelin loss.

31835207.conclusion_quote: The downregulation in the expression of QKI-V5 in the blood of patients with CNS-inflammatory-demyelinating-diseases and in the brain and blood of EAE mice is likely caused by a circulating factor and might promote re-myelination by regulation of myelin-associated genes.
31835207.summary: Researchers measured QKI-V5 levels in blood from people with MS or NMO and in mice with EAE, finding it lower in both, with signs a circulating factor may be responsible.

33093659.conclusion_quote: An amendment to this paper has been published and can be accessed via a link at the top of the paper.
33093659.summary: This is a correction notice for a study in which an albumin-IL-4 fusion protein was tested in mice with EAE, but the abstract gives no results.

32554432.mechanism: Receptor restrains dendritic cell maturation and Th1/Th17 polarization
32554432.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that P2Y 6 functions as a pivotal regulator on DC maturation, and the loss of P2Y 6 results in the aggravated experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, which suggests that P2Y 6 may play a pivotal role in the pathogenesis of autoimmune diseases.
32554432.summary: In mice with EAE, lacking the P2Y6 receptor made dendritic cells more active and disease more severe than in normal mice.

32948198.mechanism: Radiolabelled antibody binds CD19 on B cells for imaging
32948198.conclusion_quote: CD19-PET imaging can be used to detect elevated levels of B cells in the CNS of EAE mice, and has the potential to impact the way we study, monitor, and treat clinical MS.
32948198.summary: This study built a PET scan tracer for CD19 on B cells, which detected more B cells in the brains of mice with EAE, a model of MS.

31932428.mechanism: Loss of gap junction protein boosts neuroinflammation
31932428.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that oligodendroglia-specific Cx47 ablation induces severe inflammation upon autoimmune demyelination, underscoring a critical role for Cx47 in regulating neuroinflammation.
31932428.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the connexin 47 gap junction protein from oligodendrocytes worsened inflammation and demyelination, with more immune cells and Th17 cells in the spinal cord.

32240164.mechanism: removes autotaxin from myeloid cells, lowering LPA signaling
32240164.conclusion_quote: Accordingly, ATX genetic deletion from CD11b+ cells attenuated the severity of EAE, thus proposing a pathogenic role for the ATX/LPA axis in neuroinflammatory disorders.
32240164.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the autotaxin gene from CD11b positive immune cells, mostly macrophages and microglia, reduced disease severity.

33040279.mechanism: Blocks IDO enzyme, lowering kynurenine pathway neurotoxic metabolites
33040279.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that the inflammatory process concomitant with the activation of IDO/KP is involved in the pathogenic mechanisms of EAE.
33040279.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, blocking the IDO enzyme reduced disease signs, inflammation, and harmful kynurenine pathway byproducts.

32353424.mechanism: inhibits DHODH enzyme, limiting T cell overactivation
32353424.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings highlight DHODH as a therapeutic target for autoimmune disease of the nervous system, and demonstrate a novel role for piperine in the treatment of MS.
32353424.summary: Piperine, a black pepper compound, blocks the DHODH enzyme and reduced inflammation and myelin damage in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

32892382.mechanism: Reduces inflammatory cytokines, apoptosis and oxidative stress
32892382.conclusion_quote: This study emphasized the immune-modulatory and antioxidative effects of shikonin, which may have an important healing effect on the severity of EAE.
32892382.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, shikonin reduced brain demyelination and inflammatory signals while boosting antioxidant activity and protective proteins.

33284575.mechanism: Induces tolerogenic dendritic cells that suppress T cells
33284575.conclusion_quote: Together, this work demonstrates the utility of immunoconjugates for inducing tolerance while establishing the foundation for future studies exploring methods to enrich and target DCs for tolerogenic therapies.
33284575.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, given a steroid linked to a peptide before disease onset had milder disease than mice given the two pieces separately.

32438469.mechanism: removing SIRPα from dendritic cells reduces Th17 cell priming
32438469.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our results suggest that SIRPα expressed on CD11c + cells, such as cDC2s and mDCs, is indispensable for the development of EAE, being required for the priming of self-reactive Th17 cells in the periphery as well as for the inflammation in the CNS.
32438469.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the SIRPα protein from dendritic immune cells reduced disease and lowered Th17 inflammatory cells in lymph nodes and the brain.

32035108.mechanism: Homes selectively to inflamed CNS tissue
32035108.conclusion_quote: We suggest that peptide MS-1 might be useful for targeted drug delivery to CNS in EAE/MS.
32035108.summary: In mice with EAE, a newly identified peptide selectively accumulated in inflamed spinal cord after injection, suggesting it could help deliver drugs to the CNS.

33046105.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our work supports a dual role for miRNAs in autoimmune demyelination.
33046105.summary: Researchers tracked microRNAs active in the cells that make myelin in mice with EAE, finding 20 that change before peak disease and some that help or hinder cell maturation.

33362775.mechanism: Scavenges ROS and activates NRF2, suppressing TXNIP/NLRP3 inflammasome
33362775.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results indicate that bixin is a promising therapeutic candidate for treatment of MS.
33362775.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS-like disease, the plant compound bixin reduced inflammation and nerve damage by activating the NRF2 antioxidant pathway.

32899717.mechanism: Selectively activates S1P1 receptor, causing internalization and lymphocyte depl
32899717.conclusion_quote: In summary, these data suggest that S1P 1 -selective compounds may have an advantage over fingolimod and siponimod, not only in MS but also in other autoimmune diseases.
32899717.summary: Two new fingolimod-like compounds, ST-1893 and ST-1894, reduced disease symptoms and immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord in mice with EAE.

32865844.mechanism: shifts T helper cells from Th1 toward Th2 gene expression
32865844.conclusion_quote: The nutraceutical approaches may be promising in the prevention and/or treatment of MS.
32865844.summary: In mice with EAE, ATRA and calcitriol, forms of vitamin A and vitamin D, lowered Th1 immune genes and raised Th2 genes in spleen cells.

32531881.mechanism: Lowers cell death and reactive gliosis after ischemia
32531881.conclusion_quote: These changes occurred because the protective effect of hypothermia in ischemic damage was disrupted by cuprizone administration.
32531881.summary: In gerbils fed cuprizone to induce demyelination, cooling before brain ischemia protected hippocampal cells, but cuprizone disrupted this protection.

33072080.conclusion_quote: In summary, more human multiple sclerosis risk genes were differentially expressed in OSE than was observed for MOG EAE, especially in T H 1 cells.
33072080.summary: Researchers compared gene activity in spontaneous and induced EAE mice, a model of MS, and found the spontaneous model better reflected human MS risk genes.

32696752.mechanism: Regulates microglia polarization and reduces inflammation
32696752.conclusion_quote: DHTS1 can suppress cuprizone-induced demyelination and cell apoptosis through regulating the microglia polarization and mitigating inflammatory reaction in the central nerve system.
32696752.summary: In mice fed the toxin cuprizone, which damages the myelin coating of nerves, the drug DHTS1 reduced myelin loss and nerve cell death by calming inflammatory microglia.

32559701.mechanism: activates CB1 receptors to reduce spasticity
32559701.conclusion_quote: cannabis extract which includes delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) is a potential treatment option for PTS in NMOSD patients.
32559701.summary: In one patient with neuromyelitis optica who had painful muscle spasms after a severe reaction to carbamazepine, cannabis extract helped control the spasms well.

32106388.mechanism: Blocks NF-κB signaling, reducing inflammation and immune activation
32106388.conclusion_quote: These data illustrated that Pari could diminish MOG-triggered EAE, as well as macrophages and T cells activation through blocking NF-κB activation.
32106388.summary: Paricalcitol, a vitamin D analogue, reduced paralysis, nerve damage and immune cell inflammation in mice with EAE by blocking an inflammatory signaling pathway.

32404525.mechanism: Loss of CD4 T cells impairs antiviral control, worsening neuron damage
32404525.conclusion_quote: In summary, the current study suggests that CD4 + T cells are critical for controlling acute-stage poliomyelitis (gray matter inflammation), chronic axonal degeneration, and inflammatory demyelination due to loss of protective antiviral host immunity.
32404525.summary: In mice infected with a mouse coronavirus used to model MS-like brain inflammation, removing CD4 T cells increased virus levels, nerve damage and spinal cord inflammation.

31906749.mechanism: Cuts acetylcholine release, limiting CD4 T-cell proliferation
31906749.conclusion_quote: These findings emphasize that inhibiting ACh release by vagotomy can ameliorate the exacerbation of EAE through suppressing CD4 + T cells proliferation and regulating the differentiation of Th1, Th2 and Th17.
31906749.summary: In mice with EAE, cutting the vagus nerve to reduce acetylcholine release eased disease, lowering CD4 T cell numbers and inflammatory cytokines.

32021162.mechanism: Blocks infiltration of microglia and Th1 cells
32021162.conclusion_quote: Intravenous administration of NHNK ameliorated the severity of EAE by suppressing the infiltration of activated microglia and Th1 cells into the spinal cord.
32021162.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, an intravenous honokiol nanoformulation given at symptom peak reduced disease severity, spinal cord inflammation and demyelination.

32524994.mechanism: Removing CD44 receptor did not change cuprizone-induced pathology
32524994.conclusion_quote: Despite a robust expression induction, Cd44-deficiency did not ameliorate cuprizone-induced pathology.
32524994.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to model demyelination, removing the CD44 gene did not reduce brain damage, although CD44 levels rose sharply in affected areas.

32199028.mechanism: Sustains mitochondrial function and energy production
32199028.conclusion_quote: The present findings corroborate the hypothesis that neuroprotective agents may be of relevance to counteract MS progression and disclose the translational potential of dexpramipexole to treatment of progressive MS patients as a stand-alone or adjunctive therapy.
32199028.summary: In female mice with a progressive MS model, oral dexpramipexole delayed disability worsening, extended survival, and reduced nerve fiber loss in the spinal cord.

34589847.mechanism: blocks P2X7 receptors on microglia, reducing inflammation
34589847.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that P2x7 receptors drive T cell-independent inflammation and demyelination, but are not relevant to regenerative responses involved in myelin repair.
34589847.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that damages myelin, lacking P2X7 receptors reduced demyelination and inflammation, but blocking them later did not improve myelin repair.

32931861.mechanism: raises Nrf-2 and IL-10, lowers IL-17 expression
32931861.conclusion_quote: Thus, alterations in lifestyle, such as regular exercise, may modulate inflammation and disease severity in patients with MS.
32931861.summary: In mice with EAE, six weeks of voluntary wheel running before disease onset raised the protective molecules Nrf-2 and IL-10, lowered IL-17, and reduced spinal cord immune cell infiltration and disease severity.

32379272.mechanism: loss of endothelial laminin limits T cell checkpoint, promotes pathogenic Th17 c
32379272.conclusion_quote: This highlights the importance of the interface between the endothelial monolayer and the underlying BM for modulation of immune cell phenotype.
32379272.summary: In mice with EAE, removing laminin 511 from blood vessel lining worsened disease by letting more harmful T cells into the brain.

31981074.mechanism: Inhibits stress-induced PP1 regulatory subunit, prolonging eIF2α phosphorylation
31981074.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that Sephin1 could be a potential anti-prion drug selectively targeting one component of the UPR pathway.
31981074.summary: In prion-infected cells and mice, the drug Sephin1 reduced harmful prion protein and extended survival, alone or combined with metformin.

32573694.mechanism: Removing IL-1 receptor from pain-sensing neurons blocks IL-1 signaling that driv
32573694.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these data reveal that neuronal IL-1R1 signaling mediates pain, uncovering the potential benefit of anti-IL-1 therapies for pain management in patients with chronic inflammatory diseases.
32573694.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the IL-1 receptor from pain-sensing nerve cells prevented pain-like behavior without changing disease progression, showing these nerve cells drive pain.

32528964.mechanism: type 1 interferon raises delta-globin mRNA and lowers beta-globin mRNA
32528964.conclusion_quote: Our results represent a proof of principle that delta-globin expression can be enhanced through the use of molecules.
32528964.summary: In knockout mice with interferon activation and in people with multiple sclerosis on interferon treatment, delta-globin and HbA2 levels rose, but the study is about blood hemoglobin rather than MS itself.

32353176.mechanism: blocks MOSPD2, reducing inflammatory monocyte migration
32353176.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that MOSPD2 is key in regulating migration of inflammatory monocytes, and that anti-MOSPD2 mAbs constitute a potential therapy for the treatment of CNS inflammatory diseases.
32353176.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the MOSPD2 gene or blocking it with antibodies reduced disease severity and inflammatory monocyte migration.

32733435.mechanism: Describes gut bacteria linked to CNS immune genes
32733435.conclusion_quote: Here, changes in a small number of distinct gut bacteria, but not overall gut microbiota, could affect acute and chronic immune responses, causing AFM- and MS-like lesions in the CNS.
32733435.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, which causes MS-like spinal disease, certain gut bacteria rose alongside immune gene activity in the spinal cord, but no treatment was tested.

32967056.mechanism: Boosts S1P lyase, lowering S1P and suppressing NF-κB signalling
32967056.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these findings revealed a novel anti-inflammatory mechanism of vitamin B6 and provided guidance on its clinical use.
32967056.summary: Vitamin B6 supplementation in mice with EAE, a model of MS, reduced inflammation by lowering S1P buildup and slowed disease progression.

33042160.mechanism: Blocks Malt1 protease, dampening NF-kB-driven T-cell activation
33042160.conclusion_quote: Thus, there is a place for further investigation of the role of Malt1 signaling in the setting of transplantation.
33042160.summary: In mice receiving skin transplants, blocking Malt1 in T cells prolonged graft survival better than cyclosporine but increased Th17 cells.

32281944.mechanism: Removing STAT5 eliminates IL-17 producing gamma-delta T cells
32281944.conclusion_quote: Our data identify that the neonatal microenvironment in combination with STAT5 is critical for post-thymic γδT17 development and tissue-specific imprinting, which is essential for infection and autoimmunity.
32281944.summary: In mice with EAE, genetically removing STAT5 eliminated a type of immune cell that drives inflammation, making the mice resistant to the disease.

31715458.mechanism: Shifts B-cell populations and reduces inflammatory T cells in CNS
31715458.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that B cell function impacts IFN-β efficacy during neuroinflammation.
31715458.summary: In mice with EAE, interferon beta reduced inflammation and inflammatory T cells only in the model where B cells were not needed for disease, and had no effect when B cells drove it.

33109748.mechanism: Activates PKM2, shifting Th17 cells toward GM-CSF
33109748.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data clarify the therapeutic potential of PKM2 activators in MS-like disease and how these agents alter T cell function.
33109748.summary: In mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis-like disease, PKM2-activating drugs TEPP-46 and DASA-58 reduced IL-17-producing immune cells but increased GM-CSF-producing ones, shifting damage to the brain.

32224229.conclusion_quote: The findings indicate that (a) the LOT and AC are indeed suitable tracts for studying lysolecithin-induced de- and remyelination and (b) experimental demyelination proceeds differently between the two tracts.
32224229.summary: In an animal model where lysolecithin injections caused myelin loss, the olfactory LOT and AC both demyelinated and recovered, with the LOT repairing faster than the AC.

31916130.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrated that CPZ-induced demyelination induces apparent alterations in the expression of most of the myelin-related genes, including the 6 key genes MBP, MAG, and MOG and GFAP, CXCR4, and NgR, which were observed to be downregulated and upregulated, respectively, suggesting that the differences in gene expression in vivo could serve as potential therapeutic targets for remyelination.
31916130.summary: In mice fed a cuprizone diet to cause demyelination, researchers measured thousands of gene activity changes, finding myelin genes like MBP and MOG were lowered.

31519420.conclusion_quote: Our findings confirmed livestock exposure to the four targeted TBDs of major concern for livestock development.
31519420.summary: A field survey of 903 livestock blood samples in the Comoros found four tick-borne diseases circulating among animals, with no multiple sclerosis model or treatment tested.

33322784.mechanism: not applicable, imaging study without treatment
33322784.conclusion_quote: The apparent temporal signal changes in GluCEST imaging during demyelination and remyelination demonstrated the potential usefulness of GluCEST imaging as a tool to monitor the myelination process.
33322784.summary: In rats fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, then allowed to recover, a brain imaging method tracked glutamate changes in the corpus callosum that followed myelin loss and repair.

31949182.mechanism: blocks vasopressin receptors, reducing blood-brain barrier leakage
31949182.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate that V1a and V2 AVP receptors can modulate BBB permeability and consequently are involved in the CNS inflammatory process during EAE.
31949182.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, blocking vasopressin receptors with conivaptan reduced blood-brain barrier leakage, perivascular inflammation and clinical signs.

32829384.mechanism: Blocks RORγt, suppressing Th17 cell differentiation
32829384.conclusion_quote: Our results showed that RORγt inverse agonists may inhibit the development of autoimmune diseases and may provide new clues for the treatment of Th17-mediated immune diseases.
