32829384.summary: Researchers tested two new small molecules that block RORγt, a driver of inflammatory Th17 cells, in mice with EAE, reducing disease severity.

31904386.conclusion_quote: Our data suggests that demyelination of the brain does not result in enhanced neurogenesis or migration of neuroblasts, supporting that myelin is not a major inhibitory factor for stroke-induced neurogenesis.
31904386.summary: In mice, deliberately demyelinating the brain with cuprizone after stroke did not boost new neuron formation, though it reduced neurogenesis in mice without stroke.

32293054.mechanism: Widens blood vessels to restore spinal blood flow and oxygen
32293054.conclusion_quote: We conclude that nimodipine could be repurposed to offer substantial clinical benefit in MS.
32293054.summary: In mice with EAE and a model of early MS lesions, nimodipine improved spinal blood flow and oxygen, restored movement, and reduced myelin loss.

31852750.mechanism: IL-9 signaling restrains GM-CSF production by CD4 T cells via dendritic cells
31852750.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that IL-9 reduces autoimmune neuroinflammation by suppressing GM-CSF production by CD4 + T cells through the modulation of DCs.
31852750.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the IL-9 receptor made disease worse, with more GM-CSF-producing T cells and inflammatory dendritic cells in the central nervous system.

33424253.mechanism: Activates Ahr, blocks Arid5a stabilization of inflammatory mRNAs
33424253.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our findings reveal differential modulation of Ahr and Arid5a as a new therapeutic strategy for MS.
33424253.summary: In mice with EAE, a compound called Flavipin reduced disease severity and inflammatory immune cells by activating Ahr and blocking Arid5a.

32875283.summary: In a humanized mouse model with human immune cells, researchers found that thymus T cells reactive to an insulin fragment are removed during development, a process relevant to autoimmune disease.

31939090.mechanism: Describes proteasome subunit changes under inflammatory cytokines
31939090.conclusion_quote: Since β5 mRNA levels are unchanged by the cytokine treatment, it is fair to conclude that displacement of constitutive β-subunits with inducible β5i subunits is likely the mechanism underlying the decrease in c-20S.
31939090.summary: In cultured neurons and astrocytes exposed to inflammatory cytokines, proteasome changes were driven mainly by swapping constitutive subunits for inducible ones.

32371484.mechanism: Enhances vascular integrity and apoptosis of infiltrated monocytes
32371484.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrate that mild hypoxia promotes recovery from preexisting inflammatory demyelinating disease and suggest that this protection is primarily the result of enhanced vascular integrity and accelerated apoptosis of infiltrated monocytes.
32371484.summary: In mice with relapsing EAE, mild low-oxygen air speeded recovery from existing disease by strengthening blood vessels and clearing inflammatory monocytes.

32189712.mechanism: No treatment tested, biomarker study only
32189712.conclusion_quote: Neurofilament light protein may be more useful as a measure of ongoing neurodegenerative activity in EAE, which would make this protein a potential candidate for use as a surrogate marker for assessment of treatments aimed at reducing axonal injury.
32189712.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, researchers tracked neurofilament protein levels over time and found it may reflect ongoing nerve damage, suggesting it could serve as a marker.

31984956.mechanism: Not applicable, describes a blood vessel isolation method
31984956.conclusion_quote: Therefore, it allows for investigation of a range of differences that may otherwise remain obscure: CNS portions (cortex, cerebellum, optic lobe, brainstem, hypothalamus, pituitary, and spinal cord), CNS tissue type (gray or white matter), individuals, experimental treatment groups, and species.
31984956.summary: Researchers developed a method to isolate blood vessels from different brain and spinal cord regions across five vertebrate groups, and tested it in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

32582799.conclusion_quote: Our results show that exposing EAE mice to thyme extract improved their clinical symptoms, however, there was no significant effect on urinary melatonin concentration.
32582799.summary: Thyme extract given to mice with EAE, a model of MS, improved their clinical symptoms but did not change urinary melatonin levels.

32278882.conclusion_quote: The data presented clearly indicated that the severity index is a suitable tool to analyze disease severity in EAE.
32278882.summary: In mice with EAE, a new severity score tracked higher levels of immune cells that calm inflammation with more damage to myelin and nerve fibers.

31828731.mechanism: no treatment tested, describes protective RAS changes
31828731.conclusion_quote: These data provide evidence that the protective arm of RAS, through both ligand and receptor expression, is associated with reductions in the pathological processes that occur in the earlier stages of MS and EAE, possibly slowing the neurodegenerative process and enhancing neural repair.
31828731.summary: In an EAE animal model and human MS brain tissue, researchers found that protective renin angiotensin system components rise during disease stabilization and remyelination.

32222873.mechanism: Loss of liver sialylation promotes T cell inflammation
32222873.conclusion_quote: These findings align with previously reported pro-inflammatory changes in liver macrophages, and support a model in which the liver microenvironment sets a systemic immune tone that is regulated by tissue α2,6-sialylation and mediated by liver macrophages and systemic T cells.
32222873.summary: In mice lacking the ST6Gal1 enzyme in liver cells, reduced liver sialylation drove more T cell inflammation and worsened EAE, a mouse model of MS.

32703234.mechanism: Loss increases proteoglycans, macrophage TNF and MMP output
32703234.conclusion_quote: These results emphasize CSPGs as a prominent modulator of neuroinflammation and they highlight CSPGs accumulating in lesions in promoting axonal injury.
32703234.summary: In mice lacking the EXTL2 enzyme, spinal cord demyelination caused more proteoglycan buildup, nerve damage and inflammation than in normal mice.

32014578.conclusion_quote: The results suggest that CPZ differentially affects oligodendrocytes throughout the CNS and induces subtle motor changes such as ataxia.
32014578.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a demyelinating toxin, foot slips increased on walking tests, and demyelination was widespread, most severe in the cerebellum and brainstem.

32536579.mechanism: Overexpressed Id1 raises regulatory T cells and lowers autoantibodies
32536579.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that during the pathogenesis of SLE, up-regulation of Id3 can promote Treg differentiation to play an inhibitory effect on autoimmune responses.
32536579.summary: This study of lupus patients and mice found that the protein Id3 rose with regulatory T cells and disease activity, and mice overexpressing Id1 had more regulatory T cells and fewer autoantibodies.

31637574.mechanism: promotes remyelination and suppresses microglia and astrocyte inflammation
31637574.conclusion_quote: All the data prove that Compound 21 exerts protective effect on MS through promoting remyelination and suppressing neuroinflammation, indicating that Compound 21 might be a potential drug candidate for MS treatment.
31637574.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced MS, compound 21 improved movement and coordination, promoted myelin repair, and reduced brain inflammation.

32087232.mechanism: suppresses dendritic cell maturation and antigen presentation
32087232.conclusion_quote: Our results implicated the alleviative effect of early ASI administration on EAE might be mediated by suppressing the maturation and function of DCs.
32087232.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, early daily astragaloside IV delayed symptoms and reduced severity by calming immune cells called dendritic cells.

32687611.mechanism: Induces antigen-specific Tr1 cells that suppress autoimmunity
32687611.conclusion_quote: These results thus provide new insights into the rules that govern Tr1-cell recruitment and their autoregulatory function.
32687611.summary: A computer model of immune cells in mice with both liver and brain-spinal cord autoimmunity found that nanoparticle-based Tr1 cell treatment mainly helps the liver, not the nervous system.

31963761.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results demonstrate that CPZ-mediated demyelination induces behavioral deficits with apparent alterations in miRNA expression, suggesting that differences in miRNA expression in vivo may be new potential therapeutic targets for remyelination.
31963761.summary: In mice fed the cuprizone toxin diet to cause demyelination, researchers found movement and anxiety problems and 240 changed microRNAs, with some suggesting possible future remyelination targets.

32581731.conclusion_quote: These data for the first time demonstrated the CPZ-induced mitochondria dysfunction in brain cells of living mouse and specified the differential susceptibility and vulnerability of brain cells to the CPZ intoxication.
32581731.summary: In mice fed the toxin cuprizone for one week, oligodendrocytes which make myelin were most damaged, while neurons were largely spared.

33243290.conclusion_quote: The behavior of ex-Th17 cells in EAE lesions in vivo resembles Th1 rather than Th17 cells, underlining that their change in cytokine production is associated with functional phenotype alterations of these cells.
33243290.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, former Th17 immune cells that began making interferon gamma moved through inflamed brain and spinal cord tissue like Th1 cells.

32112820.mechanism: Promotes oligodendrocyte progenitor differentiation and survival
32112820.conclusion_quote: Our study suggest that NEP1-40 can promote OPC differentiation and survival.
32112820.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, injecting NEP1-40 into the hippocampus reduced depression-like behavior and helped oligodendrocyte precursor cells mature.

32355819.mechanism: Antioxidant actions reduce oxidative damage and cell death
32355819.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that DMF may alleviate PSCI via neuroprotective actions, providing a new therapeutic strategy for PSCI.
32355819.summary: In rats with stroke, dimethyl fumarate improved memory and reduced nerve cell death and oxidative damage, suggesting protection against post stroke cognitive decline.

30730246.mechanism: Not applicable, describes lesions without treatment
30730246.conclusion_quote: Our findings underscore the relevance of this nonhuman primate EAE model for better understanding mechanisms of MS lesion formation in the SC.
30730246.summary: In marmosets with EAE, a monkey model of MS, researchers used MRI and tissue staining to map spinal cord lesions, finding focal and subpial lesions tied to myelin loss.

32289743.mechanism: enhances myelin debris clearance and shifts microglia to M2 phenotype
32289743.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our results demonstrated CZ-7 has a potential therapeutic effect for MS and other demyelinating diseases through enhancing myelin debris clearance to improve the microenvironment.
32289743.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, the new compound CZ-7 improved behavior and remyelination by helping cells clear myelin debris.

32843103.conclusion_quote: Immunohistochemical studies demonstrated that these microglia with NG2 gene activity also synthesized the NG2 protein, suggesting activated microglia as an additional source of the NG2 proteoglycan after acute brain injuries.
32843103.summary: In mice with stroke and stab wounds, activated microglia turned on the NG2 gene and made NG2 protein, while NG2-expressing precursor cells did not become microglia.

32892670.mechanism: Reduces inflammation and apoptosis in fetal tissues
32892670.conclusion_quote: The findings of the present study confirm the neuroprotective effects of antenatally administered fingolimod, which also significantly improved preterm fetal lung injury and placental inflammation in LPS-exposed preterm pregnancies by possible antiapoptotic and anti-inflammatory effects.
32892670.summary: In a rat model of preterm birth caused by infection, pregnant rats given fingolimod had less inflammation and cell death in the placenta, fetal lung, and brain.

32194859.mechanism: Inhibits T cell activation and Th1 differentiation
32194859.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that dNP2-LRR is a novel agent, which regulates effector T cell functions and could be a promising molecule for the treatment of CNS autoimmune diseases such as multiple sclerosis.
32194859.summary: In mice with EAE, a peptide linked NLRX1 protein fragment that crosses the blood brain barrier reduced inflammation and disease severity by suppressing T cell activity.

31963428.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest a role for TSPAN32 in the immune responses underlying the pathophysiology of MS and represent a proof-of-concept for additional studies aiming at dissecting the eventual contribution of TSPAN32 in other autoimmune diseases and its possible use of TSPAN32 as a diagnostic factor and therapeutic target.
31963428.summary: In blood and immune cells from people with multiple sclerosis, the protein TSPAN32 was found to be lower than in healthy people, suggesting a role in the disease.

31863516.conclusion_quote: CS is advantageous whenever image features are close to the detection threshold.
31863516.summary: Tests a compressed sensing image reconstruction method for fluorine MRI at low signal, including in mice with EAE, to detect faint signals more reliably.

31759082.conclusion_quote: Data obtained from the present study suggest that nuclear accumulation of GAPDH, GluA2 and p53 plays a key role in the pathophysiology of neuronal cell death in PD.
31759082.summary: Post-mortem brain tissue from people with Parkinson's disease showed more GAPDH, GluA2, p53 and caspase 3 in cell nuclei, linked to cell death.

32613467.mechanism: Downregulates AQP4 via A2B receptor and p38 MAPK
32613467.conclusion_quote: Thus, we concluded that mesenchymal stem cells alleviated blood-brain barrier disruption by downregulating AQP4 in multiple sclerosis, possibly through inhibiting the A 2B AR/p38 MAPK signaling pathway.
32613467.summary: Transplanted stem cells given at disease onset reduced blood-brain barrier leakage and lowered the AQP4 water channel in mice with EAE, an MS model, and improved their symptoms.

31830588.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our data suggest that DKI and microstructural modeling can provide a unique contrast capable of detecting EAE-specific changes correlating with clinical disability.
31830588.summary: Researchers used advanced MRI on spinal cords from mice with EAE to link tissue damage measures with disability severity.

32504082.mechanism: Removing TMEM106B impairs oligodendrocyte myelination and remyelination
32504082.conclusion_quote: Together these findings reveal an important function for TMEM106B in myelination with possible consequences for therapeutic strategies aimed at lowering TMEM106B levels.
32504082.summary: In mice, deleting the Tmem106b gene made myelin loss from cuprizone worse and slowed myelin repair, suggesting caution for therapies that lower this gene.

33357244.conclusion_quote: The present study points to the importance of astrocyte-oligodendrocyte interactions for remyelination, highlighting the necessity to further determine the impact of astrocyte dysfunction on remyelination inefficiency in demyelinating disorders including MS.
33357244.summary: In rats with osmotic demyelination and human autopsy tissue, losing astrocytes kept precursor cells from maturing into myelin making cells, so lesions repaired poorly.

32192522.mechanism: Describes microglia Wnt7a role in stem cell differentiation
32192522.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data reveal the role of reparative microglia in NSC oligodendrogenesis with the involvement of Wnt7a.
32192522.summary: In a virus-induced demyelination model, repair-promoting microglia were found to release Wnt7a, which helps neural stem cells develop into myelin-producing oligodendrocytes.

32146280.mechanism: blocks ER protein translocation and retro-translocation
32146280.conclusion_quote: Together, our data indicate that CD4 + T cell function, and Th1 cell function in particular, is dependent on protein translocation and dislocation across the ER.
32146280.summary: In lab-grown T cells and mice with EAE, blocking protein transport in the endoplasmic reticulum reduced inflammatory signals from Th1 cells, and NMS-873 lessened disease severity.

32534098.mechanism: Estrogen receptor alpha signalling regulates microglial activation
32534098.conclusion_quote: Thus, our results identify agathisflavone as a novel compound that may act via ER to regulate microglial activation and enhance remyelination and repair.
32534098.summary: In mouse cerebellar slices with lysolecithin-induced myelin damage, the flavonoid agathisflavone enhanced myelin repair and changed microglial activity, effects blocked by estrogen receptor inhibition.

32572784.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that TRPA1 plays an important role of the LPC-induced oxidative stress and cell damage in OLN-93 oligodendrocyte.
32572784.summary: In a rat oligodendrocyte cell line exposed to lysophosphatidylcholine, the study found that the TRPA1 ion channel drives oxidative stress and cell damage, a finding from cells alone.

33246492.mechanism: Protects intestinal barrier, reduces oxidative stress and gut inflammation
33246492.conclusion_quote: These findings reveal that OA ameliorates the gut dysfunction found in EAE mice.
33246492.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, oleanolic acid protected the gut lining, reduced inflammation and oxidative stress, and improved gut health markers.

32428844.mechanism: Inhibits DHODH, reducing pyrimidine synthesis and T-cell proliferation
32428844.conclusion_quote: The investigations highlighted that the desired selective immunomodulatory properties can be separated from general antiproliferative effects seen and related adverse events in first-generation DHODH inhibitors.
32428844.summary: In rats with EAE and human immune cells, vidofludimus blocked DHODH more strongly than teriflunomide and reduced disease scores as doses increased.

31656989.mechanism: Precursors suppress T cells and protect myelin
31656989.conclusion_quote: To conclude, glial-committed human NPC induce ongoing immune-regulatory and neuroprotective effects, following transplantation into mice with a clinical-relevant model of chronic-active MS and during established disease, entering the chronic phase.
31656989.summary: In mice with chronic progressive EAE, transplanted human precursor cells reduced disease severity, inflammation, demyelination and axon loss.

33081798.mechanism: inhibits RNA polymerase-1 ribosomal RNA production
33081798.conclusion_quote: These data correlate RAM-589.555-induced clinical amelioration and its CNS-permeability to decreased CNS-inflammation, and decreased micro- and astrogliosis, while restoring micro- and astroglial anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective capacity.
33081798.summary: In mice with EAE, an oral drug reached the brain, calmed inflammation, and protected support cells, improving disease symptoms.

28609201.mechanism: STAT3 promotes Tiam1 expression while Smad3 suppresses it
28609201.conclusion_quote: Our findings uncover the complexity of STAT3/Smad3 signaling in regulating Tiam1 expression and Th17 cells.
28609201.summary: Laboratory study of mouse immune T cells showing that the signaling proteins STAT3 and Smad3 have opposite effects on Tiam1 gene activity in Th17 cells, without testing an MS model.

32087283.mechanism: Suppresses TLR4-mediated NF-κB and MAPK p38 signaling
32087283.conclusion_quote: Therefore, this study suggests that DHT exerts anti-neuroinflammatory and neuroprotective effects; thus, androgen replacement therapy is a potential therapeutic strategy for improving cognitive and behavioral function in neuroinflammation-related diseases.
32087283.summary: In mice with lipopolysaccharide-induced brain inflammation, the hormone dihydrotestosterone reduced inflammation and nerve damage and improved memory and movement.

32244486.conclusion_quote: Significantly, many of the predicted hotspot residues were found to be conserved in representative viruses from different genera, suggesting that the molecular determinants of capsid assembly are conserved across the family.
32244486.summary: Computer analysis of a virus capsid that infects mice predicted key residues for subunit assembly, many shared across virus genera. No multiple sclerosis model or treatment was tested.

31332963.mechanism: Enhances microglial clearance of myelin debris, promoting remyelination
31332963.conclusion_quote: Ganaxolone promotes remyelination in response to focal demyelination of the corpus callosum of ovariectomized rats.
31332963.summary: In female rats with a lysolecithin-induced brain demyelinating lesion, daily ganaxolone injections promoted myelin repair by helping immune cells clear damaged myelin.

32103474.conclusion_quote: The present study revealed, for the first time, the emergence and maturation of key cartilage and bone collagens, in high resolution, at multiple locations across the entire rudiment, including the joint regions, at three of the most developmentally significant stages of skeletogenesis, furthering the understanding of disease and regeneration of skeletal tissues.
32103474.summary: In developing mouse embryos, researchers mapped where key collagen proteins appear and how they organise in forming cartilage, bone and joints. This study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

32022313.conclusion_quote: The results show significant time/frequency-dependency of diffusional kurtosis in the mouse brain, which can provide sensitivity to probe intrinsic cellular heterogeneity and pathological alterations in gray and white matter.
32022313.summary: In ex vivo mouse brains, including cuprizone-treated mice with demyelination, diffusion MRI measurements changed with scan timing, revealing white matter damage.

31812846.mechanism: Blocks IL-6 in gut tissue, reducing Th17 cells
31812846.conclusion_quote: Ingested ACTH inhibits EAE clinical disease by inhibiting IL-6 in the GALT.
31812846.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, oral ACTH given during active disease reduced symptoms by lowering IL6 in gut immune tissue and shifting T cell balance.

32169103.mechanism: Loss of Sema4A reduces Th17 cell driven inflammation
32169103.conclusion_quote: Sema4A is involved not only in the Th cell priming but also in the acceleration of Th17 cell-mediated neuroinflammation in the effector phase, which could contribute to the higher disease activity observed in RRMS patients with high serum Sema4A levels.
32169103.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Sema4A gene reduced disease severity driven by Th17 immune cells, suggesting Sema4A helps fuel inflammation after the immune attack begins.

32772264.mechanism: Activates TREM2 on microglia, boosting myelin debris clearance
32772264.conclusion_quote: These results are relevant as they propose TREM2 on microglia as a potential new target to promote remyelination.
32772264.summary: In the cuprizone mouse model of demyelination, a TREM2-activating antibody helped microglia clear myelin debris, increased new myelin-forming cells, and supported axon integrity.

32047502.mechanism: Lack of PTPN22 expands activated effector and regulatory T cells during lymphope
32047502.conclusion_quote: Overall the expansion of Tregs is likely to keep the expanded T effector populations in check and sparing Treg during therapeutic mAb depletion may be a useful strategy to prevent occurrence of secondary autoimmunity.
32047502.summary: In mice whose T cells were depleted with antibodies, lacking the PTPN22 gene led to more active immune T cells and more regulatory T cells during recovery.

32926949.mechanism: protects myelin, reduces glial activation, enhances endogenous remyelination
32926949.conclusion_quote: Overall, our data suggest that nano-Hst reduces the latency of visual signals through its protective effects on myelin sheath, amelioration of glial activation, and enhancement of endogenous remyelination.
32926949.summary: In rats whose optic chiasm was damaged by lysolecithin, oral nano-hesperetin shortened visual signal delay, reduced myelin loss and glial activation, and boosted natural myelin repair.

33282858.mechanism: Deleting LRP1 from progenitor cells increases oligodendrocyte differentiation
33282858.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that the selective blockade of LRP1 function on adult OPCs may enhance myelin repair in demyelinating diseases such as multiple sclerosis.
33282858.summary: In mice, deleting the LRP1 receptor from adult progenitor cells produced more new myelin forming cells and improved repair after cuprizone damage to myelin.

32998402.mechanism: Not applicable: no treatment or genetic change tested
32998402.conclusion_quote: We provide strong evidence that the diffuse increase in anti-AQP4 staining intensity is due to a metabolic injury to the brain, whereas the focal, perivascular loss of anti-AQP4 immunoreactivity is mediated by peripheral immune cells.
32998402.summary: In mice with toxin-induced demyelination and autoimmune EAE, the water channel AQP4 rose diffusely but dropped near immune cell entry sites.

32221280.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes a human microglia transplant model
32221280.conclusion_quote: This model will serve as a tool to study the role of human microglia in brain development and degeneration.
32221280.summary: Researchers transplanted human stem cell derived microglia into mouse brains, where the cells kept human traits and responded to cuprizone toxin damage.

32418846.mechanism: Antioxidant that reduces oxidative stress in the retina
32418846.conclusion_quote: Results do not support ALA having beneficial effects on GA or BCVA.
32418846.summary: In a randomized trial of 53 people with geographic atrophy, an oral antioxidant supplement did not slow the loss of retinal tissue or improve vision compared with placebo.

32900255.mechanism: Shifts gut microbiota, raises butyrate, reduces CNS inflammation
32900255.conclusion_quote: Our data reinforce the beneficial effects of oral probiotics that would be coadjuvant treatments to current MS therapies.
32900255.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a model of progressive MS, an oral probiotic improved motor disability and reduced spinal cord inflammation while changing gut bacteria.

33208869.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that DCX-expressing NPCs were able to contribute to the generation of mature oligodendrocytes during remyelination in the adult hippocampus.
33208869.summary: In mice given cuprizone to strip myelin, researchers tracked brain progenitor cells in the hippocampus and found some became oligodendrocytes that make myelin during repair.

31552482.mechanism: Removing LRP1 in OPCs impairs antigen presentation
31552482.conclusion_quote: Our study places OPCs as major regulators of neuroinflammation in an LRP1-dependent fashion.
31552482.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing LRP1 from oligodendrocyte progenitor cells dampened inflammation and improved myelin repair.

32265335.mechanism: Virus induces interferon, blocking IL-12 and IL-23
32265335.conclusion_quote: Here, we demonstrate that the protective effects of some rodent malaria strains on T cell-mediated inflammatory pathologies are due to an RNA virus cohosted in malaria-parasitized blood.
32265335.summary: In mice with EAE and cerebral malaria, a mouse virus found in malaria parasite stocks reduced immune activation and disease, so it could confound these studies.

33114541.conclusion_quote: Thus, the anti-oxidative stress function is a critical process to maintain the normal physiological function of sperm.
33114541.summary: This study used metabolomics to examine how eel sperm become active, finding changes in energy use and antioxidant defense. It does not involve multiple sclerosis or any animal model of MS.

32597864.mechanism: Not applicable, describes an ex vivo model
32597864.conclusion_quote: Thus, cerebellar slice cultures are a fast, reproducible, and quantifiable model for recapitulating myelination.
32597864.summary: Researchers describe a mouse cerebellar slice culture system for studying myelin formation and repair after hypoxia or chemical damage, as a fast and reproducible model.

31820013.mechanism: Blocks TRPA1 calcium influx, reducing macrophage ROS and IL-1β
31820013.conclusion_quote: Therefore, the inhibition of TRPA1 may protect THP-1-derived macrophages against LPC-induced injury.
31820013.summary: In laboratory-grown human macrophage cells, blocking the TRPA1 calcium channel reduced harmful oxidant production, cell death and IL-1β release triggered by a fatty lipid, with no MS model used.

33074649.conclusion_quote: The challenge now remains to utilize these insights to push development of new immunotherapeutics into clinical settings.
33074649.summary: This review describes how self assembling biomaterials could improve immunotherapies for cancer and autoimmune disease, including a mouse model of multiple sclerosis, without testing new treatments.

32307944.mechanism: Reduces cell death through extrinsic and intrinsic pathways
32307944.conclusion_quote: In cultured VSMCs treated with lysoPC, 17β-E₂ reduced apoptotic cell death by down-regulating both extrinsic and intrinsic apoptosis pathways, contributing to the preventive action of MHT against CHD.
32307944.summary: In rat blood vessel muscle cells exposed to a fat-derived toxin, estradiol reduced cell death, pointing to a heart protective effect of hormone therapy rather than any effect on multiple sclerosis.

31490574.mechanism: Inhibits hyaluronidase, unblocking oligodendrocyte progenitor maturation
31490574.conclusion_quote: All together, these findings support the notion that hyaluronidase activity originating from OPCs in CNS lesions is sufficient to prevent OPC maturation, which delays myelination or blocks remyelination.
31490574.summary: In mice with lysolecithin-induced corpus callosum demyelination, the S3 hyaluronidase inhibitor accelerated oligodendrocyte maturation and improved functional remyelination.

33643554.mechanism: reduces oxidative stress and protects cerebellar tissue
33643554.conclusion_quote: However, KV intervention significantly enhanced behavioral functions and ameliorated CPZ-induced cerebellar degeneration.
33643554.summary: In rats with cuprizone-induced demyelination, Kolaviron improved movement and exploration, reduced oxidative stress, and protected the cerebellum.

31904273.conclusion_quote: In-process microbiological controls combined with PMB PCR screening provide a comprehensive assessment of UC-MSC exposure to infectious risk, vertical transmission risk appearing inherently low.
31904273.summary: This study screened horse umbilical cord stem cell products and mothers' blood for infectious pathogens, and does not involve multiple sclerosis.

33195607.mechanism: Not applicable, not an MS study
33195607.conclusion_quote: This study, therefore indicated that Polysorbate-20 together with Candida rugosa lipases had promising ability to improve growth performance of broiler chickens fed with low energy diet and curtail the growth depression without affecting blood metabolites, carcass, and visceral organs weights.
33195607.summary: This study tested feed emulsifiers and lipase enzymes in broiler chickens fed a low-energy diet, finding one combination improved growth. It does not involve multiple sclerosis.

31726178.conclusion_quote: Our multiomics-based analysis identified 110 OMP-nMGs implicated in energy production and lipid and glycan biosynthesis in the pathogenesis and pathophysiology of demyelinating disorders.
31726178.summary: Researchers analyzed mitochondrial genes across species, cuprizone-treated mice, and MS patient brain tissue, finding 110 linked to energy production and demyelinating disease.

33654948.conclusion_quote: The EAE model will continue to be useful for development of therapeutics for MS.
33654948.summary: This protocol describes how to induce a chronic disease resembling multiple sclerosis in C57BL/6J mice by immunizing them with a myelin protein, to study the disease.

32733206.mechanism: activates TNFR2 receptor, boosting myelin basic protein production
32733206.conclusion_quote: It also shows that TNFR2 is an early marker of microglia activation and promotes myelin synthesis, suggesting that microglial TNFR2 activation can be exploited therapeutically to stimulate CNS repair.
32733206.summary: In mouse cerebellar slices with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, an antibody that activates TNFR2 increased myelin protein, suggesting a route to brain repair.

33178205.conclusion_quote: Airway epithelial mRBPs profiling reveals a COPD-specific global downregulation of RBPs shared by a subset of control smokers, the potential of functional cooperation by coexpressed RBPs and significant impact on relevant pathogenetic pathways in COPD.
33178205.summary: Researchers measured RNA binding protein levels in airway cells from people with COPD, smokers, and severe asthma, finding widespread lowered levels in COPD.

31444265.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that pregnancy supports the expansion of Treg clonotypes that are equipped to recognize EAE-associated Ags.
31444265.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, pregnancy expanded regulatory T cells that recognize disease linked antigens, which may help explain pregnancy related protection.

30768649.conclusion_quote: This data suggests a strong association between autoantibody localization and disease.
30768649.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, fluorescent antibodies lingered in the brain and spinal cord, tracking with disease severity and overlapping with enzyme activity that breaks down tissue.

31409036.mechanism: Ganciclovir kills GFAP-expressing astrocytes via thymidine kinase
31409036.conclusion_quote: The present study indicates that astrocyte depletion in virus triggered CNS diseases contributes to a deterioration of clinical signs that are mediated by a dysfunction of perivascular astrocytes.
31409036.summary: In SJL mice with a virus-induced MS-like disease, removing astrocytes worsened clinical signs, reduced spinal cord inflammation, and caused blood vessel leakage.

31068461.mechanism: plasma extracellular vesicles deliver fibrinogen that drives CD8+ T cells
31068461.conclusion_quote: Together, these data suggest that fibrinogen in pEVs contributes to the perpetuation of neuroinflammation and relapses in disease.
31068461.summary: In mice with EAE, plasma extracellular vesicles carrying fibrinogen caused relapsing disease driven by CD8+ T cells, and fibrinogen was also found in vesicles from MS patients.

31412103.mechanism: MicroRNAs block glutamate receptor signalling, desensitising neurons
31412103.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that miR-223-3p and miR-27a-3p are upregulated in response to inflammation to mediate a compensatory neuroprotective gene expression program that desensitizes neurons to glutamate by targeting messenger RNAs involved in glutamate receptor signalling.
31412103.summary: In mice with EAE, adding microRNA-223-3p protected nerve fibres from damage, and both microRNAs shielded cultured neurons from inflammatory injury.

30733631.conclusion_quote: An unexpected finding was that microglial cells at this time were in a "deactivated" state, and further studies suggested that the microglial deactivation was responsible for the increased excitatory drive.
30733631.summary: In an animal model of MS called EAE, brain immune cells called microglia were unexpectedly less active early on, which increased nerve signaling in the amygdala.

31016368.conclusion_quote: In summary, we provide a protocol that allows to study the direct interplay of immune-mediated and metabolic oligodendrocyte injury and its consequences for the cerebral white and grey matters.
31016368.summary: In mice with EAE, adding cuprizone to make the brain's myelin fragile produced lesions resembling type III MS lesions, giving researchers a model to study immune and metabolic damage.

31366377.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that EAE can be used to study the pathobiology of optic neuropathy and to examine the preclinical neuroprotective effects of drugs that target activation of neurotoxic A1 astrocytes.
31366377.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, support cells in the optic nerve and retina turned toxic, and retinal nerve cells died weeks later.

30724464.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the study provides an understanding of the pathogenesis of MS in the EAE animal model.
30724464.summary: This study mapped protein changes in five brain regions and the spinal cord of mice with EAE, finding the spinal cord had the most altered proteins.

31522437.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrates that level of IL-17 production is directly associated with inflammation and demyelination.
31522437.summary: In mice with EAE induced by different doses of myelin protein, higher serum IL-17 levels matched more brain inflammation and demyelination.

31466733.mechanism: nematode infection alters activation state of CD11b cells
31466733.conclusion_quote: This activation state illustrates the heterogeneity of CD11b + cells in EAE mice following nematode invasion; these may have important consequences for understanding the effects of CD11b integrin, which is involved in the downregulation of neuroinflammatory disorders.
31466733.summary: In mice with EAE, infection with the intestinal worm Heligmosomoides polygyrus changed the activation state of CD11b immune cells, which may help explain how the infection calms inflammation.

31377418.mechanism: blocks Drp1 mitochondrial recruitment and mitophagy
31377418.conclusion_quote: Together, we conclude that ONOO - serves as a key mediator in Drp1 nitration modification and assembly for facilitating mitophagy activation.
31377418.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the Drp1 protein or neutralizing peroxynitrite reduced harmful mitophagy, axon damage and nerve cell death.

31998072.conclusion_quote: Here, we summarize the role of TLRs and MyD88 in MS and discuss the possible therapies that are based on these molecules.
31998072.summary: This review summarizes how TLR and MyD88 immune signaling may contribute to multiple sclerosis and its animal model, EAE, and discusses possible treatments based on these molecules.

31376787.mechanism: reduces cytokines and GSK-3β, modulates histone enzymes
31376787.conclusion_quote: Altogether, results demonstrate beneficial effects and potential targets of chrysin in EAE.
31376787.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, chrysin reduced weight loss, clinical signs, and inflammatory cytokine levels.

31624998.conclusion_quote: Our results point to the possible link between Kv1.5 channel and the pathophysiological processes in EAE.
31624998.summary: Researchers measured the potassium channel Kv1.5 in rat spinal cords with EAE, finding lower levels at peak disease and expression mainly in astrocytes.

30853826.mechanism: No treatment tested, inflammation lowers olfactory signal genes
30853826.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that inflammation in the olfactory bulb of EAE-affected mice is associated with the downregulation of some olfactory signal transduction genes, particularly olfactory marker protein and stomatin-like 3, which may lead to olfactory dysfunction in an animal model of human multiple sclerosis.
30853826.summary: In mice with EAE, inflammation in the olfactory bulb was linked to lower activity of genes involved in smell, including OMP and STOML3, which may explain smell problems.

31611942.mechanism: Inhibits RIPK1 kinase, blocking oligodendrocyte apoptosis and necroptosis
31611942.conclusion_quote: The present study revealed that Nec-1 effectively attenuated the progression of EAE by suppressing apoptosis and necroptosis in oligodendrocytes, and represents a potential novel therapeutic agent for the treatment of MS.
31611942.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug Necrostatin-1 reduced disease severity, spinal cord damage and inflammation by protecting myelin-producing cells from dying.

31228686.mechanism: Describes immune response during remyelination, no treatment tested
31228686.conclusion_quote: However, compared to CFA mice, remyelination was reduced (day 14) suggesting this aggressive immune response also compromised myelin repair in EAE mice.
31228686.summary: In mice, an autoimmune inflammation model (EAE) speeded early myelin repair after a brain lesion but slowed repair at a later stage.

30823515.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease lesions without testing treatment
30823515.conclusion_quote: This comparative study further indicates the suitability of TMEV-IDD as animal model also for the investigation of progressive SC lesions in MS.
30823515.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, spinal cord lesions resembled those in progressive multiple sclerosis, including axon loss, though demyelination mainly hit white matter in mice.

30674717.mechanism: Neuronal PERK loss removes ATF4-independent axon protection
30674717.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that PERK activation in neurons protects axons and neurons against inflammation in MS and EAE through ATF4-independent mechanisms.
30674717.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the PERK gene from neurons worsened nerve damage, nerve cell loss and myelin loss and delayed recovery, while removing ATF4 had no effect.

30426768.conclusion_quote: Tet protein-mediated 5hmC modifications represent a critical target involved in EAE-induced myelin damage.
30426768.summary: In mice with EAE, vitamin C raised DNA hydroxymethylation and BDNF levels in the spinal cord, reducing neurological deficits and suggesting epigenetic targeting may help MS.

31221818.conclusion_quote: Regulation of intestinal microbiota composition can become a new therapeutic target for the treatment of MS.
31221818.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, gut bacteria shifted over time as immune signals and Axl and SOCS3 levels changed, suggesting gut microbes may matter in MS.

31427972.mechanism: inhibits NF-κB signaling, reducing dendritic cell activation
31427972.conclusion_quote: These findings, for the first time, demonstrated the ability of Scopoletin to impair DC activation, downregulating pathogenic Th1/Th17 inflammatory cell responses and, eventually, reducing EAE severity.
31427972.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a plant compound called scopoletin reduced immune cell activation and inflammation in the brain and spinal cord, lessening disease severity.

31281443.mechanism: Enriched housing improves cognition and motor function
31281443.conclusion_quote: It was therefore concluded that EE can improve MS-associated cognitive and motor deficits.
31281443.summary: Mice fed a cuprizone diet that damages myelin performed better on memory and motor tests when housed in an enriched environment, while induced depression worsened results.

30649100.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes spinal cord changes
30649100.conclusion_quote: We propose that tactile hypersensitivity in female EAE mice may be more immune-driven, whereas pain in male mice with EAE may rely more heavily on neurodegenerative and plasticity-related mechanisms.
30649100.summary: In mice with EAE, males showed nerve injury and enlarged neuron branching in the spinal cord, while both sexes showed inflammation linked to touch sensitivity.

31137960.mechanism: Boosts NK cell activity, cutting inflammatory cytokines
31137960.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data demonstrated that TGF-β could confer protection against EAE model in mice through NK cells, which would be useful for the clinical therapy of MS.
31137960.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, giving TGF-β reduced disease severity and inflammation, apparently by boosting natural killer cells.

31673072.mechanism: Alters histone methylation, miRNA and lncRNA expression
31673072.conclusion_quote: In summary, this study demonstrates that CBD suppresses inflammation through multiple mechanisms, from histone methylation to miRNA to lncRNA.
31673072.summary: In mice with EAE, an animal model of MS, cannabidiol eased symptoms and changed histone marks, microRNAs and long noncoding RNAs in immune T cells.

31778303.mechanism: Inhibits acid sphingomyelinase enzyme, reducing neuroinflammation
31778303.conclusion_quote: The studies identify the acid sphingomyelinase as a novel therapeutic target for treating MS patients.
31778303.summary: In mice with EAE, an animal model of MS, the drug amitriptyline blocked acid sphingomyelinase, reducing disease symptoms and attenuating harmful brain inflammation.

31103935.mechanism: Growth factors promote remyelination and reduce inflammation
31103935.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, these data suggest the PRP as a potential candidate for MS treatment.
31103935.summary: In mice with EAE, an intrathecal injection of platelet-rich plasma improved movement and remyelination and reduced inflammation, suggesting possible use for MS.

31998225.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes imaging biomarker of lesions
31998225.conclusion_quote: Therefore, MRE could emerge as a safe tool suitable to monitor disease activity in MS.
31998225.summary: In EAE, an animal model of MS, researchers used elastography to detect brain stiffness loss at lesions, which tracked clinical disability and fibronectin levels.

31033006.mechanism: lowers inflammatory cytokines and boosts antioxidant enzymes
31033006.conclusion_quote: Our results have confirmed that curcumin is an effective therapeutic agent that could ameliorate the severity of EAE.
31033006.summary: Curcumin given to mice with EAE, a model of MS, reduced inflammatory cytokines, raised antioxidant activity, and lessened myelin loss in the brain.

31051217.mechanism: Removes FABP7 from astrocytes, altering inflammation and fibronectin production
31051217.conclusion_quote: Collectively, FABP7 in astrocyte may have a role to protect from the induction of inflammation leading to demyelination in CNS at early phase of EAE.
31051217.summary: In mice in which the FABP7 gene was removed, EAE symptoms began earlier with more early spinal cord inflammation, but later disease scores were milder.

30901861.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or gene change tested
30901861.conclusion_quote: Our exploratory studies therefore show that genetic background influences the effects of cigarette smoke on autoimmune neuroinflammation.
30901861.summary: In mice with EAE, daily cigarette smoke exposure delayed onset and prolonged disease in SJL/J mice but reduced symptoms in C57BL/6J mice, showing that genetic background matters.

31106489.conclusion_quote: Our results highlight the flexibility of axons towards changes in the glial compartment and depict the structural changes they undergo upon myelin removal.
31106489.summary: In mice given cuprizone, a model of myelin loss, researchers found more nodes of Ranvier and vesicle filled unmyelinated axons, showing that nerve fibers adapt when myelin is removed.

32373298.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
32373298.conclusion_quote: Given the permeability in blood-retina/brain/CSF barrier by complete Freund's adjuvant, the pattern of T cells may be changed in the testes during EAE as a consequence of the blood-testis barrier permeability.
32373298.summary: In experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, an animal model of MS, immune T cell patterns changed over time in the brain, spinal cord and testes.

31024304.mechanism: Protects myelin and oligodendrocytes, reduces microglia-mediated inflammation
31024304.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that venlafaxine may exert its therapeutic effects via facilitating myelin integrity and controlling neuroinflammation, which may provide extra benefits to MS patients with depression and anxiety beyond the symptom management.
31024304.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to model demyelination, the antidepressant venlafaxine reduced myelin loss, brain inflammation, depression-like behavior, and memory problems.

30899262.mechanism: Modulates gut microbiota, reducing Th1 and Th17 cells
30899262.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, probiotic L. reuteri changed gut microbiota to modulate immune responses in EAE, making it a novel candidate in future studies to modify the severity of MS.
30899262.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the probiotic Lactobacillus reuteri reduced disease severity by restoring gut bacteria and calming harmful immune cells.

30867127.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes lesion formation mechanisms
30867127.conclusion_quote: This study underpins the significance of brain-intrinsic degenerative cascades for immune cell recruitment and, in consequence, MS lesion formation.
30867127.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, early brain lesions resembled early MS lesions and drew in immune cells when followed by EAE induction.

31186441.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes atrophy only
31186441.conclusion_quote: We hypothesize this atrophy could be a result of inflammatory associated neurodegenerative processes, which may also be involved in MS.
31186441.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, MRI scans showed brain regions grew during peak inflammation and then shrank long term, with demyelination and nerve loss found.

31949423.mechanism: removing SOCS2 alters T-cell populations in the CNS
31949423.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these results suggest that SOCS2 plays a dual role in the immune response during EAE.
31949423.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the SOCS2 gene delayed early disease and blocked recovery, showing SOCS2 both harms and helps.

30717494.mechanism: Blocks P-gp efflux, increasing astragaloside brain entry
30717494.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings implicate that P-gp inhibitor can promote the therapeutic efficacy of ASIV on EAE mice, which may boost its clinical usage together with ASIV in the therapy of MS.
30717494.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the P-gp transporter with tariquidar let more astragaloside IV reach the brain, reducing symptoms, inflammation and myelin loss.

31281236.mechanism: Not applicable: imaging tracer evaluation study
31281236.conclusion_quote: Ex vivo autoradiography with a fluorine radiotracer should be preferred, to adequately evaluate and compare radiotracers for the assessment of myelin content.
31281236.summary: In rats given lysolecithin to damage myelin, the amyloid tracer PIB poorly tracked myelin loss on PET scans, so tissue scans work better.

31739589.mechanism: No treatment or genetic change tested
31739589.conclusion_quote: In summary, DigiGait™ is more sensitive than conventional scoring approaches to study motor deficits during the EAE pre-clinical phase.
31739589.summary: Mice with EAE, an MS model, were tested with a high speed gait device that detected subtle motor problems earlier than standard clinical scoring.

31629984.mechanism: Regulates autophagy through AKT/mTOR signalling pathway
31629984.conclusion_quote: Our data show that 1. autophagy defects can cause neuronal damage in EAE mice; and 2. curcumin may regulate the activation of autophagy in EAE mice by affecting the AKT/mTOR autophagy signalling pathway, further balancing central nervous system and peripheral autophagy.
31629984.summary: Curcumin given to mice with EAE, a model of MS, appeared to regulate balanced autophagy through the AKT/mTOR pathway and may protect nerve cells.

31247271.mechanism: depletes gut bacteria, shifting immune and brain responses
31247271.conclusion_quote: This study supports the view that depletion of gut microbiota by antibiotics from weaning profoundly impacts adult immunological and neurobehavioral responses.
31247271.summary: Mice with EAE given antibiotics from weaning to adulthood had delayed symptom onset, altered immune signals, worse memory, and more anxiety-like behavior.

31855963.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that CD8 autoreactive T cells in EAE have a lower encephalitogenic function but are unique and independent on pathogenic of EAE rather than their CD4 counterparts.
31855963.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, CD8 T cells were less able than CD4 T cells to cause disease when transferred, suggesting separate roles.

30972735.mechanism: Measures complement and microRNA gene expression changes
30972735.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these observations indicate probable implication of complement system and miR-146a in course of immune-related diseases and reveal more facts about the pathogenesis of MS.
30972735.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, levels of the complement factor H gene and the miR-146a microRNA changed in liver and brain during disease stages.

28891414.mechanism: Reduces inflammatory cytokines and plaque formation
28891414.conclusion_quote: Walnut oil significantly reduced disease severity, inhibited plaque formation, and altered cytokine production.
28891414.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, daily walnut oil reduced disease severity and brain plaques and shifted immune signals toward less inflammation.

31106910.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that microglia suppressed secondary progression of EAE by inhibiting the proliferation of CD4 + T cells in the CNS.
31106910.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug that depletes microglia during the progressive phase worsened disease, increased deaths, and expanded immune T cells in the spinal cord.

31327180.mechanism: Reduces inflammatory infiltration and iNOS upregulation
31327180.conclusion_quote: The SFN treatment showed anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidative effects in the EAE mice.
31327180.summary: Sulforaphane, a compound found in broccoli, reduced symptom scores, spinal cord inflammation, and demyelination in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

30547416.mechanism: not applicable, describes disease mechanism only
30547416.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data support the view that stressed oligodendrocytes have the potential to activate microglia cells through a specific cocktail of chemokines and cytokines among IL6.
30547416.summary: Researchers stressed oligodendrocyte cells and fed mice cuprizone, finding stressed cells can activate microglia immune cells, with IL6 identified as a likely signal.

31525189.mechanism: Loss of NLRX1 removes brake on inflammatory signaling
31525189.conclusion_quote: In summary, our findings highlight the importance of NLRX1 in controlling the early stages of CNS inflammation and preventing the onset of spontaneous autoimmunity.
31525189.summary: Mice lacking the NLRX1 gene developed spontaneous EAE with more CNS inflammation and demyelination, showing NLRX1 normally restrains early inflammation in the brain and spinal cord.

31852844.mechanism: Removing TNFR2 signaling reduces astrogliosis inflammation and boosts remyelinat
31852844.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest the TNFR2 signaling pathway as a potentially novel mechanism for curtailing astrogliosis and promoting remyelination, thus providing new insights into mechanisms limiting progressive MS.
31852844.summary: In mice with EAE carrying human HLA DR2b, deleting TNFR2 caused progressive disease, more harmful astrocyte inflammation, and weaker myelin repair.

31722722.mechanism: Removing Nav1.6 sodium channel from retinal ganglion cells
31722722.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results are consistent with Nav1.6 promoting inflammation and contributing to axonal degeneration following demyelination.
31722722.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Nav1.6 sodium channel from retinal nerve cells reduced inflammation and improved optic nerve health.

30873027.mechanism: Reduces inflammation and boosts myelin repair via PDK4
30873027.conclusion_quote: In summary, although PDC activity was reduced by melatonin, it caused a reduction in inflammatory mediators while stimulating oligodendrogenesis, suggesting that oligodendrocytes are forced to use an alternative pathway to synthesize fatty acids for remyelination.
30873027.summary: In mice with EAE, melatonin reduced disability, lowered inflammation, boosted myelin proteins and improved remyelination, with higher PDK4 levels.

31071102.mechanism: Reduces astrocyte and microglial activation after demyelination
31071102.conclusion_quote: Together, these studies highlight the potential of clozapine to support enhanced functional recovery after demyelination, such as that occurring during MS.
31071102.summary: In mice with cuprizone demyelination, clozapine given after damage speeded functional recovery and reduced inflammatory cell activation, though it did not prevent demyelination.

30666403.mechanism: Describes blood-brain barrier leakage patterns, no treatment tested
30666403.conclusion_quote: This study underscores that a leaky BBB is a characteristic feature of EAE, but it also suggests that extent and region specificity of BBB damage differs between individual EAE models that vary in the underlying immunopathology.
30666403.summary: In mice with two types of EAE, the protective blood brain barrier leaked in both, but the leakage pattern and severity differed between the models.

31861635.conclusion_quote: These data suggested that myelin-specific CD49d + CD154 + lymphocytes present in the brain can interfere with remyelination mediated by oligodendrocytes probably as a result of establishing proinflammatory environment.
31861635.summary: In mice with EAE and in blood from people with MS, a lymphocyte subset was found to interfere with brain repair by oligodendrocytes, likely by promoting inflammation.

30678721.mechanism: Deleting endothelial integrin reduces vascular remodeling and repair
30678721.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that α5β1 integrin-mediated angiogenic remodeling represents an important repair mechanism that counteracts vascular disruption during the early stages of EAE development.
30678721.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting endothelial α5 integrin caused earlier and faster disease, because blood vessels were damaged more and repaired less.

31402611.mechanism: not applicable, describes disease course only
31402611.conclusion_quote: It is evident that the NOD mouse model lacks validity as a progressive MS model as the individual course seems to be an asynchronous, relapsing-remitting neurodegenerative disease, characterized by increasingly poor recovery from relapse.
31402611.summary: In mice with EAE induced by MOG peptide, individual disease courses looked relapsing rather than progressive, so this model poorly represents progressive MS.

30944096.mechanism: Stabilizes SOCS1 to limit IFN-gamma JAK-STAT signaling
30944096.conclusion_quote: Thus, astrocyte-specific OTUB1 is a critical inhibitor of neuroinflammation in CNS autoimmunity.
30944096.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the OTUB1 protein from astrocytes worsened disease, with more immune cell buildup and demyelination in the spinal cord.

interventions: Peptide conjugated phosphorodiamidate morpholino antisense oligomers targeting ITGA4
31506448.mechanism: Exon skipping reduces integrin alpha 4 protein levels
31506448.conclusion_quote: With the promising results in ameliorating disease progression, we are optimistic that the candidate oligomer may also be applicable to many other diseases associated with integrin alpha 4 mediated inflammation.
31506448.summary: Researchers used antisense oligomers to lower integrin alpha 4 protein, and in mice with EAE the treatment delayed disease progression.

30985749.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes barrier imaging method
30985749.conclusion_quote: Thus, assessing both, BBB permeability and MMP activity in spatial correlation to immune cell accumulation in the CNS during EAE allows to specify loss of integrity of the endothelial and glial barriers of the NVU.
30985749.summary: This protocol shows how to induce EAE in mice, measure blood brain barrier leakage using fluorescent dyes, and visualize enzyme activity that lets immune cells enter the brain.

30551467.conclusion_quote: Thus, the possible therapeutic potential of thyme for treatment of MS could be considered in future research.
30551467.summary: In mice with EAE, thyme extract given from the time of immunization reduced clinical symptoms and spinal cord damage while lowering inflammatory cytokines.

31403472.mechanism: Deleting histone demethylase in T cells reduces inflammation
31403472.conclusion_quote: Together, these data demonstrate that the X escapee Kdm6a regulates multiple immune response genes, providing a mechanism for sex differences in autoimmune disease susceptibility.
31403472.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Kdm6a gene from CD4+ T immune cells reduced disease symptoms and nerve damage.

31342587.conclusion_quote: CEST MRI signals at 1 and 2 ppm were sensitive to the subtle pathological changes at an early stage in EAE mice, and have potential as novel imaging biomarkers complementary to functional and physiological MRI measures.
31342587.summary: In mice with EAE, a CEST MRI scan method detected subtle brain changes before symptoms appeared, suggesting it could serve as an early imaging marker of disease activity.

31376423.conclusion_quote: The metabolite level of the plasma was significantly altered in response to the EAE pathogenesis, and these changes were related to inflammation status at each disease stage.
31376423.summary: Researchers measured blood metabolites over time in mice with EAE, an MS model, finding altered fats and bile acids linked to inflammation at each disease stage.

30741923.mechanism: Hectd3 ubiquitin ligase promotes Stat3 and Malt1 signaling for Th17 cells
30741923.conclusion_quote: Thus, our studies delineate a mechanism connecting signaling related polyubiquitination of Malt1 and Stat3, leading to NF-kB activation and RORγt expression, to pathogenic Th17 cell function in EAE.
30741923.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Hectd3 gene reduced disease severity by weakening the immune cells that drive inflammation, called Th17 cells.

30718413.mechanism: Blocks DGAT1, freeing retinol for regulatory T cells
30718413.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that DGAT1 suppresses retinol-dependent Treg formation and suggest its potential as a therapeutic target for autoimmune inflammation.
30718413.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the DGAT1 enzyme, or removing it, reduced disease severity and increased regulatory T cells that calm the immune attack.

30696913.mechanism: Reduces gut microbiota diversity and fatty acids
30696913.conclusion_quote: Thus, the alteration of gut microbiota leads to an escalation of CNS-directed autoimmunity in DA rats.
30696913.summary: In rats with EAE, giving antibiotics early in life disturbed gut bacteria and made the disease and CNS inflammation worse.

30472298.mechanism: Modulates pro and anti inflammatory cytokine production
30472298.conclusion_quote: Carvacrol exhibits modulatory effects on expression of pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines.
30472298.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the plant compound carvacrol reduced disease signs and shifted immune cytokine levels toward a calmer, less inflammatory profile.

30315511.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease metabolic profile
30315511.conclusion_quote: Overall, our study suggests that urine and plasma metabolomics may contribute to the identification of a distinct metabolic fingerprint of EAE disease discriminating from the healthy control which may aid in the development of an objective non-invasive monitoring method for progressive autoimmune diseases like MS.
30315511.summary: Researchers profiled urine and plasma from mice with chronic EAE, finding a metabolic fingerprint that may help monitor MS without invasive tests.

interventions: Neutralization of high intracellular miR-665 concentration
31775315.mechanism: Neutralizes miR-665, restoring myelin protein synthesis
31775315.conclusion_quote: Together, these data point to new targets for therapeutic intervention promoting CNS remyelination.
31775315.summary: In cells from MS patients and mice with EAE, blocking the molecule miR-665 restored myelin protein production by oligodendrocytes grown in the lab.

31737624.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that STAT3, rather than DNA methylation, contributes to the regulation of miR-384 during Th17 polarization.
31737624.summary: In lab-grown immune cells, researchers found that the STAT3 protein switches on the microRNA miR-384 during Th17 cell development, a process linked to multiple sclerosis.

30798007.mechanism: Preserves immature suppressor cells that suppress T cells
30798007.conclusion_quote: Taking together, all these data add new insights into the mechanism of IFN-β treatment in EAE and point to MDSCs as a putative endogenous mediator of its beneficial role in this animal model of MS.
30798007.summary: In mice with EAE, a single interferon-beta injection at disease onset reduced severity and boosted immunosuppressive myeloid cells that dampen T cell activity.

30660624.mechanism: reduces MOG antibody, microglia activation and neuroinflammation
30660624.conclusion_quote: These results provide potent evidence for the therapeutic effects of HF in CPZ-induced demyelination.
30660624.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice modeling demyelination, hydroxyfasudil improved behavior and myelin damage, reduced harmful MOG antibodies and microglia-driven inflammation, and supported repair.

31118079.mechanism: No treatment tested, compares disease models
31118079.conclusion_quote: Overall, these findings, showing increased concentrations of intrathecally produced Igs, substantial infiltration of ASC, and the presence of B cell supporting chemokines in the CNS of TMEV-IDD mice, but not R-EAE mice, suggest a potentially important role for Igs and ASC in the chronic progressive phase of demyelinating diseases.
31118079.summary: In two mouse models of MS, the chronic progressive TMEV model had more antibody making B cells and antibodies in the spinal cord than the relapsing EAE model.

31570595.mechanism: reduces prolactin production, lowering pathogenic Eomes-positive T cells
31570595.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results indicate that extrapituitary PRL plays a crucial role in the CNS inflammation mediated by pathogenic Eomes + Th cells.
31570595.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking prolactin production with bromocriptine or Zbtb20 siRNA reduced harmful immune T cells in the nervous system and eased later-stage symptoms.

31620963.mechanism: Activates AMPK, raising neurotrophic factors and lowering NogoA
31620963.conclusion_quote: This study for the first time reveals that metformin-induced AMPK, a master regulator of energy homeostasis, activation following toxic demyelination could potentially accelerate regeneration and supports spontaneous demyelination.
31620963.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, metformin given during recovery activated AMPK, boosted nerve growth factors, reduced NogoA, and increased myelin-producing cells in the brain.

30934882.mechanism: Activates GLP-1 receptor, reducing Th1/Th17 cells and antigen-presenting cells
30934882.conclusion_quote: These results obtained indicate that dulaglutide modulates the differentiation of encephalitogenic Th1/Th17 and the pathogenicity of Th1 cells by influencing antigen presenting cells quantities, providing mechanism insight on T cells regulation in ameliorating EAE by GLP-1.
30934882.summary: In mice with EAE, the GLP-1 drug dulaglutide reduced harmful immune T cells and immune cells in the brain and spinal cord, easing disease symptoms.

30673676.mechanism: Blocks LILRA1, lowering inflammatory cytokine levels
30673676.conclusion_quote: The key findings of this study collectively propose that LILRA1 suppression exerts a potent anti-inflammatory effect on MS mice.
30673676.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the LILRA1 gene reduced levels of inflammatory proteins IL-6, IL-17 and TNF-alpha, suggesting it could help treat MS.

31251832.conclusion_quote: Our study detailed characterized the dynamics of myelin alterations and microglial status in the brain of the CPZ model.
31251832.summary: In mice fed the cuprizone toxin, myelin loss and recovery varied by brain region, and remyelination finished within three weeks after withdrawal.

32038176.conclusion_quote: We found that synaptic transmission in CA1 neurons was diminished in vitro , and that neuronal firing rates in CA1 and the dentate gyrus (DG) were substantially reduced during demyelination in vivo , which partially recovered after a short remyelination period.
32038176.summary: In mice fed a cuprizone diet to cause demyelination, hippocampal neuron firing dropped and partly recovered after a short remyelination period, showing reversible loss of function.

31543821.summary: This record is a correction notice, so it does not report any new experiment in mice with EAE.

30949115.summary: This is a correction notice for an earlier perspective article on blood clotting in multiple sclerosis, reporting no new experiments.

31683117.mechanism: Immune-modulating helminth-derived compound reducing CNS inflammation and demyel
31683117.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that TPC may provide a beneficial clinical effect in EAE and may therefore have a potential value for ameliorating clinical manifestations and delaying disease progression in MS.
31683117.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, given the helminth-derived compound tuftsin-phosphorylcholine had better clinical scores and less CNS inflammation and demyelination.

31399117.conclusion_quote: We revealed that treatment with butyrate suppressed demyelination and enhanced remyelination in an organotypic slice culture in association with facilitating oligodendrocyte differentiation.
31399117.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination and in brain slice cultures, the gut bacteria product butyrate reduced myelin loss and helped myelin regrow.

31357085.mechanism: suppresses neuroinflammation, glial activation and cytokine release
31357085.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that cordycepin may represent a useful therapeutic agent in demyelination-related diseases via suppression of neuroinflammation.
31357085.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice that model demyelination, cordycepin improved movement, promoted myelin repair and reduced brain inflammation.

31729981.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
31729981.conclusion_quote: This study provides evidence that females are uniquely affected by MOG 35-55 -EAE and that this difference may result from additional signaling not present in the male.
31729981.summary: Researchers profiled gene and microRNA activity in sensory nerve ganglia of female and male mice with EAE, finding females showed far more disrupted genes than males.

30684125.mechanism: Promotes oligodendrocyte precursor differentiation via mTOR upregulation
30684125.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results demonstrated that SA could act as a potential drug candidate for the treatment of demyelinating diseases.
30684125.summary: Shikimic acid, a star anise compound, promoted oligodendrocyte precursor maturation and remyelination in rat cells and in mice with EAE or lysolecithin induced demyelination.

30209761.mechanism: Blocks P2X7 receptor, reducing microglial activation and cytokines
30209761.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that microglia are involved in inducing neuroinflammation at a very early stage of MS/EAE via a P2X7R-dependent mechanism.
30209761.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, blocking the P2X7 receptor with Brilliant Blue G delayed disease onset and reduced microglia activation and inflammatory signals.

31190448.conclusion_quote: Lodygin and colleagues recently identified a candidate grey matter target antigen in a rat model of multiple sclerosis, a disease classically associated with the white matter antigen, myelin.
31190448.summary: This commentary discusses a rat model study by Lodygin and colleagues that found a possible grey matter target antigen in multiple sclerosis, a disease usually linked to myelin.

30623969.mechanism: removes TASK1 potassium channel, altering oligodendrocyte differentiation
30623969.conclusion_quote: However, while being involved in developmental myelination our data suggest that TASK1 channels have no major effect on remyelination.
30623969.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to strip myelin, removing the TASK1 potassium channel sped up normal myelin development but did not improve myelin repair afterward.

30511355.mechanism: Removing DDIT3 lessens oligodendrocyte apoptosis and demyelination
30511355.conclusion_quote: This study identifies DDIT3 as an important regulator of graded oligodendrocyte vulnerability in a MS animal model.
30511355.summary: In a cuprizone-induced demyelination model, mice lacking the Ddit3 gene had less oligodendrocyte death, myelin loss, and inflammation than normal mice.

31523122.mechanism: Preserves retinal ganglion cells independently of Nrf2 induction
31523122.conclusion_quote: This work underscores the potential of DMF to mitigate the severity and recurrence of optic neuritis episodes in patients with RRMS.
31523122.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, dimethyl fumarate reduced optic neuritis severity, preserved vision and retinal nerve cells, and lessened motor problems, and it helped delay optic neuritis relapses in patients.

31615022.mechanism: reduces oxidative stress and lipopolysaccharide levels
31615022.conclusion_quote: on balance, EVOO offers a better neuroprotective effect.
31615022.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, olive oil, hydroxytyrosol and oleic acid lowered gut bacterial toxin levels and oxidative damage, improving clinical scores.

30902474.conclusion_quote: In this work an animal model of EAE has been characterised and detailed for the study of demyelinating alterations in the retina and the ON.
30902474.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found retinal ganglion cell loss and optic nerve axon damage, making it useful for studying eye damage in MS.

31221190.mechanism: Reduces inflammatory cytokines and immune signaling markers
31221190.conclusion_quote: The present results demonstrate that the intraperitoneal administration of the composite PEALut significantly reduces the development of clinical signs in the MOG 35-55 model of EAE.
31221190.summary: In mice with EAE, a daily injected mix of palmitoylethanolamide and luteolin reduced paralysis signs and lowered inflammation markers in the brainstem and cerebellum.

32161909.mechanism: Antigen-specific regulatory CD8 T cells suppress relapses
32161909.conclusion_quote: These data support a potential immunotherapeutic strategy using CD8 transfer and/or LM vaccination to boost disease regulatory CD8 T cells.
32161909.summary: In mice with relapsing EAE, transferring myelin-targeted regulatory CD8 T cells reduced relapses and treated ongoing disease, and Listeria infection boosted this effect.

30353480.mechanism: blocks MIF and D-DT binding to CD74 receptor
30353480.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that binding affinity for CD74 could serve as an in vitro indicator of biological potency of DRhQ and thus support its possible clinical utility as an effective therapy for MS and perhaps other diseases in which there is an inflammatory reaction driven by MIF and D-DT.
30353480.summary: A modified version of a DRα1-MOG peptide construct bound the CD74 receptor more strongly and improved disease in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

30820910.conclusion_quote: Toxin-based models offer lesions with predictable spatiotemporal patterns and relatively discrete phases of damage and repair: a simpler system to study the relevant biology and how this can be manipulated.
30820910.summary: This chapter reviews toxin-based animal models of myelin damage, including lysolecithin, ethidium bromide, and cuprizone, and gives protocols for using them.

30959793.mechanism: Loss of MMP12 reduces microglia activation and astrogliosis
30959793.conclusion_quote: This indicates that MMP12 plays an important role in microglia activation, polarization, and migration as well as astrogliosis and microglia/astrocyte interaction.
30959793.summary: In mice with Theiler's murine encephalomyelitis, removing the Mmp12 gene reduced scarring-type astrogliosis and activated microglia in the spinal cord, suggesting a benefit.

30738572.mechanism: Heat-killed bacteria boost immune response to myelin antigen
30738572.conclusion_quote: MOG-MIFA immunized mice showed an early disease onset and more severe clinical scores in comparison with MOG-CFA immunized mice, demonstrating for the first time the adjuvant effect of MAP on EAE development.
30738572.summary: In mice with EAE, heat-killed Mycobacterium avium paratuberculosis added to the immunizing adjuvant caused earlier onset and more severe disease than standard adjuvant.

31105520.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes NTPDase1 expression in EAE
31105520.conclusion_quote: Together, our data suggest an association between NTPDase1 up-regulation by reactive microglia and infiltrated macrophages and their transition toward antiinflammatory phenotype in EAE.
31105520.summary: In mice with EAE, the enzyme NTPDase1 rose in spinal cord immune cells, mainly activated microglia and macrophages, and was linked to a less inflammatory cell state.

30933850.conclusion_quote: Almost complete emigration of pathogenic clones from blood to spinal cord indicates that blood is not a suitable compartment to study EAE-mediating T cells.
30933850.summary: In mice with EAE, most spinal cord T cells were unique to each animal, and pathogenic T cells almost fully left the blood for the spinal cord.

30913278.mechanism: Enters cells and restores UDP-GlcNAc, raising N-glycan branching
30913278.conclusion_quote: Thus, GlcNAc-6-Acetate may provide an improved therapeutic approach to raise N-glycan branching, inhibit pro-inflammatory T cell responses and treat autoimmune diseases such as MS.
30913278.summary: In mice with EAE, a modified form of GlcNAc sugar entered T cells more easily, reducing harmful inflammatory T cell responses and slowing disease progression.

30910981.mechanism: reverses progenitor senescence, restoring oligodendrocyte support
30910981.conclusion_quote: Based on these data, we conclude that cellular senescence contributes to altered progenitor cell functions in demyelinated lesions in MS.
30910981.summary: In human stem-cell-derived progenitor cells from patients with progressive MS, rapamycin reversed signs of cell aging and improved their ability to support myelin-producing cell development.

31368247.mechanism: High intensity running suppresses encephalitogenic T cell generation
31368247.conclusion_quote: High-intensity training induces superior effects in preventing autoimmunity in EAE, but does not alter immune responses to E. coli infection.
