31368247.summary: Mice that ran on a treadmill at high intensity had milder EAE and fewer self-attacking immune cells, while their response to a bacterial infection was unchanged.

31235582.mechanism: not applicable, dye labels lesions for tracking
31235582.conclusion_quote: Therefore, NR administration is a simple and powerful method to track and analyze the detailed molecular, cellular, and metabolic changes that occur within the lesion microenvironment over time following CNS injury.
31235582.summary: In mice with lysolecithin or EAE induced demyelination, a vital dye called neutral red marked lesions so researchers could track their changes over time.

31341075.mechanism: Promotes IL-17 producing encephalitogenic T cells
31341075.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that IL-11 might serve as a biomarker of early autoimmune response and a selective therapeutic target for patients with early relapsing-remitting MS.
31341075.summary: Mice with relapsing remitting EAE given IL-11 at symptom onset had worse, longer lasting disease and more inflammatory Th17 cells in the spinal cord.

30820608.mechanism: Blocks MAPK signaling, lowering SGK1 and raising BDNF
30820608.conclusion_quote: Our results not only provide novel insights into disease pathogenesis, but also offer promising therapeutic targets for MS.
30820608.summary: In mice with EAE, celastrol reduced inflammatory genes and protected against disease by lowering SGK1 and raising BDNF through the MAPK pathway.

29376456.mechanism: No treatment tested, imaging of CSF flow
29376456.conclusion_quote: In experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model of multiple sclerosis, we show a reduction of parenchymal CSF circulation specifically in the spinal cord but not in the brain.
29376456.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, showed reduced fluid circulation within the spinal cord but not the brain, measured by MRI after contrast injection.

30405214.summary: This correction notice fixes an author's name in a study of brain activity after recovery from experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis.

32245296.mechanism: Unclear, reduces EAE without changing splenic T cells
32245296.conclusion_quote: This is the first experimental evidence showing that administration of aqueous extract of Tarragon reduces the severity of EAE, but the protective effect of Tarragon is independent of alteration in T cells in the spleen.
32245296.summary: In mice with EAE, an extract of the tarragon plant reduced clinical disease scores, though it did not change spleen T cell types, suggesting other mechanisms are involved.

31620191.mechanism: reduces STAT3 and IL-17 genes, raises FOXP3 expression
31620191.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that the HSO/EPO treatment can be used to ameliorate the demyelination of spinal cord, which was confirmed by immunological and histological findings.
31620191.summary: In mice with EAE, a hemp seed and evening primrose oil supplement reduced disease severity and spinal cord damage by lowering inflammatory gene activity.

31065973.mechanism: Loss of TLR4 reduces Th17 infiltration via CCL25/CCR9
31065973.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that TLR4 may mediate Th17 infiltration through CCL25/CCR9 signal during pathogenesis of EAE.
31065973.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the TLR4 gene reduced disease severity and spinal cord inflammation by lowering Th17 cell entry through the CCL25 and CCR9 pathway.

31620456.conclusion_quote: Higher concentrations in canine patients with SRMA as well as positive association with TNCC in CSF suggest an involvement in pro-inflammatory pathways and chemotaxis in SRMA.
31620456.summary: In dogs with spontaneous inflammatory brain and spinal cord diseases, higher NGAL levels in spinal fluid tracked with inflammation, suggesting a role in steroid-responsive meningitis-arteritis.

31226280.mechanism: Blocks A2A receptor, reducing microglia and macrophage activation
31226280.conclusion_quote: The identification of the effective therapeutic window of A 2A receptor antagonist provide insight into the role of A 2A receptor signaling in EAE, and support SCH58261 as a candidate for the treatment of MS in human.
31226280.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug SCH58261 blocks A2A receptors and reduced spinal cord inflammation, demyelination, and behavioral deficits when given after symptoms began.

31471462.mechanism: NLRP3 gain-of-function shifts T cells toward Th2
31471462.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our data evidence that the NLRP3 gain-of-function promotes a Th2-related response, a pathway that could be better explored in the treatment of multiple sclerosis.
31471462.summary: In mice with EAE, boosting NLRP3 activity only in CD4 T cells reduced disease severity and shifted immune cells toward a Th2 response.

interventions: hemp seed oil/evening primrose oil (HSO/EPO) supplement
30936931.mechanism: Raises IL-10 and RICTOR expression, reduces cell infiltration, promotes remyelin
30936931.conclusion_quote: The EPO/HSO has beneficial effects on the repair of myelin, which was confirmed by immunological and histological findings.
30936931.summary: In mice with EAE, a hemp seed and evening primrose oil supplement raised IL-10 and RICTOR gene expression, reduced immune cell infiltration, and supported myelin repair.

31484731.mechanism: Reduces Th1/Th17 cells, boosts regulatory T cells
31484731.conclusion_quote: Thus, this study strongly supports the potential use of CCL2 as a regulatory mediator for treating inflammatory autoimmune diseases.
31484731.summary: In mice with EAE, low picomolar doses of the chemokine CCL2 reduced inflammation and boosted regulatory T cells, including in established chronic disease.

31357414.mechanism: Mycotoxin kills glia and boosts inflammatory cytokines
31357414.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that GTX administered in a non-neuronal site was able to increase neuroinflammation in EAE.
31357414.summary: In mice with EAE, a mold toxin called gliotoxin given away from the nervous system worsened symptoms and increased brain inflammation.

31346085.mechanism: Removing SLAMF9 alters pDC survival, differentiation and IFN output
31346085.conclusion_quote: These results suggest the crucial role of SLAMF9 in pDC differentiation, homeostasis, and function in the steady state and during experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
31346085.summary: Mice lacking the SLAMF9 gene had milder and delayed experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a mouse model of MS, with altered plasmacytoid dendritic cells.

31156238.conclusion_quote: The correlation of BDNF level with clinical manifestations of MS and the changes of its level during disease-modifying therapy is considered.
31156238.summary: This review article summarizes how brain-derived neurotrophic factor, a protein that supports nerve cells, relates to multiple sclerosis symptoms and changes during treatment.

30883917.conclusion_quote: This retraction has been agreed due to discrepancies in the type and number of animals used in experiments performed by the corresponding author, Milena Penkowa, identified during the course of investigations into Ms. Penkowa's research by the University of Copenhagen in 2012, rendering the data and conclusions drawn from them unreliable.
30883917.summary: This notice retracts a 2003 study of metallothionein treatment in an EAE model because animal number discrepancies made its data unreliable.

31411745.mechanism: Represses HIF-1α, increasing Th1 and Th17 differentiation
31411745.conclusion_quote: Together, our results provide evidence that microRNA 182 may be one of the transitional hubs contribution to regulate Th cells expansion in response to self-antigens and differentiation of antigen specific Th cells during the progression of autoimmune inflammations.
31411745.summary: In mice with EAE, boosting microRNA 182 worsened symptoms and increased inflammatory T helper cells that drive immune attacks on the nervous system.

31132768.mechanism: blocks beta-adrenoceptors, reducing immune cell migration and Th17 cells
31132768.conclusion_quote: This study suggests that sympathetic dysregulation is involved in the outbreak of clinical EAE.
31132768.summary: In rats with EAE, the blood pressure drug propranolol reduced immune cell activation and Th17 cells, and lowered how often the disease appeared.

31641069.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that mild EAE coupled with natural aging may be a solution to better modeling the neurodegenerative processes seen in MS.
31641069.summary: In mice with a mild spontaneous form of EAE, aged animals showed relapsing symptoms, progressive motor loss, spinal cord shrinkage, synapse loss and nerve damage, resembling MS neurodegeneration.

30700587.mechanism: Signals regulatory T cells through Lag3, not IL-10
30700587.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results uncover an irreplaceable contribution of Tregs during IL-27-mediated control of inflammation.
30700587.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, IL-27 prevented nerve-tissue inflammation by acting on regulatory T cells, and it failed when those cells were removed.

31454809.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrate that many neuroimmune endpoints are induced in EAE without PTX and although clinical disease is mild, this can be used as an autoimmune model when PTX inactivation of G protein-coupled receptors is not desired.
31454809.summary: In female mice with EAE induced without pertussis toxin, spinal cord inflammation and B cell changes were mapped, showing many immune markers rose despite mild disease.

31151084.mechanism: No treatment tested, measures chemokine levels only
31151084.conclusion_quote: We concluded that CCL26, which in turn binds to the receptor CCR3, showed pro-inflammatory effects and aggravated tissue damage involving BBB impairment, especially in the acute stage of EAE.
31151084.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, levels of the immune signal CCL26 and its receptor CCR3 rose and tracked brain inflammation and blood brain barrier damage during the acute stage.

30637619.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that antiviral APR is a potent exacerbator of EAE, and that this activity directly correlates with the severity of the disease.
30637619.summary: In mice with EAE, an immune stimulus that mimics a viral infection, given during the chronic phase, worsened paralysis, mainly in more severely affected animals.

31262031.conclusion_quote: These results suggest differences in the pathogenesis of demyelination in these two animal models.
31262031.summary: In dogs with canine distemper and mice with Theiler's virus, oxidative stress markers were measured in damaged myelin, with higher levels found only in the dog disease.

31351476.mechanism: Reduces TLR2 signaling, shifting microglia toward pro-repair phenotype
31351476.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that reducing TLR2 signaling in vivo by inducing TLR2 tolerance significantly enhances myelin repair.
31351476.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, low doses of TLR2 ligands that induce tolerance improved myelin repair and shifted brain microglia toward a pro-repair state.

30937629.conclusion_quote: We can demonstrate that a negative correlation exists between the two variables "extent of cuprizone-induced demyelination" and "starting weight."
30937629.summary: In mice given the cuprizone model of demyelination, lighter mice at the start showed more severe myelin loss and microglia activation than heavier mice.

31358793.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, lowers lymphocytes and brain inflammation
31358793.conclusion_quote: These findings suggests that, unlike the case in multiple sclerosis, fingolimod may potentially have therapeutic benefits in AD at low doses that do not affect peripheral lymphocyte function.
31358793.summary: In 5xFAD mice modeling Alzheimer's disease, low dose fingolimod improved memory and reduced brain inflammation without changing circulating lymphocyte counts.

31233276.mechanism: inhibits glutaminase 1, reducing glycolysis and HIF-1α protein
31233276.conclusion_quote: We demonstrated that inhibition of glutaminolysis represents a potential new treatment strategy for patients with SLE and Th17-related autoimmune diseases.
31233276.summary: In mice with EAE and lupus-prone MRL/lpr mice, blocking the enzyme glutaminase 1 reduced harmful Th17 immune cells and their energy use, improving disease.

30469023.conclusion_quote: DTI and OCT measures are tightly correlated during the chronic phase of axonal degeneration (4-8 weeks) in EAE mice.
30469023.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers used eye scans and nerve imaging to track how retinal nerve cells and their fibers degenerate over time.

30704526.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate that the interaction between pre-activated microglia and CD4 + autoreactive T cells during the induction and propagation of tissue damage in the CNS is limited.
30704526.summary: In LEWzizi rats with spontaneous brain pathology, EAE caused inflammation in forebrain areas without worsening tissue damage.

31440724.mechanism: Reduces acute seizures, mechanism not determined
31440724.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that CBD could be effective in decreasing TMEV-induced acute seizures when the seizure test is conducted at the TPE of CBD.
31440724.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a model used in multiple sclerosis research, cannabidiol reduced acute seizures, especially two hours after dosing.

31484353.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates region-specific brain atrophy of different subcortical brain regions after chronic cuprizone-induced demyelination.
31484353.summary: Male mice given cuprizone to induce demyelination developed shrinkage of deep brain regions like the thalamus after 12 weeks but not after 5 weeks.

30484905.conclusion_quote: From our data, we conclude that remyelination occurs despite an abundant glial reaction in this animal model.
30484905.summary: In rats with an MS-like disease induced by MOG immunization, researchers found that a dense astrocyte scar did not stop myelin repair by oligodendrocyte precursor cells.

30230112.conclusion_quote: Diffusion and MRI texture metrics may provide compensatory information on myelin repair and ODI and NDI could be sensitive measures of evolving remyelination, deserving further validation.
30230112.summary: In mice with spinal cord demyelination, advanced MRI measures tracked remyelination over five weeks, with ODI and NDI showing the clearest changes over time.

30940543.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that 34-week cuprizone administration induces and sustains demyelination and results in reversible motor coordination dysfunction.
30940543.summary: In mice fed the toxin cuprizone for up to 34 weeks, demyelination persisted and caused reversible balance problems, with parvalbumin shifting inside damaged nerve fibers.

30851639.mechanism: Stabilised sulforaphane activates Nrf2 oxidative stress response
30851639.summary: In mice with relapsing EAE, a stabilised sulforaphane compound called SFX-01 reduced lasting disability and spinal cord demyelination and cell death.

30762897.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes immune cell movement to lungs
30762897.conclusion_quote: These studies underscore the pleiotropic effect of MDSCs on T cells and their potential pro-inflammatory phenotypes in neuro-inflammatory disease.
30762897.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, immune cells called myeloid derived suppressor cells gathered in the lungs and may help drive harmful T cell responses.

31004709.mechanism: rebalances regulatory T cells and Th17 cells
31004709.conclusion_quote: High doses of rapamycin (1 mg/kg) have a better relieves inflammation of EAE by altering the balance of Treg/Th17 in a mouse model.
31004709.summary: Rapamycin was tested at two doses in mice with EAE, an MS model, and the higher dose improved neurological scores and rebalanced regulatory and Th17 T cells.

30450647.mechanism: removing Vav3 alters oligodendrocyte maturation and RhoA activation
30450647.conclusion_quote: Taken together, this study highlights Vav3 as a novel regulator of oligodendrocyte maturation and remyelination, suggesting that manipulation of the Vav3-dependent signaling pathway could help to improve myelin repair.
30450647.summary: In mice with the Vav3 gene removed, myelin repair after cuprizone and lysolecithin damage was impaired, showing Vav3 helps the brain rebuild myelin.

31403466.mechanism: Not applicable, commentary on a genetic study
31403466.conclusion_quote: This study concisely shows the value of X chromosome gene expression in T cell regulation of autoimmunity and the relevance of Kdm6a in the pathogenesis of EAE as a model of MS.
31403466.summary: This commentary describes a study in which removing the Kdm6a gene from T cells changed immune responses in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

30777084.mechanism: Reduces microglia activation, cytokines and oxidative stress
30777084.conclusion_quote: This study shows that IFNβ1a is able to reverse the inflammatory and cognitive effects of intra-hippocampal Aβ 1-42 in the rat.
30777084.summary: In rats with an Alzheimer's-like model, interferon beta-1a given after amyloid injection reduced brain inflammation and improved memory.

30859497.mechanism: Blocks CSF1 receptor, depleting brain microglia
30859497.conclusion_quote: Microglia-depleted, TMEV-infected mice develop seizures, manifest paralysis, and uniformly succumb to fatal encephalitis regardless of viral amount.
30859497.summary: In mice infected with a picornavirus, depleting microglia with PLX5622 caused seizures, paralysis, and fatal brain inflammation regardless of how much virus was given.

31600882.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal evidence that mitochondrial dysfunction is present at the asymptomatic stages in the EAE model of MS, and that the changes in MRC enzyme activities are tissue-specific and are not confined to the CNS.
31600882.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, mitochondrial energy enzyme activity was measured in spinal cord, liver and muscle, showing changes before symptoms appeared.

30820906.mechanism: Toxin kills mature oligodendrocytes causing demyelination and autoimmunity
30820906.conclusion_quote: Thus, the DTA mouse enables investigation of the mechanisms that promote remyelination in MS and other adult-onset demyelinating diseases.
30820906.summary: In mice, a genetic model kills mature myelin-producing cells, causing demyelination, recovery, and later autoimmune disease, to help study MS mechanisms.

30894198.mechanism: Reduces CNS inflammatory cell infiltration and cytokine expression
30894198.conclusion_quote: Peripherally-administered orexin A ameliorated EAE by reducing CNS neuroinflammation.
30894198.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, injected orexin A started after symptoms began reduced brain and spinal cord inflammation and demyelination.

31610192.mechanism: Protects mitochondria, reduces oxidative stress, raises Sirt3 levels
31610192.conclusion_quote: EA can effectively protect muscle tissue against cuprizone-induced demeylination via the mitochondrial protection, oxidative stress prevention and Sirt3 overexpression.
31610192.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, ellagic acid improved muscle weakness and mitochondrial function, likely by raising Sirt3 levels.

31016544.mechanism: Activates AMPK, restores mitochondrial function, reduces oxidative stress
31016544.conclusion_quote: Our data implicated that metformin exerts its therapeutic effects on MS by AMPK signaling improved mitochondrial homeostasis and protected oligodendrocytes.
31016544.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, metformin increased myelinated axons, reduced oxidative stress and gliosis, and protected oligodendrocytes.

31623261.conclusion_quote: The i.s. infection model offers the advantage of a significantly earlier onset of clinical signs, inflammatory and demyelinating SC lesions and additionally enables the investigation of virus-mediated PN lesions.
31623261.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus directly into the spinal cord, disease and nerve damage appeared about six weeks earlier than after brain infection, and nerve lesions also developed.

31346868.conclusion_quote: This substrate is degraded during incubation with purified antibodies and B cells from patients with multiple sclerosis, but not healthy volunteers.
31346868.summary: This study tested a new fluorescent test substrate that antibodies and B cells from MS patients break down, but healthy people's cells do not, as a possible diagnostic marker.

31498148.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results suggest that iron accumulation in the weeks after inflammatory demyelination may contribute to lesion repair rather than inflammatory demyelination per se.
31498148.summary: In marmosets with EAE and in human MS lesions, iron built up inside immune cells weeks after demyelination, possibly helping repair rather than causing damage.

30703396.conclusion_quote: A recovery period of 6 weeks after removal of CPZ was not accompanied by a similar return of normal activity indicating long lasting behavioural effects caused by this neurotoxicant.
30703396.summary: In mice given the cuprizone toxin, behaviour was tracked after withdrawal, and activity and motor coordination had not fully returned to normal even six weeks later.

31012202.mechanism: Not applicable, imaging study without a treatment
31012202.conclusion_quote: QSM is sensitive to the demyelination process of cuprizone exposure, which can be a complementary technique to conventional T 2 -weighted images and DTI metrics.
31012202.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, MRI showed that susceptibility mapping tracks myelin loss and recovery in the corpus callosum, complementing standard scans.

31180502.conclusion_quote: Our results substantially extend previous characterization of protein-stimulated PRF.
31180502.summary: This study examined how a viral protein boosts ribosome frameshifting in Theiler's virus, using infected cells and cell free lab reactions, without testing any treatment for multiple sclerosis.

31447458.mechanism: Not applicable, describes toxin-induced myelin damage
31447458.conclusion_quote: Our data reveal that expression intensity of CNPase may be dependent on the degree of HCP- and CPZ-induced damage of the myelin sheath.
31447458.summary: In rats given hexachlorophene or cuprizone to damage myelin, CNPase levels in the spinal cord depended on how much myelin was damaged.

31033673.conclusion_quote: After repeated administrations of Gd-DTPA, ongoing inflammation may facilitate the retention of Gd in the brain tissue.
31033673.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, repeated doses of a gadolinium contrast agent stayed longer in inflamed brains than in healthy brains.

31034962.mechanism: Blocks IL-17A signalling, preserving blood-brain barrier integrity
31034962.conclusion_quote: These data highlight the potential importance of targeting IL-17A in preserving BBB integrity in RRMS.
31034962.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking IL-17A reduced disease, and higher IL-17A in patients' spinal fluid tracked with blood-brain barrier leakage in relapsing MS.

30684521.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease only
30684521.conclusion_quote: LMCE peak intensity in the meninges corresponds to the acute inflammatory phase of EAE-MOG disease progression, and is associated with clinical symptoms and higher inflammatory cell density.
30684521.summary: In mice with EAE, MRI showed meningeal inflammation peaked early, alongside weight loss, symptoms, and more immune cells in the brain's membranes.

30713249.mechanism: Reduces optic nerve inflammation and demyelination, protects axons
30713249.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that IVIg has neuroprotective properties in experimental optic neuritis, and is a promising new treatment for optic neuritis.
30713249.summary: In mice with EAE and optic neuritis, intravenous immunoglobulin given before symptoms appeared reduced optic nerve inflammation, demyelination and clinical signs of disease.

31189570.mechanism: Inhibits T cell activation and cytokine production
31189570.conclusion_quote: In vivo administration of Skint8-IgG Fc reduces T cell activation and alleviates experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis in mice.
31189570.summary: In mice with EAE, a fusion protein made from Skint8 reduced T cell activation and eased disease symptoms, suggesting a new way to calm harmful immune responses.

29447086.mechanism: Reduces Th17 cytokines, chemokines and chemokine receptors
29447086.conclusion_quote: VD down-regulates the expression of some inflammatory cytokines, chemokines and chemokine receptors in EAE mice.
29447086.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, vitamin D treatment lowered levels of inflammatory immune signals in the spinal cord and blood.

31798659.mechanism: reduces microglia activation, possibly promoting oligodendrocyte precursor activ
31798659.conclusion_quote: Our results revealed that apamin prevents myelin destruction more significantly as compared to remyelination process.
31798659.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced myelin damage, apamin given during or after the damage increased myelin content, mainly by preventing myelin destruction.

30941120.mechanism: blocks glycolipid antigen presentation via CD1d on macrophages
30941120.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal a novel pathway from the presentation of Mye-GalCer to IL-17 production, and highlight the promising therapeutic potential of D-sphingosine for the human disorder of multiple sclerosis.
30941120.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, D-sphingosine blocked myelin lipid presentation to immune cells, lowered IL-17 and reduced disease symptoms.

30863056.mechanism: iron nanoparticles increase microglia and T cell activation
30863056.conclusion_quote: A single exposure to ferucarbotran exacerbated neuroinflammation and disease severity of EAE, which might be attributed to the enhanced activation of microglia and T cells.
30863056.summary: In mice with EAE, a single intravenous dose of the iron-based MRI contrast agent ferucarbotran made brain and spinal cord inflammation and disease symptoms worse.

30536911.conclusion_quote: Continuous psychological distress has more severe effects on myelin sheath destruction in the preclinical stage.
30536911.summary: In rats given the cuprizone demyelinating diet, prior psychological and physical stress caused more severe loss of myelin than cuprizone alone.

30507373.conclusion_quote: Such sequences are under-represented within picornaviral genomes, suggesting that slip-prone sequences create a fitness cost.
30507373.summary: This virology study tested whether a picornavirus polymerase slips on certain RNA sequences and adds extra nucleotides, without studying multiple sclerosis or any disease model.

31071011.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte maturation through TGF-β receptor signaling
31071011.conclusion_quote: These data provide the therapeutic possibility of TGF-β for demyelinating diseases.
31071011.summary: Giving TGF-β1 to mice with toxin-induced spinal cord demyelination and an MS model promoted myelin repair and restored neurological function.

31140740.mechanism: No treatment tested, compares injury models
31140740.conclusion_quote: Concertedly, parameters of the CAPs offer a novel functional assessment strategy for cerebral white matter injury in rodent models.
31140740.summary: In mice, a diet-induced demyelination model and a focal stroke produced different nerve signal changes, so these recordings can tell the two injuries apart.

31462662.mechanism: Depletes gut microbes, lowering immune reactivity
31462662.conclusion_quote: Vancomycin administration attenuated both EAE symptoms and protease inhibitor induction potentially by decreasing immune system reactivity, supporting a subset of the microbiota's role in modulating the host's latent period response.
31462662.summary: In mice with EAE, the antibiotic vancomycin reduced disease symptoms and lowered stool protease inhibitors, suggesting gut microbes influence the disease's silent early phase.

31684959.conclusion_quote: Changes in retinal thickness mirror neuronal loss and clinical severity.
31684959.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, eye scans of the retina tracked nerve cell loss, with retinal thinning matching nerve damage and disease severity.

31167379.conclusion_quote: Since IL-2, IL-21, TNF-β, and IL-1R1 play a crucial role in the activation of immune cells, our data indicate that high expression of these molecules in Th17 cells from MS patients could be related to their high inflammatory status.
31167379.summary: In human immune cells from MS patients and healthy donors, Th17 cells from MS patients showed higher levels of IL-21, TNF-beta, IL-2 and IL-1R1, suggesting stronger inflammation.

31083955.mechanism: delivers immunosuppressant with myelin antigen to induce tolerance
31083955.conclusion_quote: These results highlight the benefits of co-delivery of autoantigens with immunosuppressant drugs as AgDCs for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
31083955.summary: In mice with EAE, a myelin peptide linked to dexamethasone protected against symptoms and worked better than dexamethasone alone.

29402503.mechanism: Preserves cortical glutamate release and synaptic proteins
29402503.conclusion_quote: We conclude that "prophylactic" EE is beneficial to synaptic derangements and preserves glutamate transmission in the cortex of EAE mice.
29402503.summary: In mice with EAE, living in an enriched environment reduced clinical symptoms and preserved brain glutamate release and synaptic protein levels.

31290162.mechanism: Gene suppresses dendritic cell antigen presentation via p38
31290162.conclusion_quote: Our findings support that NLRC3 serves as a potential target for treating adaptive immune responses driving multiple sclerosis and other autoimmune disorders.
31290162.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, losing NLRC3 worsened immune attacks, and vaccination with NLRC3-boosted dendritic cells slowed disease progression.

31061496.mechanism: Not applicable: observational gut bacteria profiling only
31061496.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate for the first time that gut microbiota may determine the susceptibility to CP or RR forms of EAE.
31061496.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers profiled gut bacteria and found distinct microbial communities linked to chronic progressive versus relapse remitting disease courses.

31683658.conclusion_quote: By this mechanism, laquinimod allows remyelination in non-supportive environments.
31683658.summary: In mice exposed to cuprizone, laquinimod started during ongoing damage helped progenitor cells mature, restored myelin, and reduced inflammation and axon injury.

31919790.mechanism: CD226 loss boosts Treg suppression through CTLA-4 TIGIT
31919790.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate a pivotal role for CD226 in attenuating Treg function in EAE that was associated with downregulating the expression levels of CTLA-4 and TIGIT.
31919790.summary: Mice lacking the CD226 gene developed less severe EAE, a mouse model of MS, with more regulatory T cells that suppressed inflammation better.

31244929.mechanism: binds exposed extracellular matrix for PET imaging
31244929.conclusion_quote: Imaging of 64 Cu-GPVI-Fc accumulation in the ECM matrix appears to be a promising candidate for monitoring chronic inflammation.
31244929.summary: Researchers used a radioactive PET imaging tracer that binds scar tissue to detect chronic inflammation, including in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

30847935.conclusion_quote: Here, we report human magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and corresponding pathological data that inflammation-dependent intracerebral remodeling of the vessel wall is directly associated with the prominence of intralesional veins on susceptibility-based MRI.
30847935.summary: In marmosets with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, inflamed brain lesions showed thickened, widened blood vessel walls filled with collagen, linked to visible veins on MRI scans.

30607821.conclusion_quote: These results precisely define a part of the corpus callosum which should be used as a region of interest during remyelination experiments.
30607821.summary: In the cuprizone model of demyelination, the study mapped which part of the corpus callosum is reliably demyelinated, finding the most medial 500 micrometre sector consistently affected.

31653831.mechanism: Alters gut microbiota, reducing encephalitogenic T cell responses
31653831.conclusion_quote: We conclude that dietary tryptophan restriction alters metabolic properties of gut microbiota, which in turn have an impact on encephalitogenic T cell responses.
31653831.summary: In mice with EAE, a diet without tryptophan blocked brain autoimmunity, changed gut bacteria, and weakened immune cells that attack nerve coverings.

30539784.mechanism: reduces apoptosis, inflammation and oxidative stress
30539784.conclusion_quote: It seems that rifampicin is able to be added to the armamentarium of therapies for multiple sclerosis.
30539784.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, rifampicin improved movement, reduced cell death and inflammation, and promoted myelin repair.

31723036.mechanism: blocks B-cell migration across CNS barriers
31723036.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that restricting access to the CNS by targeting ALCAM on pathogenic B lymphocytes might represent a promising strategy for the development of next-generation B lymphocyte-targeting therapies for the treatment of MS.
31723036.summary: In mice with a B cell-driven form of EAE, blocking the ALCAM protein reduced disease severity by limiting harmful B cells from entering the brain and spinal cord.

31061131.mechanism: Deletion lowers STAT3 activity and Th17 cell formation
31061131.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that FAM64A regulates Th17 differentiation and colitis and inflammation-associated cancer by modulating transcriptional activity of STAT3.
31061131.summary: In mice lacking the Fam64a gene, immune cell formation dropped and EAE, a mouse model of MS, was milder because STAT3 activity was reduced.

31803018.mechanism: Not applicable: imaging method for measuring myelin integrity
31803018.conclusion_quote: In summary, we have demonstrated that SCoRe microscopy is an effective and powerful tool to perform both quantitative and qualitative analyses of compact myelin integrity in health or after injury in vivo , demonstrating its future application in high-throughput assessments and screening of the therapeutic efficacy of myelin repair therapies in preclinical animal models of demyelinating diseases.
31803018.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, a new imaging method measured myelin loss and debris in the brain.

30872675.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes virus-induced nerve damage
30872675.conclusion_quote: Intraspinal TMEV infection of resistant mice induced inflammation, demyelination and delayed viral clearance in the spinal cord and more interestingly, subsequent, virus-triggered inflammation and degeneration within the PN associated with dramatic and progressive clinical signs.
30872675.summary: In resistant mice infected with a virus directly into the spinal cord, spinal cord demyelination was followed by a nerve disorder similar to Guillain Barre syndrome.

interventions: human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells (UCMSCs)
31105859.mechanism: Immunomodulation regulates cytokine secretion and T cell differentiation
31105859.conclusion_quote: Our results showed that UCMSC transplantation significantly ameliorated the clinical symptoms of MS.
31105859.summary: In cynomolgus monkeys with EAE, a model of MS, intravenous umbilical cord stem cells eased clinical symptoms and reduced demyelination seen on brain scans, likely by calming the immune system.

31796042.mechanism: PET tracer binds folate receptor beta on macrophages
31796042.conclusion_quote: Our EAE results imply that FR-β may be a useful target for in vivo imaging of multiple sclerosis-related immunopathology.
31796042.summary: In rats with EAE, a folate tracer used in PET scans lit up inflamed lesions by binding folate receptor beta on immune cells, suggesting a way to image MS inflammation.

31406382.mechanism: Removing T-cell PlGF reduces pathogenic TH17 cell development
31406382.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings provide insights into the PlGF-dictated links among angiogenesis, T H 17 cell development and autoimmunity.
31406382.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, deleting placental growth factor from T helper cells reduced inflammatory TH17 cells and disease progression.

31073181.mechanism: blocks CMKLR1 receptor, reducing immune cell trafficking
31073181.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that α-NETA-based CMKLR1 inhibitors may prove safe and effective in treating demyelinating diseases and potentially other autoimmune disorders.
31073181.summary: In mice with EAE, a compound called α-NETA that blocks the CMKLR1 receptor was safe and eased symptoms better than Tecfidera, and improved versions worked even better.

30612739.mechanism: Gut IgA plasma cells secrete IL-10 suppressing neuroinflammation
30612739.conclusion_quote: Our data show that IgA + PB and/or PC mobilized from the gut play an unexpected role in suppressing neuroinflammation.
30612739.summary: In mice with EAE, gut derived IgA producing plasma cells that release IL-10 calmed nervous system inflammation, and losing these cells made the disease worse.

31578269.mechanism: Removing RelB from dendritic cells causes Treg accumulation
31578269.conclusion_quote: Thus, we provide clear evidence that RelB-dependent pathways regulate the capacity of DCs to quantitatively and qualitatively impact on Treg biology and constitute an attractive target for treatment of autoimmune diseases but may come at risk for reduced immune tolerance in the intestinal tract.
31578269.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the relB gene from dendritic cells caused regulatory T cells to build up and protected the mice from disease.

32184863.mechanism: Protects myelin and oligodendrocytes against cuprizone toxin
32184863.conclusion_quote: We could conclude that myelinated structures could be protected by UA in corpus callosum, which provide favorable evidence for the possibility of application of UA in demyelinating diseases and traumatic injuries.
32184863.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone to damage myelin, ursolic acid in drinking water reduced demyelination and protected oligodendrocyte cells in the corpus callosum.

31467038.mechanism: Glutamine antagonist blocks T-cell proliferation and activation
31467038.conclusion_quote: JHU-083, a well-tolerated, brain penetrable glutamine antagonist, is a promising novel treatment for both the physical and cognitive deficits of MS.
31467038.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug JHU-083, which blocks glutamine use, reduced T-cell activity, lessened physical symptoms and reversed memory problems when given before or after onset.

31888063.mechanism: expands regulatory T cells, lowers pro-inflammatory cytokines
31888063.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrated the potential immunomodulatory effects of oral administration of TPC in a chronic colitis murine model.
31888063.summary: In mice with colitis, an oral peptide compound eased symptoms and boosted regulatory T cells. This is not an MS study.

31399516.mechanism: Removes integrin α4 from dendritic cells and monocytes
31399516.conclusion_quote: Thus, inflammatory conditions can promote an environment that is indifferent to α4 integrin expression by DCs.
31399516.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the α4 integrin gene from dendritic cells and monocytes reduced some cell buildup in the brain and gut but did not impair inflammation or infection defense.

31125332.mechanism: Foxp1 stabilizes Foxp3 expression, maintaining Treg suppressive function
31125332.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our study demonstrates that Foxp1 plays critical roles in both maintaining Treg cell quiescence during homeostasis and regulating Treg suppressive function.
31125332.summary: In mice with EAE, removing Foxp1 from regulatory T cells made inflammatory disease worse, showing that Foxp1 helps these immune-calming cells keep working properly.

30208760.mechanism: Loss of Mir223 raises ATG16L1 and autophagy
30208760.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these data indicate that Mir223 is a novel and important regulator of autophagy and that Atg16l1 is a Mir223 target in this process, which may have implications for improving our understanding of the neuroinflammatory process of EAE.
30208760.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the microRNA Mir223 reduced inflammation, demyelination and clinical symptoms while increasing autophagy in microglia through the ATG16L1 gene.

31103264.mechanism: Bob1 binds RORγt to boost IL-17A gene transcription
31103264.conclusion_quote: Thus, our findings demonstrate that Bob1 enhances IL-17A expression in vivo and in vitro by interacting with RORγt in Th17 cells, suggesting that Bob1 plays a pivotal role in Th17-mediated autoimmune disease.
31103264.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Bob1 gene reduced disease, because Bob1 helps Th17 immune cells make the inflammatory signal IL-17A.

31849962.mechanism: Not applicable, describes gene expression only
31849962.conclusion_quote: These findings may shed light on identifying molecular signals that control monocyte differentiation and functions during EAE.
31849962.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers compared gene activity in inflammatory monocytes and the immune cells they turn into, finding distinct gene patterns for each cell type.

31292459.conclusion_quote: This cell-specific and sex-specific investigation of the optic nerve provides targets for the development of therapeutic strategies tailored for optic neuritis in MS.
31292459.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, optic nerve astrocytes showed raised complement gene C3, with a larger increase in females that tracked with nerve cell loss.

30738137.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the regulation of ER stress pathway would be beneficial for the survival of oligodendrocyte.
30738137.summary: Researchers found higher levels of ER stress markers in brain cells of mice with EAE, especially oligodendrocytes, suggesting these cells are vulnerable to cell death.

31154574.mechanism: Astrocyte-driven IL-23 expression triggers CNS inflammatory cytokine cascade
31154574.conclusion_quote: Our model confirms a critical role for IL-23 in the induction of inflammation in the CNS, in particular facilitating the accumulation of lymphocytes in and around the brain.
31154574.summary: In genetically modified mice that produce IL-23 in brain support cells, the animals develop progressive ataxia, brain tissue damage, and buildup of immune cells in the brain.

31009359.mechanism: Blocks lymphocyte exit from lymphoid organs
31009359.conclusion_quote: For siponimod administered at 3 mg/kg in transient middle cerebral artery occlusion mouse model, our findings do not provide preclinical evidence for the use of S1PR1/5 modulators as neuroprotectant in stroke therapy.
31009359.summary: In mice with stroke, the drug siponimod reduced immune cells entering the brain but did not shrink the damaged area.

30696113.conclusion_quote: These findings support the notion that TSPO is a valuable marker for the in vivo visualization and quantification of neuropathological changes in the MS brain.
30696113.summary: In mice given the cuprizone diet to cause demyelination, a PET scan tracer for TSPO detected brain damage, and microglia plus recruited monocytes expressed TSPO, supporting it as a marker.

31861667.mechanism: Inhibits HIF-1 signaling, reducing K2P5.1 channel expression in T cells
31861667.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results suggest a mechanism for K 2P 5.1 up-regulation via HIF-1 in the CD4 + T cells of the IBD model.
31861667.summary: In mice with chemically induced inflammatory bowel disease, low oxygen raised HIF-1 and K2P5.1 channel levels in immune T cells, but this study did not model multiple sclerosis.

31036429.mechanism: Negatively regulates TLR4-MyD88 signaling, promoting M2 microglia
31036429.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, these data indicates that IRAK-M significantly improves EAE onset through down-regulation of the TLR4-MyD88 signaling pathway, which finally leads to differentiation of M2 phenotype in the microglia.
31036429.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the IRAK-M gene made disease start earlier and become more severe, with more harmful M1 microglia infiltrating the nervous system.

30996143.mechanism: Selective thyroid hormone agonist promotes oligodendrocyte differentiation
30996143.conclusion_quote: These results support the clinical investigation of selective CNS-penetrating TH agonists, but not TH, for myelin repair.
30996143.summary: In mice with demyelination, the selective thyroid hormone drugs sobetirome and Sob-AM2 improved myelin repair and motor function, while thyroid hormone itself worsened disease.

30895941.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that differences in gene expression profiles related to regulation of T cell immunity seen in male and female neuroinflammatory disease drive relapsing versus progressive disease course.
30895941.summary: In mice with EAE, immune cells from female donors caused relapsing disease while cells from male donors caused progressive disease, regardless of the recipient's sex.

30890743.mechanism: Gene knockout raises Th17 and Tfh immune responses
30890743.conclusion_quote: Therefore, Anp32b appears to fulfill a role in regulating adequate adaptive immune responses and, hence, may be involved in dysregulation of pathways leading to autoimmune disorders and/or immune deficiencies.
30890743.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Anp32b gene made disease worse and increased activated T cells and follicular helper T cell numbers.

31814564.conclusion_quote: The optimized prokaryotic expression method for the recombinant mouse PLP139-208 was successfully established and effectively performed.
31814564.summary: Researchers optimized bacterial production of a mouse myelin protein fragment that could later be used to prepare immune material for studying multiple sclerosis in mice.

31792189.mechanism: alters gut bacterial networks and reduces microglia in males
31792189.conclusion_quote: Together, these data demonstrate the potential of alcohol to significantly alter the course of autoimmunity differentially in males and females via effects on gut bacterial networks and support further need to evaluate dose and sex-specific alcohol effects in multiple sclerosis (MS) and other autoimmune neuroinflammatory conditions.
31792189.summary: In mice with EAE, a moderate alcohol diet before disease onset improved recovery in males but not females, with sex-specific shifts in gut bacteria.

31649664.mechanism: No treatment tested, descriptive study of cell types
31649664.conclusion_quote: In sum, CNS-ILC1 phenotype, distribution and moderate inflammatory response during EAE suggest that they may act as gatekeepers involved in the control of neuroinflammation.
31649664.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers found that CNS ILC1 immune cells differ from NK cells, with ILC1s staying stable in inflammation and possibly helping control brain inflammation.

29392518.mechanism: PDGF levels correlate with reduced GABAergic inhibition
29392518.conclusion_quote: These findings show that PDGF affects GABAergic activity both in MS patients and in EAE hippocampus.
29392518.summary: In MS patients and mice with EAE, higher cerebrospinal fluid PDGF levels were linked to weaker inhibitory brain signaling, suggesting PDGF affects GABA activity.

31038798.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte differentiation of progenitor cells
31038798.conclusion_quote: Thus, aging restricts the ability of MSCs to support the generation of oligodendrocytes and consequently inhibits their capacity to enhance the generation of myelin-like sheaths.
31038798.summary: In rats, stem cells from aged animals were less able than cells from younger animals to help cells that make myelin develop and repair myelin in demyelination models.

30772428.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that increased glial activation may be related to behavioural abnormalities in CPZ exposure mice and that anti-inflammatory properties may be involved in the CLZ mechanisms.
30772428.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to mimic schizophrenia-like symptoms, clozapine reversed abnormal behaviour and reduced activated glial immune cells in the brain.

31134091.mechanism: Rai loss boosts astrocyte CD39, suppressing T cells
31134091.conclusion_quote: These results identify a new mechanism, to which Rai contributes to a major extent, by which astrocytes modulate the pathogenic potential of autoreactive T cells.
31134091.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Rai gene from astrocytes made them better at calming attacking T cells, which reduced inflammation in the nervous system.

31905713.mechanism: Not applicable, describes immune differences between mouse strains
31905713.conclusion_quote: We conclude that only C57BL/6 mice were predisposed to spontaneous and MOG-induced acceleration of EAE development.
31905713.summary: Comparing three mouse strains immunized with MOG to induce EAE, only C57BL/6 mice were prone to faster autoimmune disease.

31487788.mechanism: Activation lowers TSPAN32 expression in T cells
31487788.conclusion_quote: Overall, these data suggest an immunoregulatory role for TSPAN32 in T helper immune response and may represent a target of future immunoregulatory therapies for T cell-mediated autoimmune diseases.
31487788.summary: Researchers found that the protein TSPAN32 drops in T immune cells when activated, including in mice with EAE and in MS patients' cells, suggesting a regulatory role.

30635412.mechanism: Radioactive tracer binds CSF1R to image microglia
30635412.conclusion_quote: [ 11 C]CPPC can be synthesized in sufficient radiochemical yield, purity, and specific radioactivity and possesses binding specificity in relevant models that indicate potential for human PET imaging of CSF1R and the microglial component of neuroinflammation.
30635412.summary: A radioactive tracer that binds microglia's CSF1R showed specific brain uptake in mice and monkeys with inflammation, and in mice with EAE, a demyelination model.

30953735.mechanism: blocks SIRT1 activity, enhancing progenitor cell proliferation
30953735.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data suggest that SIRT1 inhibition may help to expand the endogenous pool of OPCs without affecting their differentiation.
30953735.summary: In mice with EAE and cultured mouse progenitor cells, blocking the SIRT1 enzyme with Ex527 increased progenitor cell division without changing their maturation into myelin-making cells.

30941147.conclusion_quote: These results highlight the importance of the NF-κB/mTOR/MYC axis in PRMT5-driven pathogenic T cell expansion and may guide targeted therapeutic strategies for MS.
30941147.summary: In mouse and human T helper cells, researchers found that NF-κB, mTOR and MYC signals drive buildup of the PRMT5 protein during immune activation relevant to MS.

31801252.mechanism: Deletes LRP1 in NG2 expressing precursor cells
31801252.conclusion_quote: As LRP1 is necessary for the survival of OPCs in vivo, we assume that it will play an important role in myelin repair.
31801252.summary: In mice lacking LRP1 in NG2 precursor cells, recombined oligodendrocyte precursors progressively disappeared, and EAE differences were not statistically significant.

31785610.conclusion_quote: Children with ADS MOG+ and macaques with EAE induced with rhMOG, present a similar cytokine signature in the CSF and a comparable aspect of brain lesions indicating analogous pathophysiological processes.
31785610.summary: Children with MOG antibody related demyelination and macaques with induced EAE showed similar inflammatory signals and brain lesion patterns, suggesting shared disease processes.

31658770.mechanism: Hsp60 peptide nanoparticles detect autoantibodies with high sensitivity
31658770.conclusion_quote: This, and related models, can now be experimentally tested thanks to the autoantibody detection hypersensitivity provided by the functionalized VLPs.
31658770.summary: Researchers built virus-based nanoparticles that detect very small amounts of antibodies against an Hsp60 peptide, and used them to track these antibodies in mice with colitis.

31158268.mechanism: Increases FXN transcription by reducing R-loops and pausing
31158268.conclusion_quote: Since inherited deficiency in FXN is the primary cause of FA, and DMF is demonstrated to increase FXN expression in humans, DMF could be considered for Friedreich's therapy.
31158268.summary: In Friedreich's ataxia cells and mice, and in people with MS taking the drug, dimethyl fumarate raised frataxin levels, suggesting a possible treatment for that inherited disease.

30755603.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings reveal the innate-like pathogenic function of antigen non-related memory CD4 + T cells, which contributes to the development of autoimmune diseases.
30755603.summary: In mice with EAE, memory CD4 T cells unrelated to myelin infiltrated the spinal cord and released inflammatory signals, increasing disease, and similar cells were found in people with MS.

30506868.mechanism: Gene deletion alters BACE1 substrate roles in myelination
30506868.conclusion_quote: These data identified APP and APLP2 as modulators of normal myelination and demyelination/remyelination conditions.
30506868.summary: In mice lacking APP or APLP2, myelin formation and repair after cuprizone-induced demyelination were altered, with APP loss impairing remyelination.

30937636.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate that remyelination is impaired in YAC128 mice and suggest that WM plasticity may be compromised in HD.
30937636.summary: Mice with a Huntington disease model were given cuprizone to strip myelin, then allowed to recover. Their myelin repair was impaired compared with normal mice.

31278536.conclusion_quote: Secreted Mig was biologically active, inducing chemoattraction of mouse activated CD4 + T lymphocytes.
31278536.summary: Mouse astrocytes infected with Theiler's murine encephalomyelitis virus released a chemokine called Mig that attracted activated T cells, not resting ones.

30849920.mechanism: Blocks PDE5 enzyme, reducing myelin gene expression
30849920.conclusion_quote: We therefore conclude that blocking PDE5 activities exerts a negative impact on intrinsic oligodendroglial differentiation processes.
30849920.summary: In cultured rat oligodendrocyte precursor cells, sildenafil reduced myelin protein production and impaired their ability to form myelin sheaths, suggesting harm to repair.

30662948.mechanism: Agonist antibody activates VSIG4, suppressing NLRP3 and IL-1β
30662948.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight VSIG4 as a prospective target for treating NLRP3-associated inflammatory disorders.
30662948.summary: Mice lacking the VSIG4 gene had worse EAE, a mouse model of MS, and an agonistic VSIG4 antibody reduced inflammation and improved EAE symptoms.

31432714.mechanism: activates type II NKT cells that suppress dendritic cell maturation
31432714.conclusion_quote: Our data reveal that sulfatide-activated type II NKT cells can suppress immunogenic maturation of LDCs to reduce allergic airway inflammation in mouse models of asthma, and it is possible that the immunomodulatory effect needs type I NKT cells.
31432714.summary: In mice with asthma, sulfatide-activated immune cells calmed lung dendritic cells and reduced airway inflammation. This is not a multiple sclerosis study.

30801815.mechanism: Raised GFAP reduces astrocyte CXCL10 release and NF-κB activity
30801815.conclusion_quote: We demonstrate that a persistent GFAP increase alters the astrocytic cell signaling profile, thereby protecting oligodendrocytes, myelin and, subsequently, axons from cuprizone-induced demyelination.
30801815.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, extra human GFAP in astrocytes protected oligodendrocytes, myelin and nerve fibres from demyelination.

30876913.conclusion_quote: Our results discover relevant caveats in the currently used methods of immunofluorescence analysis.
30876913.summary: A new open source computer method analyzes stained spinal cord sections in mice with EAE and shows that single number measures can mislead.

31285535.mechanism: Restores IL-2 signaling to expand regulatory T cells
31285535.conclusion_quote: Thus JunB plays a crucial role in the development of Treg cells by facilitating IL-2 signaling.
31285535.summary: In mice with dextran sulfate colitis, deleting JunB from CD4 T cells impaired regulatory T cell development, and IL-2 antibody complexes restored these cells and eased colitis.

30706162.mechanism: Not applicable, descriptive study of microglia localization
30706162.conclusion_quote: As a microglial contribution to the glia limitans was also observed in human brain tissue, these findings may help characterizing microglial alterations within the NVU in various neuropathologies.
30706162.summary: In mice with EAE and in human brain tissue, microglia were found to form part of the protective barrier around blood vessels, with the densest coverage around capillaries.

30939763.conclusion_quote: CDV infection caused an increased expression of the antiviral effector proteins MX, PKR, OAS1 and ISG15, which probably contributed to a restricted viral replication, particularly in neurons and oligodendrocytes.
30939763.summary: In a dog model of demyelinating brain disease, canine distemper virus increased antiviral immune proteins in brain lesions, possibly limiting virus spread.

30635649.mechanism: Lacking CD70 reduces pathogenic Th1 Th17 cell activity
30635649.conclusion_quote: CD70 + CD4 + T lymphocytes are found in the CNS during acute autoimmune inflammation in humans and mice, highlighting CD70 as both an immune marker and an important costimulator of highly pathogenic proinflammatory T H 1/T H 17 lymphocytes infiltrating the CNS.
30635649.summary: Researchers found that removing CD70 from T cells made mice with EAE, a model of MS, develop less severe disease after transfer.

interventions: genetic mouse model of oligodendrocyte ablation
31356882.mechanism: Oligodendrocyte ablation causes demyelination, then spontaneous recovery
31356882.conclusion_quote: Our results support the hypothesis that skull-surface recorded evoked potential latencies can dynamically track CNS myelination changes.
31356882.summary: In a genetic mouse model where oligodendrocytes are destroyed, skull recorded sensory brain signals slowed and then recovered, tracking myelin loss and repair over months.

30032422.conclusion_quote: Thus, the results suggested that the levels of plasma CNAs and LHX2 methylation might serve as potential biomarkers for the diagnosis of AD, particularly during the early stages of the disease.
30032422.summary: In a study of 36 people with Alzheimer's disease and healthy controls, higher levels of circulating DNA fragments and LHX2 methylation pointed toward possible early diagnostic markers.

30837498.conclusion_quote: A sequence comparison of the DA-C L and DA-D S genome sequences showed mutations in the leader (L) and L* proteins of DA-C L variant, which may be the cause of attenuating phenotype of DA-C L variant in the C57BL/6 mouse model of epilepsy.
30837498.summary: In a viral epilepsy model, mice infected with the small variant of a virus had more seizures, inflammation and brain damage than mice infected with the large variant.

30502648.mechanism: silences miR-21, reducing Th17 cells and increasing B10 cells
30502648.conclusion_quote: Targeting miR-21 may represent a valuable therapeutic intervention strategy for preventing transplant rejection.
30502648.summary: In mice with pancreatic islet transplants, an antagomiR that silences microRNA-21 prolonged graft survival by reducing Th17 cells and increasing B10 cells, not studying MS.

31404142.mechanism: Akt3 signaling in T-cells protects CNS from inflammation
31404142.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that Akt3 signaling in T-cells and not neurons is necessary for maintaining CNS integrity during an inflammatory demyelinating disease.
31404142.summary: In mice with EAE, removing Akt3 from T-cells worsened inflammation and nerve damage, while boosting Akt3 activity delayed disease, showing T-cell Akt3 protects the brain and spinal cord.

30860634.mechanism: Gene loss boosts T cells and cytokines
30860634.conclusion_quote: We conclude that CXCL17 is a novel factor regulating T cell homeostasis and function.
30860634.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, those lacking the Cxcl17 gene developed worse disease, with more T cells and lower survival.

30808363.mechanism: activates NK cells via aryl hydrocarbon receptor
30808363.conclusion_quote: This study clarifies how DNAM-1 modifies the bidirectional crosstalk of NK cells with CD155 + DC, which can be exploited to suppress CNS autoimmunity and strengthen tumor surveillance.
30808363.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug laquinimod activated natural killer immune cells, which reduced antigen presentation by dendritic cells and calmed brain inflammation.

31100354.mechanism: Exercise reduces microglia activation, protecting myelin and axons
31100354.conclusion_quote: Overall, these results suggest that life-style interventions can be effective against the demyelinating-inflammatory processes occurring in the brains of MS patients.
31100354.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause brain demyelination, a running wheel reduced weight loss, improved movement and coordination, and protected myelin and nerve fibers.

30770561.mechanism: removes enzyme that breaks down tryptophan, altering kynurenine pathway
30770561.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that Ido1 deletion promotes seizures and neuropathogenesis during acute TMEV encephalitis.
30770561.summary: In C57BL/6J mice infected with Theiler's virus, deleting the Ido1 gene increased seizures and hippocampal brain damage during acute viral encephalitis.

31201236.mechanism: Describes T cell mitochondria and calcium signaling
31201236.conclusion_quote: The model revealed T cell mitochondria sharply alter direction within minutes following exposure to agonist peptide Ag, changing from accumulation at the immunological synapse to retrograde movement toward the distal end of the T cell body.
31201236.summary: In T cells from a mouse model of MS, mitochondria reversed direction within minutes after strong antigen contact, and their position predicted calcium signaling levels.

30668642.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrated strong topographical spread of neurodegeneration along recognized neural projections and showed that myelin and glial pathology precedes axonal loss in the process, suggesting that the mechanism of trans-synaptic damage may be at least partially mediated by glial components at the cellular level.
30668642.summary: In glaucoma patients, MS patients, and an animal model of optic nerve injury, damage spread along visual pathways, with myelin loss occurring before axon loss.

29873041.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes GPR17 expression
29873041.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate that GPR17 expression induction correlates with acute demyelination and sufficient endogenous remyelination.
29873041.summary: In mice with cuprizone or LPC induced damage to myelin, researchers mapped the GPR17 receptor in brain cells and found it rose where repair happened well.

31178861.mechanism: Trains innate macrophages toward anti-inflammatory state, suppressing IL-17 T ce
31178861.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal that cells of the innate immune system can be trained in vitro or in vivo to be more anti-inflammatory by exposure to helminth products and this protects mice against the induction of a T cell-mediated autoimmune disease.
31178861.summary: In mice with EAE, pretreatment with a parasitic worm extract trained immune cells to be less inflammatory, which protected the mice from developing the disease.

30765742.conclusion_quote: Computational data demonstrated thirteen MOG residues with a robust contribution to the antigen-antibody interaction.
30765742.summary: A computer simulation study of how an antibody binds the myelin protein MOG, identifying key binding sites. No animal models, human cells, or treatments were tested.

31443774.conclusion_quote: This article seeks to provide evidence to prove that use of octopuses as laboratory samples for generation of EAE may open up new approaches for researchers to better approach MS.
31443774.summary: This hypothesis paper proposes using octopuses as a new animal model, instead of mice or rats, for creating experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis to study multiple sclerosis.

30706542.mechanism: dampens pathogenic B-cell functions and limits oligodendrocyte apoptosis
30706542.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we showed that besides suppressing T cells, DMF dampens pathogenic B cell functions, which probably contributes to its clinical effectiveness in relapsing MS.
30706542.summary: In mice with EAE and toxic demyelination, dimethyl fumarate dampened harmful B cells, protected myelin-making cells and reduced axon damage.

30656310.mechanism: blocks TLR9 signaling, reducing dendritic cell activation and inflammatory cytok
30656310.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that degradable PEMs may be able to promote tolerogenic immune function in the context of autoimmunity.
30656310.summary: Researchers coated a TLR9-blocking molecule in a degradable polymer film and found it reduced inflammatory immune cell activity and shifted T cells toward calming types in lab tests.

31552029.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, pMAIT cells expressing the TRAV1-TRAJ33 chain have characteristics similar to human and mouse MAIT cells, further supporting the idea that the pig is an animal model for investigating MAIT cell functions in human disease.
31552029.summary: In pigs, MAIT immune cells were characterized in blood and tissues and resembled those in humans and mice, but no multiple sclerosis model was tested.

30829880.mechanism: Delivers growth factors and anti-inflammatory cytokines intranasally
30829880.conclusion_quote: ST266 is a potential neuroprotective therapy to prevent RGC damage, and intranasal delivery warrants further study as a novel mechanism to deliver protein therapies for optic neuropathies.
30829880.summary: In mice with EAE, intranasal ST266, a secretome from amnion cells, given continuously after onset preserved vision and retinal nerve cells better than placebo.

31507371.mechanism: Mucosal tolerance reduces spinal cord inflammatory infiltrates
31507371.conclusion_quote: These results suggest a role for influencing E-selectin specific responses to limit neuroinflammation that warrants further exploration and characterization to better understand its potential to mitigate neurodegeneration in disorders such as MS.
31507371.summary: In mice with EAE, nasal delivery of E-selectin before or after symptoms began reduced disease severity and inflammation in the spinal cord.

31428102.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that localization of heterogeneous B cell populations, including activated and isotype-switched B cell phenotypes, to the CNS and intrathecal Ab (ItAb) synthesis can occur independently of SLO-like follicles during chronic inflammatory demyelinating disease.
31428102.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a model of progressive MS, B cells built up in the central nervous system and made antibodies without forming organized lymphoid follicles.

31028571.mechanism: Activates RAS/MEK/ERK signaling to promote OPC differentiation
31028571.conclusion_quote: The results of the present study suggest that CDK18 is a promising cell-type specific target to treat demyelinating disease.
31028571.summary: In a lab model of nerve demyelination, boosting CDK18 in myelin-precursor cells helped them mature into myelin-forming cells.

30232810.mechanism: unclear, alters microglia density and oligodendrocyte differentiation
30232810.conclusion_quote: Teriflunomide altered microglia density and oligodendrocytes differentiation, which was associated with less evident microstructural damage on MRI.
30232810.summary: In mice with a virus-induced demyelinating disease, teriflunomide lowered microglia counts and was linked to less brain tissue damage seen on MRI.

31292248.conclusion_quote: These data strongly suggest that L blocks PKR activation by preventing the interaction between PKR and viral dsRNA.
31292248.summary: In cell culture, a Theiler's virus protein was found to stop the PKR stress sensor kinase from detecting viral RNA, which limits stress granule formation.

31214480.mechanism: Modulates S1P1 receptors, keeping lymphocytes out of CNS
31214480.conclusion_quote: The results support the potential therapeutic benefits of combining ponesimod with DMF to improve disease activity control in patients with MS.
31214480.summary: In mice and rats with EAE, the S1P1 drug ponesimod reduced paralysis, and adding dimethyl fumarate worked even better.

31037121.mechanism: Not a treatment study, imaging of neuroinflammation only
31037121.conclusion_quote: The combination of [ 18 F]DPA-714 PET and T 2 mapping may allow to further elucidate the regional and temporal profile of inflammatory signals depending on the myelination status, although the underlying inflammatory microenvironment changes.
31037121.summary: In mice fed the cuprizone diet, which causes myelin loss, PET and MRI scans tracked inflammation from demyelination through early repair, showing inflammation peaked and then declined.

29273325.conclusion_quote: Thus, Eu-VSOP have the potential to reveal various aspects of choroid plexus involvement in neuroinflammation, including monocyte recruitment from the blood and alterations of the choroid plexus epithelium.
29273325.summary: In mice with EAE, a europium tagged iron oxide imaging agent revealed choroid plexus involvement in relapses and tracked brain inflammation with MRI and microscopy.

32140045.conclusion_quote: The study showed strain and age differences in number of IFN-γ-producing NK cells in EAE rat dLNs, and suggested that their pathogenetic relevance depends on frequency and/or activity of other cells involved in CD4+ T cell (auto)immune response.
32140045.summary: This study examined natural killer immune cells in rats with EAE, an MS model, finding that age and strain changed their numbers, but their role in disease depended on other immune cells.

31635426.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this study demonstrates circulating EqPV-H infections in Thoroughbred horses from central Europe and revealed age and breeding history as risk factors for EqPV-H infections.
31635426.summary: In German Thoroughbred horses, this study found equine parvovirus with older age and breeding history as risk factors, not related to multiple sclerosis.

31315675.conclusion_quote: Although the majority of the IRL damage observed is likely due to retrograde degeneration following optic neuritis, initial pathology, possibly due to gliosis, may contribute further to IRL thinning.
31315675.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of optic neuritis, retinal layers first thicken from swelling, then thin as nerve cells degenerate, with early glial activation preceding cell loss.

30572255.mechanism: Shifts T-cell responses toward regulatory profile
30572255.conclusion_quote: It was ultimately attained that TEX and MSC-EXO utilized various mechanisms to modulate the recall immune responses.
30572255.summary: In a lab test using immune cells from mice with EAE, exosomes from stem cells or tumor cells shifted immune responses, with tumor exosomes producing stronger regulatory effects.

31286875.conclusion_quote: In the central pathological process of EAE mice, B cells exert role through the mechanism other than producing antibodies and the levels of brain TPI and GADPH are related to the severity of autoimmune induced-damage.
31286875.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers tracked B cell types over 30 days and found B cells may act in the brain and spinal cord beyond making antibodies.

31117220.conclusion_quote: As horse sera are commonly used for the production of anti-sera, which are included in human and veterinary medical products, these results implicate the requirement for diagnostic tests to prevent EqPV-H transmission.
31117220.summary: This study found an equine virus in many commercial horse serum samples from several countries, suggesting worldwide spread and a need for screening tests.

30421250.mechanism: Not a therapy, fluorine imaging contrast agent
30421250.conclusion_quote: Enhanced SNR and T 1 shortening indicate the potential benefit of in vivo 19 F MR at higher B 0 to study inflammatory processes with greater detail.
30421250.summary: Researchers tested fluorine MRI at a stronger magnet in mice with EAE and found clearer, more detailed signals from a contrast agent in brains and lymph nodes.

31266512.mechanism: Anti-inflammatory and multiple molecular pathway effects
31266512.conclusion_quote: The functional rescue provided by BPC 157 after spinal cord injury implies that BPC 157 therapy can impact all stages of the secondary injury phase.
31266512.summary: In rats with spinal cord injury, a single dose of the peptide BPC 157 improved motor recovery and reduced nerve damage, including myelin loss.

30759305.mechanism: siRNA silences LINGO-1, promoting oligodendrocyte myelin repair
30759305.conclusion_quote: LINGO-1 downregulation was associated with signs of repair in histopathological sections, higher expression of pontine myelin basic protein (MBP) mRNA and protein and lower levels of caspase-3 activity indicating neuroprotection and remyelination enhancement.
30759305.summary: In rats with chemically induced myelin damage, nasal delivery of nanoparticles carrying LINGO-1 silencing RNA improved movement and helped myelin repair.

30582962.mechanism: Boosts microglia clearing myelin debris and OPC differentiation
30582962.conclusion_quote: These results highlight the importance of targeting microglia during the repair processes in order to enhance remyelination.
30582962.summary: In mice with virus-induced demyelination, the endocannabinoid 2-AG sped up myelin debris clearance and oligodendrocyte maturation, producing complete remyelination with thicker myelin.

31297860.conclusion_quote: Surprisingly, the effects of reduced muscle were often more pronounced than those of absent skeletal muscle, indicating a complex relationship between muscle mass and joint morphogenesis.
31297860.summary: In mouse embryos lacking or with reduced limb muscle, joint shapes were measured in 3D, showing reduced muscle often affected joints more than absent muscle.

31203904.conclusion_quote: Here, I propose that calcifying nanoparticles may have a role in the etiology and/or pathophysiology of MS.
31203904.summary: This hypothesis paper proposes that tiny calcium-based particles could trigger nerve damage in multiple sclerosis, but it tests no treatment or experiment.

31578786.mechanism: reduces reactive oxygen species, DNA damage and senescence in cholangiocytes
31578786.conclusion_quote: PC protects cholangiocytes against LPC-induced cytotoxicity and cellular senescence, suggesting its potential as a target for inhibiting LPC-related carcinogenesis and its promotion.
31578786.summary: In human bile duct cells, a fat molecule called phosphatidylcholine reduced damage and aging caused by lysophosphatidylcholine. This study does not address multiple sclerosis.

30870435.mechanism: removes NG2 proteoglycan from OPCs and pericytes
30870435.conclusion_quote: Overall, this study suggests that vascular OPCs, in virtue of their developmental arrangement and response to neuroinflammation and growth factors, could be integrated among the classical NVU cell components.
30870435.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the NG2 gene made brain blood vessels keep their tight junctions better, though vessel basal membrane proteins were reduced.

31511021.mechanism: Lacking claudin-12 leaves blood brain barrier tight junctions intact
31511021.conclusion_quote: Our present study thus shows that claudin-12 is not essential in establishing or maintaining BBB TJs integrity.
31511021.summary: Mice engineered to lack claudin-12 kept an intact blood brain barrier and showed no worse inflammation when given EAE, a model of MS.

30692691.mechanism: Not applicable: describes a human organoid model of oligodendrocyte development
30692691.conclusion_quote: We anticipate that this method can be used to study oligodendrocyte development, myelination, and interactions with other major cell types in the CNS.
30692691.summary: Researchers grew human stem cell derived brain organoids containing oligodendrocytes, which matured over time and began wrapping neurons, offering a model to study myelin formation.

31362166.mechanism: Imaging tracer binds myelin, no treatment tested
31362166.conclusion_quote: [ 11 C]PIB PET imaging is an efficient tool for detecting demyelination in grey and white matter, in a non-human primate model of progressive MS.
31362166.summary: Researchers used a PET brain scan tracer to detect myelin loss in marmosets with an MS like disease, finding reduced signal in grey and white matter regions.

31534149.conclusion_quote: This research underlines the power of MTR for the study of peripheral nerve injury in small tissues such as the sciatic nerve of rodents and contributes new knowledge to the effect of aging on recovery after injury.
31534149.summary: In young and aged rodents with sciatic nerve crush or lysolecithin demyelination, MRI magnetization transfer showed slower nerve recovery in aged animals.

30605480.conclusion_quote: To conclude, this study proposes a repeatable semi-automatic protocol capable of providing mean 3D realistic developmental map of a developing rudiment allowing researchers to study how growth and adaptation are directed by biological and mechanobiological factors.
30605480.summary: Using imaging and computer registration, researchers built a 3D map of knee joint growth in mouse embryos before birth. The study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

31790150.conclusion_quote: We think that such a new explanation of the mechanism of SCCHN tumors' platinum resistance identifies novel approach to treating these tumors.
31790150.summary: This cancer study in head-and-neck tumor cell lines found that copper-driven ATP7B increase, linked to TMEM16A, reduces cisplatin effectiveness, and copper chelators restored drug sensitivity.

30631981.mechanism: delivers drug to brain to promote remyelination
30631981.conclusion_quote: The studies proved that SLN-encapsulated MTA can be substantially delivered to the brain and can effectively remyelinate the neurons.
30631981.summary: In mice with cuprizone induced demyelination, oral nanoparticle packaged methylthioadenosine reached the brain better and helped restore myelin and motor function.

30456797.mechanism: Blocks CSF-1R signaling, reducing microglia numbers and demyelination
