30456797.conclusion_quote: Preventive and therapeutic BLZ945 treatment promoted remyelination and neuroprotection in the chronic model.
30456797.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, the oral CSF-1R inhibitor BLZ945 reduced microglia and protected myelin, with clearer benefit in the chronic model.

31366238.conclusion_quote: New myelin generation is essential for learning.
31366238.summary: In mice, researchers found that learning new memory links increased myelin-producing cells, and that chemically inducing demyelination in a brain region impaired learning.

31049507.conclusion_quote: These results have important implications for the design of essential oil based nanoemulsions as effective antifungal delivery systems in foods.
31049507.summary: Tested cinnamon oil nanoemulsions with different surfactants against Fusarium graminearum fungus in food settings. Ionic surfactant versions inhibited fungal growth and mycotoxin production better than standard ones. Not an MS study.

29974515.mechanism: Suppresses LPC-triggered caspase 3 activation, reducing endothelial cell death
29974515.conclusion_quote: Heparin is protective against LPC cytotoxicity and might intervene steps between mitochondrial membrane potential drop/p38 activation and caspase 3 activation.
29974515.summary: In mouse brain endothelial cells grown in a dish, heparin reduced cell death caused by lysophosphatidylcholine, a fat molecule found in oxidized cholesterol particles. This study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

31168611.conclusion_quote: Altogether, the present results offer strong evidence of cell-type and ligand-specific Notch signaling activation and its time- and area-dependent participation in toxic demyelination and spontaneous remyelination.
31168611.summary: In rats given the toxin cuprizone, which damages myelin, researchers mapped how Notch signaling changes during demyelination and natural myelin repair.

30316103.mechanism: AHR-dependent reduction of pathologic Th1 T cells
30316103.conclusion_quote: These results identify the AHR pathway as a potential target for driving targeted immunosuppression in the CNS in the context of atmospheric PM-mediated autoimmune disease.
30316103.summary: In mice with EAE, intranasal urban dust particles delayed disease onset and reduced severity, with the benefit depending on the AHR pathway.

31623610.conclusion_quote: Specific M/M polarization is highly correlated to the demyelination-remyelination process probably via modulations of the inflammatory niche, cytokine components, and OPC response.
31623610.summary: In mice with two types of induced myelin damage, researchers tracked how immune cells called microglia and macrophages changed their activation state over time, which matched the pace of myelin repair.

31184779.mechanism: Knockdown alters K63 ubiquitin trafficking of myelin proteins
31184779.conclusion_quote: Altogether, the counterbalance of the K63Ub machinery and BRCC3-triggered DUB machinery are important for the cellular trafficking of myelin proteins and OL differentiation.
31184779.summary: In cultured oligodendrocyte precursor cells and rats fed cuprizone, reducing BRCC3 impaired oligodendrocyte maturation and myelin protein production.

30238390.mechanism: Not applicable: describes axonal transport breakdown
30238390.conclusion_quote: In this correlative ultrastructural-immunohistochemical study, we provide strong evidence that breakdown of the axonal transport machinery results in focal accumulations of mitochondria and different synaptic proteins.
30238390.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, researchers found damaged nerve fibers build up mitochondria and synaptic proteins, with similar patterns seen in progressive MS patient tissue.

29984057.conclusion_quote: Cuprizone significantly induced oxidative and nitrosative stress coupled with memory decline and cortico-hippocampal neuronal deficits; however, administration of M. oleifera significantly reversed the neuropathological deficits induced by cuprizone.
29984057.summary: In rats given cuprizone to mimic MS, Moringa oleifera plant treatment reversed memory decline and brain nerve damage linked to oxidative stress.

30702966.mechanism: nasal nanocarriers deliver drug directly to brain
30702966.conclusion_quote: Hence it can be inferred that the nose-to-brain delivery of TFM-MNLC can be considered as effective and safe delivery for brain disorders.
30702966.summary: In animals given cuprizone to damage myelin, nasal delivery of teriflunomide nanocarriers produced faster remyelination than oral drug and appeared safe.

30555470.mechanism: Shifts microglia to anti-inflammatory state, promotes remyelination
30555470.conclusion_quote: Overall, tuftsin effectively combined with benztropine to significantly improve MS-like pathologies in both models.
30555470.summary: In mice with EAE and in the cuprizone model, tuftsin plus benztropine calmed inflammation and improved myelin repair and symptoms.

29935880.conclusion_quote: Overall, our data indicate that there is a significant involvement of the MIF pathway in MS ethiopathogenesis and that interventions specifically blocking MIF receptors may represent useful therapeutic approaches in the clinical setting.
29935880.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug ISO-1 that blocks MIF improved disease features and supports MIF as a treatment target.

29536745.mechanism: Antioxidant, reduces proinflammatory cytokines and raises anti-inflammatory cyto
29536745.conclusion_quote: Astaxanthin is a powerful tool for intervention in EAE on a model of multiple sclerosis, so it can be studied further to prevent and treat MS (Tab. 2, Fig. 3, Ref. 41).
29536745.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, astaxanthin given before disease onset reduced inflammation and symptom severity while increasing anti-inflammatory signals.

29397207.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes cholinergic changes
29397207.conclusion_quote: These studies on VAChT expression suggest central cholinergic imbalance during EAE progression.
29397207.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, spinal cord levels of a cholinergic transporter rose along with immune cell infiltration and glial activation, suggesting cholinergic imbalance.

30187907.conclusion_quote: This study shows for the first time that inflammation precedes oligodendrocyte death and neuronal loss and that macrophages/ microglia are the only cells persisting in large numbers in the chronic phase of the disease, probably because of the switch from proinflammatory to anti-inflammatory phenotype.
30187907.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, inflammatory cells dominated early disease, oligodendrocytes and neurons declined later, and macrophages or microglia persisted in chronic stages.

29516383.mechanism: binds inflamed CNS regions and activated endothelial cells
29516383.conclusion_quote: The peptide is therefore a candidate for further analyses of the molecular alterations in inflammatory lesions.
29516383.summary: In rats with EAE, a peptide called Ph48, chosen by phage display, bound inflammatory lesions in CNS tissue and inflamed human brain endothelial cells.

29925173.conclusion_quote: The trend of the proportion of CD4(+) T cells expressing CD1d molecules during the course of EAE pathogenesis is verified, which lays a foundation for further study on the interaction between CD4(+) T cells and NKT cells in the progression of EAE models.
29925173.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers measured how the share of CD4 T cells carrying CD1d changed as disease rose and recovered.

30201769.mechanism: TRPM2 loss lowers CXCL2, curbing neutrophil infiltration
30201769.conclusion_quote: Together, the results suggest that TRPM2 plays an important role in progression of EAE pathology and shed light on its putative role as a therapeutic target for MS.
30201769.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the TRPM2 channel reduced inflammatory signals and immune cell entry into the spinal cord and brain, slowing disease.

29527165.mechanism: inhibits lymphocyte proliferation and macrophage phagocytosis
29527165.conclusion_quote: These in vivo experiments have shown that intraperitoneal injections of immunocortin in a daily dosage 100 μg per animal reduced symptoms of EAE in DA rats.
29527165.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, daily injections of a synthetic immunocortin peptide reduced disease symptoms.

29574981.mechanism: Not applicable, describes lipid changes only
29574981.conclusion_quote: Decreases in myelin content in the cuprizone model were accompanied by decreases in oleic acid concentration and is associated with PC 36:1 suggesting that specific lipids could be a potential biomarker for myelin degeneration.
29574981.summary: In cuprizone-fed mice and MS patient brains, the fat molecule PC 36:1 fell as myelin was lost, hinting it could mark myelin damage.

29464444.mechanism: Not applicable, describes iron changes during demyelination
29464444.conclusion_quote: Our results revealed that the CZ-containing diet influences the systemic iron metabolism in mice, particularly the iron homeostasis of the liver.
29464444.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause brain demyelination, blood and liver iron stores fell while liver hepcidin rose, suggesting that systemic iron control is disturbed.

30150982.mechanism: Inhibits Th17 differentiation and STAT3 and NF-κB signaling
30150982.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results show that carnosol has enormous potential for development as a therapeutic agent for autoimmune diseases such as MS.
30150982.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the plant compound carnosol eased symptoms, reduced inflammation and demyelination, and blocked harmful Th17 immune cells.

30482850.mechanism: Raises IL-11 to expand regulatory T cells
30482850.conclusion_quote: These results identify a previously uncharacterized mode of action of aspirin.
30482850.summary: In mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, low dose aspirin reduced symptoms and inflammation by boosting protective regulatory T cells through IL-11.

29920290.conclusion_quote: Thus, gal-3 is induced in distinct cell types that are engaged in removal of damaged axons and cell debris and axon regeneration and remyelination, suggesting a potential neuroprotective role of gal-3 in EAE mice.
29920290.summary: In mice with EAE, the protein galectin 3 appeared in immune cells and nerve support cells that clear damaged tissue, peaking near symptom onset and hinting at a protective role.

29803827.mechanism: Blocks CSF1R, depleting microglia and macrophages
29803827.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings suggest that ablation of microglia/macrophages during the symptomatic phase of EAE reduces CNS inflammation and may also promote a more permissive environment for remyelination and recovery.
29803827.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug called PLX5622 removed microglia and macrophages after symptoms began, improving mobility, weight gain, and myelin preservation.

30647949.mechanism: not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
30647949.conclusion_quote: Moreover, the study includes a first analysis of the detailed histopathological changes of the optic nerve and retina on an EAE model, all of these as the background for testing drugs with potential therapeutic role in MS.
30647949.summary: Researchers characterized damage to the brain, spinal cord, optic nerve and retina in mice with EAE, a model of MS, to prepare for future drug tests.

29557516.conclusion_quote: Collectively, the results suggest that the olfactory dysfunction of EAE is closely linked to downregulation of OMP and the development of inflammatory foci in the olfactory system in an animal model of human multiple sclerosis.
29557516.summary: In rats and mice with EAE, an MS model, researchers found olfactory bulb inflammation and lower olfactory marker protein, linked to poorer smell detection.

29775564.mechanism: Human IgM antibody that accelerates remyelination
29775564.conclusion_quote: These results further confirm the remyelination-promoting capabilities of rHIgM22 and support additional investigation of its therapeutic potential in MS.
29775564.summary: In mice with demyelination caused by cuprizone, a single dose of the antibody rHIgM22 sped up hippocampal myelin repair and improved memory and maze performance.

29140922.mechanism: Activates S1PR1 receptor, reverses spinal central sensitization
29140922.conclusion_quote: We conclude that fingolimod behaves as an S1PR1 agonist to reduce pain in multiple sclerosis by reversing central sensitization of spinal nociceptive neurons.
29140922.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, daily fingolimod reduced nerve pain sensitivity by acting on S1PR1 receptors in the spinal cord.

29517994.mechanism: Reduces retinal inflammation and gliosis, preventing ganglion cell death
29517994.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, these data suggest that the balanced mixture of FAs may represent a useful form of diet supplementation to limit inflammatory events and death of RGCs associated to optic neuritis.
29517994.summary: In mice with EAE, a fatty acid dietary supplement reduced retinal inflammation and gliosis and prevented loss of retinal ganglion cells.

29275848.mechanism: suppresses leukocyte migration by targeting CCL7 chemokine
29275848.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results characterize a novel aspect of miR-23b function in leukocyte migration, and they identify miR-23b as a potential therapeutic target in the amelioration of MS and likely other autoimmune diseases.
29275848.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, boosting microRNA miR-23b blocked immune cells from entering the brain and spinal cord, reducing disease severity.

29534847.mechanism: Blocks NRG1 signaling, reducing microglia-driven inflammation
29534847.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, expression of neuregulin antagonist in the brain and spinal cord protects females but not males, suggesting a complex interplay between NRG1 and sex difference in EAE that may be associated with microglia-mediated inflammation.
29534847.summary: In mice with EAE, a genetically added NRG1 blocker in the brain and spinal cord protected female mice from severe disease but not male mice.

30607150.mechanism: Inhibits mTORC1 and lowers Th1 IFN-gamma gene expression
30607150.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggeste that HSO/HPO can be used as a potent immunomodulator and as a good candidate for re-myelination and downregulation of immune response for treatment of MS.
30607150.summary: In mice with EAE, hemp seed and evening primrose oils lowered immune and mTOR gene activity and regenerated myelin, while rapamycin did not regenerate myelin.

29066310.mechanism: Deleting synapsin I curbs abnormal synaptic vesicle release
29066310.conclusion_quote: In vivo, the ablation of SynI expression is protective in terms of disease progression and neuronal damage in the experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis mouse model of MS.
29066310.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, deleting the gene for synapsin I reduced nerve damage and slowed how quickly the disease progressed.

29545117.mechanism: Lowers miR-181c, reducing Th17 cells via TGF-beta signaling
29545117.conclusion_quote: Our results identified a novel miRNA that promotes Th17 cell differentiation and autoimmunity, thus miR-181c may serve as a potential treatment target in patients with MS.
29545117.summary: In mice with EAE, reducing miR-181c delayed disease onset and slowed its progression by lowering harmful Th17 immune cells.

29386552.mechanism: blocks NF-κB p65 activation in macrophages and microglia
29386552.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that iguratimod ameliorates acute and chronic EAE by suppressing inflammatory cell infiltration and immune cell activation, partly through inhibition of NF-κB p65, supporting the therapeutic potential of this drug for not only acute, but also chronic MS.
29386552.summary: In mice with EAE, the anti-rheumatic drug iguratimod reduced disease severity and nerve damage whether given before or after symptoms began, by calming immune cells in the spinal cord.

29409686.mechanism: LPA5 receptor signaling drives pain after demyelination
29409686.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that LPA5 signaling may play a key role in the mechanisms underlying neuropathic pain following demyelination in the brain.
29409686.summary: In mice given cuprizone to induce brain demyelination, LPA5 receptor levels in the corpus callosum rose, and pain sensitivity was linked to LPA5 signaling.

30369926.conclusion_quote: This study suggests dynamic thymic alterations occurring in response to EAE, from the induction to the chronic phase, that might help to elucidate the MS pathophysiology.
30369926.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the thymus shrank early in disease and partly recovered later, alongside changes in immune cells and nerve damage.

30338822.mechanism: Reduces oxidative stress, inflammation, and boosts regulatory T cells
30338822.conclusion_quote: Aside from oxidative stress, LA possessed anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects on EAE.
30338822.summary: In mice with long-term EAE, alpha-lipoic acid reduced oxidative stress and inflammation, increased regulatory T cells, and preserved myelin protein.

29895691.mechanism: Blocks caspase one, reducing inflammasome activation and glial pyroptosis
29895691.conclusion_quote: Thus, GSDMD-mediated pyroptosis in select glia cells is a previously unrecognized mechanism of inflammatory demyelination and represents a unique therapeutic opportunity for mitigating the disease process in MS and other CNS inflammatory diseases.
29895691.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug VX-765 blocking caspase one reduced inflammation and cell death, prevented nerve injury, and improved behavior.

30405357.mechanism: No treatment tested, observational lineage tracing
30405357.conclusion_quote: Thus, at present there is no compelling evidences that clonal relationship influences the position or function of astrocytes in the EAE model.
30405357.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers tracked groups of related astrocytes after injury and found their responses varied, with no clear link to shared ancestry.

29515033.mechanism: Loss impairs endothelial cells, reducing T cell crossing
29515033.conclusion_quote: These findings identify calnexin in brain endothelial cells as a potentially novel target for developing strategies aimed at managing or preventing the pathogenic cascade that drives neuroinflammation and destruction of the myelin sheath in MS.
29515033.summary: Mice lacking calnexin, a protein in brain blood vessel cells, resisted EAE, an MS-like model, because immune cells could not cross into the brain.

30185466.conclusion_quote: Thus, early EAE is a state of microglial "deactivation" associated with reduced synaptic pruning.
30185466.summary: In mice with early EAE, a model of MS, basolateral amygdala neurons showed more excitatory synapses while microglia appeared less active and pruned fewer synapses.

30007349.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes hyaluronan degradation
30007349.conclusion_quote: KIAA1199 expression by activated astrocytes may explain the focal HA degradation observed during progression of MS and could represent a possible new therapeutic target.
30007349.summary: In mice with EAE and one human MS patient, the protein KIAA1199 was found in activated astrocytes inside lesions where hyaluronan was broken down.

29086442.mechanism: Loss reduces MMP9 and blood brain barrier leakage
29086442.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings demonstrate that Klk6 secreted by OLs plays a critical role in the pathogenesis of EAE/MS and that it might serve as a potential therapeutic target for MS.
29086442.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Klk6 gene delayed symptom onset, reduced paralysis, and limited immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord.

29791026.mechanism: Blocks leukocyte diapedesis through endothelial basement membrane
29791026.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results suggest that CD99L2 participates in the development of EAE by supporting diapedesis of leukocytes through the endothelial basement membrane of blood vessels of the BBB in the CNS.
29791026.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting CD99L2 from blood vessel lining cells reduced immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord and lessened disease severity.

29803554.mechanism: Diet preserves axonal caliber and myelin thickness
29803554.conclusion_quote: These findings demonstrate that differences in axonal pathology occur in the absence of observable differences in clinical signs, and that inter-study comparisons may be confounded by differences in dietary care.
29803554.summary: In mice with EAE, the AIN-93 M diet protected axons and myelin from loss compared with standard Teklad chow, even though disease symptoms looked similar.

29099627.mechanism: Immunomodulation: lowers IL-17 and TNF-α, raises IL-10
29099627.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the combination of MSCs and nicotine can be suggested as a promising strategy for further MS therapeutics improvement.
29099627.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, combining stem cell therapy with nicotine reduced disease symptoms and inflammatory cytokines more than either treatment alone.

28964723.conclusion_quote: These studies not only provide definitive evidence for the contribution of MOG-specific antibodies to MS, but also reveal mechanistic insight that could lead to new therapeutic targets.
28964723.summary: In mice with EAE, antibodies from MS patients that target myelin protein MOG worsened disease, and this worsening depended on immune receptors called Fc gamma receptors.

30151738.mechanism: Reduces T-cell proliferation via NOX2 in peripheral cells
30151738.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, phytol supplementation of the diet leads to amelioration of EAE pathology in both a NOX2-dependent and a NOX2-independent manner via yet unknown mechanisms.
30151738.summary: Mice with EAE fed a diet enriched with phytol had milder symptoms, less demyelination, and fewer immune cells infiltrating the brain and spinal cord.

30043528.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest the presence of a pathologically relevant TLR2 related innate immune abnormality in patients with both relapsing-remitting and progressive MS.
30043528.summary: In blood samples from 26 MS patients and 32 healthy controls, half of MS patients showed enhanced immune responses to TLR2 stimulation, including some with progressive disease.

29904389.mechanism: Deleting RhoA cuts T-cell proliferation, migration and cytokines
29904389.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrates that RhoA is a central regulator of several archetypical T-cell responses, and furthermore points toward RhoA as a new potential therapeutic target in diseases such as MS, where T-cell activity plays a central role.
29904389.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting RhoA only in T-cells reduced disease incidence and severity, along with fewer T-cells entering the brain and spinal cord.

29567431.mechanism: Promotes M2 macrophage polarization, inhibits inflammatory M1 responses
29567431.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that Env59-GP3 ISU peptide has therapeutic potential in EAE possibly through inducing the polarization of M2 macrophages and inhibiting inflammatory responses.
29567431.summary: In mice with EAE, a peptide derived from a human retrovirus fragment reduced disease, nerve damage and inflammation, likely by shifting macrophages toward a calming type.

29242126.conclusion_quote: Up regulation of PHB in relapsing vs remission MS patients imply the potential use of PHB to clinically evaluate subclinical disease status towards prognosis of an oncoming relapse.
29242126.summary: In mice with EAE and in MS patients, prohibitin 1 levels were higher during relapses than remission, suggesting it could help predict an upcoming relapse.

29127843.mechanism: Inhibits osteopontin and Th17 cell differentiation via PI3K/AKT/NF-κB
29127843.conclusion_quote: The findings described herein provide novel evidence for the role of IFN-β in Th17 differentiation partly through the inhibition of OPN.
29127843.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, interferon beta reduced disease incidence and damage by lowering Th1 and Th17 immune cells and osteopontin levels.

30052483.mechanism: Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects reduce oxidative stress
30052483.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the GA treatment can protect the brain tissue against EAE in mice with its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
30052483.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, received 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid, a licorice compound, which reduced brain oxidative stress, inflammation, and tissue damage.

29328415.mechanism: increases tyrosine hydroxylase and noradrenaline levels
29328415.conclusion_quote: These results suggested that drugs targeting LC survival and function, including catalpol, may be able to benefit patients with MS.
29328415.summary: In mice with EAE, a natural compound called catalpol improved clinical scores, raised noradrenaline levels in the spinal cord, and protected nerve cells in the brain's locus coeruleus.

29193293.mechanism: Antagonizes S1PR1, reducing glial activation and oligodendrocyte death
29193293.conclusion_quote: Our study identifies functional antagonism of S1PR1 as a major mechanism for the protective effect of FTY720 in the cuprizone model and suggests pathogenic contributions of astrocyte S1PR1 signaling in primary demyelination and its potential as a therapeutic target for CNS inflammation.
29193293.summary: In mice fed the cuprizone diet, daily FTY720 or CYM5442 blocking S1PR1 receptors reduced brain cell death, inflammation, and loss of myelin insulation.

29288338.mechanism: Removing TLR2 reduces astrogliosis and changes microglia activation by region
29288338.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that the TLR2 orchestrates glia activation during gray and white matter demyelination in the presence of an intact blood-brain barrier.
29288338.summary: In mice given the cuprizone toxin to damage myelin, removing the TLR2 immune receptor reduced astrocyte activation in some brain areas but did not change myelin loss.

30367633.mechanism: not applicable, descriptive study of EZH2 expression
30367633.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest a role of EZH2 in the migration of T cells in MS patients.
30367633.summary: In blood samples from people with MS, researchers found fewer EZH2-positive T cells in untreated patients, suggesting this protein may help T cells migrate.

29440425.mechanism: Promotes anti-inflammatory phenotype in antigen-presenting cells
29440425.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest the potential for bryo-1 as a therapeutic agent in MS, particularly given its established clinical safety.
29440425.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the compound bryostatin-1 prevented neurologic deficits and reversed them even when started late in disease.

30252090.conclusion_quote: Hence, similar to developmental myelination, the (re)expressed galectin-4 upon demyelination may act as factor in the timing of oligodendrocyte differentiation, while the persistent presence of galectin-4 on demyelinated axons may disrupt this fine-tuning of remyelination.
30252090.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination and in human MS tissue, researchers found this protein appears on nerve fibres and immune cells, and stays present in chronic lesions where repair fails.

29378942.mechanism: Activates ILC2s, promoting nonpathogenic Th2 myelin response
29378942.conclusion_quote: Thus, in contrast to their pathogenic role in allergy, we propose a sex-specific role for both mast cells and ILC2s as attenuators of the pathogenic Th response in CNS inflammatory disease.
29378942.summary: In mice with EAE, males made more IL-33, which activates ILC2 immune cells to calm harmful responses, and giving IL-33 to females reversed their more severe disease.

30030849.mechanism: Not applicable, bacterial infection is an exposure not treatment
30030849.conclusion_quote: The present results indicate that oral infection with P. gingivalis augmented the severity of EAE.
30030849.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, infection with the gum bacterium P. gingivalis, given by mouth or under the skin, made disease symptoms worse.

29266540.conclusion_quote: Overall, susceptibility mapping appears to be a more promising tool than T 2 * or frequency shift mapping for the early diagnosis and treatment of diseases in which myelination is implicated.
29266540.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, fingolimod reduced myelin loss, and susceptibility MRI mapping detected myelin changes best.

29572472.conclusion_quote: LysM-EGFP//CD11c-EYFP mice appear as a powerful tool to differentiate moDCs from macrophages and to study the dynamics of immune cell maturation and phenotypic evolution in EAE.
29572472.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, were studied with fluorescent reporters to track how immune cells invade the spinal cord and change over time.

29749614.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest miRNAs, including miR-31, may regulate entry of DCs into the CNS during EAE, and could potentially represent therapeutic targets for CNS autoimmune diseases such as MS.
29749614.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers found that microRNAs, especially miR-31, are enriched in dendritic cells entering the brain and spinal cord, possibly controlling their entry.

30048715.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that demyelination of grey matter areas in the thalamocortical system permanently affects vMGN frequency specificity and the prevalence of bursting in the auditory thalamus.
30048715.summary: In mice with lysolecithin lesions or cuprizone-induced demyelination, auditory thalamus neurons responded less precisely to sound and fired fewer bursts.

28872930.conclusion_quote: Both CD4 + and CD8 + T cells were most sensitive to MOG antigen stimulation for IFN-γ production during the early stage of EAE, but then rapidly lost the function despite their vigorous proliferation at the peak stage and later.
28872930.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, T cells that attack myelin produced the most interferon gamma early on, then lost that ability later despite multiplying.

30219773.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our results indicate that Cer metabolism is linked to G-CSF signaling in MS.
30219773.summary: Blood samples from 72 people with multiple sclerosis and 25 healthy volunteers showed altered ceramide fat levels, linked to a signaling pathway that controls immune cells.

30214192.summary: This correction notice amends an earlier study of a nanodrop antioxidant in an MS animal model and reports no new experiment.

29436030.mechanism: ATF6α loss worsens oligodendrocyte death from ER stress
29436030.conclusion_quote: Thus, these data suggest the protective effects of ATF6α activation on oligodendrocytes in immune-mediated demyelinating diseases.
29436030.summary: In mice with EAE and in developing mice expressing IFN-γ, removing the ATF6α gene made myelin-producing cells die faster, worsened myelin loss, and increased disease severity.

28659048.mechanism: antagonist antibody blocks VISTA immune checkpoint signaling
28659048.conclusion_quote: This study along with previous EAE data, suggests that interventions that enhance VISTA regulatory activity may be effective for the treatment of autoimmune disease.
28659048.summary: In lupus-prone mice, blocking the VISTA immune brake with an antibody worsened kidney damage and brought on earlier protein in the urine. This is a lupus model, not MS.

29448957.mechanism: blocks CSF-1 receptor, reducing microglia survival and neuroinflammation
29448957.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data suggest that a short-term therapeutic inhibition of the CSF-1 receptor pathway by BLZ945 in the murine cuprizone model enhances central remyelination by modulating neuroinflammation.
29448957.summary: In mice on a cuprizone diet, the drug BLZ945 blocks microglia signaling and improved remyelination in some brain regions but not others, and did not help EAE mice.

30409508.conclusion_quote: Our study reveals very specific profiles of reactive astrocytes depending on the triggering stimulus.
30409508.summary: Using human stem cell derived astrocytes, researchers found that different multiple sclerosis linked inflammatory signals trigger distinct reactive changes in these brain support cells.

30065723.mechanism: Suppresses proinflammatory CD4 T effector cell programs
30065723.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results support the observation that the association between VitD status and MS susceptibility is genotype dependent and suggest that the outcome of VitD status in MS is determined by gene-by-sex interactions.
30065723.summary: In mice with EAE, a high vitamin D diet protected female mice but not males, and its effects depended on the mouse genetic background.

30010211.mechanism: Knocks down Notch1, promoting oligodendrocyte maturation and remyelination
30010211.conclusion_quote: Our study provided evidence that the inhibition of Notch1 gene could accelerate remyelination in MS.
30010211.summary: In a mouse model of cuprizone-induced demyelination, blocking the Notch1 gene with small interfering RNA sped up myelin repair and improved balance and movement.

30340030.conclusion_quote: VEP could be exploited as neurophysiological marker to test novel treatments against neurodegeneration involving ONs.
30340030.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, an MS model, visual nerve signal tests showed delays and nerve damage, and no treatment was tested.

29471880.conclusion_quote: These data highlight the promise of [ 18 F]FSPG-PET as a technique to provide insights into neuroimmune interactions in MS and the in vivo role of xc- in the development and progression of this disease, thus warranting further investigation.
29471880.summary: In mice with EAE, a PET scan tracer called FSPG detected higher activity of the cystine glutamate transporter than FDG, even before symptoms appeared.

29038005.mechanism: Inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome signaling and reduces inflammatory cytokines
29038005.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these results suggest that inhibition of the NLRP3 signaling pathway may be a novel mechanism by which PDN exerts its protective actions in demyelinating diseases.
29038005.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, prednisone reduced demyelination, brain inflammation and anxiety-like behavior by blocking the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway.

30543718.summary: This is a correction notice for a 2018 PLoS One paper on transglutaminase 2 inhibitors tested in monocytes and a mouse model of MS, not a new study.

29224959.conclusion_quote: A decreased NAA level has been particularly shown in lumbar spinal cord in relationship with the clinical signs.
29224959.summary: In an EAE model of MS, metabolomics found higher lactate and glucose and lower NAA, especially in the lumbar spinal cord, linked to paralysis signs.

29409838.conclusion_quote: We therefore identified that NODDI maps can help to highlight the internal microanatomy of the hippocampus but NODDI still presents limitations in grey matter as it failed to capture selective dendritic alterations occurring at early stages of a neurodegenerative disease such as multiple sclerosis, whereas DTI maps were significantly altered.
29409838.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, diffusion MRI scans showed DTI detected hippocampal changes in the molecular layer, while NODDI missed early dendrite damage.

29148731.mechanism: delivers antigen and TGF beta to dendritic cells, inducing regulatory T cells
29148731.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates that the codelivery of immunomodulatory cytokines on Ag-NPs may enhance the efficacy of Ag-specific tolerance therapies by programming Ag presenting cells for more efficient tolerance induction.
29148731.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, nanoparticles carrying a disease antigen plus TGF beta reduced disease severity and worked at lower doses than nanoparticles alone.

29629902.mechanism: Blocks α4 integrin, reducing brain inflammatory markers
29629902.conclusion_quote: This model holds promise as a valuable tool for understanding the pathology of RE and for developing patient-tailored experimental therapeutics.
29629902.summary: Mice given immune cells from Rasmussen's encephalitis patients developed seizures and brain inflammation, and blocking α4 integrin reduced inflammatory markers. This is not an MS study.

29518786.conclusion_quote: Our data uncovered the expression profiles of lncRNAs and mRNAs in vivo and in vitro, which may help delineate the mechanisms of astrocyte activation during MS/EAE process.
29518786.summary: In mice with EAE and in cultured mouse astrocytes, researchers measured which long noncoding RNAs and messenger RNAs change in activity, finding shared changes linked to inflammation and metabolism.

29688408.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes fibrinogen deposition
29688408.conclusion_quote: In summary, our data support the notion that fibrinogen is a key player in the early pathogenesis, as well as sustained inflammation, of inflammatory demyelinating lesions.
29688408.summary: In marmosets with EAE and human MS tissue, fibrinogen leaks early from blood vessels into lesions and persists at active lesion edges.

29222794.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes EAE induction method
29222794.conclusion_quote: The protocol in this chapter presents a method to actively induce experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), one of the most widely used animal models to study efficacy of potential drugs for treatment of multiple sclerosis.
29222794.summary: This methods chapter describes how to induce EAE, a mouse model of MS, in female C57BL/6 mice using myelin peptide immunization and pertussis toxin, causing paralysis from spinal cord inflammation.

30150571.mechanism: Inhibits T cell proliferation and Th1 response
30150571.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we propose a model that can explain the dual immunoregulatory function of Nlrp12 in EAE.
30150571.summary: In mice with EAE, a gene called Nlrp12 protected against disease in one model but worsened it in another, and it dampened T cell activity.

30194392.conclusion_quote: This work identifies miRNAs that are affected by inflammation and suggests novel candidates that may be targeted to improve neuroprotection in the context of pathological inflammation.
30194392.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers measured microRNA levels in nerve cells and found 14 that changed in motor and retinal neurons.

29707601.mechanism: Binds myelin, promoting remyelination after systemic injection
29707601.conclusion_quote: This in vitro assay will be valuable for future screening of MS regenerative therapies targeting remyelination.
29707601.summary: In mice with a virus-induced MS-like disease, a lab test of how DNA aptamers bind myelin predicted which versions would repair myelin in the body.

29304807.mechanism: Boosts glial glutamate transporter expression, reducing excitotoxic damage
29304807.conclusion_quote: Overall, our results suggest that laquinimod protects against glutamate excitotoxicity of the cerebellum of EAE mice by bursting the expression of glial glutamate transporters, independently of its anti-inflammatory effects.
29304807.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug laquinimod, delivered into the brain, protected against nerve-damaging glutamate overload by boosting protective glutamate transporters.

35538965.mechanism: T cells carry magnetite nanoparticles into the brain
35538965.conclusion_quote: Our data demonstrated that T cells containing nanomaterials hold the possibility of carrying and releasing nanoparticles in the brain.
35538965.summary: Researchers loaded myelin-specific T cells with magnetite nanoparticles, transferred them into mice with EAE, and found the nano-loaded cells inside the central nervous system.

30006713.conclusion_quote: There are a number of EAE models, being actively induced EAE in strains such as C57Bl/6 mice very robust and reproducible.
30006713.summary: This methods paper describes how to induce EAE in mice by immunizing them with MOG 35-55 peptide, a widely used model of multiple sclerosis.

29407174.mechanism: Suppresses PGAM5-driven necroptosis and inflammation in microglia
29407174.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings provide evidence that NBP can attenuate the progression of EAE by suppressing PGAM5-induced necroptosis and inflammation in microglia and represents a new therapeutic strategy for treating autoimmune diseases.
29407174.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug butylphthalide reduced disease severity by blocking a cell-death and inflammation pathway in microglia, the brain's immune cells.

29699382.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease-altered stem cell gene expression
29699382.conclusion_quote: These data provide insight into the failure of autologous BM-MSCs to promote recovery in MS and support the concept of utilizing non-autologous MSCs in future clinical trials.
29699382.summary: Researchers compared stem cells from mice with EAE, a model of MS, to healthy mice and found many gene changes linked to inflammation and reduced myelin repair.

29611013.conclusion_quote: The original version of this article unfortunately contained a mistake.
29611013.summary: This correction notice for a mouse study of RNS60 nebulization in EAE only fixes misplaced figure legends and reports no new results.

29203302.mechanism: mimics interferon beta, binds IFNAR1 receptor, reduces inflammation
29203302.conclusion_quote: We conclude that MSPEP27 has protective effects against MOG-induced EAE via reduction of immune dysfunction and inflammation.
29203302.summary: In mice with EAE, a computer-designed peptide copying part of interferon beta bound its receptor and reduced inflammation, with protective effects.

29740445.mechanism: Deleting Perp makes Th17 cells resist caspase-dependent apoptosis
29740445.conclusion_quote: Therefore, Perp deletion promoted Th17 responses and exacerbated the development and severity of EAE.
29740445.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Perp gene in T cells made Th17 immune cells resist cell death, causing earlier, more severe disease with spinal cord damage.

29329699.mechanism: disrupts blood-brain barrier, increasing CNS inflammation
29329699.conclusion_quote: Thus, sCD40L induces more severe inflammation in the central nervous system by disrupting the BBB.
29329699.summary: In mice with EAE and human brain endothelial cells, giving soluble CD40 ligand worsened disease and made the blood-brain barrier leakier.

29235698.conclusion_quote: Discrepancies in the type and number of animals used in experiments performed by Milena Penkowa and reported in Table 1, identified during the course of investigations into Ms Penkowa's research, render the data and conclusions drawn from them unreliable.
29235698.summary: This is a retraction notice for a 2000 study of metallothioneins in animals with EAE, a model of MS, withdrawn because the reported animal numbers were inconsistent.

29283442.conclusion_quote: These observations demonstrate the heterogeneity of CNS myeloid cells, their evolution during the course of autoimmune demyelinating disease, and their plasticity on the single cell level.
29283442.summary: In human MS lesions and mice with EAE, researchers found that immune cells called myeloid cells shift from inflammatory to calming forms, which may guide future treatments.

30544973.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that above-mentioned miRNAs may play a crucial role in the pathogenesis of MS, and that miR-99b, miR-125a, and miR-146b in particular may serve as useful biomarkers for disease activity.
30544973.summary: Researchers profiled microRNAs in spleen cells and blood of mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, finding nine raised microRNAs, three of which may serve as disease activity markers.

29274729.mechanism: blocks T-cell proliferation and activation, induces apoptosis
29274729.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that pathogenic CD4 + T cells may be viable targets by gemcitabine for therapeutic benefit in MS.
29274729.summary: Gemcitabine, a cancer drug, blocked harmful immune T cells in the lab and prevented disease in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

28962999.mechanism: Nr4a1 loss boosts inflammatory macrophages and Th1/Th17 cells
28962999.conclusion_quote: Our results, for the first time, demonstrate that Nr4a1 not only induces Type 2 macrophages/microglia phenotype, but is also a critical inhibitory molecule for Th1/Th17 cell differentiation.
28962999.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Nr4a1 gene caused earlier and more severe disease, with more inflammatory macrophages and Th1 and Th17 immune cells in the central nervous system.

29523207.mechanism: Oxysterols reduce LPS-induced pro-inflammatory marker expression in glial co-cul
29523207.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrate that inflammation profoundly affects oxysterol levels and that oxysterols can modulate glial cell activation.
29523207.summary: In cell cultures and in mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers measured how inflammation changes oxysterol levels and found some oxysterols can calm inflammatory glial cell activity.

30241860.mechanism: inhibits Th17 cell differentiation and proliferation
30241860.conclusion_quote: These results indicating EAP20-1 could benefit EAE through inhibiting Th17 cell differentiation and suggesting a therapeutic potential of EAP20-1 in MS.
30241860.summary: In mice with EAE, a polysaccharide from the herb Eclipta prostrata eased symptoms and reduced spinal cord inflammation and demyelination by blocking Th17 immune cells.

30619258.conclusion_quote: Therefore, TMEV infection may induce different patterns of cytokine expressions as well as lymphatic vessel dysfunction by rather different mechanisms between the CNS and heart, which might explain observed patterns of organ-specific immunopathology.
30619258.summary: In SJL and C3H mice infected with Theiler's virus, cytokine and lymphatic vessel patterns differed between spinal cord and heart, possibly explaining the different organ damage.

29068088.conclusion_quote: These results shed light on the mechanisms of LPC injury and homeostasis.
29068088.summary: In mice, researchers found that the chemical lysophosphatidylcholine damages myelin by disrupting its fats, and that the brain partly buffers it.

28452087.mechanism: Expands regulatory T cells, depletes CD8 T cells
28452087.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, data revealed that the suppressive capacity of Treg on viral elimination is efficiently boosted by CD8-depletion, which renders C57BL/6 mice susceptible to develop chronic neuroinfection and TMEV-IDD.
28452087.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, boosting regulatory T cells while depleting CD8 T cells caused chronic infection, myelin loss and nerve damage, worsening disease.

29495967.mechanism: Stabilizes HIF-1α, activates PPARγ and CB2 receptors
29495967.conclusion_quote: This study provides new significant insights about the potential role of VCE-004.8 for MS treatment by ameliorating neuroinflammation and demyelination.
29495967.summary: In mice with EAE and Theiler's virus encephalopathy, the cannabidiol derivative VCE-004.8 reduced demyelination, nerve damage, and immune cell infiltration, and lowered inflammation.

30144326.conclusion_quote: The observed changes in cholinergic markers expression and cellular localization in the CNS during EAE disease progression suggests their potential involvement in the development of the neuroinflammatory process and may lay the ground to consider cholinergic system components as putative anti-inflammatory therapeutic targets for MS.
30144326.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers measured cholinergic system markers in the brain and spinal cord during acute and remitting disease, finding many altered levels.

29773813.mechanism: Blocks Th1 and Th17 differentiation via JAK/STAT signaling
29773813.conclusion_quote: Thus, our data demonstrated that NTG-A-009 ameliorated inflammation through the inhibition of Th1 and Th17 cells generation making it a potential therapeutic candidate for the treatment of inflammatory diseases.
29773813.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug NTG-A-009 reduced harmful Th1 and Th17 immune cells and eased disease symptoms.

29363187.mechanism: Loss of GPR65 worsens disease via iNKT cells
29363187.conclusion_quote: These findings provide functional support for the genetic association of GPR65 with MS and demonstrate GPR65 signals suppress autoimmune activity in EAE.
29363187.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Gpr65 gene made disease worse, and this effect depended on iNKT immune cells rather than CD4 T helper cells.

29509323.mechanism: Suppresses HMGB1 release and inflammatory cytokines
29509323.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, rTM down-regulated inflammatory mediators in the peripheral circulation and prevented HMGB1 release from nuclei in the central nervous system, suppressing EAE-related inflammation.
29509323.summary: Mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS, improved after recombinant thrombomodulin treatment, which lowered inflammatory signals and HMGB1 in blood and spinal cord.

29454153.mechanism: Treadmill running intended to restore muscle carnosine levels
29454153.conclusion_quote: In EAE exercise therapy does not restore this.
29454153.summary: In mice with EAE and in people with MS, muscle carnosine levels fell substantially, and 10 days of treadmill exercise training did not restore them.

29444620.mechanism: Not applicable, no therapeutic mechanism tested
29444620.conclusion_quote: Thus, exposure to the induction procedure and repeated gavage differentially altered subsequent anxiety-like behavior in the two EAE variants.
29444620.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, repeated oral gavage and disease induction changed anxiety-like behavior differently in two mouse strains, suggesting gavage can distort drug testing results.

29876728.conclusion_quote: This data may suggest that there is an EPO-mediated cross-talk between the kidney and CNS during EAE pathogenesis.
29876728.summary: In mice with EAE, erythropoietin rose in both kidney and brain at peak disease alongside increased inflammatory TNF alpha, suggesting possible crosstalk between the two organs.

29931449.mechanism: Gene loss lowers regulatory T cells
29931449.conclusion_quote: These findings demonstrate a novel role for GPR54 in regulating self-tolerant immunity in a sex hormone independent manner.
29931449.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the GPR54 gene reduced regulatory T cells and made the autoimmune disease more severe, independent of sex hormones.

30134798.mechanism: Deletes pathogenic T cells, expands regulatory T cells
30134798.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that multiple mechanisms can lead to the expansion of the Treg population, depending on the DC subset and receptor targeted.
30134798.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody linked to a myelin peptide targeted immature dendritic cells, which reduced harmful T cells, boosted regulatory T cells, and improved symptoms.

29608575.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, limiting lymphocyte trafficking and inflammation
29608575.conclusion_quote: Given the efficacy demonstrated by ozanimod and its metabolite RP-101075 in the NZBWF1 preclinical animal model, ozanimod may warrant clinical evaluation as a potential treatment for systemic lupus erythematosus.
29608575.summary: In lupus-prone NZBWF1 mice, ozanimod and its metabolite reduced kidney damage, urine protein, and immune cell activity, suggesting possible use in lupus patients.

30144320.mechanism: Increases CSF1 causing microglia activation and neuronal loss
30144320.conclusion_quote: These results implicate that CSF1 upregulation in CNS may play an important role in the proliferation and activation of microglia in EAE, contributing to neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration.
30144320.summary: In mice with EAE, higher CSF1 levels in spinal cord and forced CSF1 expression in neurons triggered microglia activation, neuron loss, and demyelination.

29687146.mechanism: Raises TLR3/TLR9 and IFN-beta, lowers Th1 Th17
29687146.conclusion_quote: These findings shed light on the potential of genistein as a prophylactic strategy for multiple sclerosis (MS) prevention.
29687146.summary: Genistein, a plant compound, given before immunization delayed disease and reduced inflammation and demyelination in mice with EAE.

30157451.mechanism: Not a treatment, detects virus RNA
30157451.conclusion_quote: In summary, the developed RT-RPA assay offers a rapid, sensitive and specific alternative method for monitoring of TMEV, especially in resource-limited conditions.
30157451.summary: Researchers developed a fast virus detection test for Theiler's virus in mouse colonies and found it matched standard lab testing.

29111742.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that the acetylation and methylation of lysine on MBP are PTMs associated with the neurological disability produced by EAE.
29111742.summary: In mice with EAE, lysine acetylation of myelin basic protein rose at peak disability, and the HDAC inhibitor trichostatin A improved their symptoms without changing acetylation.

29499143.conclusion_quote: This mechanism reduces CNS damage and ameliorates motor impairment.
29499143.summary: A commentary on a study where transplanted neural stem cells in mice with an animal model of MS released anti-inflammatory prostaglandin E2 and removed succinate, reducing damage.

30013568.mechanism: Reduces HMGB1 expression and neuronal HMGB1 release
30013568.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the results indicate that GL has a strong neuroprotective effect on EAE mice by reducing HMGB1 expression and release and thus can be used to treat central nervous system inflammatory diseases, such as MS.
30013568.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, glycyrrhizin reduced disease severity, inflammation and demyelination by lowering levels and release of the inflammatory protein HMGB1.

30546391.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease only
30546391.conclusion_quote: The significant increases in the activation level of astrocytes and inflammatory cytokine level have a close relationship with EAE progression.
30546391.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, researchers found more activated brain astrocytes and higher inflammatory cytokines that tracked with worsening disease.

29155139.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that the anti-TMEV capsid antibodies neutralise virus infection by preventing heparan sulfate from binding to the capsid.
29155139.summary: Rabbit antibodies against the Theiler's virus capsid blocked infection of cultured cells by preventing heparan sulfate from binding to the virus.

30334416.mechanism: Shifts T-cell balance, lowering TNF and IL-17 cells
30334416.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that artemisinin may be a new choice for MG treatment.
30334416.summary: In rats with experimental myasthenia gravis, an autoimmune muscle disease, artemisinin reduced symptoms and rebalanced immune cells that drive inflammation.

29916800.conclusion_quote: Our results, therefore, provide evidence to support the existing nomenclature, and confirm that A. centrale (ex Theiler 1911) Ristic and Kreier 1984 is, indeed, a distinct species.
29916800.summary: Gene sequence comparisons of cattle parasites Anaplasma centrale and Anaplasma marginale showed they form separate groups, confirming A. centrale is a distinct species.

29542092.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, for the first time, this study demonstrated a significant positive correlation between Klotho and TAC changes during the pathogenesis of EAE.
29542092.summary: Klotho and antioxidant levels rose and fell together in the brain and spinal cord of mice with EAE, a model of MS.

29528433.mechanism: Deleting Slfn8 reduces IL-6 inflammation from endothelial cells
29528433.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that Slfn8 may play a role in EAE by regulating inflammation in endothelial cells.
29528433.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Slfn8 gene reduced disease scores and lowered inflammatory signals from blood vessel cells.

28800924.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we provide evidence implicating a role for GM-CSF in promoting virus replication and proinflammatory cytokine expression in macrophages, indicating that GM-CSF may be a key factor for TMEV infection and the induction of chronic TMEV-induced immunopathogenesis in the CNS.
28800924.summary: In a lab culture of mouse bone-marrow macrophages infected with Theiler's virus, cells grown with GM-CSF supported more virus replication and inflammation than cells grown with M-CSF.

30173119.mechanism: Loss of IL-33 raises pathogenic T cells
30173119.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that IL-33 plays a protective role in EAE and exerts extensive influences on multiple immune cells and neural cells involved in EAE.
30173119.summary: In mice without IL-33, induced EAE was more severe, with more demyelination, more harmful T cells, and more activated microglia and astrocytes in the brain and spinal cord.

29460173.conclusion_quote: From these observations, we conclude that cuprizone induces new contacts between axons and myelins at the internode region.
29460173.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone to cause demyelination, optic nerves showed more abnormal contact points between nerve fibers and their myelin coverings, but few major structural changes.

30366205.mechanism: Removes Blimp-1 transcription factor from T cells
30366205.conclusion_quote: The immunized Blimp-1 conditional knockout mice have a significantly delayed disease onset but enhanced disease severity during the effector phase compared to their wild-type littermates, suggesting that Blimp-1 is a unique transcription factor with distinct roles in the regulation of myelin-specific CD4 T cells during priming and effector phase of EAE.
30366205.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Blimp-1 gene from immune cells delayed disease onset but made later disease more severe.

29514678.mechanism: Antioxidant that reduces oxidative stress and protects neurons
29514678.conclusion_quote: A prophylactic LA treatment is necessary to protect from visual loss and retinal thinning in EAE-ON, suggesting that a clinical ON trial starting therapy after the onset of symptoms may not be successful.
29514678.summary: In mice with EAE optic neuritis, lipoic acid given before symptoms appeared protected the retina and vision, but treatment started after symptoms did not work.

29392175.conclusion_quote: HSL enables detailed molecular myelin characterization that can substantially improve upon the current understanding of remyelination in multiple sclerosis and provides a strategy to assess remyelination treatments in animal models.
29392175.summary: In mice with induced focal demyelination and in patient MS lesions, a combined imaging method mapped lipids and showed newly formed myelin has a different lipid makeup than normal myelin.

29301568.mechanism: Binds proteoglycans, reducing inflammatory chemokines and cytokines
29301568.conclusion_quote: Therefore surfen suppresses inflammation but inhibits remyelination in these models.
29301568.summary: In mice with EAE and with induced myelin lesions, the drug surfen reduced inflammation and symptoms but slowed myelin repair.

29944870.mechanism: Blocks microglia M1 switch via miR-136-5p and HOTAIR
29944870.conclusion_quote: In summary, SF blocks microglia switching to a pro-inflammatory M1-like phenotype by ceRNA effect of miR-136-5p and lncRNA HOTAIR in cuprizone-induced demyelination.
29944870.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, sulfasalazine calmed inflammatory microglia and boosted myelin repair, acting through interactions between microRNA and long non-coding RNA.

30312921.mechanism: Light boosts precursor cells, calms microglia and astrocytes
30312921.conclusion_quote: Although further studies are required, it is suggested that LLLT represents a feasible therapy for demyelinating diseases.
30312921.summary: In mice given a cuprizone diet to damage myelin, transcranial laser light treatment improved motor coordination and reduced demyelination, with more oligodendrocyte precursor cells.

29409311.mechanism: Stem cells promote remyelination of damaged corpus callosum
29409311.conclusion_quote: Our data indicated a remyelination potency of multiple i.p. BM-MSCs in the cuprizone model of multiple sclerosis in mice.
29409311.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, repeated injections of human bone marrow stem cells reduced myelin loss and restored myelin protein levels.

29473171.mechanism: Blocks L-type calcium channels reducing neuronal calcium influx
29473171.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data suggest a CNS-specific effect of L-type voltage-gated calcium channel blockade to inflammation-induced neurodegeneration.
29473171.summary: In mice with EAE, the calcium channel blocker nimodipine, given before or after symptoms began, reduced disease severity and protected nerves from damage without changing peripheral immune responses.

30091739.mechanism: Unclear, reduces hippocampal neuronal damage and weight loss
30091739.conclusion_quote: Pharmaceutical development of Moringa oleifera into appropriate therapeutic formulations could offer somerelief to patients of demyelinating conditions that have clinical features of neurological deficits.
30091739.summary: In rats given the cuprizone toxin to damage the brain, Moringa leaf extract reduced weight loss and hippocampal tissue damage, suggesting possible protective benefit.

29928277.conclusion_quote: Thus, our data support the notion that maternal Hpx can imprint the immune response of the offspring suffering EAE probably due to a reduced capacity to trigger suppression.
29928277.summary: In mice with EAE, offspring of mothers with low thyroid hormone during pregnancy had earlier, more severe disease and weaker immune suppression by regulatory T cells.

29402285.mechanism: No treatment tested, imaging study only
29402285.conclusion_quote: Increase of 18 F-VC701 uptake in EAE mice is strongly associated with the presence of microglia activation in the acute phase of the disease.
29402285.summary: Researchers used a PET scan with a tracer and MRI in mice with EAE, a model of MS, to detect brain and spinal cord inflammation. The tracer built up where immune cells called microglia were active.

32055173.mechanism: emulsifies dietary fat to improve nutrient digestion
32055173.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, lysolecithin supplementation improved FCR and TTNR of energy and ether extract when broiler chickens were offered a reduced energy diet.
32055173.summary: Broiler chickens fed diets with added lysolecithin emulsifier grew more efficiently and digested energy and fat better, with no effect on blood fats.

29685293.mechanism: blocks IL-6 receptor, reducing spinal microglia activation and proliferation
29685293.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that MR16-1 can decrease mechanical allodynia in EAE mice through inhibition of microglial activation and proliferation in the spinal cord.
29685293.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody blocking the IL-6 receptor reduced pain sensitivity and calmed overactive microglia in the spinal cord, whether given before or after onset.

29031957.mechanism: Dampens autoreactive T-cell activation and proliferation
29031957.conclusion_quote: ET inhibits immune system responses to an auto-antigen to attenuate EAE, rather than generally suppressing the immune system, but does not induce a direct neuro-protective effect against EAE.
29031957.summary: In mice with EAE, six weeks of treadmill running reduced harmful immune T cells, lessening disease, but did not directly protect the nervous system.

30333477.mechanism: Blocks RGMa, promoting axon growth and reducing inflammation
30333477.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results show that a humanized anti-RGMa antibody has therapeutic effects in mouse models of SPMS.
30333477.summary: In mice with EAE, a humanized antibody blocking RGMa slowed disease progression, reduced inflammation and nerve damage, and improved motor recovery.

29761559.mechanism: Deleting GSK3b in oligodendrocytes reduces caspase-dependent apoptosis
29761559.conclusion_quote: Collectively, the data show that GSK3b is pro-apoptotic for caspase-dependent cell death, likely through activation of nuclear GSK3b and its depletion promotes survival of oligodendrocytes and attenuates myelin loss.
29761559.summary: In mice given the cuprizone demyelinating diet, deleting GSK3b in mature oligodendrocytes improved their survival, preserved myelinated axons, and reduced glial activation.

29541433.conclusion_quote: According to the results, lysolecithin-induced demyelination at optic chiasm and VEP impairments can be restored by administration of levothyroxine.
29541433.summary: In rats with lysolecithin-induced demyelination of the optic chiasm, levothyroxine injections reduced visual signal impairment, with the highest doses giving the strongest protection.

30198844.mechanism: Blocks glutathione synthesis, raising T cell oxidative stress
30198844.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that glutamine catabolism fuels de novo synthesis of GSH and directs the lineage choice in T cells.
30198844.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting genes that make glutathione in T cells slowed disease progression and showed that this antioxidant production shapes immune cell fate.

30372424.mechanism: Removes ASC, blocking caspase-8 inflammasome IL-1β release
30372424.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our study suggests that microglia-derived IL-1β via noncanonical caspase-8-dependent inflammasome is necessary for microglia to exert their pathogenic role during CNS inflammation.
30372424.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the ASC protein from microglia, the brain's immune cells, reduced T cell buildup and inflammation in the central nervous system.

29030079.conclusion_quote: We have clarified the temporal changes in the DTI values coupled with histological properties over both the demyelination and remyelination processes.
29030079.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to demyelinate their brains, imaging scans tracked FA, MD and RD changes that matched myelin loss and repair, with radial diffusivity most sensitive.

29627590.mechanism: Not applicable, imaging study without treatment
29627590.conclusion_quote: OCT together with DTI can detect retinal and optic nerve damage and elucidate to the temporal sequence of neurodegeneration in this rodent model of MS in vivo.
29627590.summary: In mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS, eye scans and nerve imaging showed early swelling then nerve thinning in the optic nerve and retina over time.

30322946.mechanism: No treatment tested, viral exposure triggers inflammation
30322946.conclusion_quote: Collectively, we demonstrate that asymptomatic intranasal viral acquisition accelerates subsequent neuroinflammation in a nonhuman primate model of MS.
30322946.summary: In marmosets with EAE, an earlier intranasal herpesvirus HHV-6 exposure, even without symptoms, sped up the onset of brain inflammation resembling MS.

29903027.mechanism: Reduces immune infiltration, microglia and retinal cell death
29903027.conclusion_quote: From our study, we deduce neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory effects of laquinimod on the optic nerve and retina in EAE mice, when animals were treated before any clinical signs were noted.
29903027.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, laquinimod reduced optic nerve inflammation and demyelination and protected retinal nerve cells when given before symptoms appeared.

29293022.mechanism: Improves fat digestibility in low-energy broiler feed
29293022.conclusion_quote: These findings indicated that lysolecithin supplementation at 500 g/tn of feed in low-energy diets maintained broiler performance.
29293022.summary: In broiler chickens, lysolecithin added to low-energy feed helped maintain growth and improved fat digestion. The study does not use an MS or demyelination model.

29146590.mechanism: blocks CaMKIIα activity, reducing pain and clinical signs
29146590.conclusion_quote: Together, these data implicate a critical role of CaMKIIα as a cellular mechanism for pain and neuropathy in multiple sclerosis and IL-17 may act upstream of CaMKIIα in the generation of pain.
29146590.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the CaMKIIα protein with KN93 or siRNA reduced ongoing and evoked pain as well as clinical disease scores.

30697467.mechanism: No treatment or genetic change tested
30697467.conclusion_quote: Our research team found significant low levels of histamine and diamine oxidase in RRMS patients; however the pathogenesis of this issue was unclear.
30697467.summary: Researchers measured histamine and diamine oxidase in blood serum of 50 relapsing MS patients and 41 controls, finding lower levels in the patients.

30303567.conclusion_quote: We conclude that neurosteroidogenesis/myelination status and glial reactivity are inversely related in the hippocampus and neocortex.
30303567.summary: In mice given cuprizone to induce demyelination, brain levels of proteins that make neurosteroids dropped while inflammation rose, then recovered in grey matter after remyelination.

29484707.mechanism: Shifts microglia anti-inflammatory via CB2, boosts suppressive MDSCs
29484707.conclusion_quote: Together, these data suggest a robust modulatory effect in the peripheral and central immunity by 2-AG and highlight the interest of modulating endogenous cannabinoids to regulate CNS inflammatory conditions.
29484707.summary: In mice with Theiler's virus-induced demyelination, the endocannabinoid 2-AG calmed brain inflammation and immune cell entry, with long-term benefits seen later in disease.

29934611.mechanism: Imaging method tracking immune cell movement
29934611.conclusion_quote: Thus, time-lapse MRI enables for assessing immune cell dynamics non-invasively in deep tissue and may serve as a tool for detection or monitoring of an inflammatory response.
29934611.summary: Researchers used repeated MRI scans to track slow immune cells in the brains of mice with EAE and found fewer slow cells than in healthy mice.

30279279.mechanism: Co-inhibits immunoproteasome LMP2 and LMP7, reducing Th17 cells
30279279.conclusion_quote: Hence, co-inhibition of LMP2 and LMP7 appears to be synergistic and advantageous for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
30279279.summary: In mice with EAE and colitis, blocking two immunoproteasome parts together strongly reduced disease, working better than blocking only one.

29128575.conclusion_quote: The study indicates the control points linked with strain differences in age-related changes in EAE pathogenesis.
29128575.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, researchers compared young and aged Albino Oxford and Dark Agouti strains, finding age-related immune cell differences that shape how severe disease becomes.

29681799.summary: This correction notice amends a 2018 cuprizone study of cystatin F deficiency and demyelination and contains no new experimental findings.

30366765.mechanism: Loss of RIP2 boosts pathogenic Th17 cell formation
30366765.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that RIP2 has a T cell-intrinsic role in determining the balance between homeostatic and pathogenic Th17 cell responses.
30366765.summary: In mice with EAE, removing RIP2 from CD4 T cells increased harmful Th17 immune cells and made the disease more severe.

30420755.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that OLs and OPCs are not passive targets but instead active immunomodulators in MS.
30420755.summary: In mice with EAE and human MS brain samples, researchers found distinct oligodendrocyte cells that express immune genes and can act on T cells, suggesting they actively influence disease.

29492193.mechanism: inhibits mTOR pathway, dampening Th17 immune cell activity
29492193.conclusion_quote: Overall, our study suggests that targeting the PI3K/mTOR pathway, although it may not be a useful therapeutic approach to promote remyelination in MS patients, it can be exploited to exert immunomodulation, preventing/delaying relapses, and to treat MS patients in order to slow down the progression of disability.
29492193.summary: In an animal model of MS and in lab-grown immune cells, the drug rapamycin, which blocks the mTOR pathway, calmed harmful immune activity but did not help repair myelin.

30206422.mechanism: Blocks TNFR1, reducing immune cell entry into brain
30206422.conclusion_quote: Collectively, we demonstrate the potential for anti-human TNFR1 therapies to effectively modulate immune responses in autoimmune disease.
30206422.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody blocking the TNFR1 receptor after disease onset reduced symptoms and immune cell entry into the brain.

29742431.mechanism: ATF4 loss impairs T-cell metabolism and redox balance
29742431.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrates that ATF4 is critical for CD4 + T cell-mediated immune responses through driving metabolic adaptation.
29742431.summary: Mice lacking the ATF4 gene in CD4 T cells had weaker redox balance, metabolism, and Th1 responses and developed more severe EAE, a mouse model of MS.

30152864.mechanism: Agonist of sphingosine-1 phosphate receptors, raises BDNF
30152864.conclusion_quote: Taken together we did not observe a neuroprotective effect of fingolimod in the subacute MPTP mouse model of PD.
30152864.summary: Mice given the Parkinson's-like toxin MPTP were treated with fingolimod, which did not protect dopamine neurons, though it briefly raised BDNF.

29422534.mechanism: Loss of RFX1 raises IL-17A via epigenetic changes
29422534.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings identify a unique role for RFX1 in Th17-related autoimmune diseases.
29422534.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Rfx1 gene worsened disease and increased harmful Th17 immune cells, suggesting RFX1 restrains these cells.

29942088.mechanism: Stabilizes IL-2 conformation, favoring regulatory T cell expansion
29942088.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that IL-2-F5111.2 may provide an immunotherapy to treat autoimmune diseases and graft-versus-host disease.
29942088.summary: In mice with EAE, a human antibody that locks IL-2 into a shape favoring regulatory T cells reduced disease severity, and it also helped diabetes and graft-versus-host models.

28939414.mechanism: Deletes Sirt7 gene, mild immune and neurogenesis effects
28939414.conclusion_quote: However, overall this epigenetic factor is not capable of impacting the acute or chronic phase of neuroinflammation.
28939414.summary: Mice lacking the Sirt7 gene were given EAE, a mouse model of MS, and showed no change in disease severity but fewer surviving new brain cells in the hippocampus.

30139963.mechanism: Not a treatment, diagnostic substrate cleaved by antibodies
30139963.conclusion_quote: Data presented herein suggest the elaboration of potential specific, rapid, and sensitive diagnostic criteria of active progressive MS.
30139963.summary: In mice with EAE and people with MS, a fluorescent probe cut by patient antibodies could help diagnose active progressive MS.

30006714.conclusion_quote: In this chapter, we will discuss the surgical procedure of injection of lysolecithin into ventral thoraco-lumbar spinal cord white matter of mice, which is particularly suitable for investigating remyelination using transgenic animals.
30006714.summary: This methods chapter describes how injecting lysolecithin into the spinal cord of mice causes demyelination, a model useful for studying how myelin repairs itself.

30171909.mechanism: Exercise raises brain neuroactive steroid levels in a sex-dependent way
30171909.conclusion_quote: Overall, these results indicate that exercise has moderate beneficial effects on brain neuroactive steroid levels in EAE.
30171909.summary: Mice with EAE that voluntarily ran on wheels had altered brain steroid levels, with higher pregnenolone in running females, though some effects depended on sex rather than exercise.

29325992.conclusion_quote: Thus, CARS microscopy is potent tool for quantitative monitoring of myelin degradation in unprecedented spatiotemporal resolution during oligodendrocyte damage.
29325992.summary: In mice given cuprizone, a toxin that strips myelin, imaging showed lipid debris builds up where myelin is thinnest, supporting a way without dyes to track myelin breakdown.

29366861.mechanism: No treatment tested, profiles RNA expression changes
29366861.conclusion_quote: These dysregulated lncRNAs may have function in EAE and they could be novel biomarkers and therapeutic targets of EAE.
29366861.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers mapped thousands of RNA changes in immune T cells, suggesting long noncoding RNAs may drive disease and could serve as biomarkers.

29141529.conclusion_quote: Our results indicated rhMOG1-125 and MOG34-56 could induce successfully EAE models resembling MS in cynomolgus monkeys.
29141529.summary: Researchers immunized cynomolgus monkeys with human MOG protein or a MOG peptide, producing EAE that resembled multiple sclerosis in a primate model.

29626115.mechanism: Ezh2 loss raises Socs3, degrading TRAF6 and dampening inflammatory signaling
29626115.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings establish Ezh2 as a macrophage lineage-specific mediator of autoimmune inflammation and highlight a previously unknown mechanism of Ezh2 function.
29626115.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Ezh2 gene from macrophages and microglia reduced immune cell activation and inflammation by raising levels of the Socs3 protein.

30498033.mechanism: Loss of TNFR2 weakens regulatory T cell suppression
30498033.conclusion_quote: Our findings expose the intrinsic and beneficial effects of TNFR2 signaling in T reg cells that could translate into protective functions in vivo, including treatment of autoimmunity.
30498033.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting TNFR2 only from regulatory T cells worsened disease and weakened control of Th17 immune responses.

30413714.mechanism: Id2 sequesters E2A, lowering Foxp3 expression
30413714.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that controlling Id2 expression may provide a novel approach for effective T reg cell immunotherapies for both autoimmunity and cancer.
30413714.summary: In mice with EAE, raising Id2 in regulatory T cells made them turn into inflammatory Th17 cells, which worsened the disease.

30446383.mechanism: RASA3 loss raises IRF4, reducing pathogenic Th17 cells
30446383.conclusion_quote: Therefore, a RASA3-IRF4-Cbl-b pathway specifically directs pTh17 cell generation by balancing reciprocal Th17-Th2 cell programs.
30446383.summary: In mice with EAE, removing RASA3 from T cells reduced disease by shifting cells away from inflammatory Th17 cells and toward a Th2 pattern.

29531164.mechanism: PD-L1 on dendritic cells limits T cell activation
29531164.conclusion_quote: Our work points to critical roles for PD-L1 expressed on DCs in mediating PD-1 functions.
29531164.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting PD-L1 from dendritic cells worsened disease and increased follicular helper T cell development.
