29727445.mechanism: viral peptide inhibits T-cell activation bypassing TCR complex
29727445.conclusion_quote: Overall, our findings suggest that fusion protein based T-cell modulation may be a common viral trait.
29727445.summary: In mice with a T-cell driven model of MS, a viral fusion peptide from HTLV-1 calmed overactive immune T-cells, eased symptoms, and delayed disease onset.

29485864.mechanism: Inhibits RIP1 kinase to block necroptotic cell death
29485864.conclusion_quote: Oral administration of 22 (10 mg/kg, bid) attenuated disease progression in the mouse experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) model of multiple sclerosis (MS).
29485864.summary: A brain-penetrating pill called compound 22, which blocks the RIP1 kinase enzyme, slowed disease progression in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

29419802.mechanism: Activates AKT and Krox20, promotes Schwann cell differentiation and myelination
29419802.conclusion_quote: These findings reveal novel effects of NTP on SCs differentiation in vitro and in vivo, and indicate NTP as a promising treatment option for peripheral nerve injuries and demyelinating diseases.
29419802.summary: In rats with lysophosphatidylcholine-induced nerve demyelination, Neurotropin given by osmotic pump after injury improved remyelination and nerve function.

29550892.mechanism: blocks Abl kinase activity, reducing CNS inflammation
29550892.conclusion_quote: Here we demonstrate that the non-synonymous SNP does not change Arg's binding affinity for F-actin but suggest a role for Abl kinases in CNS inflammation pathogenesis by showing that pharmacological inhibition of Abl kinases ameliorates EAE, but not experimental arthritis.
29550892.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug blocking Abl kinases reduced disease, while the same treatment did not help arthritis.

29697856.mechanism: Drives neutrophil recruitment into spinal cord, causing demyelination
29697856.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these findings emphasize that CXCL1-mediated attraction of neutrophils into the CNS augments demyelination suggesting that this signaling pathway may offer new targets for therapeutic intervention.
29697856.summary: In mice with EAE, inducing the chemokine CXCL1 in the brain and spinal cord increased neutrophil immune cell entry, worsening disease and myelin damage.

29652922.conclusion_quote: Our current data show that L* binds the ankyrin repeats R1 and R2 of RNase L and inhibits 2'-5' oligoadenylates (2-5A) binding to RNase L.
29652922.summary: This study examines how a Theiler's virus protein blocks an antiviral enzyme pathway in virus-infected cells and mice, and does not study multiple sclerosis or demyelination.

30008424.mechanism: Not applicable, traces cell origin only
30008424.conclusion_quote: Overall, our data demonstrate that a heterogeneous population of astrocytes are derived from NG2 glia in an injury type-dependent manner.
30008424.summary: In mice with EAE and spinal cord injury, genetic labeling tracked NG2 glial cells becoming astrocytes, with the share depending on the type of injury.

29307297.conclusion_quote: Mapping the transcriptome and methylome in T lymphocytes and neurons in females versus males could reveal mechanisms underlying sex differences in autoimmunity and neurodegeneration.
29307297.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers examined how sex chromosomes, separate from sex hormones, may drive male and female differences in immune attacks and nerve damage.

29521254.mechanism: RegRF complement-dependently kills activated MBP-specific lymphocytes
29521254.conclusion_quote: The regRF produced during the immune response is a specific control factor for the expansion of antigen-activated CD4+lymphocytes.
29521254.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a natural antibody called regulatory rheumatoid factor was found to limit the growth of immune T cells triggered by myelin protein.

30049713.mechanism: Blocks CRAF-MAPK signalling in surface prohibitin-expressing Th17 cells
30049713.conclusion_quote: Our observations suggest a pivotal role for the PHB-CRAF-MAPK signalling axis in regulating the polarization and pathogenicity of Th17 cells and unveil druggable targets in autoimmune disorders such as MS.
30049713.summary: In mice with EAE, a vaccine polysaccharide that binds prohibins on Th17 immune cells reduced inflammation and disease severity while increasing protective Treg cells.

29212907.mechanism: Removes EHD recycling regulators, impairing T-cell receptor recycling
29212907.conclusion_quote: Our studies reveal a novel role of the EHD family of endocytic recycling regulatory proteins in TCR-mediated T cell functions.
29212907.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting EHD1, EHD3 and EHD4 from CD4 T cells impaired TCR recycling and reduced disease severity.

30216414.mechanism: neutralises GM-CSF, reducing pro-inflammatory mediator production
30216414.conclusion_quote: These results underscore the critical role of GM-CSF on pro-inflammatory mediator production.
30216414.summary: In mice with relapsing and chronic EAE, an antibody blocking GM-CSF prevented and treated disease, while blocking IL-17 did not stop relapses.

30029164.mechanism: activates NRF2, controlling redox and inflammation
30029164.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates the relevance of the inflammatory response in experimental AD, tightly regulated by NRF2 activity, and provides a new strategy to fight AD.
30029164.summary: In mice with combined Alzheimer-like amyloid and tau pathology, daily dimethyl fumarate reduced inflammation markers and improved memory and movement compared with untreated mice.

28975357.mechanism: Induces regulatory T cells and alternative macrophages
28975357.conclusion_quote: These results enhance our understanding of mechanisms involved in the inhibition of immune responses in the CNS during nematode infection.
28975357.summary: In mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis-like disease, infection with a gut worm reduced symptoms and calmed immune attacks on the brain and spinal cord.

29923617.mechanism: Loss increases M1 macrophages and activated microglia
29923617.conclusion_quote: We propose that CD93 is an important neuro-immune regulator to control central nervous system inflammation.
29923617.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CD93 gene made brain and spinal cord inflammation worse, with more immune cells and more damage to the blood brain barrier.

29518148.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, trapping lymphocytes in lymph nodes
29518148.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that fingolimod could serve as a candidate DMD for managing the disease activity of MS patients with high Sema4A levels.
29518148.summary: Fingolimod reduced relapses and disability worsening in MS patients with high blood Sema4A levels, and improved disease in mice with EAE given Sema4A.

29467767.mechanism: Removing Casz1 reduces Th17 cell differentiation
29467767.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these data identify Casz1 as a new Th plasticity regulator having important clinical implications for autoimmune inflammation and mucosal immunity.
29467767.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Casz1 gene from CD4 T cells lowered disease susceptibility by reducing harmful Th17 inflammatory cells.

29916184.mechanism: Induces regulatory T cells and anti-inflammatory macrophages
29916184.conclusion_quote: These results lend strong support to the conclusion that a three day course of antibiotic treatment given prior to the induction of severe EAE profoundly protected the mice by inducing regulatory lymphocytes in the periphery and an anti-inflammatory milieu in the affected spinal cord tissue.
29916184.summary: In mice with EAE, a three day course of oral antibiotics given before disease induction protected against severe symptoms and increased regulatory immune cells.

29343683.mechanism: Deleting HIF-1α reduces IL-10-producing B cells
29343683.conclusion_quote: Taken together, this study demonstrates the key function of the hypoxia-associated transcription factor HIF-1α in driving IL-10 expression in CD1d hi CD5 + B cells, and in controlling their protective activity in autoimmune disease.
29343683.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the HIF-1α gene from B cells reduced protective IL-10-producing B cells and made the autoimmune disease worse.

29497358.conclusion_quote: Although both DTI and DBSI detected hippocampal injury/inflammation, DTI-FA was less specific than DBSI-derived pathological metrics for hippocampal CA1 dendritic injury and inflammation in TMEV-induced seizure mice.
29497358.summary: In mice with virus-induced seizures, brain imaging methods were compared for detecting hippocampal inflammation and nerve cell branch damage, and one advanced method was more specific.

29718478.mechanism: Developmental chemical exposure alters T cell subsets
29718478.conclusion_quote: These observations suggest that developmental exposure to complex mixtures of water contaminants, such as those derived from UOG operations, could contribute to immune dysregulation and disease later in life.
29718478.summary: In mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS, early life exposure to a mixture of oil and gas chemicals made disease start earlier and worse in females.

28656482.conclusion_quote: It suggests that astrocyte could react strongly to an inflammatory insult inducing neuronal death in the CNS.
28656482.summary: In rats whose mothers had low thyroxine during pregnancy, brain support cells called astrocytes reacted more strongly to inflammation, while microglia reacted less.

28965161.conclusion_quote: Together, our findings suggest that inhibition of NLRP3 inflammasome activation may be a potential therapeutic approach to alleviate MS-associated CNP and disease relapses in patients with RR-MS.
28965161.summary: In mice with relapsing remitting EAE, the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950 given after symptoms began reversed nerve pain and reduced relapse signs such as tail and hindlimb weakness.

29510038.mechanism: Inverse agonist of RORγt blocks IL-17A cytokine expression
29510038.conclusion_quote: Compound 10 was selected as a clinical compound for the treatment of Th17-driven autoimmune diseases.
29510038.summary: An oral drug that blocks an immune switch behind IL-17 inflammation reduced symptoms in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

29397565.mechanism: Binds Olig1 promoter and promotes oligodendrocyte precursor differentiation
29397565.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings demonstrate that Myt1L is an essential regulator of OPC differentiation, thereby supporting Myt1L as a potential therapeutic target for demyelinating diseases.
29397565.summary: In cultured precursor cells and in animals with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, changing Myt1L gene activity affected precursor cell maturation and myelin repair, with higher activity helping repair.

29453977.mechanism: Epigenetic HDAC inhibition reduces neutrophils and PD-L1 cells
29453977.conclusion_quote: Thus, in addition to myelin-specific T cell tolerance induction observed previously, selective repression of mature neutrophils and PD-L1 + cells is critically involved in the epigenetic regulation of P-EAE.
29453977.summary: In mice with progressive EAE, the epigenetic drug Trichostatin A reduced activated neutrophils and PD-L1 positive immune cells, which improved the clinical disease course.

29944018.mechanism: blocks IL-9 receptor, shifts T helper cell balance
29944018.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that administration of rrIL-9 may provide a novel therapeutic strategy against MG or related autoimmune diseases.
29944018.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune myasthenia gravis, a recombinant rat IL-9 treatment reduced disease incidence and severity and lowered harmful antibody levels.

29193274.mechanism: Lowers systemic inflammation markers and restores bone metabolites
29193274.conclusion_quote: Taken together, we suggest that proCT could be used as a diagnostic biomarker in MS patients and that melatonin normalizes bone metabolites in MS.
29193274.summary: In mice with EAE and in MS patients, melatonin reduced disease severity and normalized bone-related markers such as vitamin D and osteocalcin.

29632143.mechanism: Restrains Th17 cells by binding and inhibiting IL-17 promoter
29632143.conclusion_quote: Thus, our study demonstrates the requirement of TCF-1 in vivo at stages earlier than double-positive cells to restrain peripheral Th17 immunity by directly binding and inhibiting IL-17 promoter in its intrinsic histone deacetylase-dependent manner.
29632143.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the TCF-1 gene early in T cell development increased Th17 inflammatory cells and worsened disease by raising IL-17 levels.

29217470.mechanism: Galectin-9 binding suppresses activated T cells
29217470.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that gene therapy using IFN-β-gal-9 fusion proteins is expected to be safe and effective for the treatment of MS.
29217470.summary: In mice with EAE, a gene therapy producing an interferon-beta and galectin-9 fusion protein improved disease without the low blood cell counts seen with standard interferon-beta.

30425261.mechanism: blocks NAADP-evoked calcium release in T lymphocytes
30425261.conclusion_quote: Taken together, data suggest that the NAADP/Ca 2+ signalling mechanism may serve as a potential target for T cell- or cardiomyocyte-related diseases such as multiple sclerosis or arrhythmia.
30425261.summary: In rats with EAE, a small molecule that blocks a calcium signal in T immune cells improved clinical disease.

30014603.conclusion_quote: MOG-specific Abs affinity purified from patients with inflammatory demyelinating disease induce pathological changes in vivo upon cotransfer with myelin-reactive T cells, suggesting that these Abs are similarly pathogenic in patients.
30014603.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, antibodies purified from patients with anti-MOG disease caused myelin damage and immune cell infiltration when transferred alongside myelin-reactive T cells.

29359175.mechanism: Compares tissue dissociation methods for isolating immune cells
29359175.conclusion_quote: Enzymatic dissociation of CNS tissue of C57BL/6 mice with active EAE with the Kit should be the standard method.
29359175.summary: This study compared ways of breaking down brain and spinal cord tissue from mice with EAE to collect immune cells, finding an enzyme kit worked best.

29535709.mechanism: Loss of αv integrins impairs Treg gut accumulation
29535709.conclusion_quote: These observations demonstrate that despite the general upregulation of αv integrins in Treg at sites of inflammation, they are relevant for adequate Treg accumulation only in specific disease settings.
29535709.summary: In mice with EAE, removing αv integrins from regulatory T cells did not change their brain accumulation or recovery, though it reduced their gut accumulation in colitis.

28277099.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that CD169 + cells promote neuroinflammation.
28277099.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing CD169 positive immune cells reduced inflammation and eased disease symptoms.

30265424.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease without treatment
30265424.conclusion_quote: We conclude that MOG, DNA-histone and DNA-met-BSA have different effects on numerous bone marrow, cellular, immunological and biochemical parameters of immunized mice, but all antigens finally significantly stimulate the development of the EAE.
30265424.summary: In mice with EAE, immunization with myelin, DNA histone or DNA methylated albumin complexes changed immune cells and antibodies, and all three ultimately worsened the disease.

30257377.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that IL-1β reduces RCLMC contractility via COX-2/PGE 2 signaling with synergistic cooperation by TNF-α.
30257377.summary: Rat heart lymphatic muscle cells exposed to the inflammatory signal IL1β contracted less through the COX2 and PGE2 pathway, a study of heart inflammation rather than MS.

29593720.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these results indicate that two different markers of TLR2-activity-urinary TLR2-stimulants and serum sTLR2 levels-are significantly elevated in MS patients compared to HC.
29593720.summary: Blood and urine samples from people with multiple sclerosis showed higher levels of a TLR2 immune signal than healthy people, suggesting a possible disease biomarker.

29616029.mechanism: deletion of Ron receptor increases inflammatory macrophage activation
29616029.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results illustrate that activation of Ron in the CNS could be a potential therapeutic approach to treating various grades of CNS inflammation underlying neurodegeneration.
29616029.summary: Mice lacking the Ron receptor had more brain and spinal cord inflammation and worse symptoms in an MS model, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, than normal mice.

30918455.mechanism: prevents ribosomal protein degradation, protecting against neurotoxicity
30918455.conclusion_quote: Kv provides protective roles against CPZ-induced neurotoxicity through prevention of ribosomal protein degradation.
30918455.summary: In rats given cuprizone to mimic MS damage, the plant compound kolaviron improved behavior and protected brain cells in the prefrontal cortex and hippocampus.

29408448.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that DMF could potentially thwart diabetes-induced myocardial tissue injury, likely via activation of Nrf2 function, providing firm impetus for future repurposing of DMF in the management of DCM.
29408448.summary: In type 1 diabetic mice with heart disease, dimethyl fumarate reduced heart oxidative stress, inflammation and scarring, likely by activating Nrf2. No MS model was used.

28911344.conclusion_quote: The method using the chromogenic reagent cuprizone presented the greatest molar absorptivity, followed by bathocuproine and neocuproine.
28911344.summary: This analytical chemistry study compared three spectrophotometric methods for measuring copper in sugar cane spirit. It does not involve multiple sclerosis or any disease model.

29959474.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that expression of IL-17F is associated with non-pathogenic T cells, pointing to a differential function of IL-17A versus IL-17F.
29959474.summary: In mice with EAE, a fluorescent reporter showed that the inflammatory signals IL17A and IL17F come from different immune cells, with IL17F linked to harmless T cells.

29514694.conclusion_quote: The response to IFN-α through STAT proteins signaling is strongly dysregulated in MS patients irrespective of disease stage.
29514694.summary: Immune cells from the blood of people with MS showed stronger STAT and p38MAPK signaling after activation than those from healthy people, and similar patterns appeared in mice with EAE.

30086167.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes immune changes
30086167.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the study indicated that strain differences in immunization-induced changes in thymopoiesis and peripheral CD4+CD28- T-cell generation could contribute to rat strain-specific clinical outcomes of immunization for EAE.
30086167.summary: In rats with EAE, immunization caused thymus shrinkage and immune changes that differed between a susceptible and a resistant strain, shaping how severe the disease became.

30417113.mechanism: Promotes IL-10 regulatory T cells, reducing inflammation
30417113.conclusion_quote: Thus, changes in the spore-forming fraction may influence T lymphocyte-mediated inflammation in MS.
30417113.summary: In mice with EAE, gut spore-forming bacteria from people with or without MS promoted calming immune cells and eased symptoms of the disease.

30297998.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone to strip myelin, researchers found that microglia immune cells respond differently with age and by brain region.

30284949.mechanism: Epigenetic modifiers convert astrocytes into oligodendrocyte lineage cells
30284949.conclusion_quote: These findings seem promising for the application of epigenetic modifiers, especially their targeted delivery to glial scars to treat demyelinating diseases.
30284949.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, human astrocytes treated with epigenetic chemicals turned into myelin-making cell types after transplantation, suggesting a possible repair approach.

29501084.mechanism: Blocks CB1 receptor, increasing TLR-4 and NF-kB signaling in microglia
29501084.conclusion_quote: Our research indicated that inhibition of CB 1 R induced M1 phenotype-Th17 axis changed of microglia/macrophages through TLR-4 and NF-κB/p65 which accelerated the onset and development of EAE.
29501084.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the CB1 receptor with SR141716A made disease start earlier and progress faster, with more inflammatory signals from immune cells in the brain and spinal cord.

30305655.conclusion_quote: This suggests that earlier reports of whole-brain metabolism in anaesthetised animals may be confounded by partial volume effects and not informative enough for translational studies.
30305655.summary: In rats with brain metastases and in pigs, hyperpolarised pyruvate MRI showed that crossing the blood-brain barrier limits brain imaging. This is not an MS study.

29606615.mechanism: Forced transcription factor expression converts neuroblasts into oligodendrocyte
29606615.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight the unexpected plasticity of committed neuroblasts and provide proof of concept that they could be targeted for the treatment of demyelinated lesions in the adult brain.
29606615.summary: In mice with demyelination caused by cuprizone, forcing OLIG2 and SOX10 into brain neuroblasts turned them into myelin-producing cells and improved repair.

29398205.conclusion_quote: We propose that more careful studies of TSPO distribution in neuroinflammation and other stress cascades associated with psychotic symptoms will allow us to understand the biological mechanisms underlying psychosis-related behaviors.
29398205.summary: In mouse models of psychosis with inflammation, maternal immune activation and cuprizone exposure caused different TSPO inflammation signals and stress pathway changes.

29748743.mechanism: activates Keap1/Nrf2 pathway and nuclear Nrf2 translocation
29748743.conclusion_quote: Hence, apo-LF, but not holo-LF, induces the translocation of Nrf2 from cytoplasm to the nucleus, probably due to its capacity to induce EPO synthesis.
29748743.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, recombinant human lactoferrin reduced severe symptoms and activated the protective Nrf2 pathway.

29367251.mechanism: Inhibits MALT1 protease activity, reducing early inflammation and T cell activat
29367251.conclusion_quote: These data emphasize the importance of early inflammation and activation of T cells through MALT1 for controlling the virulence of an attenuated rabies virus in the brain.
29367251.summary: In mice infected with an attenuated rabies virus, lacking MALT1 or blocking it with mepazine made infection in the brain more severe and sometimes fatal.

30231889.conclusion_quote: Our data support ARNT2 as a neuronal transcription factor whose sustained expression is linked to neuronal and axonal health, protection that may primarily be driven through its partnering with Npas4 to influence BDNF expression.
30231889.summary: Researchers found that the neuroprotective protein ARNT2 drops in mice with EAE, an MS model, as disease worsens, and tracks with nerve damage.

29627379.mechanism: Raises p21, promoting cell cycle exit and differentiation
29627379.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that cell cycle regulation may contribute to the differentiation-promoting effect of quetiapine.
29627379.summary: In cultured rat progenitor cells and in mice, the antipsychotic quetiapine helped progenitors mature into myelin-making oligodendrocytes by raising p21, a cell cycle brake.

30185226.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that microbial communities on psoriatic skin is substantially different from those on healthy skin.
30185226.summary: Researchers compared skin bacteria in psoriasis patients with healthy people, and found mice colonized with Staphylococcus aureus developed Th17 inflammation. This paper does not study MS.

29382353.mechanism: reduces macrophage inflammation and monocyte brain infiltration
29382353.conclusion_quote: Administration of laquinimod reduced lesion volume and axonal damage and restored neurogenesis after TBI.
29382353.summary: In mice with traumatic brain injury, the oral drug laquinimod, given before and after injury, reduced inflammation, axonal damage and ventricle enlargement.

29540737.mechanism: Gene removal increases Erk1/2 activity and oligodendrocyte remyelination
29540737.conclusion_quote: Here, we demonstrate that the absence of Gpr17 enhances remyelination in vivo with a toxin-induced model whereby focal demyelinated lesions are generated in spinal cord white matter of adult mice by localized injection of LPC(L-a-lysophosphatidylcholine).
29540737.summary: In mice with spinal cord demyelination, removing the Gpr17 receptor gene enhanced myelin repair, linked to higher Erk1/2 signaling.

29137549.mechanism: Activates S1P receptors, reducing follicle apoptosis
29137549.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that a long-acting oral analogue of S1P might decrease spontaneous follicular apoptosis based on the nonapoptotic primordial follicle ratio and AMH levels when compared with placebo.
29137549.summary: In aging female rats, an oral S1P analogue called fingolimod reduced spontaneous ovarian follicle death and raised AMH levels.

29501770.mechanism: protects myelin sheath and reduces glial activation
29501770.conclusion_quote: Overall, our findings indicate that quercetin could remarkably improve the functional recovery of the optic pathway by its protective effects on myelin sheath and attenuation of glial activation.
29501770.summary: In rats with a chemically induced demyelinating lesion in the optic chiasm, daily oral quercetin sped up visual signals, reduced glial activation, and improved myelin repair.

29357233.mechanism: Nanoparticles improve brain delivery of fumarate drug
29357233.conclusion_quote: These findings provide proof of concept for a biocompatible nanomedicine for MS with tremendous promise for effective brain delivery and patient compliance on the grounds of a reduction in the dosage frequency.
29357233.summary: In rodents with cuprizone-induced demyelination, once-daily nanoparticle-packed dimethyl fumarate improved movement and repaired myelin better than three daily plain doses.

29334034.mechanism: damages sperm plasma and acrosomal membranes
29334034.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrated that sperm membrane destabilization could be a novel strategy in bovine SMGT protocols for the generation of transgenic embryos by ICSI.
29334034.summary: In cattle sperm and embryos, not a multiple sclerosis model, chemicals that weaken sperm membranes improved uptake of foreign DNA and gene expression.

29754485.mechanism: Micronized droplets improve absorption of krill oil omega-3s
29754485.conclusion_quote: On the basis of these findings, the S-SEDDS approach might be an efficacious dosage option to enhance the nutraceutical properties of KO.
29754485.summary: In rats given corn oil to raise blood triglycerides, a specially formulated krill oil was absorbed better and lowered triglycerides more than plain krill oil.

29022246.mechanism: Scavenges reactive oxygen species and reduces apoptosis
29022246.conclusion_quote: We conclude that ALA has protective effects against toxic demyelination via reduction of redox signaling, and alleviation of polydendrocytes vulnerability to excitotoxic challenge.
29022246.summary: In a cuprizone model of demyelination, alpha-lipoic acid reduced oxidative stress and cell death, protected oligodendrocytes, and increased myelin-forming progenitor cells.

30212518.conclusion_quote: Our findings showed the feasibility of reprogramming of astrocytes into oligodendrocyte-like cells in vivo, by using a single transcription factor, Sox10.
30212518.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, a viral vector carrying the Sox10 gene turned brain astrocytes into oligodendrocyte-like cells, suggesting a possible route to myelin repair.

30292054.conclusion_quote: Based on the results of this study, increases in EEG spikes and spike clusters in groups of infected mice may be used as a new readout for studies on antiepileptogenic or disease-modifying drug effects in this model, because the significant increase in average spike counts in mice with late seizures obviously indicates a proepileptogenic alteration.
30292054.summary: Mice infected with Theiler's virus had more brain electrical spikes when they also had late seizures, suggesting spike counts could serve as a readout for epilepsy drug studies.

28394030.conclusion_quote: The geometry of axons affects the MR signal significantly.
28394030.summary: This MRI simulation study found that realistic axon shapes change predicted white matter signals, compared with measured signals from demyelinated mice.

29600597.mechanism: MMP7 protease cleaves fibronectin aggregates impairing remyelination
29600597.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that MMP7 cleaves fibronectin aggregates, while reduced (pro)MMP7 levels in MS lesions contribute to their persistent presence.
29600597.summary: Laboratory study using human MS lesion tissue, cells, and mice with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, finding that the enzyme MMP7 breaks down persistent fibronectin aggregates and is reduced in chronic lesions.

30190412.mechanism: DMT1 iron uptake needed for progenitor maturation
30190412.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that DMT1 is vital for OPC maturation and for the normal myelination of the mouse brain.
30190412.summary: In mice, deleting the iron transporter DMT1 from myelin-making progenitor cells caused less myelin and slower repair after cuprizone-induced demyelination.

29627579.mechanism: activates Hedgehog pathway, increasing proliferation and remyelination
29627579.conclusion_quote: These studies demonstrate that Hedgehog pathway interventions may have therapeutic potential to modulate astrogliosis and to promote remyelination after chronic demyelination.
29627579.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, a drug called SAG injected into the brain after chronic damage increased cell growth and improved myelin repair.

30114292.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease biomarkers only
30114292.conclusion_quote: Pathology-based multi-omics identified four CSF markers that were differentially expressed in MS subtypes.
30114292.summary: Researchers compared MS brain lesion gene activity with mice fed cuprizone, then measured matching proteins in spinal fluid and found four markers differing between MS subtypes.

29416501.mechanism: lentivirus knockdown lowers Bcl11b, boosting oligodendrocyte maturation
29416501.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results provide insight into the functional role of Bcl11b in the negative regulation of GPC differentiation through the repression of OLG differentiation-associated genes.
29416501.summary: In mice with lysolecithin injury to myelin, knocking down Bcl11b in progenitor cells produced more myelin-making cells at the lesion, supporting repair.

30205359.conclusion_quote: Thus, there is age-dependent acquired NPC dysfunction, with loss of immune-modulatory and neurotrophic properties, which is induced by the pathological Alzheimer's brain environment at a critical time point before neurodegeneration.
30205359.summary: In Alzheimer's mice (5xFAD), brain stem cells that normally protect tissue lost their supportive and immune-calming abilities by seven months of age, before major nerve cell loss.

30043541.mechanism: improves nutrient digestion and intestinal morphology in broilers
30043541.conclusion_quote: It was concluded that a reduced-energy diet impaired bird performance, while dietary supplementation of LPL and xylanase to reduced-energy diets positively affected productive performance, nutrient utilization, intestinal morphology and abdominal fat percentage.
30043541.summary: In broiler chickens, adding lysophospholipids or xylanase to low-energy feed improved growth and nutrient digestion. The study does not involve multiple sclerosis or any MS model.

29045809.mechanism: Not applicable: lineage tracing of Shh-responsive cells
29045809.conclusion_quote: These studies reveal a postnatal cell population with transient Shh signaling that contributes to oligodendrogenesis during CC myelination, and gives rise to cells that continue to proliferate in adulthood and contribute to CC remyelination.
29045809.summary: In mice, cells that responded to the Shh signal after birth were tagged and shown to produce myelin-forming cells, including cells that contribute to repair after cuprizone-induced demyelination.

29593734.mechanism: Absence of miR-146a reduces inflammation and demyelination
29593734.conclusion_quote: During demyelination, absence of miR-146a reduced inflammatory responses, demyelination, axonal loss, the number of infiltrating macrophages, and increased the number of myelinating oligodendrocytes.
29593734.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone to strip myelin, those lacking the microRNA miR-146a had less nerve damage, less myelin loss, and fewer inflammatory cells than normal mice.

29058769.conclusion_quote: These models enable the study of cellular and humoral autoimmunity against major antigenic epitopes of the myelin basic protein, myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein, or proteolipid protein.
29058769.summary: This protocol describes how to induce a multiple sclerosis-like disease, called EAE, in Lewis rats and how to score its severity.

29153612.mechanism: Dampens immune cell proliferation and cytokines, boosts Fas-induced apoptosis
29153612.conclusion_quote: We conclude that fluoxetine possesses immune-modulating effects resulting in the amelioration of symptoms in EAE.
29153612.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the antidepressant fluoxetine delayed disease onset and reduced paralysis, including in mice with established disease, by calming immune responses.

27832402.conclusion_quote: Using flow cytometric analyses of central nervous system-derived lymphocytes we found that only antigen-specific, formerly naive T helper cells became activated during inflammation of the central nervous system encountering their corresponding antigen.
27832402.summary: In an animal model of MS (EAE), naive helper T cells entered the inflamed central nervous system, but only those recognizing the target antigen became activated.

28356385.mechanism: Knockout reduces Th17 cell differentiation and CNS inflammation
28356385.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our results identify RGC-32 as a novel regulator of Th17 cell differentiation in vitro and in vivo and suggest that RGC-32 is a potential therapeutic target in multiple sclerosis and other Th17-mediated autoimmune diseases.
28356385.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the RGC-32 gene reduced immune cells that drive inflammation in the brain and spinal cord, which lessened disease severity.

28686480.mechanism: Suppresses effector memory T cells and expands Tregs
28686480.conclusion_quote: In essence, these findings implicate that CaeA may be considered as a potent future immunosuppressive drug.
28686480.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug caerulomycin A reduced disease symptoms by lowering harmful T cells and increasing regulatory T cells.

28139754.mechanism: Cuts oxidative stress, boosts SIRT1 mitochondrial function
28139754.conclusion_quote: Intranasal delivery of neuroprotective ST266 is a potential novel, noninvasive therapeutic modality for the eyes, optic nerves and brain.
28139754.summary: In mice with EAE, intranasal ST266, a secretome from amnion cells, reduced optic nerve inflammation, preserved vision and protected retinal nerve cells.

28992973.mechanism: blocks activated factor X, reducing immune cell infiltration
28992973.conclusion_quote: Our study identifies FX as a possible target in neuroinflammatory diseases.
28992973.summary: Rats with EAE given rivaroxaban, a drug that blocks a blood-clotting factor, developed less severe disease with fewer immune cells entering the brain and spinal cord.

28367355.mechanism: Raises TGF-β and expands regulatory T cells
28367355.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that oral GTB may be considered as a possible therapy for MS patients.
28367355.summary: Mice with experimental allergic encephalomyelitis, a model of MS, were fed glyceryl tribenzoate, which reduced symptoms, inflammation, and nerve damage by boosting TGF-β and regulatory T cells.

28836302.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease model only
28836302.conclusion_quote: This study underpins the significance of brain-intrinsic degenerative cascades for immune cell recruitment and, in consequence, MS lesion formation.
28836302.summary: In mice with cuprizone and EAE, combined toxic and immune injury produced inflammatory brain lesions resembling MS, with some forebrain lesions repairing spontaneously over time.

28186117.mechanism: Reduces inflammatory infiltration and replaces degenerated neural cells
28186117.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that PMSCs may replace EMSCs as a source of cells in MS stem cell therapy.
28186117.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, transplanted placental stem cells reduced inflammation, protected nerve fibres, and improved neurological function, much like embryonic stem cells did.

29034884.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes iPSC line generation
29034884.conclusion_quote: These lines offer a good tool to study MS pathomechanisms and for drug testing.
29034884.summary: Researchers made six stem cell lines from people with multiple sclerosis, carrying two TNFRSF1A gene variants, to study the disease and test drugs later.

28271325.mechanism: Boosts regulatory T cells and suppresses Th17 cells
28271325.conclusion_quote: Together, these results suggest that nebulization of RNS60 may be used to control aberrant immune responses in MS and other autoimmune disorders.
28271325.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, inhaled RNS60 saline reduced symptoms, inflammation and demyelination and increased calming regulatory T cells.

28776347.mechanism: Inactivates inflammatory cells, reducing inflammation and demyelination
28776347.conclusion_quote: Our results revealed that oral-formulated tacrolimus inhibited the autoimmunization in MS pathogenesis by inactivating inflammatory cells.
28776347.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, oral tacrolimus lowered symptom scores and reduced spinal cord demyelination and inflammation, with higher doses working best.

29155752.conclusion_quote: We show how these gait parameters can be used to quantify impaired movements of the hip, knee, and ankle joints in EAE.
29155752.summary: Methods study measuring walking in mice with EAE, a model of MS, using treadmill motion tracking of hip, knee, and ankle joints.

28736194.mechanism: Histone deacetylase blockade induces T cell tolerance
28736194.conclusion_quote: These data indicate that epigenetic modifications induced by histone hyperacetylation facilitates T cell tolerance induction in the periphery leading to reduced migration of T cells to the spinal cord and mitigation of neuronal damage and improved clinical outcome.
28736194.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug Trichostatin A protected against disease by promoting tolerance in myelin-targeting T cells and reducing their entry into the spinal cord.

28405624.mechanism: GM-CSF and IL-17 drive brain neutrophil influx
28405624.conclusion_quote: These results identify a GM-CSF/IL-17/IFN-γ axis that regulates inflammation in the central nervous system and suggest that a combination of cytokine-neutralizing therapies may be needed to dampen central nervous system autoimmunity.
28405624.summary: In mice with EAE, removing GM-CSF did not prevent spinal cord disease, but GM-CSF together with IL-17 was needed for inflammation that targeted the brain.

28726401.mechanism: Selective agonist activates CB2 receptor, calming immune attack
28726401.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, 57 significantly alleviated the clinical symptoms and protected the murine central nervous system from immune damage in an experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) mouse model of multiple sclerosis.
28726401.summary: A new selective CB2 receptor activator, compound 57, eased symptoms and protected the central nervous system from immune damage in mice with EAE.

29088843.mechanism: Inhibits dendritic cell activation and NF-κB p65 phosphorylation
29088843.conclusion_quote: These data strongly suggested that immethridine could inhibit the function of DCs and indicated the therapeutic potential on EAE.
29088843.summary: Immethridine, a histamine H3 receptor agonist, was tested in mice with EAE and reduced disease by dampening dendritic cell function.

28581731.mechanism: blocks activation of myelin-destroying immune cells
28581731.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that the BPI peptides were highly active at suppressing EAE when conjugated to the large Fc scaffold in this manner.
28581731.summary: Researchers attached immune blocking peptides to an antibody fragment and found the combined treatment reduced symptoms and myelin damage in mice with EAE.

28629631.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, early demyelination in the optic nerve was moderately reduced by 10days treatment with a low dose probenecid.
28629631.summary: In mice fed a cuprizone diet to damage myelin, the drug probenecid reduced early demyelination in the optic nerve when given for 10 days.

28443093.conclusion_quote: Using T cells as an example, we demonstrate the suitability of this novel methodology in imaging the post-arrest multistep T-cell extravasation across the cervical spinal cord microvessels.
28443093.summary: Researchers developed a new method to film immune T cells crossing blood vessels in the neck region of the spinal cord in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

28392360.mechanism: Stimulates glial cells to produce neurotrophin 3
28392360.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that MAT therapy for EAE acts, at least in part, by stimulating local production of NT3 by glial cells in the CNS, which protects neural cells from CNS inflammation-induced tissue damage.
28392360.summary: Matrine, a plant-derived compound, boosted production of the protective protein NT3 in glial cells of mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis.

28030334.mechanism: parasite products reduce Th1 and Th17 responses
28030334.conclusion_quote: Thus, parenteral administration of T. suis-derived products results in a skewing of the immune response with a significant impact on disease severity in a CNS inflammatory disease model.
28030334.summary: In an animal model of MS called EAE, injecting Trichuris suis parasite products before disease onset reduced disease severity and lowered inflammatory immune cell responses in the spinal cord and spleen.

29222419.mechanism: Inhibits pannexin channels, reducing ATP release and inflammasome activity
29222419.conclusion_quote: The beneficial and therapeutic effects of PBN in the context of EAE demonstrate an intriguing link between PBN and neuroinflammation, which might foster translational interest.
29222419.summary: Probenecid was given to mice with already symptomatic EAE, a model of MS, and it prolonged survival, slowed symptom worsening, and reduced spinal cord inflammation and oligodendrocyte loss.

28361437.mechanism: blocks lymphocyte trafficking and reduces microglia activation
28361437.conclusion_quote: Preventive treatment with fingolimod suppressed clinical symptoms and neuroinflammation in the brainstem.
28361437.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, fingolimod given before or after disease onset reduced brain inflammation and symptoms, but symptoms returned after stopping treatment.

28762472.mechanism: Notch1 loss reduces Th1 and Th17 T-cell priming
28762472.conclusion_quote: In summary, our results reveal a key role of the Notch1 receptor in myeloid cells for the initiation and progression of EAE.
28762472.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Notch1 from myeloid immune cells reduced spinal cord damage, inflammation, and harmful Th1 and Th17 T-cell activation.

28739526.conclusion_quote: Thus, stress may synergistically exacerbate severity of EAE by altering epigenetic regulatory pathways.
28739526.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, chronic stress worsened symptoms and changed microRNA levels in the spinal cord, suggesting stress may increase disease severity.

28216651.mechanism: Gαq loss lowers IL-6 and Th17 cells
28216651.conclusion_quote: In summary, our data highlighted the critical role of Gαq in regulating Th17 differentiation and MS pathogenesis.
28216651.summary: Mice without the Gαq gene had milder EAE, a mouse model of MS, with fewer Th17 immune cells, less immune cell infiltration and less nerve damage.

interventions: a novel humanized CCR2 targeting antibody
28386765.mechanism: depletes CCR2+ monocytes, reducing cortical demyelination
28386765.conclusion_quote: We conclude that biologics depleting CCR2 + monocytes might be attractive candidates for preventing cortical lesion formation and ameliorating disease progression in MS.
28386765.summary: Researchers depleted CCR2-positive monocytes with an antibody in marmosets with EAE, which reduced cortical demyelination and disease severity.

27704281.mechanism: Loss of miR-223 boosts MDSC numbers and suppression
27704281.conclusion_quote: These results support a critical role for miR-223 in modulating MDSC biology in EAE and in MS and suggest potential novel therapeutic applications.
27704281.summary: In mice with EAE, knocking out the miR-223 gene caused milder disease and more myeloid-derived suppressor cells that calm the immune system.

27974153.mechanism: Absence of TnC reduces Th1 and Th17 encephalitogenic responses
27974153.conclusion_quote: These results show that TnC is important for the pathogenesis of CNS autoimmunity and that its deficiency interferes with Th1 and Th17 encephalitogenic potentials.
27974153.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, removing the tenascin C gene eased disease and weakened immune cells that drive inflammation.

27847283.mechanism: Inhibits microglial activation in the dentate gyrus
27847283.conclusion_quote: We conclude that early memory impairment in EAE is due to a selective disruption of the dentate gyrus associated with microglia activation.
27847283.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking microglia with minocycline prevented memory problems and brain changes in the dentate gyrus, a region involved in memory.

28038358.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings help to elucidate the mechanisms of IL-22 in MS development.
28038358.summary: In people with MS and in mice with EAE, IL-22 was found to increase Fas and cell death in oligodendrocytes and reduce protective FOXP3 regulatory T cells through NF-κB signaling.

28576706.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte precursor differentiation into mature myelin-making cel
28576706.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate strong remyelination-promoting capabilities of rHIgM22 and further support its therapeutic potential in MS.
28576706.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced brain demyelination, the human antibody rHIgM22 sped up myelin repair and helped precursor cells mature into myelin-producing oligodendrocytes.

28284334.mechanism: Reduces immune cell infiltration and oxidative stress
28284334.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results indicate that the inflammatory response generated in EAE is distinct between the sexes and its modulation by daily exercise can have sex-specific effects on disease-related outcomes.
28284334.summary: Mice with EAE given daily access to running wheels improved clinically only if male, while females showed little benefit, with sex differences in inflammation and nerve damage.

28607752.mechanism: antagonizes dopamine and serotonin receptors, reducing CNS immune cell infiltrat
28607752.conclusion_quote: These studies indicate that clozapine is an effective immunomodulatory agent with the potential to treat immune-mediated diseases such as MS.
28607752.summary: In mice with EAE, an animal model of MS, the antipsychotic clozapine reduced disease severity, and combining it with glatiramer acetate gave more protection than either drug alone.

28768912.conclusion_quote: Taken together, single-cell GPCR expression analysis identifies functionally relevant subpopulations with specific GPCR repertoires and provides a basis for the development of new therapeutic strategies in immune disorders.
28768912.summary: Researchers measured receptor gene activity in single immune and blood vessel cells from mice with EAE, finding distinct cell subgroups with specific receptor patterns linked to inflammation.

28186720.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that cuprizone induces global perturbations in cellular metabolism that may be independent of its copper chelating ability and potentially related to its interactions with pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, a coenzyme essential for amino acid metabolism.
28186720.summary: Researchers gave mice and brain cells the toxin cuprizone and found it disrupted metabolism, possibly by a route separate from blocking copper.

28466255.mechanism: Removing FPR1 reduces microglia activation and inflammatory cytokines
28466255.conclusion_quote: Combined together, these results suggest that the FPR1 is an important part of the innate immune response in the course of cuprizone-induced demyelination.
28466255.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, genetically removing the FPR1 receptor reduced glial cell activation and slightly lessened myelin loss.

29363907.mechanism: activates Nrf2 pathway, raising antioxidant enzyme heme oxygenase-1
29363907.conclusion_quote: This indicates that the regulation of the Nrf2-dependent antioxidant pathway by DMF occurs at a certain time interval (early EAE/MS) and strongly underlines the importance of the earliest introduction of the therapy to the patient.
29363907.summary: In rats with EAE, dimethyl fumarate raised the antioxidant enzyme heme oxygenase-1 only at early symptom onset, not at the peak or during recovery.

28634006.mechanism: Lowers Th1 and Th17 differentiation, worsens neuron death
28634006.conclusion_quote: Thus, through the alleviation of inflammatory processes and the exacerbation of neurodegenerative processes, androgens may contribute to the epidemiologic sex differentials observed in MS prevalence and course.
28634006.summary: In mice with EAE, testosterone eased early inflammation but worsened later nerve damage, and in human neurons it increased cell death under stress.

28701795.mechanism: Not a treatment, terahertz spectroscopy detects myelin deficit
28701795.conclusion_quote: The results well matched the pathological analysis, indicating that PCA-tdTHz is a quick, powerful, evolving tool for identification and evaluation myelin deficit in preclinical animals and potentially in para-clinical human biopsy.
28701795.summary: In mice with dysmyelination and monkeys with EAE, a terahertz light scanning method detected and graded myelin loss without labels or special tissue preparation.

28235673.mechanism: Tightens blood-brain barrier, limiting T-cell invasion
28235673.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate that laquinimod exerts its therapeutic effects by tightening the BBB and limiting parenchymal invasion of effector T cells, thereby reducing CNS damage.
28235673.summary: In mice with EAE and in human brain cell tests, laquinimod reduced harmful T cells entering the brain by tightening the blood-brain barrier.

28417055.mechanism: inhibits GSK-3β, reducing microglia activation and inflammation
28417055.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that lithium ameliorates clinical symptom of acute monophasic rat EAE, and GSK-3 is a target for the suppression of acute neuroinflammation as far as rat model of human CNS disease is involved.
28417055.summary: In rats with acute EAE, a model of MS, lithium inhibited GSK-3β, which delayed paralysis onset, reduced its severity, and calmed inflammation in the spinal cord.

28057537.mechanism: inhibits NKCC1 chloride co-transporter in neurons
28057537.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that mechanical hypersensitivity in EAE is not mediated by altered levels of NKCC1.
28057537.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, blocking the NKCC1 chloride transporter with bumetanide did not relieve mechanical pain sensitivity, though it corrected transporter levels.

28653829.mechanism: inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome and IL-1β release
28653829.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results suggest that JC-171 is a selective NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitor with biological activity in vivo, thus strongly encouraging further development of this lead compound as a potential therapeutic agent for human MS.
28653829.summary: In mice with EAE, a new experimental drug that blocks the NLRP3 inflammasome delayed disease and reduced severity when given before or after symptoms began.

28663721.conclusion_quote: Our data provide a novel perspective on the presence of GFAP in blood as it identifies exosomes as potential astrocyte-derived signals within blood.
28663721.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found more exosomes carrying the astrocyte protein GFAP in blood than in control mice.

28793252.mechanism: Reduces Th1/Th17 cells, boosts regulatory T cells
28793252.conclusion_quote: Our study provides evidence that the administration of gut commensals may regulate a systemic immune response and may, therefore, have a possible role in treatment strategies for MS.
28793252.summary: In mice with EAE, a human gut bacterium called Prevotella histicola reduced inflammatory immune cells and increased calming regulatory T cells, suppressing disease.

29051763.mechanism: Blocks Th17/Th1 expansion, boosts Tregs and Bregs
29051763.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these results suggest that IL-12p35 can be exploited as a novel biologic for treating central nervous system autoimmune diseases and offers the promise of ex vivo production of large amounts of Tregs and Bregs for immunotherapy.
29051763.summary: In mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS, the IL-12p35 protein reduced harmful immune cells entering the brain and spinal cord and eased disease.

28840346.mechanism: No treatment tested, imaging and vision measures only
28840346.conclusion_quote: DTI measures FA and RD are associated to VEP latency in early stages of EAE but associated to VEP amplitude in later stages, suggesting that the patterns of DTI related to the functional decline may depend on the stage of disease progression.
28840346.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers compared brain imaging of the optic nerve with vision tests and found links that change as the disease progresses.

28257578.mechanism: Expresses interferon-beta, lowers interferon-gamma from T cells
28257578.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that IFN-β transgene expression by single administration of the pMx-IFN-β can be an effective long-term treatment for MS.
28257578.summary: Mice with EAE given a single injection of a plasmid carrying the interferon-beta gene had milder symptoms for a month and less brain barrier leakage.

28756481.mechanism: Not applicable, structural study of peptide conformation
28756481.conclusion_quote: The results indicate that the side chains of mutated amino acids in the cyclic analogue have different spatial orientation compared with the corresponding side chains of the linear analogue, which can lead to reduced affinity to TCR.
28756481.summary: Researchers used NMR and computer simulations to study how modified versions of a myelin peptide fold in solution, without testing animals or human cells.

34541112.conclusion_quote: Here we describe protocols for passive transfer model of EAE using freshly isolated (MOG)-specific CD4 + T cells or periodically restimulated MOG-specific CD4 + T cell lines, which are suitable for tracking pathogenic CD4 + T cells in vivo , particularly in the CNS ( Ogura et al. , 2008 ; Arima et al. , 2012 and 2015b).
34541112.summary: This protocol paper describes how to induce EAE in mice by transferring myelin-specific immune T cells, allowing researchers to track disease-causing cells in the nervous system.

27959414.conclusion_quote: Results from the present study indicate that IL‑17 may contribute to neuropathic pain by promoting the proliferation of astrocytes and secretion of proinflammatory cytokines in spinal nerve ligation‑induced neuropathic pain.
27959414.summary: In rats with nerve-injury pain, researchers found that the immune signal interleukin 17 rose in the spinal cord and may drive pain by boosting astrocyte growth and inflammatory chemical release.

28844788.mechanism: Not applicable, describes inflammation patterns only
28844788.conclusion_quote: These results reinforce a significant role for the meninges in the development and propagation of central nervous system inflammation associated with MS and EAE.
28844788.summary: In mice with EAE, immune cell inflammation began in the membranes covering the spinal cord and then spread into the underlying nerve tissue, moving from tail end toward the head.

28177496.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our data suggest that synaptophysin as a reliable marker of axonal damage in the CNS in inflammatory/demyelinating conditions.
28177496.summary: In mice fed cuprizone or infected with a virus, and in MS patient tissue, synaptophysin built up in damaged nerve fibers, suggesting it is a reliable marker of axonal damage.

28757328.mechanism: Blocking IFN-γ restores CB1 receptor function in striatum
28757328.conclusion_quote: Overall these results indicate that IFN-γ exerts a relevant control on mood, through the modulation of CB1R function.
28757328.summary: In mice, injecting IFN-γ into the brain caused anxiety- and depression-like behavior, while blocking IFN-γ in mice with EAE restored cannabinoid receptor function in the striatum.

28338530.mechanism: tracer binds P2X7 receptor to image neuroinflammation
28338530.conclusion_quote: We conclude that [C]GSK1482160 has the potential for application in monitoring neuroinflammation.
28338530.summary: A radioactive tracer that binds the P2X7 inflammation marker showed higher signal in rats with EAE, an MS model, at peak disease.

28578388.mechanism: Blocks CLEC12A, reducing myeloid cell entry into CNS
28578388.conclusion_quote: These studies reveal the utility of a DC-specific mechanism in designing new therapeutics for MS.
28578388.summary: In mice with EAE, a blocking antibody against CLEC12A delayed disease onset, reduced severity, and limited immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord.

28687602.mechanism: PET tracer binds CD20 on B cells
28687602.conclusion_quote: B cells can be detected in the CNS of EAE mice using 64 Cu-rituximab PET.
28687602.summary: In mice with EAE, a radiolabeled rituximab scan detected B cells in the brain and spinal cord, with higher signal than controls.

28130201.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes expression changes
28130201.conclusion_quote: The results provide evidence that the involvement of mitochondrial UCP2 in CNS inflammation during EAE may be mainly explained by the invasion of activated T-lymphocytes.
28130201.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the mitochondrial protein UCP2 rises in the spinal cord as immune T cells invade, but not in the brain.

28112256.mechanism: Shifts microglia to repair, boosts neurotrophic factors
28112256.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings demonstrate that FSD-C10 promotes neural repair through mechanisms that involved both immunomodulation and induction of neurotrophic factors.
28112256.summary: In mice with EAE and in brain slice cultures, the drug FSD-C10 protected nerves, calmed immune attacks, and helped myelin repair via neurotrophic factors.

28617951.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes IGF-I pathway expression changes
28617951.conclusion_quote: We therefore suggest that the altered expression of the IGF-I system including GSK3β in spinal cord neurons might involve in pathophysiological events during the EAE.
28617951.summary: In mice with EAE, spinal cord neurons changed how they produce IGF-I, its binding protein, and GSK3β, which may contribute to disease processes.

27883356.conclusion_quote: The BMPS provides a suitable and reliable model to investigate neuron-neuroglia function as well as pathogenic mechanisms in neurotoxicology.
27883356.summary: Researchers grew a 3D human brain model from stem cells that formed mature neurons, support cells and myelin over eight weeks, offering a tool for studying MS.

28992974.mechanism: Reduces inflammatory cell infiltration and TSPO levels in CNS
28992974.conclusion_quote: The results indicate that Diazepam exerts protective effects on EAE development, decreasing the incidence of the disease and reducing the number of inflammatory cells in CNS, with a concomitant decrease of TSPO levels in brain tissue and CNS inflammatory CD11b + cells.
28992974.summary: In rats with EAE, the anti-anxiety drug diazepam reduced disease incidence and the number of inflammatory immune cells in the central nervous system.

29132838.mechanism: reduces microglia and macrophage activation and blocks Th1/Th17 cell differentia
29132838.conclusion_quote: Therefore, we suggested that diosgenin may be a potential therapeutic drug for inflammatory demyelinating diseases, such as MS.
29132838.summary: In EAE, an animal model of MS, diosgenin, a plant steroid, reduced inflammation and demyelination and slowed disease progression.

28560740.mechanism: Describes remyelination and axon damage timing
28560740.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that remyelination may not only be protective over a long period of time, but may play an important role in the immediate axonal recuperation after a demyelinating insult.
28560740.summary: In mice given cuprizone or lysolecithin to damage myelin, and in human MS lesions, damaged axons were found being remyelinated early, suggesting repair helps nerves recover quickly.

28238951.mechanism: Antioxidant radical reducing oxidative stress and immune activation
28238951.conclusion_quote: The ability of oral TEMPOL to reduce inflammation and axonal damage and loss demonstrate both anti-inflammatory and protective properties, with significant promise for the treatment of MS and related neurological disorders.
28238951.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, oral TEMPOL delayed and reduced disease, calmed inflammation and protected nerve fibers, whether given before or after symptoms began.

28739922.mechanism: Mechanism not identified, suppresses autoimmune disease
28739922.conclusion_quote: Thus, salates may be useful in stopping the progression of MS, and may provide new insight into mechanisms of controlling autoimmune disease.
28739922.summary: In mice with EAE, the sunscreen ingredients homosalate and octisalate reduced disease, suggesting salates might help slow multiple sclerosis progression.

27781303.conclusion_quote: Although the inflammatory environment in the brain of EAE mice enhances the proliferation of hippocampal NPCs, in the long term neurogenesis is progressively depleted, giving prominence to gliogenesis.
27781303.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, brain inflammation first boosted new brain cell production in the hippocampus but later depleted neurogenesis, favoring support cells called astrocytes.

28760957.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our results demonstrate a potential for 13 C MRSI of HP [1- 13 C]pyruvate as a neuroimaging method for assessment of inflammatory lesions.
28760957.summary: In cuprizone-fed mice modeling multiple sclerosis, a hyperpolarized carbon 13 pyruvate scan detected inflammatory lesions by tracking increased lactate production from activated immune cells.

29403442.mechanism: reduces IL-6 and Th17 cell differentiation
29403442.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that LH2171 might down-regulate IL-6 production and the subsequent Th17 differentiation and spinal cord infiltration, consequently alleviating EAE symptoms.
29403442.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the probiotic Lactobacillus helveticus SBT2171 reduced disease severity by lowering harmful Th17 immune cells and interleukin 6.

28124770.mechanism: Tests whether injection procedure alters demyelination and remyelination.
28124770.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that a local stereotactic injection has no major impact on CNS demyelination and remyelination.
28124770.summary: In the cuprizone model of demyelination, a local stereotactic injection briefly opened the blood-brain barrier but did not change myelin loss or repair.

28830377.mechanism: pre-induction treadmill exercise alters gait and mechanical allodynia
28830377.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that Catwalk system is a useful tool to investigate subtle motor impairment and mechanical allodynia at chronic time points of the EAE model, improving the functional investigation of gait abnormalities and demyelination sequelae.
28830377.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers used a walking analysis system to detect subtle gait changes and pain sensitivity, finding that prior exercise did not fully prevent these problems.

28421248.mechanism: Not applicable, describes cell migration to lymph nodes
28421248.conclusion_quote: Our data supports the hypothesis that brain-resident antigen presenting cells (APC) are capable of migrating to CNS-draining LNs to present myelin-associated epitopes.
28421248.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers traced brain immune cells that appear to travel to nearby lymph nodes, where they may present myelin targets.

29163172.mechanism: Inhibits TAK1, cutting cytokines and activated microglia
29163172.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that TAK1 inhibition may provide a potent approach toward treating autoimmune demyelinating diseases.
29163172.summary: In mice with EAE, the TAK1 inhibitor 5Z-7-oxozeaenol given after symptoms began eased disease, lowered inflammatory chemicals, and reduced activated microglia.

28028151.mechanism: Blocks DOCK8-Cdc42 activation and T cell migration
28028151.conclusion_quote: Together, our study demonstrates LRCH1 as a novel effector to restrain PKCα-DOCK8-Cdc42 module-induced T cell migration and ameliorate EAE.
28028151.summary: In mice with EAE, a protein called LRCH1 blocked immune cell movement into the nervous system, and mice lacking it had worse disease.

28356108.mechanism: Protects EAE without directly altering CD4 T cells
28356108.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our studies indicate that clozapine does not mediate its protective effects by directly altering CD4 T cells.
28356108.summary: In mice with EAE, the antipsychotic clozapine was found to reduce disease without directly changing CD4 immune cells, though it increased regulatory T cells.

29150266.mechanism: proposed anti-inflammatory and remyelinating effects of gene-modified stem cells
29150266.conclusion_quote: It is expected that Interleukine-35 and Hepatocyte Growth Factor genes expressed from MSCs could effectively perform in immunotherapy of Multiple Sclerosis.
29150266.summary: This hypothesis paper proposes, without testing, delivering IL-35 and HGF genes into stem cells to treat multiple sclerosis in EAE mice.

29107957.mechanism: restores mitochondrial ATP production via GOT2
29107957.conclusion_quote: GOT2-mediated ATP synthesis may be a pivotal mechanism underlying the protective effect of febuxostat against neurodegeneration in EAE.
29107957.summary: In mice with secondary progressive EAE, the drug febuxostat protected nerve cells by restoring cell energy production through the GOT2 enzyme.

28830026.mechanism: Shifts microglia to M2 and suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome
28830026.conclusion_quote: In summary, we reported for the first time that PRO therapy causes polarization of M2 microglia, attenuation of M1 phenotype, and suppression of NLRP3 inflammasome in a CPZ-induced demyelination model of MS.
28830026.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, progesterone treatment reduced inflammatory microglia, increased healing-associated microglia, and improved behavior and myelin damage.

28939293.mechanism: Reduces oxidative stress and gut bacteria LPS markers
28939293.conclusion_quote: In conclusion the data show the ability of SAC to modify EAE evolution.
28939293.summary: In mice with EAE, the garlic compound SAC reduced oxidative damage, inflammation and gut bacteria marker LPS, outperforming NAC.

28341037.mechanism: blocks CCR5 receptor reducing T cell entry
28341037.conclusion_quote: Our study provided the evidence that the prior influenza virus infection may promote the type I T cells infiltration into the CNS, and subsequently cause a long-term exacerbation of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
28341037.summary: In mice with EAE, prior influenza infection increased harmful T cells entering the brain and spinal cord, and blocking the CCR5 receptor reduced the worsened disease.

28741149.mechanism: adds peripheral IL-6 that may trigger seizures
28741149.conclusion_quote: We found that pathologic levels of IL-6 in the periphery may play a role in the development of seizures when viral replication within the brain is limited.
28741149.summary: In mice infected with a brain virus, higher levels of interleukin-6 in the blood appeared to contribute to seizures, mainly when the virus did not spread within the brain.

27707650.mechanism: removes dendritic cells during priming, cutting Treg induction
27707650.conclusion_quote: DCs facilitate iTreg induction by creating a milieu with high levels of interleukin (IL)-2 due to a strong proliferative response.
27707650.summary: In mice with EAE, removing dendritic cells during early immune priming blocked regulatory T cell formation and led to severe, unchecked autoimmune attack.

28228555.mechanism: suppresses Th17 differentiation by targeting OGT
28228555.conclusion_quote: These results contribute to the importance of miR-15b in Th17 differentiation and the pathogenesis of MS.
28228555.summary: In mice with EAE, boosting the microRNA miR-15b reduced disease and Th17 immune cells, while blocking it made disease worse.

28840755.mechanism: Toxin causes demyelination when given by gavage
28840755.conclusion_quote: This alternative cuprizone dosing regime minimizes the interanimal variability on demyelination and hence provides a consistent model for pharmacological evaluations, in addition to reducing the number of animals used in the experiments.
28840755.summary: Researchers developed a mouse model where the toxin cuprizone is given by stomach tube, producing consistent demyelination and quick remyelination, reducing variation between animals.

29045782.mechanism: Noncovalently inhibits peptidyl arginine deiminase (PAD) enzymes
29045782.conclusion_quote: This novel series of compounds show promise for further development as disease modifying agents for the potential treatment of MS.
29045782.summary: In mice with EAE, a small molecule that blocks PAD enzymes reduced physical disability and cleared T cells from the brain, suggesting possible future MS treatment.

28670480.mechanism: Alters gut microbiota and increases Th17 cells
28670480.conclusion_quote: These results uncovered a deleterious role of decaffeinated HSCBs in aggravating the pathogenesis of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis in mice.
28670480.summary: In mice with EAE, long-term drinking of caffeine-free sugary cola worsened disease by altering gut bacteria and increasing harmful immune cells.

28288184.mechanism: Removes CD73 enzyme that makes immunoregulatory adenosine
28288184.conclusion_quote: These data show that while CD73 expression is regulated during EAE, this enzyme is not absolutely required to either promote or limit Th17 cell expansion or EAE severity.
28288184.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CD73 enzyme did not change disease severity or inflammatory Th17 cell levels in the nervous system.

28505283.mechanism: Describes oxidative stress and iron changes in lesions
28505283.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates that oxidative injury and aberrant iron distribution are prominent pathological hallmarks of marmoset EAE thus making this model suitable for therapeutic intervention studies aimed at reducing oxidative stress and associated iron dysmetabolism.
28505283.summary: In marmoset monkeys with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found that oxidative damage and iron redistribution mark brain lesions, similar to human MS.

29142736.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or gene change tested
29142736.conclusion_quote: These observations suggest that CD1 mice are less vulnerable to cuprizone-induced demyelination than C57BL/6 mice and thus genetic background factors appear to influence the susceptibility to cuprizone-induced demyelination.
29142736.summary: In mice, the cuprizone toxin model compared two mouse strains and found CD1 mice had less severe myelin loss than C57BL/6 mice, suggesting genetic background affects susceptibility.

28619431.conclusion_quote: The lack of influence of CD20 B cell depletion in relapsing EAE, coupled with the relatively marginal and inconsistent results obtained in other mouse studies, suggests that rodents may have limited value in understanding the mechanism occurring following CD20 B cell depletion in humans.
28619431.summary: In mice with relapsing EAE, an antibody that removed CD20 B cells did not improve the disease, while removing CD4 T cells did reduce it.

28769926.conclusion_quote: Our studies provide the first evidence for enabling the prediction of clinical disease using serum NDICPs.
28769926.summary: Researchers tracked blood proteins from brain tissue in mice with EAE over time and found that four of them changed before symptoms appeared, suggesting possible early warning markers.

28934025.mechanism: lowers hippocampal inflammatory cytokines and raises IL-10
28934025.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings demonstrate that the drug we used here can reduce anxiety and depression-like symptoms in EAE-induced mice.
28934025.summary: In mice with EAE, a new compound called TAMEC reduced anxiety and depression behaviors and lowered inflammatory signals in the hippocampus.

28474886.mechanism: dampens B cell receptor signaling via multivalent antigen binding
28474886.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that nonhydrolyzable conjugation increased the avidity of cSAgA PLP:LABL to drive in vivo efficacy through modulated BCR-mediated signaling.
28474886.summary: In mice with EAE, a stable click chemistry version of an antigen carrying polymer bound B cells more tightly and worked better at lower doses than the original.

interventions: human adipose tissue-derived stem cell (hADSC) transplantation
28198408.mechanism: rebalances Th17 and Treg cells, reducing inflammation
28198408.conclusion_quote: Transplantation of hADSCs alleviates the neurological function impairment and histological changes, and reduces the inflammatory cell infiltration and demyelination in EAE mice, which might be associated with the regulation of Th17/Treg balance.
28198408.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, transplanted human fat-derived stem cells eased weight loss, nerve symptoms and inflammation, and reduced myelin damage.

28238065.conclusion_quote: This study illustrates that the established protocol of cuprizone intoxication (i.e., mixed in ground rodent chow) is the gold standard method to achieve consistent and reproducible demyelination.
28238065.summary: In mice, cuprizone mixed into ground chow caused more consistent corpus callosum demyelination than cuprizone containing pellets, which were less effective.

28095433.mechanism: Blocks JAK-STAT signaling, suppressing Th1 and Th17 differentiation
28095433.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrated that BJ-3105 inhibits the phosphorylation of STAT in response to cytokine signals and subsequently suppressed the differentiation of Th cell responses.
28095433.summary: In mice with EAE, a lab compound called BJ-3105 reduced harmful immune T cells and slowed disease progression by blocking cytokine signaling.

28444343.mechanism: Increases intestinal collagen gene expression and villus growth
28444343.conclusion_quote: Thus, lysolecithin elicits gene expression in the intestinal epithelium, leading to enhanced collagen deposition and villus length.
28444343.summary: In broiler chickens, adding lysolecithin to feed increased gut lining collagen and villus length, but the study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

28464811.mechanism: promotes Olig1 and Olig2 expression for remyelination
28464811.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrated that Catalpol had a strong neuroprotective effect on EAE mice.
28464811.summary: Catalpol, a compound from the Chinese herb Radix Rehmanniae, was tested in mice with EAE, an MS model. It improved neurological function, reduced inflammation and demyelination, and boosted myelin repair.

28446680.conclusion_quote: The VHEV L* protein clearly inhibited mouse but not human RNase L, indicating that this virus originates from mice.
28446680.summary: Tests whether a viral protein blocks mouse or human RNase L to trace the origin of a virus passaged in mice, finding it likely came from mice.

29153609.conclusion_quote: We revealed elevated serum CCL20 concentrations in MS, and discovered an inverse correlation between CCL20 and SIRT1 activity in MS patients.
29153609.summary: In a study of 38 relapsing MS patients and 40 healthy people, blood tests found higher CCL20 levels and an inverse link with SIRT1 activity.

28696309.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these data identify a mechanism by which peripheral infection may exacerbate MS as well as other neurological diseases.
28696309.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, influenza infection triggered disease and drew immune cells into the brain and spinal cord.

28939838.conclusion_quote: Thus, CC strains can be a powerful resource for studying how viral infection can cause different neurological outcomes depending on host genetic background.
28939838.summary: In mice infected with a virus that causes nerve damage, five genetically different Collaborative Cross strains showed distinct neurological outcomes, suggesting new disease models.

28124768.mechanism: Not applicable, no therapeutic mechanism tested
28124768.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the current study rebuts the hypothesis of cuprizone as a heat-sensitive compound, as well as the assumption that heat exposure is a reason for an insufficient demyelination of cuprizone-containing pellets.
28124768.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a demyelination model, heating the toxin at up to 121 degrees did not reduce its demyelinating effect, in mice or rat oligodendrocyte cultures.

28515278.mechanism: blocks P2Y12 receptor, reducing Th17 cell differentiation
28515278.conclusion_quote: Our findings not only revealed the critical role of P2Y 12 in Th17 differentiation and EAE pathogenesis, but also suggested the promising potential of P2Y 12 antagonists in the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
