28515278.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing or blocking the P2Y12 receptor reduced harmful Th17 immune cells and lessened disease severity and demyelination.

28543188.mechanism: CD44 loss alters gut microbiota and short-chain fatty acids
28543188.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our results demonstrate that the attenuation of EAE seen following CD44 gene deletion in mice may result from alterations in the gut microbiota and SCFAs.
28543188.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the CD44 gene reduced disease, and transferring gut bacteria from these mice also eased disease, suggesting gut microbes play a role.

28544286.mechanism: Not applicable: describes disease model only
28544286.conclusion_quote: We observed a consistent pattern of demyelination, beginning in the cerebellum by 4 weeks and involving more rostral regions of the brain by 8 weeks on the cuprizone diet, with validation using Luxol fast blue histology.
28544286.summary: Researchers fed rats a cuprizone diet and used whole brain MRI every two weeks to track myelin loss, which began in the cerebellum and spread rostrally.

27908754.conclusion_quote: The results demonstrate that the citrullination of arginine in combination with the backbone conformation of mutated linear and cyclic analogs are significant elements for the immune response triggering the induction of pro-inflammatory cytokines.
27908754.summary: In mice with EAE, a modified citrullinated myelin peptide, especially in a cyclic form, triggered stronger T cell responses and inflammatory cytokine release than the linear version.

28344072.conclusion_quote: The findings imply that in demyelinating lesions are generated proteolytic OPN fragments and that OPN/MT interactions contribute to tissue remodeling during an autoimmune attack.
28344072.summary: In rats with relapsing EAE, an animal model of MS, researchers found osteopontin and metallothionein rose together in the brain and spinal cord, possibly helping reshape damaged tissue.

27807983.conclusion_quote: The parallel TMEV diagnosis in brain and feather-pulp RNA were similarly useful for diagnosis, at least in experimentally infected turkeys and in three cases of disease encountered in commercial flocks.
27807983.summary: In turkeys, a new PCR test detected the Turkey Meningoencephalitis virus in feathers as well as brain tissue, offering a less invasive sampling option.

28677863.conclusion_quote: Netrin-1 decreased in EAE and in MS patients, mainly during relapse, suggesting an anti-inflammatory role of netrin-1.
28677863.summary: Researchers measured netrin-1 levels in mice with EAE and in people with MS, finding lower levels in patients, especially during relapses.

28778453.mechanism: Astrocyte IL-6 makes microglia less responsive
28778453.conclusion_quote: Our results show that chronic transgenic production of IL-6 reduced cuprizone-induced cerebellar demyelination and induced a specific activation state of the resident microglia population (Iba1 + , CD11b + , MHCII + , CD68 - ), likely rendering them less responsive to subsequent injury signals.
28778453.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, producing extra IL-6 in astrocytes reduced cerebellar myelin loss and made resident microglia less reactive to later injury.

28284714.conclusion_quote: Thus, the altered relation between regulatory T cell and effector CD4+ T cell subsets was linked with persistence of mild neuroinflammation in AO rat EAE model.
28284714.summary: Researchers compared aged Albino Oxford and Dark Agouti rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, finding that a regulatory T cell imbalance linked to milder longer lasting inflammation.

28241881.mechanism: Inhibits Th1 and Th17 T-cell differentiation
28241881.conclusion_quote: BJ-1108 treatment ameliorates inflammation and EAE by inhibiting Th1 and Th17 cells differentiation.
28241881.summary: In mice with EAE, a small molecule called BJ-1108 blocked harmful immune T cells from forming, delaying disease onset and slowing its progression.

28642092.mechanism: Knockout reduces dendritic cell and T-cell CNS entry
28642092.conclusion_quote: Our study identifies CCL17 as a unique modulator of EAE pathogenesis regulating DC trafficking as well as peripheral T reg cell expansion in EAE.
28642092.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CCL17 gene reduced immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord and lessened disease severity.

28913765.mechanism: Blocks pyrimidine synthesis, curbing inflammation and viral load
28913765.conclusion_quote: Perhaps the most interesting result of the study has been teriflunomide's antiviral activity in the CNS, indicating it may have a role as an antiviral prophylactic and therapeutic compound for CNS viral infections.
28913765.summary: In mice infected with a virus causing demyelination, teriflunomide reduced viral load and inflammation in the nervous system but did not slow disability.

27130268.mechanism: Blocks immune cell entry and A2A receptor upregulation
27130268.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these results allow us to propose that this endogenous purine might be a putative novel and helpful tool for the prevention of autoimmune and neurodegenerative diseases, such as MS.
27130268.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, twice-daily inosine reduced disease signs, immune cell entry into the nervous system, and demyelination.

27876534.mechanism: reduces astrocytosis, nitric oxide and lipopolysaccharide levels
27876534.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that TMS could be a promising treatment for neuroinflammatory conditions such as multiple sclerosis.
27876534.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, transcranial magnetic stimulation improved motor symptoms and reduced brain inflammation markers and nerve cell loss.

28672408.mechanism: lowers chemokine and receptor expression in spinal cord
28672408.conclusion_quote: Treatment of EAE mice with ginger extract down-regulate the expression of CCL20 and CCL22 and their receptors in EAE mice.
28672408.summary: Ginger extract given to mice with EAE lowered levels of chemokines and their receptors in the spinal cord, suggesting reduced immune cell entry into the nervous system.

27919626.mechanism: Delivers glucocorticoid preferentially to macrophages, controlling their functio
27919626.conclusion_quote: We conclude that application of GC via IOH-NP has the potential to improve MS therapy in the future.
27919626.summary: In mice with EAE, steroid-loaded nanoparticles reached immune macrophages more selectively than free steroid while keeping full therapeutic effect.

28192476.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease mechanism only
28192476.conclusion_quote: We demonstrate here that Th40 cells drive a rapid, more severe EAE disease course than conventional CD4 T cells.
28192476.summary: In mice with EAE, immune cells that carry the CD40 marker caused faster and more severe disease than conventional CD4 T cells when transferred into recipient animals.

28125677.mechanism: Restores presynaptic glutamate and GABA release defects
28125677.conclusion_quote: These results improve our knowledge of the molecular events accounting for the beneficial effects elicited by fingolimod in demyelinating disorders.
28125677.summary: In mice with EAE, oral fingolimod given early or late reduced symptoms and restored nerve signaling defects in the brain, but less so in the spinal cord.

28865458.mechanism: blocks SUR1-TRPM4 channels on astrocytes, reducing inflammatory signals
28865458.conclusion_quote: SUR1-TRPM4 may be a druggable target for disease modification in MS.
28865458.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug glibenclamide started after symptoms levelled off improved clinical scores and reduced myelin loss and inflammation.

28439012.mechanism: neutralizes G-CSF, blocking neutrophil-driven autoimmune susceptibility
28439012.conclusion_quote: Early life exposure to bisphenol-A may represent an environmental consideration in multiple sclerosis.
28439012.summary: In mice with EAE, prenatal bisphenol-A exposure made males more susceptible to disease, and blocking G-CSF prevented this increased susceptibility.

28011150.mechanism: Inhibits NF-kB, reducing cytokines and immune cell activation
28011150.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that PL can mitigate MOG-induced EAE symptoms and activation of macrophages and T cells by inhibiting NF-κB signaling.
28011150.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug piperlongumine reduced paralysis, demyelination and immune cell buildup by blocking the NF-kB inflammation pathway.

27908532.mechanism: Blocks ribosomal RNA transcription, triggering lymphocyte apoptosis
27908532.conclusion_quote: Moreover, oral administration of RAM-589.555 blocks ribosomal RNA transcription and significantly suppresses and ameliorates experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE).
27908532.summary: Oral RAM-589.555, a drug that blocks ribosome production, reduced immune cell growth and eased disease in mice with EAE.

27812760.mechanism: Not a treatment study, describes oxidative stress changes
27812760.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, the study indicated that the increased pro-oxidant-antioxidant balance in plasma may be an early indicator of EAE development.
27812760.summary: In male and female rats with EAE, a model of MS, spinal cord oxidative stress rose, with males showing greater changes and worse symptoms.

27544641.conclusion_quote: However, there are distinct differences which limits the contribution of EAE to the understanding of MS.
27544641.summary: This lecture summary reviews how EAE mouse models became established for studying multiple sclerosis and how they have contributed to MS research.

28284347.mechanism: Induces M2 microglia that expand regulatory B cells
28284347.conclusion_quote: Our study suggests that estrogen neuroprotection induces a regulatory feedback loop between M2 macrophages/microglia and regulatory B cells.
28284347.summary: In mice with EAE, estrogen boosted anti-inflammatory M2 microglia and regulatory B cells in the spinal cord, and these cells helped protect against disease.

27935632.mechanism: not applicable, describes demyelination without testing treatment
27935632.conclusion_quote: These results might help us to further understand the role of white matter abnormalities in demyelinating diseases or a wide range of psychiatric disorders.
27935632.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to induce demyelination, researchers measured nerve fiber loss in the corpus callosum and found about 45% fewer myelinated fibers, mostly thin ones.

28929408.mechanism: suppresses microglial activation and inflammatory cytokine production
28929408.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that yokukansan reduces demyelination owing to anti-inflammatory effects on microglia.
28929408.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, the herbal medicine yokukansan reduced myelin loss and lowered activated immune cells called microglia in the brain.

29195512.mechanism: removes CXCR3 signaling, dampening inflammation and barrier leak
29195512.conclusion_quote: Together, these data have implications for understanding the role of BBB permeability in the pathogenesis of demyelinating disease.
29195512.summary: In mice fed the toxic cuprizone diet, blood brain barrier leakage began before demyelination, and mice lacking CXCR3 signaling had less inflammation and barrier damage.

28446186.conclusion_quote: Taken together, orally administered low-dose fingolimod showed an impressive immunomodulatory effect in the rat model of experimental autoimmune neuritis.
28446186.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune neuritis, a model of peripheral nerve inflammation, oral fingolimod prevented symptoms, reduced immune cells, and protected nerves from damage.

28396177.mechanism: Not applicable: describes EAE induction method
28396177.conclusion_quote: By providing a detailed active MOG 35-55 -EAE protocol that yields consistent and robust pathology, we aim to foster comparability between pre-clinical studies and facilitate the discovery of MS therapeutics.
28396177.summary: A detailed protocol for chronic EAE in C57BL/6 mice, a model of MS, gives consistent paralysis and MS like damage in the spinal cord and brain.

29259169.mechanism: Inhibits B-lymphocyte activity, oxidative stress, and microglial activation
29259169.conclusion_quote: In summary, we present a systematic approach to identify generic medications for progressive multiple sclerosis with the potential to advance rapidly into clinical trials, and we highlight clomipramine for further development.
29259169.summary: Researchers screened generic drugs and found clomipramine reduced disease signs, inflammation and nerve damage in mice with EAE, an MS model.

28430292.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or gene change tested
28430292.conclusion_quote: This study revealed that iron deposition in the JVL group as a model for CCSVI was not associated with cardinal histopathological findings of MS.
28430292.summary: In rats with jugular vein ligation mimicking chronic venous insufficiency, iron collected in brain white matter but no demyelination or inflammation appeared, challenging the vein theory of multiple sclerosis.

28796840.mechanism: Not applicable, essay with no treatment tested
28796840.conclusion_quote: There are things that can be achieved only by research.
28796840.summary: This personal essay, not an original study, argues that research matters and briefly mentions an EAE mouse model without testing any treatment.

27889959.mechanism: reduces inflammation and apoptosis, raises neurotrophic factors
27889959.conclusion_quote: DMF may constitute a promising target for future SCI therapies.
27889959.summary: In mice with spinal cord injury, dimethyl fumarate given after the injury reduced inflammation and improved motor recovery. This is not an MS or demyelination model.

28128219.mechanism: Knockout or knockdown of TG2 reduces fibronectin production
28128219.conclusion_quote: TG2 contributes, at least partly, to fibronectin production, and may play a role in fibronectin deposition during cuprizone-induced demyelination.
28128219.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to strip myelin, changing tissue transglutaminase in astrocytes altered fibronectin scar protein levels, suggesting a role in scarring that may block repair.

28655617.mechanism: Inhibits SphK1/S1P signaling, reducing S1P levels
28655617.conclusion_quote: These results indicated that BBR suppresses demyelination and loss of neurophysiological function by inhibiting the SphK1/S1P signaling pathway.
28655617.summary: In mice with EAE, berberine reduced loss of nerve function and myelin damage, along with lower SphK1 and S1P levels.

29234109.mechanism: Loss of JunB blocks Th17 cell development
29234109.conclusion_quote: Here we show that the AP-1 transcription factor JunB is required for Th17 cell development.
29234109.summary: In mice without the JunB gene, immune cells fail to become inflammatory Th17 cells, and the mice are fully protected from EAE, a model of MS.

28887429.mechanism: Removing NFM does not change disease course
28887429.conclusion_quote: Although NFM 15-35 is immunogenic and cross-reactive with MOG at the polyclonal level, it fails to expand a threshold level of encephalitogenic, high-affinity MOG-specific T cells.
28887429.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the neurofilament protein NFM did not change disease course, because NFM specific T cells were not the key drivers of the illness.

28533365.conclusion_quote: Here, we show that molecular MRI targeting the endothelial adhesion molecule P-selectin unmasks the pathological events that take place in the spinal cord of mice subjected to chronic or relapsing experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
28533365.summary: In mice with EAE, a P-selectin-targeted MRI scan tracked spinal cord disease activity and predicted relapses and remissions, which conventional MRI cannot show.

28556945.mechanism: Lowers LRF transcription factor, impairing oligodendrocyte remyelination
28556945.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, LRF can modulate the extent of remyelination, potentially by contributing to interactions regulating transcription.
28556945.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing the LRF gene from oligodendrocyte-lineage cells reduced myelin repair, though oligodendrocyte numbers stayed normal.

28821276.conclusion_quote: Using the cuprizone model of inflammatory demyelination, our data reveal a novel form of synaptic (mal)adaption in the CNS that is characterized by a shift of the excitation/inhibition balance toward inhibitory network activity associated with an increase in GABAergic inhibitory synapses and a possible increase in excitatory input onto inhibitory interneurons.
28821276.summary: In mice fed a cuprizone diet to cause demyelination, the visual relay area of the brain showed fewer excitatory and more inhibitory synapses, shifting network activity toward inhibition.

28411187.conclusion_quote: Our current data thus identify Nr4a1 as regulator of microglia activation and potentially new target for the treatment of inflammatory CNS diseases such as multiple sclerosis.
28411187.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Nr4a1 made microglia overactive and worsened disease, while activating Nr4a1 with a ligand improved the disease course.

28848043.mechanism: Blocks FASN, lowering Th17 inflammatory cell generation
28848043.conclusion_quote: These studies demonstrate the necessity of FASN in the autoimmune inflammatory function of Th17 cells.
28848043.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the FASN enzyme only in Th17 immune cells reduced disease, showing FASN drives their inflammatory, damaging activity.

29202545.mechanism: Lowers MMP9 gene expression linked to myelin destruction
29202545.conclusion_quote: In addition, tart cherry extract and pure p-coumaric acid ingestion could decrease MMP9 gene expression level considerably during remyelination.
29202545.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, tart cherry extract and p-coumaric acid reduced MMP9 gene expression during remyelination, more than normal chow did.

28559011.mechanism: Gene deletion increases dendritic cell and T-cell inflammation
28559011.conclusion_quote: Therefore, PTPσ is a key negative regulator in EAE initiation and progression, which acts by regulating functions of DCs, T cells, and other immune cells.
28559011.summary: Mice lacking the PTPσ gene had worse experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a mouse model of MS, with more nerve and myelin damage and more inflammation.

28694434.mechanism: increases BDNF levels, protecting striatal neurons
28694434.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that laquinimod could provide a mild effect on motor function and striatal histopathology, but not on survival.
28694434.summary: Laquinimod, an oral drug studied for MS, was tested in R6/2 mice with Huntington's-like disease. It mildly improved motor function and striatal brain tissue but did not extend survival.

28620692.conclusion_quote: For the first time, this study establishes a pathomechanistic link between the well-established autoimmune attack on the CNS and ENS pathology in MS, which might provide a paradigm shift in our current understanding of the immunopathogenesis of the disease with broad diagnostic and therapeutic implications.
28620692.summary: In mice with an antibody-driven MS model, the gut's enteric nervous system degenerated before brain lesions appeared, and similar damage appeared in patients' colon tissue.

29162133.conclusion_quote: We provide evidence for the first time that MOG 35-55 EAE induces production of antibodies with affinity to SVZ of naive mice in three different age groups.
29162133.summary: Antibodies from mice with EAE, a model of MS, were found to bind neural precursor cells in the brain's subventricular zone of healthy mice, possibly triggering cell death pathways.

28192470.mechanism: differentiates stem cells into myelin-forming oligodendrocytes
28192470.conclusion_quote: These results showed that embryonic stem cells and human induced pluripotent stem cells maintained in a dissociated monolayer and feeder-free culture system have the potential to generate oligodendrocyte progenitor cells and mature oligodendrocytes in vitro and in vivo.
28192470.summary: This study shows that monkey and human stem cells grown in a new culture system can be turned into myelin-forming oligodendrocytes in lab dishes and mouse brains.

28330904.mechanism: Monocyte-autonomous TNF supports monocyte survival and function
28330904.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data reveal a previously unappreciated critical cell-autonomous role of TNF on monocytes for their survival, maintenance, and function.
28330904.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting TNF from monocytes and macrophages delayed disease onset and reduced inflammatory monocyte entry into the spinal cord.

29163045.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results suggest that the process of neuroinflammation in EAE may be associated with altered ADP signaling.
29163045.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, an enzyme that breaks down ATP and ADP-sensing receptors changed during disease, suggesting altered ADP signaling.

28783571.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that DHF-6 may improve cognitive impairment and the positive symptoms of schizophrenia by alleviating white matter lesions via facilitating remyelination and inhibiting neuroinflammation, thus may be beneficial in the treatment of schizophrenia.
28783571.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage brain white matter, the flavanone derivative DHF-6 improved memory-related behavior, reduced inflammation, and promoted myelin repair.

28863329.mechanism: Notch1 loss in B cells reduces antibody production
28863329.conclusion_quote: Together, our results suggest that both Notch1 and its ligands in B cells play an important role in antibody production.
28863329.summary: In mice with EAE, removing Notch1 from B cells did not change antibody production, though it reduced antibody output in lab-grown B cells.

28216674.mechanism: CCR7 loss traps dendritic cells in CNS
28216674.conclusion_quote: These data are the first to show that CD11c high DC use CCR7 for migration out of the CNS, and in the absence of this receptor they remain in the CNS in situ and exacerbate EAE.
28216674.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the CCR7 gene kept inflammatory dendritic cells trapped in the brain and spinal cord, worsening disease.

28675559.conclusion_quote: The presented data support the role of inflammatory pathways in epileptogenesis and comorbidities in two distinct epilepsy models.
28675559.summary: This review discusses rodent epilepsy models in which brain inflammation drives seizures and related conditions, and notes that these seizures often resist standard drugs. It does not study multiple sclerosis.

29166603.mechanism: Lacking caveolae reduces Th1 lymphocyte entry into CNS
29166603.conclusion_quote: Therefore, tight junction remodeling facilitates Th17 migration across the BBB, whereas caveolae promote Th1 entry into the CNS.
29166603.summary: In mice with EAE, removing caveolae reduced entry of Th1 immune cells into the spinal cord, while tight junction changes at the blood-brain barrier were unaffected.

27721430.mechanism: Mutation dampens type I interferon responses
27721430.conclusion_quote: The USP15-TRIM25 dyad might be a potential target for intervention in acute or chronic states of neuroinflammation.
27721430.summary: In mice with EAE, a USP15 gene mutation reduced type I interferon signaling in the spinal cord and protected against neuroinflammation.

28747602.conclusion_quote: It is essential for the development of inflammation in various diseases and is a molecular basis of BBB breakdown.
28747602.summary: This review summarizes earlier work on how inflammation enters the brain in mice with EAE, a model of MS, without testing any new treatment.

27639322.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes gait changes in EAE
27639322.conclusion_quote: Kinematic analyses therefore yield highly sensitive measures of motor deficits that predict spinal cord injury in EAE mice.
27639322.summary: Researchers used high speed video to measure walking patterns in mice with EAE, finding early gait changes that tracked spinal cord damage and could help test MS treatments.

28477198.mechanism: Not applicable, describes cell methods only
28477198.conclusion_quote: Here we describe methods for in vitro differentiation of naïve murine CD4+ T cells to generate IL-9-producing Th9 cells and follow their effector functions in EAE and IBD murine models.
28477198.summary: Researchers described lab methods for turning mouse T cells into interleukin 9 producing Th9 cells and testing them in mice with EAE and bowel inflammation models.

29212956.mechanism: Removing ASPRV1 protease reduces chronic neutrophil-driven inflammation
29212956.conclusion_quote: Therefore, ICAM1+ macrophage-like neutrophils can play both shared and nonredundant roles in autoimmune demyelination, among them perpetuating inflammation via ASPRV1.
29212956.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the ASPRV1 gene made the chronic phase of disease less severe, and in many mice it faded completely.

27979248.conclusion_quote: This study could provide a useful information on stabilizer selection for the development of liquid or colloidal products with improved solubility and colloidal stability of nanosuspended BCAAs.
27979248.summary: This food chemistry study tested stabilizers for dissolving branched chain amino acids in liquid form and does not involve multiple sclerosis, animals, or human cells.

29131010.mechanism: blocks blood-brain barrier breakdown and immune cell entry
29131010.conclusion_quote: Activation of the Asm/ceramide system is a central step for the development of EAE.
29131010.summary: Mice without acid sphingomyelinase were protected against EAE, a mouse model of MS, with less immune cell entry into the brain and milder symptoms.

28680531.mechanism: Mild mitochondrial uncoupling modulates whole mitochondria physiology
28680531.conclusion_quote: Results suggest that MP201 is a potential novel treatment for optic neuritis.
28680531.summary: In mice with EAE, an optic neuritis model, the oral drug MP201 preserved vision, retinal nerve cells, and myelin in the optic nerve.

28131884.conclusion_quote: Thus, VSOP-based MRI is sensitive to visualize early neuroinflammatory processes such as GAG modifications on brain endothelial cells.
28131884.summary: In mice with EAE, inflamed brain blood vessel cells took up iron oxide nanoparticles mainly through sulfated sugar chains, suggesting MRI with these particles can detect early inflammation.

28641018.mechanism: No treatment tested, imaging probe only
28641018.conclusion_quote: Our strategy establishes a distinct yet complementary set of imaging probes for understanding disease mechanisms in three dimensions.
28641018.summary: Researchers developed metal nanoparticle probes that produce detailed 3D images of clear tissue, and used them to map lesions and immune cells in mice with an MS model.

27714632.mechanism: Sema7A deletion alters peripheral immunity and CNS inflammation
27714632.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these results indicate that sema7A is involved in peripheral immunity and CNS inflammation in MS pathogenesis.
27714632.summary: In mice lacking the sema7A gene, EAE disease course changed depending on antigen and adjuvant dose, while brain slice demyelination after LPS was unaffected.

29063445.mechanism: downregulates miR-155-5p, increasing BDNF, HRAS and BCL2 expression
29063445.conclusion_quote: Results obtained in this study suggested that high dose of IL-17 exerts protective activity via miR-155-5p downregulation.
29063445.summary: In animals with EAE, a high dose of IL-17 lowered miR-155-5p and raised BDNF, HRAS and BCL2, suggesting it may protect nerve cells from dying early in the disease.

28052250.conclusion_quote: These data suggest a significant role for EBI2 in human CD4 + T cell migration, notably in patients with MS.
28052250.summary: In human immune cells from healthy people and people with MS, memory CD4 T cells were found to carry the EBI2 receptor, which increased in patients taking natalizumab.

28768901.mechanism: Blocks CCR6 receptor, limiting Th17 cell recruitment
28768901.conclusion_quote: CCR6 plays a critical role in Th17 type inflammatory reactions, and CCR6 inhibition may offer an alternative approach for the treatment of these lesions.
28768901.summary: In mice with EAE, a blocking antibody against human CCR6 reduced clinical symptoms and central nervous system inflammation when given before or after disease onset.

28754118.mechanism: Anticoagulation blocks coagulation factors that modulate inflammation
28754118.conclusion_quote: We found a mild preventive effect of both warfarin and rivaroxaban on neurological deficits and local inflammation, indicating a modulation of the disease induction by anticoagulation.
28754118.summary: In mice with EAE, warfarin and rivaroxaban given before disease onset mildly reduced symptoms and spinal cord inflammation, while later warfarin treatment did not help.

28107629.mechanism: binds myelin for PET and fluorescence imaging
28107629.conclusion_quote: By conducting sequential PET and 3D cryoimaging in an SCI rat model, we demonstrated for the first time that PET and cryoimaging can be combined as a novel technique to image the spinal cord with high sensitivity and spatial resolution.
28107629.summary: Researchers developed a fluorinated tracer that binds myelin, allowing PET scans and tissue imaging in rats with spinal cord injury.

28057805.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes lung immune changes
28057805.conclusion_quote: Immunological analyses revealed that the induction of EAE led to a surprising alteration of the lung milieu, converting an effective stimulatory influenza-reactive environment into a suppressive one.
28057805.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, an influenza infection caused much higher death rates than in either condition alone, because the lung immune environment became suppressive.

28598502.mechanism: Bcl-3 overexpression impairs Th17 development and T-cell expansion
28598502.conclusion_quote: Thus, we concluded that fine-tuning expression of Bcl-3 is needed for proper CD4 + T-cell development and is required to sustain Th17-cell mediated pathology.
28598502.summary: In mice engineered to overexpress Bcl-3 in T cells, fewer Th17 cells formed and mice with EAE, a model of MS, were resistant to disease.

28069965.mechanism: Loss of ALCAM weakens blood-brain barrier tight junctions
28069965.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data point to a biologically important function of ALCAM in maintaining BBB integrity.
28069965.summary: In mice with EAE, knocking out the ALCAM gene made disease worse, with more inflammatory cells entering the brain and leakier blood vessels.

28666719.mechanism: Reduces infiltrating T cells, boosts regulatory T cells
28666719.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results provide strong evidence that SHED can modulate peripherally the CD4 + T cell responses suggesting that SHED would be explored as part of cellular therapy in autoimmune diseases associated with CNS.
28666719.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, infusing stem cells from baby teeth reduced harmful immune cells entering the brain and spinal cord and improved clinical signs.

28121007.mechanism: Nanotubes steer stem cells toward neuron fate
28121007.conclusion_quote: The present study indicate the marked ability of CNTs to enhance the therapeutic potential of human OBNSCs which qualify this novel therapeutic paradigm as a promising candidate for cell-based therapy of different neurodegenerative diseases.
28121007.summary: In rats with trimethyltin-induced brain damage, nanotube-supported human stem cells restored memory deficits and steered cells toward becoming neurons.

28167776.mechanism: Smad7 loss boosts tolerogenic dendritic cells and Tregs
28167776.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate that Smad7 expression governs splenic DC subset differentiation and is critical for the promotion of their efficient function in immunity.
28167776.summary: In mice with EAE, removing Smad7 from dendritic cells made the mice resistant to disease by increasing protective regulatory T cells and reducing harmful effector T cells.

29057962.mechanism: Nanobody selectively blocks TNFR1 signaling, sparing TNFR2
29057962.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data illustrate that TNFR1 is a promising therapeutic target in MS.
29057962.summary: In mice with EAE, a nanobody blocking the TNFR1 receptor delayed disease onset, eased symptoms, and reduced spinal cord inflammation while preserving myelin and neurons.

29286392.conclusion_quote: Therefore, this protocol is useful for future investigation of novel targets and functions of Qa-1-restricted CD8 + T cells.
29286392.summary: This protocol uses overlapping peptides from myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein to map Qa-1 immune epitopes, identifying a 9-mer that drives myelin-specific immune regulation in MS-related models.

28918150.mechanism: alters rumen fermentation and milk fat synthesis
28918150.conclusion_quote: The LYSO increased milk fat concentration when feeding a higher fiber and lower unsaturated FA diet, but decreased milk fat yield when feeding a lower fiber and higher unsaturated FA diet, although biohydrogenation pathways and capacity did not appear to be modified.
28918150.summary: In dairy cows, lysolecithin raised milk fat concentration on higher fiber diets but lowered milk fat yield on higher unsaturated fat diets.

28978445.mechanism: No treatment tested, imaging of myelin lipid order
28978445.conclusion_quote: We show that lipid molecular order of myelin in the mouse spinal cord is significantly reduced throughout the progression of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model for multiple sclerosis, even in myelin regions that appear morphologically unaffected.
28978445.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, imaging showed myelin lipids lost their molecular order early, even where myelin looked normal under the microscope.

28063054.mechanism: Not applicable, describes immune cell profiling method
28063054.conclusion_quote: With the aid of dimensionality reducing and clustering algorithms to visualize and analyze this high dimensional data, this allows for a more comprehensive picture of the different cell populations in an inflamed CNS, at a single cell resolution level.
28063054.summary: This methods paper explains how to induce EAE in mice and use mass cytometry to profile immune cells and microglia in the inflamed central nervous system.

28126203.mechanism: Skin TSLP production expands regulatory T cells systemically
28126203.conclusion_quote: Together, these data demonstrate that the skin has the remarkable potential to control systemic immune responses and that Vitamin D-mediated stimulation of skin could serve as a novel strategy to therapeutically modulate the systemic immune system for the treatment of autoimmunity.
28126203.summary: In mice, topical application of a vitamin D analog to the skin raised regulatory T cells through TSLP and reduced disease severity in EAE, a model of MS.

27697286.mechanism: Increases regulatory T cells, reduces inflammatory cytokines
27697286.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that IFN-γ may be used to stimulate the immunomodulatory property of WJ-MSCs in clinical situations.
27697286.summary: In mice with EAE, human umbilical cord stem cells pretreated with interferon gamma reduced symptoms, immune cell buildup in the brain, and inflammatory signals.

28368293.mechanism: activates CB2 receptor, inhibits microglia and T cells
28368293.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our study represents significant implications for clinical research and strongly supports the effectiveness of BCP as a novel molecule to target in the development of effective therapeutic agents for MS.
28368293.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the plant compound caryophyllene reduced paralysis, nerve damage, and inflammation by activating the CB2 receptor.

28889992.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings support the hypothesis of a crucial role of astrocytic CXCR7 in the progression of various CNS pathologies.
28889992.summary: In rats with EAE, an MS model, and other brain injuries, astrocytes showed a sharp rise in the CXCR7 receptor, while healthy developing brains showed little.

28289417.conclusion_quote: This study indicates that MCMV may enhance autoimmune neuropathology and abrogate inherent resistance to EAE in mouse strain by enhancing proinflammatory phenotype of antigen-presenting cells, Th1/Th17, and CD8 response to MOG 35-55 .
28289417.summary: In mice with EAE, infection with murine cytomegalovirus made normally resistant BALB/c mice develop the disease, with immune cells that attack myelin.

27912911.mechanism: Reduces Th17 cells, boosts Treg cells and IL-10
27912911.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results demonstrated that hesperidin could reduce the incidence and severity of disease.
27912911.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the citrus compound hesperidin reduced disease severity and inflammatory immune cells while boosting regulatory T cells.

28718500.mechanism: Not applicable: pathogenicity tested, no treatment
28718500.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results reveal that as well as acting as reliable biomarkers of neuronal damage, antibodies to NF-L exacerbate neurological disease, suggesting that antibodies to NF-L generated during disease may also be pathogenic and play a role in the progression of neurodegeneration.
28718500.summary: In mice with EAE and optic neuritis, injected antibodies against neurofilament light worsened neurological signs and nerve cell loss, suggesting these antibodies may drive neurodegeneration.

28219902.mechanism: NDR1 competitively binds TRAF3, promoting IL-17 signaling
28219902.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings suggest that NDR1 is involved in the development of autoimmune diseases.
28219902.summary: In mice lacking the NDR1 kinase, IL-17 driven inflammation was reduced and the mice were protected from EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis.

28780774.mechanism: alters immune response, reducing antibodies and abzyme production
28780774.conclusion_quote: The data indicate that for C57BL/6 mice, DNA may have antagonistic effects with respect to MOG immunization.
28780774.summary: In mice with EAE, immunizing with DNA instead of MOG reduced antibodies, abzymes and urine protein, and delayed the immune response.

28652396.mechanism: activates TLR7 signaling, suppressing Th17 and Th1 cells
28652396.conclusion_quote: These studies identify a new strategy to manipulate Th17/Th1 cells through TLR7 signaling, with important implications for successful immunotherapy against autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.
28652396.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug imiquimod, which activates TLR7, reduced harmful immune cells both when given before and after disease onset.

29276512.mechanism: Raises apoE, dampening inflammatory cytokine production
29276512.conclusion_quote: Collectively, we show that ldlr -/- reduces EAE disease severity in female but not in male EAE mice, and that this can be explained by increased levels of apoE in female ldlr -/- mice.
29276512.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the LDL receptor gene reduced disease in females but not males, likely by raising apoE levels in the nervous system.

28011088.conclusion_quote: In conclusion we demonstrate nitration as a relevant determinant affecting T cell recognition of carrier antigen depending on MHC haplotype.
28011088.summary: In mice with EAE, chemically altering the MOG protein at one tyrosine reduced its ability to trigger disease in one mouse strain but not another.

28549646.mechanism: Copper chelator causing demyelination, not a treatment
28549646.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that increased central dopaminergic activity may relate to the behavioral abnormality in mice, and this CPZ short-term exposure with higher dose may offer a model to study some aspects of biology relevant to schizophrenia and other related disorders.
28549646.summary: In mice with a cuprizone-induced demyelination model, short-term exposure increased activity and brain dopamine levels, without impairing memory or motor coordination.

28817212.mechanism: modulates sphingosine-1-phosphate receptors, reducing inflammation and apoptosis
28817212.conclusion_quote: Antenatal maternal fingolimod therapy had fetal neuroprotective effects by alleviating preterm birth-related fetal brain injury with inhibitory effects on inflammation and apoptosis.
28817212.summary: In a rat model of preterm fetal brain injury, the MS drug fingolimod reduced brain inflammation and cell death in pups when given to pregnant mothers.

28112212.mechanism: Imaging method only, no treatment tested
28112212.conclusion_quote: Our approach paves the way to the creation of a "database" for the characterization of the neuronal network main features for a comparative investigation of neurodegenerative diseases and therapies.
28112212.summary: Researchers used synchrotron 3D imaging to map motor neurons in healthy mouse spinal cords and compared them with a mouse model of multiple sclerosis.

28952817.mechanism: shifts immune responses from Th1 toward Th2
28952817.conclusion_quote: Since, artemisinin can shift the immune responses from Th1 to Th2, therefore, it can be helpful in the treatment of MS after more investigation.
28952817.summary: In mice with EAE, an animal model of MS, artemisinin reduced disease scores and brain plaques and shifted immune signals toward a Th2 pattern.

28397727.mechanism: neutralizes IL-9, reducing mast cell infiltration into CNS
28397727.conclusion_quote: This study revealed that IL-9 neutralization reduced mast cell infiltration in CNS and ameliorated EAE, which might be relate to the interaction between IL-9 and mast cells.
28397727.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, treated with an anti-IL-9 antibody had fewer mast cells in the central nervous system and milder disease.

28874534.mechanism: IL-27 signaling keeps Tregs stable and suppressive
28874534.conclusion_quote: These findings uncover a previously unknown role of IL-27 in regulating Treg function to control autoimmune inflammation.
28874534.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the IL-27 receptor only in regulatory T cells made disease worse and increased inflammatory immune cells in the central nervous system.

28851631.conclusion_quote: NOD, a highly autoimmunity-prone mouse strain, exhibits more profound GALT-related immune response upon immunization compared to the strains that are less prone to autoimmunity.
28851631.summary: In C57BL/6, BALB/c and NOD mice, helper T cell profiles in gut lymph tissues differ by strain, with NOD mice responding most strongly to immunization. No MS model was tested.

28315676.mechanism: Not a treatment study, genetic haplotype affects adjuvant arthritis
28315676.conclusion_quote: The finding that Ltab-Ncr3 is specific in regulating adjuvant-induced arthritis but not antigen-induced autoimmunity, and with unique effects on priming of autoreactive and arthritogenic T cells, provides new insight for understanding the regulation of autoimmune diseases.
28315676.summary: In mice with arthritis and EAE models, a genetic region in the MHC gene cluster affected adjuvant-induced arthritis but not EAE or collagen-induced arthritis.

28979263.conclusion_quote: To the best of our knowledge, this study provides the first direct link between the presence of CD4+ CTL and MS disease severity, as well as its prognostic value.
28979263.summary: In 176 patients with relapsing remitting MS, higher blood levels of a harmful immune cell type were linked to worse disability and nerve test results over five years.

28287595.conclusion_quote: Overall, bioluminescence imaging was a reliable method to assess EAE-associated optic neuritis and medication effects and was superior to the near-infrared techniques in terms of signal specificity, robustness, ease of quantification, and cost.
28287595.summary: In mice with EAE, a light-based imaging method detected optic nerve inflammation and brain barrier leaks, and worked better than near-infrared methods.

28273090.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, reducing immune cell recirculation
28273090.conclusion_quote: These findings provide further evidence for a predominantly peripheral effect of the compound in neuroinflammation.
28273090.summary: In EAE, an animal model of MS, the drug fingolimod reduced inflammation and restored astrocyte glutamate transporter levels, but did not act directly on astrocytes in culture.

28119027.mechanism: Loss of AMIGO2 alters T-cell differentiation and cytokines
28119027.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data demonstrate that AMIGO2 is important in regulating T-cell functions and EAE, and may be harnessed as a potential therapeutic target for multiple sclerosis.
28119027.summary: Mice engineered to lack the Amigo2 gene had milder EAE, a mouse model of multiple sclerosis, with fewer inflammatory T cells in the spinal cord.

27845252.conclusion_quote: We demonstrated that demyelinated brain fundamentally reorganizes its intrinsic functional connectivity paralleled by widespread damage of the structural scaffolding.
27845252.summary: Mice given cuprizone to cause brain demyelination showed altered brain connectivity, with the default mode network and hippocampus most affected.

29150604.conclusion_quote: Our results define the molecular signature of human pro-inflammatory T H 17 cells, which can be used to both identify pathogenic T H 17 cells and to measure the effect of treatment on T H 17 cells in human autoimmune diseases.
29150604.summary: Researchers profiled immune T cells from blood of people with multiple sclerosis and found certain harmful T cell types had lower IL10 gene activity than healthy controls.

29187851.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that inhibition of P2X7R on monocytes and up-regulation in astrocytes might contribute to sustain inflammatory mechanisms in MS.
29187851.summary: Researchers examined P2X7 receptor levels in blood immune cells and frontal cortex tissue from people with MS, finding it reduced on monocytes and increased on astrocytes.

28592428.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, EBV infection switches MOG processing in B cells from destructive to productive and facilitates cross-presentation of disease-relevant epitopes to CD8 + T cells.
28592428.summary: In human B cells, EBV infection changes how myelin protein fragments are processed, helping immune cells recognize them, a possible route to multiple sclerosis.

28533380.mechanism: boosts CCR8 regulatory T cell proliferation and suppression
28533380.conclusion_quote: Collectively, we demonstrate the pivotal role of CCR8 + T reg cells in restraining immunity and highlight the potential clinical implications of this discovery.
28533380.summary: In mice with EAE, a stabilized form of the CCL1 protein expanded regulatory T cells carrying CCR8, which calmed ongoing disease.

28974538.mechanism: Blocks BET protein binding at inflammatory gene promoters
28974538.conclusion_quote: We show for the first time that a BD2-selective BETi maintains anti-inflammatory properties and is effective in preclinical models of acute inflammation and autoimmunity.
28974538.summary: In mice with EAE, an oral drug that selectively targets BET protein's second bromodomain prevented disease when given early and reduced pathology when given after onset.

28426455.mechanism: Inhibits RORγt, reducing Th17-related cytokine expression
28426455.conclusion_quote: This study has shown for the first time that treatment with digoxin can ameliorate murine experimental colitis.
28426455.summary: In mice with colitis, the heart drug digoxin reduced weight loss and gut damage by lowering inflammatory Th17 signals.

28427937.mechanism: Not applicable, describes glycan detection antibodies
28427937.conclusion_quote: Finally, we confirmed the increased HNK-1 epitope expression in demyelinated brains of cuprizone-fed mice.
28427937.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, researchers made new antibodies that detect HNK-1 tagged sugar molecules and found these sugars increased in damaged brains.

28860188.conclusion_quote: JNJ0966 was efficacious in reducing disease severity in a mouse experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis model, demonstrating the viability of this therapeutic approach.
28860188.summary: In mice with EAE, a highly selective compound called JNJ0966 that blocks activation of the MMP-9 enzyme reduced disease severity.

28292961.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these results support the existence of an M-SOB effect that may reflect seasonally dependent developmental differences in adaptive immune responses to self-antigens independent of external stimuli, including exposure to sunlight and vitamin D.
28292961.summary: In mice with EAE, being born in the season with the fewest births made them less likely to develop disease than mice born in the season with the most births.

28616446.mechanism: Depletes basophils by targeting high-affinity IgE receptor
28616446.conclusion_quote: Our observations that anti-FcεRIα antibody increases Th1 and Th17 responses against myelin antigen and exacerbates EAE suggest that FcεRI, basophils, and possibly other FcεRI-bearing cells that might be affected by this antibody play important roles in influencing the severity of CNS autoimmunity.
28616446.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody targeting the IgE receptor on basophils worsened disease and increased immune attacks on myelin.

28574826.mechanism: blocks pyrimidine synthesis, limiting viral replication
28574826.conclusion_quote: Leflunomide/teriflunomide might therefore be clinically useful for preventing EBV-induced LPD in patients who have high EBV loads yet require continued immunosuppression.
28574826.summary: In human EBV-transformed B cells and mouse models, teriflunomide slowed cell growth and prevented EBV lymphomas, but the study does not address multiple sclerosis.

28191668.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease changes only
28191668.conclusion_quote: Therefore, significant ventricular modifications in ciliated cells occur early in response to tEAE suggesting a role for these cells in SVZ stem cell signalling not only during development/aging but also during inflammatory demyelination.
28191668.summary: In an animal model of MS, cells lining the brain ventricles changed early during inflammation as stem cell division in the SVZ increased.

28161197.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte formation and neurotrophic factor production
28161197.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrated that ICA treatment during the recovery period promotes remyelination and axon rewrapped, at least, in part, by promoting oligodendrogenesis and neurotrophic factor production.
28161197.summary: In cuprizone-fed mice with acute demyelination, the plant compound icariin given during recovery improved myelin repair, nerve fiber repair, and mature oligodendrocyte numbers.

28115010.conclusion_quote: ER stress is strongly associated with Rab32 upregulation in the progression of MS, leading to mitochondrial dysfunction and neuronal death.
28115010.summary: In MS brain tissue and mice with EAE, the protein Rab32 rises with cell stress, and high levels damaged mitochondria and killed human neurons in lab cultures.

27682872.conclusion_quote: Our results show that increased activation of B-cells is present following successful TB treatment, and that the expression of FASLG and IL5RA could potentially be utilised as a signature to monitor treatment response.
27682872.summary: In human tuberculosis patients, B cell gene expression rose after successful treatment, suggesting FASLG and IL5RA could help monitor treatment response.

27733015.mechanism: boosts IL-10 and regulatory T cells
27733015.conclusion_quote: The data indicate SVF cells effectively ameliorated the EAE immunopathogenesis and supports the potential use of SVF for treating MS.
27733015.summary: In mice with EAE, treatment started after disease onset with stromal vascular fraction cells or adipose stem cells improved motor function and reduced CNS inflammation.

28507026.mechanism: Inhibits GAPDH glycolysis, reducing T-cell IFN-gamma production
28507026.conclusion_quote: Finally, in transfer models of EAE, 3-BrPa robustly attenuates the encephalitogenic potential of EAE-driving immune cells.
28507026.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug that blocks the sugar-burning enzyme GAPDH reduced the ability of inflammatory immune cells to cause disease, mainly by lowering IFN-gamma production.

28462950.mechanism: Competes with ZAP70 for RhoH, limiting TCR signaling
28462950.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings indicate that TAGAP is a novel factor required for T H 17-cell differentiation and that TAGAP potentially represents a novel target of autoimmune disease therapies.
28462950.summary: Mice lacking the TAGAP gene had milder experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, an MS-like disease, because their immune cells made fewer disease-driving Th17 cells.

28851959.mechanism: Not applicable: imaging probe study without a treatment
28851959.conclusion_quote: The 19 F-CRP is a valuable tool that will allow us to study neuroinflammation with greater detail in future in vivo studies.
28851959.summary: A cryogenically cooled coil improved fluorine MRI sensitivity, letting researchers see inflammation in brains of mice with EAE, a model of MS, in finer detail.

28386103.conclusion_quote: Taken together, we demonstrate that CMV drives the expansion of CD4 + CD28 null T cells, thereby boosting the activation of disease-specific CD4 + T cells and aggravating autoimmune mediated inflammation and demyelination.
28386103.summary: Mice infected with murine cytomegalovirus before induction of EAE had worse symptoms and spinal cord demyelination, linked to expansion of CD4 CD28 null T cells.

28645323.mechanism: Not applicable: statistical method for ranking biomarkers
28645323.conclusion_quote: ERI method is more sensitive for significant feature detection during early stage of disease development.
28645323.summary: A new statistical method called early response index detected early changing proteins better than other tools in mice with a model of multiple sclerosis, aiding early biomarker discovery.

28336414.conclusion_quote: Importantly, in MS the proportion of IFNγ- and GM-CSF-secreting T cells expressing CCR6 was significantly enriched in the CSF, and was elevated in MS, suggesting these cells play a pathogenic role in this disease.
28336414.summary: In people with multiple sclerosis, most CCR6 carrying immune cells in spinal fluid were inflammatory Th1 cells or cells making only GM CSF.

28243437.conclusion_quote: These results highlight the profound impact that EBV-infected B-LCL cells can have on second and third co-stimulatory signals involved in (autoreactive) T-cell activation.
28243437.summary: In marmoset monkeys with EAE, B cells infected with Epstein Barr virus were grown alongside immune cells, which changed T cell signals and increased IL-17A production.

27488372.mechanism: Not a treatment, dendritic cells used to induce autoimmunity
27488372.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrated that the use of CD11c+ BMDC can enable the development of autopathogenic T-cells to be studied in vivo without the unwanted side-effects of long-lasting injection site inflammation.
27488372.summary: In mice, dendritic cells loaded with myelin protein triggered EAE as well as adjuvant injections did, while causing much less injection site inflammation.

28486971.mechanism: Reduces IL-1β secretion by antigen presenting cells
28486971.conclusion_quote: Together, these data support a novel role for cathepsin Z in the propagation of IL-1β-driven neuroinflammation.
28486971.summary: In mice with EAE, removing cathepsin Z reduced neuroinflammation and lowered circulating IL-1β, which reduced the immune cells that drive damage.

28104252.mechanism: Fingolimod traps lymphocytes, fumarate activates NRF2
28104252.conclusion_quote: We have standardized and validated the adult zebrafish EAE model.
28104252.summary: In adult zebrafish with EAE, fingolimod, dimethyl fumarate, dexamethasone and SR1001 each modulated disease in ways matching rodent results, supporting a quick drug-screening model.

27890794.mechanism: Restores PI3K/Akt/mTOR signalling, lowers IFN-γ and IL-17, raises PPARγ
27890794.conclusion_quote: These results provide an interesting discovery about the regulation of the PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway by cannabidiol administration, that could be a new potential therapeutic target for MS management.
27890794.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, cannabidiol given after symptom onset restored a disrupted cell-signalling pathway, reduced inflammatory cytokines, and promoted neuronal survival.

27840065.conclusion_quote: The data showed that the DA-Bead method for analysis was comparable to, if not superior to, the conventional method in terms of consistency/precision, accuracy, sensitivity and dynamic range and these results are not specific to sample type, reagents, or commercial vendor.
27840065.summary: Researchers compared two cytokine measurement methods on immune samples, including plasma from mice with EAE, and found the plate method using less sample performed as well or better.

28842429.mechanism: Secreted factors suppress inflammation and oxidative stress
28842429.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings suggest H-hPDLSCs-CM as a new pharmacologic opportunity for the management of MS.
28842429.summary: In mice with EAE, secretome from hypoxia-treated human periodontal ligament stem cells reduced symptoms and inflammation when given at symptom onset.

29273052.mechanism: No treatment tested, imaging tracer study
29273052.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that P2Y12R and P2X7R are excellent targets for PET imaging to discriminate distinct microglia phenotypes in MS.
29273052.summary: Researchers studied two microglia receptors, P2X7R and P2Y12R, as possible PET imaging targets in animals with EAE and human MS tissue, finding they could help distinguish microglia types.

28058759.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, although these sperm treatments promoted nuclear decondensation and induced plasma membrane disruption, these effects were not sufficient to improve bovine embryonic development after ICSI.
28058759.summary: In cattle sperm before injection into eggs, glutathione and membrane-disrupting agents loosened sperm structures but did not improve embryo development. This is not an MS study.

28689297.mechanism: Promotes regulatory immune cell subsets, reduces proinflammatory responses
28689297.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that with the exception of CD4 + CD25 + FoxP3 + Treg cells, E2 protection against EAE promotes highly overlapping immunoregulatory subsets in OVX females and males.
28689297.summary: Estrogen given before disease onset protected both ovariectomized female and male mice with EAE by boosting calming immune cells.

28682305.conclusion_quote: These findings reveal that the IFN-γ produced during inflammation could contribute towards disrupting the BBB and promoting TEM of CD4 + T cells.
28682305.summary: In lab cultures of brain blood vessel cells linked to EAE, the immune signal IFN-γ made the barrier leaky and helped CD4 T cells cross into the brain.

28804608.mechanism: Secretes neurotrophic factors aiding myelin repair
28804608.conclusion_quote: NTF-SCs transplantation represents a valuable option for cell-based therapy in the nervous tissue damages.
28804608.summary: In rats with spinal cord demyelination, transplanted cells that secrete neurotrophic factors increased myelin repair and thickness compared with controls.

28559895.mechanism: Boosts autophagy, reducing inflammatory cytokine production
28559895.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate for the first time that activating α7nAChR enhances monocyte/microglia autophagy, which suppresses neuroinflammation and thus plays an alleviative role in EAE.
28559895.summary: In mice with EAE and in cultured microglia, activating the alpha7 receptor with PNU282987 boosted autophagy and reduced inflammation, easing disease severity.

28388913.conclusion_quote: Our findings support the notion that axonal loss could occur early in EAE mice.
28388913.summary: In mice with EAE, a diffusion MRI method measured about 15 percent nerve fiber loss in the optic nerve at the onset of vision problems, even with nerve swelling present.

28468969.mechanism: Inhibits CK2 kinase, reducing PI3K/Akt/mTOR and STAT3 signaling
28468969.conclusion_quote: Our data implicate CK2 as a regulator of the Th17/Treg axis and Th17 cell maturation and suggest that CK2 could be targeted for the treatment of Th17 cell-driven autoimmune disorders.
28468969.summary: In mice with EAE, a CK2 kinase inhibitor given after disease onset reduced severity by lowering harmful Th17 cells in the CNS.

28824611.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings emphasize the role of other cellular sources of activated NOX than phagocytes not only during EAE but also in models of amyloid pathology.
28824611.summary: In aged mice with a model of cerebral amyloid angiopathy, brain immune enzyme NOX was overactive around blood vessels, while normal young and old mice showed low levels.

28615334.conclusion_quote: Here, we demonstrate the feasibility of whole-brain diffusion-weighted tractography in anesthetized marmosets at ultrahigh-field MRI (9.4T) and propose protocols for isolating nine major white matter fiber tracts in the marmoset brain.
28615334.summary: This imaging methods study used 9.4T brain scans in healthy anesthetized marmoset monkeys to map nine major white matter fiber tracts, testing no treatment or disease model.

28591859.conclusion_quote: Because of the large numbers of ticks recorded, wild deer on St. John could develop associated health problems (pruritis, alopecia, anemia, low weight gain, tick-borne pathogens and parasites) and could also serve as a source of these ticks for cattle and horses.
28591859.summary: This tick survey on St. John found two tick species on wild deer, but it did not study multiple sclerosis or any treatment.

28776665.conclusion_quote: Our findings offer a reference baseline for identifying accurately abnormalities of the heart and arteries in embryos that have largely completed organogenesis.
28776665.summary: Mouse embryos were analysed with high resolution imaging to define normal heart and artery anatomy and find abnormalities in embryos with lethal gene mutations, unrelated to multiple sclerosis.

28134325.mechanism: Basophil IL-6 secretion promotes Th17 cell differentiation
28134325.conclusion_quote: Therefore, our results indicate that basophils are an important inducer of T H 17 cell differentiation, which is dependent on IL-6 secretion.
28134325.summary: In mice with EAE, removing basophils or their IL-6 production reduced Th17 immune responses and lowered disease features, showing basophils drive Th17 cell development.

28363754.mechanism: Growth factor that enhances oligodendrocyte-driven myelin repair
28363754.conclusion_quote: Our findings highlight the potential use of IGF-1 as remyelinating therapy for MS, particularly the progressive stage in which chronic demyelination is the hallmark.
28363754.summary: In young and aged rats with spinal cord demyelination, continuous intrathecal IGF-1 enhanced myelin repair, while insulin had no effect.

28153692.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that chronically demyelinated mice are a valuable model with which we may begin to understand the mechanisms underlying demyelination-induced seizures.
28153692.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to chronically strip myelin, researchers observed seizure activity, loss of inhibitory interneurons, and widespread scarring, suggesting a useful model for MS-related seizures.

28836399.mechanism: Engineered stem cells secrete anti-inflammatory cytokines
28836399.conclusion_quote: These results showed that gene therapy using anti-inflammatory cytokines can be a promising approach against multiple sclerosis (MS).
28836399.summary: In mice with EAE, stem cells engineered to produce anti-inflammatory cytokines reduced brain inflammation and lesions and improved weight and physical activity.

28978041.mechanism: removes sperm RNAs before fertilization in embryo development
28978041.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrated that the sperm-carried RNAs have important roles in embryonic development.
28978041.summary: In mice, removing RNAs from sperm before injecting them into eggs lowered embryo development and birth rates. This embryo study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

29216327.mechanism: Neutralizes inhibitory proteoglycans, blocks PTPRZ signaling
29216327.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that PRM has CSPG-neutralizing activity which promotes oligodendrocyte differentiation under developmental and morbid conditions.
29216327.summary: In mice with myelin loss caused by cuprizone, protamine injected into brain fluid spaces helped nerve fibers regain their myelin coating.

28302135.mechanism: Deleting C/EBPβ in microglia dampens inflammatory gene expression
28302135.conclusion_quote: This study provides new data that support a central role for C/EBPβ in the biology of activated microglia, and it offers proof of concept for the therapeutic potential of microglial C/EBPβ inhibition in multiple sclerosis.
28302135.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the C/EBPβ gene only in microglia calmed inflammatory gene activity and reduced clinical disease signs.

28496060.conclusion_quote: By using multidimensional analysis of variation coefficient and principal component analysis for the repeatability and 48 h stability, the method was demonstrated to have good repeatability, excellent precision, and high stability, which can satisfy the metabonomics research requirement.
28496060.summary: A mass spectrometry method identified eight small molecule metabolites that differed in serum from liver cancer patients compared with healthy people, but no MS research was done.

28404595.mechanism: Deleting NLRC4 and NLRP3 reduces inflammasome-driven glial activation
28404595.conclusion_quote: These results reveal that NLRC4 and NLRP3, which normally form distinct inflammasomes, activate an LPC-induced inflammasome and are important in astrogliosis and microgliosis.
28404595.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing both the NLRC4 and NLRP3 immune sensors reduced brain inflammation, with fewer activated astrocytes and microglia.

28363057.conclusion_quote: This study suggested that differential expression of seminal plasma characteristics modulating sperm function is one of the mechanisms by which reproductive seasonality affects sperm function in the North American bison.
28363057.summary: This study compared seminal plasma and sperm function between breeding and nonbreeding seasons in North American bison. It does not study multiple sclerosis or demyelination.

29152583.mechanism: blocks retrograde vesicular transport to endoplasmic reticulum
29152583.conclusion_quote: In summary, these data indicate that inhibition of retrograde vesicular transport in vivo controls infection in a natural PyV mouse model and supports development of these compounds as potential therapeutic agents for individuals at risk for human PyV-associated diseases.
29152583.summary: In mice infected with mouse polyomavirus, the drug Retro-2.1 reduced virus levels in the kidney without harming kidney function. This is not a study of multiple sclerosis.

28599235.mechanism: Not applicable, analytical chemistry method only
28599235.conclusion_quote: Thus, the spot test method associated with DIB allows the use of devices as digital cameras and smartphones to evaluate colorimetric reaction with low waste generation, practicality, quickness, accuracy, precision, high portability and low-cost.
28599235.summary: A smartphone camera colour test measured copper in sugarcane spirits as accurately as flame atomic absorption, a standard lab method, but involved no animals or MS research.

28828543.conclusion_quote: These results showed that Myo6 is one of the unconventional myosins in oligodendrocyte lineage cells, which could play a role in clathrin-related endocytosis.
28828543.summary: In normal mice and mice given the toxin cuprizone to strip myelin, researchers found that the motor protein Myo6 is present in oligodendrocytes, the cells that make myelin.

27178192.mechanism: Blocks Wnt signaling to restore myelination
27178192.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that NMS impairs mPFC cognitive functions, at least in part, through modulation of oligodendrogenesis and myelination.
27178192.summary: In rats separated from their mothers early in life, blocking Wnt signaling with XAV939 partly restored prefrontal myelination and improved behavior.

28289377.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease effects only
28289377.conclusion_quote: Thus, the loss of oligodendrocytes and myelin sheaths bears functional consequences beyond the main axon, impeding the temporal fidelity of presynaptic APs and affecting the functional and structural organization of synaptic connectivity within the neocortex.
28289377.summary: In mice given cuprizone to strip myelin, myelin loss slowed nerve signals and caused signal failure at nerve branches and new branch growth.

28009439.mechanism: Boosts myelin repair in demyelinated spinal cord
28009439.conclusion_quote: Our adapted sudan black staining can be used to rapidly and non-toxically screen for remyelinating therapies in demyelinating diseases.
28009439.summary: Researchers developed a fast, easy, less toxic dye staining method to detect myelin repair in rat spinal cord tissue, and showed it detects benztropine's remyelination effect.

28231842.mechanism: tPA promotes migration via EGF receptor activation
28231842.conclusion_quote: Endogenous tPA facilitates the migration of OPCs during development and during remyelination after white matter lesion by the virtue of its epidermal growth factor-like domain.
28231842.summary: In mice lacking tPA, oligodendrocyte progenitor cells migrated more slowly during development and while repairing lesions in white matter, showing tPA helps them move.

29253893.mechanism: Blocks histamine receptor 3, lowering cAMP and HDAC1
29253893.conclusion_quote: From phenotypic screening to human genetics, we provide evidence for H3R as a novel therapeutic target to promote remyelination in patients with multiple sclerosis.
29253893.summary: In a mouse model of demyelination, a brain-penetrating drug that blocks histamine receptor 3 enhanced myelin repair and protected nerve fibers.

27569659.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that remyelination of white and gray matter lesions have a different functional regeneration potential, with the white matter being able to regain full functionality while cortical gray matter lesions suffer from permanently altered network function.
27569659.summary: In animal models of demyelination, white matter lesions fully recovered function after remyelination, while cortical gray matter lesions caused permanent loss of network function.

28899916.mechanism: activates PKA signaling to restore oligodendrocyte maturation
28899916.conclusion_quote: Together, GD1a overcomes the inhibiting effect of aggregated fibronectin on OPC maturation by activating a PKA-dependent signaling pathway.
28899916.summary: In rat cells and cuprizone-treated mice with demyelination, the lipid GD1a reversed fibronectin-driven blocking of myelin formation by activating a PKA signaling pathway.

26855677.conclusion_quote: Overall, the results suggest that, like experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, results from the standard cuprizone model should be carefully considered relative to clinical multiple sclerosis.
26855677.summary: In mice given the cuprizone diet, a proteomic analysis found 43 proteins detectable or undetectable across cortex, muscle, spleen and blood cells, hinting at axonal damage.

28069926.mechanism: boosts mitochondrial ATP production and prevents oligodendrocyte apoptosis
28069926.conclusion_quote: Together, our results demonstrate a novel function for creatine in promoting oligodendrocyte viability during CNS remyelination.
28069926.summary: In mice with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, creatine reduced oligodendrocyte death and increased myelin-forming cells in lesions, suggesting it supports myelin repair.

28899915.mechanism: Removes calcium channel from progenitor cells, reducing maturation
28899915.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that Ca 2+ influx mediated by L-VGCCs in oligodendroglial cells is necessary for normal remyelination and is an essential Ca 2+ channel for OPC maturation during the remyelination of the adult brain.
28899915.summary: In mice with demyelination from cuprizone, deleting the calcium channel Cav1.2 from progenitor cells slowed their maturation and impaired myelin repair.

28780738.conclusion_quote: He was an eminent success as a research scientist as well as an outstanding educator and mentor.
28780738.summary: This obituary describes John P. Craig, a physician scientist known for cholera research and teaching, and reports no experiments on MS.

27233903.mechanism: Reduces T cell infiltration, repairs white matter
27233903.conclusion_quote: Our study provides pre-clinical evidence to support the feasibility of treating MS by transplantation of iPSC-derived NSCs.
27233903.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, transplanted neural stem cells derived from induced pluripotent stem cells reduced immune cell infiltration, repaired white matter damage, and improved motor ability.

28694334.mechanism: Deleting Tsc1 in progenitor cells raises mTOR activity
28694334.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal a complex role for TSC in oligodendrocytes during remyelination in which the timing of Tsc1 deletion is a critical determinant of its effect on remyelination.
28694334.summary: In adult mice with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, deleting Tsc1 in progenitor cells sped up myelin repair, while deleting it in maturing oligodendrocytes slowed repair.

25146304.conclusion_quote: Here we describe step-by-step protocols for tissue processing, sectioning, and conventional and immunohistochemical stainings to display as well as quantify CNS inflammation, demyelination, and neuronal damage in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), an animal model of Multiple Sclerosis (MS).
25146304.summary: This methods guide explains how to prepare, stain, and measure inflammation, demyelination, and nerve damage in EAE, an animal model of MS.

27400748.mechanism: Loss of LRP1 increases microglial inflammatory NF-kB activation
27400748.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data suggest that the function of LRP1 in microglia is to keep these cells in an anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective status during inflammatory insult, including experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis and potentially in Multiple sclerosis.
27400748.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the LRP1 receptor from microglia, the brain's immune cells, worsened disease and increased inflammation.

26724970.conclusion_quote: Building on these observations with supporting epidemiologic and biologic evidence, we propose that, contrary to conventional wisdom that subclinical pertussis infections are innocuous to hosts, B. pertussis colonization is an important cause of multiple sclerosis.
26724970.summary: This paper proposes that subclinical whooping cough bacteria colonization may cause multiple sclerosis, based on existing evidence rather than new experiments.

27611574.mechanism: blocks IL-10 receptor signaling, removing immune suppression
27611574.conclusion_quote: IL-10R neutralization causes a breakdown in peripheral immune tolerance in genetically predisposed mice, which leads to immune-mediated colitis, resembling inflammatory bowel disease.
27611574.summary: In SJL mice infected with a virus that affects the brain and spinal cord, blocking the IL-10 receptor with an antibody caused or worsened bowel inflammation.

25208751.conclusion_quote: This model can be used for exploratory research, i.e., investigating the pathogenic mechanisms involved in MS, and applied research, testing the efficacy of new potential drugs.
25208751.summary: Describes how to induce EAE, a multiple sclerosis-like disease, in common marmosets and the immune lab methods used to study it.

27882351.mechanism: Gain-of-function Nav1.2 mutation increases persistent sodium currents
27882351.conclusion_quote: Thus, this study shows that increased neuronal Na V 1.2 activity exacerbates inflammation-induced neurodegeneration irrespective of immune cell alterations and identifies Na V 1.2 as a promising neuroprotective drug target in multiple sclerosis.
27882351.summary: In mice with EAE, a human gain-of-function mutation boosting sodium channel Nav1.2 activity increased nerve damage and disability without changing immune cell infiltration.

26545087.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data suggest that EAE may be a useful model for understanding MS-related trigeminal neuropathic pain conditions such as trigeminal neuralgia.
26545087.summary: Mice with EAE showed increased sensitivity to air puffs on the whisker pad, along with immune cell infiltration, glial activation and demyelination of trigeminal nerve pathways.

26614512.mechanism: Blocks IL-1β effects in dorsal root ganglia
26614512.conclusion_quote: Thus, our results suggest that hypernociception in this experimental model of EAE may be a consequence of the increase in some cytokines in DRGs, especially IL-1β.
26614512.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody that blocks interleukin 1 signaling reduced pain sensitivity, suggesting interleukin 1 beta drives this pain.

26925573.mechanism: Loss of TSPO reduces astrocyte activation
26925573.conclusion_quote: The TSPO-/- mouse could be a useful tool in better understanding the role of TSPO in CNS disease, and our results implicate TSPO as a potential therapeutic target in MS.
26925573.summary: In mice with EAE, a conditional knockout removing TSPO from neural cells reduced astrogliosis and lessened disease severity, suggesting TSPO as a possible MS target.

27909192.conclusion_quote: Even though EAE is routinely used in many laboratories and is often part of the routine assessment of knockouts and transgenes, scoring of the disease course has not become standardized in the community, with at least 83 published scoring variants.
27909192.summary: This commentary reviews how mice with EAE, a model of MS, are scored, highlighting no standard scale across labs and frequent statistical errors.

27060373.conclusion_quote: Overall, the marmoset model provides unique opportunities for systemic drug-effect profiling.
27060373.summary: This review argues that marmoset monkeys with EAE, a model of MS, may better predict human drug effects than mice because their immune systems and brain lesions resemble humans.
