28603559.conclusion_quote: We have compared and contrasted the three models induced by one single pathogen, TMEV, particularly in regard to the roles of T helper cells and natural killer T cells, which will give an insight into how interactions between the immune system and the host's genetic background determine the tissue tropism of virus and the development of virus-induced organ-specific immunopathology.
28603559.summary: This review compares three mouse disease models caused by Theiler's virus, covering MS, seizures and heart inflammation, and how immune cells and genetics shape them.

26276126.mechanism: blocks pannexin channels reducing T cell activation
26276126.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, probenecid prevented the onset of EAE.
26276126.summary: Daily probenecid, a pannexin channel blocker, reduced clinical symptoms and inflammatory lesions in mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis.

26839070.conclusion_quote: Thus, it is clear that in comparison of an EAE-susceptible with an EAE-resistant strain of rats, various discrepancies at the level of gut associated lymphoid tissue, as well as at the level of gut microbiota can be observed.
26839070.summary: In rats, a strain that develops EAE was compared with a resistant strain, revealing differences in gut immune tissue and gut bacteria. No treatment was tested.

27610007.mechanism: Removing mast cell protease reduces early inflammation
27610007.conclusion_quote: Together, the present study supports a role for mMCP-4 in the early inflammatory phases of the disease in a mouse model of MS.
27610007.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the mast cell enzyme mMCP-4 reduced early disease symptoms, preserved spinal myelin, and lowered brain endothelin-1 levels.

27536199.conclusion_quote: The present data suggest that mature DCs cause an imbalance between Th17 and Treg by secreting TGF-β1 and IL-6 in the pathogenesis of EAE disease.
27536199.summary: In mice with EAE, the researchers found more mature dendritic cells in the spleen, which were linked to an imbalance between inflammatory and regulatory immune cells.

28018327.conclusion_quote: Our data contribute to the idea that gut microbiota and GALT considerably influence multiple sclerosis pathogenesis.
28018327.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model of MS, resistant rats had more diverse Lactobacillus gut bacteria than susceptible rats, suggesting gut microbes influence disease.

27624721.mechanism: no treatment tested, observational study only
27624721.conclusion_quote: We conclude that mitochondrial dysfunction is a major cause of reversible neurological deficits in neuroinflammatory disease, such as MS.
27624721.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, live imaging of the spinal cord showed that mitochondria, the energy units inside nerve fibres, lost function early and tracked neurological symptoms.

27183579.conclusion_quote: Together, these data support an important role for ANKRD55 in multiple sclerosis and neuroinflammation.
27183579.summary: Researchers studied how the MS risk gene ANKRD55 is expressed in human immune cells and in mice with EAE, finding it was produced in immune cells and increased in inflamed brain tissue.

26679600.conclusion_quote: These findings expand previous studies showing presynaptic neural dysfunction occurring at the FrCx and might contribute to the understanding of the mechanisms involved in the genesis and prevalence of common MS symptoms.
26679600.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, immune cells called microglia and astrocytes became active in the frontal cortex within hours of onset, along with inflammatory signals.

27907119.conclusion_quote: A highly inflammatory condition primed to a white matter (WM) autoimmune response correlates with significant hypoxia and increased variation in oxygenation in GM of both cerebellum and cortex in the mouse EAE model of MS.
27907119.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, implanted sensors showed oxygen levels in brain gray matter were often lower than in control mice, with low oxygen appearing before behavioral symptoms.

26794621.mechanism: blocks protein binding to cell surface heparan sulfate
26794621.conclusion_quote: RX-111 exercises its broad spectrum anti-inflammatory activity by a singular mechanism of action, inhibition of protein binding to the cell surface GAG, heparan sulfate.
26794621.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the drug RX-111 reduced inflammation by blocking proteins from attaching to heparan sulfate on cell surfaces.

26773145.mechanism: blocks lymphocyte transmigration into the CNS
26773145.conclusion_quote: These findings underscore an important role for CD99 in the pathogenesis of CNS autoimmunity and suggest that it may serve as a novel therapeutic target for controlling neuroinflammation.
26773145.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody blocking CD99 reduced immune cells entering the central nervous system and eased disease, including relapses, when given after symptoms began.

27309150.mechanism: Selective CB2 agonist that reduces microglial activation
27309150.conclusion_quote: Compound 43 dampened neuroinflammation by reducing microglial activation in the TMEV.
27309150.summary: In mice with Theiler's virus-induced demyelinating disease, a selective CB2 agonist called PM226 reduced microglial activation and neuroinflammation.

27562847.mechanism: Reduces oxidative stress, inflammation and microglial activation
27562847.conclusion_quote: Our results show for the first time the therapeutic effects of NAS and confirm previous reports on the effectiveness of melatonin in the EAE model of MS.
27562847.summary: In mice with EAE, melatonin and N-acetylserotonin reduced symptoms, inflammation, nerve damage and myelin loss, with greater benefit when given before symptoms appeared.

26975859.conclusion_quote: MicroPET imaging modality with a specific radioligand [(11)C]TZ3321 is able to assess the expression of S1PR1 in EAE rat lumbar spinal cord.
26975859.summary: In rats with EAE, a PET scan using a radiotracer for S1PR1 showed higher uptake in the spinal cord, matching increased S1PR1 and inflammation.

27391474.mechanism: antibodies bind neuronal hnRNP A1 causing axonal degeneration
27391474.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that antibodies to the RNA-binding protein hnRNP A1 contribute to neurodegeneration in immune-mediated disease of the CNS.
27391474.summary: In mice with EAE, injecting antibodies against the protein hnRNP A1 worsened clinical disease and caused nerve degeneration in the spinal cord and cerebellum.

27120265.mechanism: Removing NCX3 exchanger impairs oligodendrocyte precursor response
27120265.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate that knocking-out NCX3 impairs oligodendrocyte response and worsens clinical symptoms in EAE without altering the immune T-cell population.
27120265.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the NCX3 calcium exchanger gene impaired oligodendrocyte precursor cell response and worsened disease symptoms, without changing immune T cell numbers.

25005074.conclusion_quote: Experimental autoimmune encephalitis (EAE), the animal model of multiple sclerosis (MS), has provided significant insight into the mechanisms that initiate and drive autoimmunity.
25005074.summary: This methods chapter explains how to induce EAE, a mouse model of MS, in several mouse strains, and how to collect immune cells from the brain and spinal cord.

27796368.mechanism: Activates CD8 regulatory T cells targeting myelin epitope
27796368.conclusion_quote: Hence, this study reveals a novel regulatory mechanism mediated by the CD8 + Treg cells.
27796368.summary: Immunizing mice with a myelin protein fragment activated CD8 regulatory T cells that suppressed ongoing EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis.

27713744.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes pain and inflammation
27713744.conclusion_quote: Overall, these findings suggest that different pathological mechanisms may underlie stimulus-evoked and spontaneous pain in EAE, and that these behaviors predominate in unique stages of the disease.
27713744.summary: In mice with EAE, pain-like sensitivity and facial grimacing appeared at different disease stages, linked to distinct nerve and immune changes.

26895672.mechanism: increases inducible regulatory T cell numbers, reduces Th17 cells
26895672.conclusion_quote: Cumulatively, zinc supplementation seems to be capable to induce tolerance in unwanted immune reactions by increasing iTreg cells.
26895672.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, daily zinc supplements reduced disease scores, lowered inflammatory Th17 cells and increased regulatory T cells.

27466819.mechanism: blocks VEGFR2 receptor signaling in neurons
27466819.conclusion_quote: These results imply the protective effects of the VEGF-A/VEGFR2 signaling on lower motor neurons and axons in the spinal cord in MS and EAE.
27466819.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the VEGFR2 receptor with SU5416 after symptoms began worsened loss of lower motor neurons and axons in the spinal cord.

27592741.conclusion_quote: In summary, we showed that acute axonal damage is evident under various experimental demyelination paradigms.
27592741.summary: In mice with EAE, cuprizone diet, or lysolecithin injury models, researchers found acute axonal damage in all three, most strongly in lysolecithin lesions.

27833528.conclusion_quote: The results showed significant and reversible modifications in white matter and gray matter regions such as in the rostral and caudal corpus callosum, the external capsule, the cerebellar peduncles, the caudate putamen, the thalamus, and the somatosensory cortex of treated mice.
27833528.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that strips myelin, high-field MRI tracked brain damage and spontaneous recovery, with T2 and radial diffusivity most sensitive to changes.

26924461.mechanism: Full agonist of S1P1 receptor, limits lymphocyte trafficking
26924461.conclusion_quote: Isoxazole 6d demonstrated impressive efficacy when administered orally in a rat model of arthritis and in a mouse experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) model of multiple sclerosis.
26924461.summary: Researchers tested a new oral isoxazole compound, 6d, which activates the S1P1 receptor, and found it worked well in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

27384502.mechanism: Thyroid hormone boosts white and cortical remyelination
27384502.conclusion_quote: In summary, we describe an in vivo demyelination/remyelination paradigm that can be powered to determine efficacy of therapies that enhance white matter and cortical remyelination.
27384502.summary: In mice given a cuprizone diet to strip myelin, daily thyroid hormone T3 injections boosted remyelination in both white matter and cerebral cortex.

27605008.mechanism: Activates STAT6 to raise TGF-β and Tregs
27605008.conclusion_quote: These studies identify a new function of NaB in upregulating TGF-β via activation of STAT6, which may be beneficial in MS patients.
27605008.summary: In mice with EAE, sodium benzoate boosts TGF-β through STAT6 activation, increasing regulatory T cells and protecting against disease.

27842340.conclusion_quote: Immunization with either MOGtag or MOG1-125 generates an autoimmune response that includes pathogenic B cells that recognize the native mouse MOG.
27842340.summary: In mice with EAE, a new easy method produced large amounts of pure mouse myelin protein that triggers B cells recognizing the native protein.

27214391.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the data provide an overview of the functional profile of immune cells during EAE pathology.
27214391.summary: In mice with EAE, a MOG peptide model, researchers mapped immune cells and inflammatory cytokines across disease phases in the spinal cord, lymph nodes, spleen and blood.

27581174.mechanism: Depletes pathogenic CD4 T cells expressing high CD48
27581174.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that anti-CD48 mAb exerts its therapeutic effects by both limiting CD4 + T cell proliferation and preferentially eliminating pathogenic CD48 ++ CD4 + T cells during EAE.
27581174.summary: In mice with EAE, an anti-CD48 antibody reduced clinical disease and lowered the number of pathogenic CD4 T cells in the central nervous system and spleen.

27611715.mechanism: Shifts cytokine balance toward IL-4 producing T cells
27611715.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our data suggest that NaB is able to induce IL-4 production by human PBMCs and therefore might be a useful candidate for conjunctive therapy in RR-MS.
27611715.summary: In a lab study of immune cells from 20 relapsing MS patients, sodium benzoate increased IL-4 producing cells and reduced interferon gamma producing cells.

26805386.mechanism: Activates EGFR pathway to boost oligodendrocyte progenitor differentiation
26805386.conclusion_quote: Tβ4 could potentially be developed as a therapy for MS patients, and for other demyelinating neurological disorders.
26805386.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, thymosin beta4 increased new myelin-making cells, remyelination, and neurological recovery, acting through the EGFR pathway.

27570231.mechanism: Raises body iron, increasing lipid peroxidation and ferritin in tissues
27570231.conclusion_quote: The data point to sexual dimorphism in mechanisms that regulate peripheral and brain iron homeostasis and imply that men and women during MS might be differentially vulnerable to exogenous iron overload.
27570231.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, iron overload sped disease onset in females and worsened progression and deaths in males, showing sex differences in iron handling.

27032554.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, influence of inflammation-triggered mechanisms on synaptic transmission may explain the negative effect of EAE on learning abilities in rats.
27032554.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, hippocampal synaptic transmission and long term potentiation were impaired, suggesting a possible cause of learning problems.

27250994.mechanism: Proposed immunomodulation, no CNS migration detected
27250994.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our data does not provide substantiation for a relevant migration of infused MSCs into the CNS of EAE mice supporting the hypothesis that potential therapeutic efficacy could be based on systemic effects.
27250994.summary: In mice with EAE, infused bone marrow stem cells did not reduce disease and were not found in the brain or spinal cord.

26855861.conclusion_quote: This method will allow investigators to look at the entire spinal cord on a single slide and evaluate the spinal cord with and without classic EAE lesions.
26855861.summary: Researchers developed a method to examine the whole spinal cord on one slide in mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, revealing uneven lesion distribution.

27388119.conclusion_quote: The present structural findings indicate that the Arg at positions 41 and 46 is a key residue for the stimulation of the encephalitogenic T-cells.
27388119.summary: Computer simulations of a myelin peptide bound to HLA and T-cell receptors found arginines 41 and 46 anchor T-cell recognition, with no animal or cell experiments.

26514969.mechanism: Inhibits neural stem cell apoptosis, promotes oligodendrocyte differentiation
26514969.conclusion_quote: In summary, scutellarin could alleviate motor deficits in a mouse model for MS, possibly by inhibiting NSC apoptosis and promoting differentiation of NSCs to myelin-producing oligodendrocytes.
26514969.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, the plant flavonoid scutellarin improved motor function and myelin, likely by protecting neural stem cells that make myelin-producing cells.

26540733.conclusion_quote: Conceptually, incorporation of dietary Neu5Gc into vital regions of the central nervous system, such as the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and the axon-myelin unit, creates targets for binding of de novo synthesized heterophilic anti-NeuGc antibodies.
26540733.summary: This viewpoint article proposes that long term red meat intake, which supplies a sugar humans cannot make, may be an overlooked trigger for multiple sclerosis. It reports no experiments.

27911409.conclusion_quote: However, inter-laboratory reliability is only achieved if the various testing parameters are replicated.
27911409.summary: This protocol explains how to run the Rotarod balance test in mice with a virus caused disease similar to progressive MS to measure disability consistently across labs.

27106785.mechanism: Raises netrin1 and DCC, lowers RhoA
27106785.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrated that YGPs exhibited a neuroprotective effect on promoting nerve regeneration at the brain and spinal cord in EAE mice induced by MOG35-55.
27106785.summary: Traditional Chinese You-Gui pills were given to mice with EAE, an MS model, which reduced nerve damage, improved nerve repair markers, and lowered neurological symptom scores.

26777627.mechanism: suppresses Th1 cell responses and inflammatory cell infiltration
26777627.conclusion_quote: These results indicated that Sal B may serve as an effective therapeutic agent for MS/EAE by inhibiting Th1 cell responses.
26777627.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, daily salvianolic acid B injections starting after symptom onset reduced disease severity by blocking Th1 immune cell responses.

27196935.mechanism: Removes IL-6 production from astrocytes, lowering CNS inflammation
27196935.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that astrocyte-secreted IL-6 has some roles in EAE pathogenesis, at least in females.
27196935.summary: In mice with EAE, removing IL-6 from astrocytes did not change overall symptoms, but delayed onset in females and reduced inflammation and demyelination.

27884750.mechanism: reduces elevated serum lactate and spinal inflammation
27884750.conclusion_quote: These data confirmed for the first time, that methylprednisolone can decreases the enhanced level of serum lactate in EAE model.
27884750.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, methylprednisolone lowered raised blood lactate, reduced spinal inflammation and demyelination, and improved clinical scores.

26725831.mechanism: Promotes oligodendrocyte maturation and reduces astrogliosis
26725831.conclusion_quote: Our data clearly indicate that T3 promotes remyelination in chronic lesions by both enhancing oligodendrocyte maturation and attenuating astrogliosis.
26725831.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, triiodothyronine (T3) treatment increased myelin repair and reduced scarring by astrocytes, a type of support cell.

27733550.mechanism: Reduces T-cell EMMPRIN expression by lowering P-Akt levels
27733550.conclusion_quote: Overall, minocycline attenuated the activation-induced elevation of EMMPRIN on T cells in culture and in EAE mice, correspondent with reduced immune function and EAE CNS pathology.
27733550.summary: In mice with EAE and in human immune cells, minocycline lowered EMMPRIN, a protein that drives inflammation, which prevented disease and reduced brain inflammation.

26810225.mechanism: Activates nicotinic receptors, reducing myeloid cell entry
26810225.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data provide evidence that nAChRs can regulate proinflammatory cell infiltration into the CNS, which could be of significant value for the treatment of neuroinflammatory disorders.
26810225.summary: In mice with EAE, nicotine acting through certain nicotinic receptors reduced harmful inflammatory immune cells entering the brain and spinal cord.

27343802.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes neuronal stress marker
27343802.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results suggest that the clinical manifestations in the EAE result not only from central demyelination but also from neuronal stress and subsequent pathophysiology of sensory neurons.
27343802.summary: In EAE, an animal model of MS, the stress marker ATF3 rose in sensory nerve cells and brainstem before motor symptoms and before T cells arrived.

26917946.mechanism: Not applicable, biomarker discovery method only
26917946.conclusion_quote: Combining PhiSSH with NGS will be useful for controlled in vivo screening of small peptide combinatorial libraries to discover biomarkers of specific molecular alterations interspersed within healthy tissues.
26917946.summary: Researchers developed a DNA subtraction method to find peptides that bind inflamed tissue in rats with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, to help discover biomarkers.

26363796.conclusion_quote: In summary, lesion progression is most intense in myelin-rich white matter regions, irrespective of the initial lesion trigger mechanism.
26363796.summary: Lesions in mice given cuprizone or lysophosphatidylcholine, and in human MS brains, grew larger in myelin-rich white matter than in gray matter.

26607112.mechanism: neutralizes CXCR7, reducing microglial migration via ERK1/2 signaling
26607112.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data demonstrate that CXCR7 suppression modulates microglial chemotaxis to ameliorate EAE.
26607112.summary: In mice with EAE, a CXCR7 blocking treatment reduced disease severity and microglial movement into the nervous system, and lowered ERK1/2 signaling.

26663200.conclusion_quote: The results obtained disclose an intense IgG antibody response against both the recombinant protein and the immunizing peptide, while no response was observed against the other synthetic fragments, thus excluding the presence of an intramolecular epitope spreading mechanism.
26663200.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers mapped which parts of the myelin protein MOG antibodies target, finding a strong response only to the immunizing peptide and the full protein.

27308096.conclusion_quote: Results from our and other studies further suggest that IL-10 produced by both macrophages and regulatory T cells may shift Th17 into more regulatory phenotypes, leading to reduced inflammatory response.
27308096.summary: In this review of prior work, IL-10 from macrophages and regulatory T cells was suggested to calm Th17 cells in mouse models of MS, arthritis and bowel inflammation.

27054832.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that susceptibility to injury and ability to repair vary across the brain, and whole-brain analysis is necessary to accurately characterize this model.
27054832.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that strips myelin, MRI scans showed demyelination and repair varied across brain regions, with the corpus callosum most affected.

26893156.mechanism: neutralizes mycobacterial adjuvant, reducing innate immune activation
26893156.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate that F(ab')2-mediated neutralization of adjuvant contributes to the therapeutic efficacy of anti-inflammatory IgG.
26893156.summary: In mice with EAE, IVIG and a fragment of it protected against disease when given early, with the fragment alone working as well by neutralizing the inflammation-driving adjuvant.

27129150.mechanism: Blocks LINGO-1 to promote myelin repair
27129150.conclusion_quote: Our research demonstrates remyelination might be an effective pathway to recover the function of neuronal axons and cognition in MS.
27129150.summary: In cuprizone-fed mice that model demyelination, an antibody blocking LINGO-1 improved learning and partly restored myelin protein and axonal transport proteins in the hippocampus.

27727297.conclusion_quote: Thus we conclude that measurement of sEMMPRIN in serum is not informative for disease activity in MS.
27727297.summary: Measured a soluble form of the immune protein EMMPRIN in blood and spinal fluid of people with MS, finding blood levels did not reflect disease activity.

26703077.mechanism: Reduces CNS nitric oxide and inflammatory cell infiltration
26703077.conclusion_quote: Together, our results suggest the use of LLLT as a therapeutic application during autoimmune neuroinflammatory responses, such as MS.
26703077.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, low-level laser light applied to the spinal cord reduced disease severity, delayed onset, and limited inflammation and myelin loss.

26957602.conclusion_quote: Therefore, myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein (MOG)-specific autoantibodies can initiate disease bouts by cooperating with the autoreactive T cells in helping them to recognize their autoantigen and become efficiently reactivated within the immune-deprived nervous tissue.
26957602.summary: In mice with EAE, antibodies made by B cells entered the brain alongside T cells, boosting their activation and triggering early clinical disease.

26921791.mechanism: blocks P2X7 receptor, reducing astrocyte activation
26921791.conclusion_quote: Our data reveal that activation of astrocytes occurs in forebrains of immunized rats at a very early stage of EAE, well before the symptomatic phase of the disease.
26921791.summary: In rats with EAE, a drug blocking the P2X7 receptor reduced early brain astrocyte activation and eased neurological symptoms.

27231712.mechanism: reduces NF-κB activation independent of Toll-like receptor signaling
27231712.conclusion_quote: Our results confirm that laquinimod prevents demyelination in the cuprizone mouse model for multiple sclerosis via downregulation of NF-κB activation.
27231712.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to model MS, the drug laquinimod prevented myelin loss and reduced inflammation and nerve damage, acting without the Toll-like receptor pathway.

26826008.mechanism: Inhibits GCPII enzyme, raising brain NAAG levels
26826008.conclusion_quote: GCPII inhibition is a promising treatment for cognitive impairment in MS, and doses providing equivalent exposures to 100mg/kg 2-PMPA in mice should be evaluated in clinical studies for the prevention and/or treatment of MS-related cognitive impairment.
26826008.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug blocking the GCPII enzyme prevented and treated cognitive decline, with the 100 mg/kg dose working best, though physical disease was unchanged.

27158987.conclusion_quote: The development of such a non-invasive procedure devoid of permanent genetic manipulation during the course of differentiation, in the context of multiple sclerosis, provides an avenue for studies with a greater cell- and human-specific focus, specifically in the context of genetic contributions to neurodegeneration and drug discovery.
27158987.summary: Researchers turned kidney cells from the urine of people with multiple sclerosis into stem cells, then into working nerve cells, creating a patient specific model for studying the disease.

27239035.mechanism: Boosts Treg cells, cuts inflammatory T cells
27239035.conclusion_quote: Moreover, the FMD promoted oligodendrocyte precursor cell regeneration and remyelination in axons in both EAE and cuprizone MS models, supporting its effects on both suppression of autoimmunity and remyelination.
27239035.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone models, periodic cycles of a fasting mimicking diet reduced symptoms and inflammation and promoted myelin repair.

27609283.mechanism: Suppresses inflammatory cytokine genes and immune cell infiltration
27609283.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results suggest anti-neuroinflammatory mechanisms by which COWE treatment delayed and suppressed the development of EAE and ameliorated the disease in mice with persistent clinical signs.
27609283.summary: Tested a Capparis ovata plant extract in mice with EAE, finding it delayed and reduced disease and lowered inflammatory gene activity.

27381476.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these results offer a minimally invasive approach to measuring ODC death in the blood of MS patients that may be used to monitor disease progression.
27381476.summary: Blood DNA markers from the MOG gene signaled dying myelin-making cells in mice fed cuprizone and were higher in MS patients during active relapses.

34527426.mechanism: Arg kinase knockout, no effect on EAE
34527426.conclusion_quote: Development of MOG-induced experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis is not dependent on Arg, but Arg plays a role for the number of B cells in immunized mice.
34527426.summary: Mice lacking the Arg kinase gene developed the same EAE as normal mice after MOG peptide immunization, though they had fewer splenic B cells.

26525654.mechanism: No treatment tested, imaging study only
26525654.conclusion_quote: Altogether our results demonstrate that DKI is sensitive to alterations of cortical areas and provides, along with WMTI metrics, information that is complementary to DT-derived metrics for the characterization of demyelination in both white and grey matter and subsequent inflammatory processes associated with a demyelinating event.
26525654.summary: In mice fed the toxin cuprizone, a brain scanning method called diffusion kurtosis imaging detected grey and white matter changes that standard scans missed during demyelination and recovery.

26673140.mechanism: Induces IL-33 and IL-5, expanding protective eosinophils
26673140.conclusion_quote: To our knowledge, this study is the first to report a role for helminth-induced IL-5 and IL-33 in protection against autoimmunity.
26673140.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, products from the liver fluke Fasciola hepatica reduced disease signs by boosting eosinophil immune cells through IL-5 and IL-33.

26945036.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
26945036.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that these 2 animal models might be appropriate for evaluation of distinct therapies for TLE.
26945036.summary: In two mouse models of temporal lobe epilepsy, researchers measured brain injury and inflammation, finding astrogliosis in kindled mice and neuron death and microgliosis in mice injected with a virus.

26783338.mechanism: Loss of microRNA reduces dendritic-cell-driven Th17 inflammation
26783338.conclusion_quote: Thus, miR-223 controls mDC-induced activation of pathologic Th17 responses during autoimmune inflammation.
26783338.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the microRNA miR-223 reduced disease, along with fewer inflammatory dendritic cells and Th17 immune cells in the central nervous system.

27327113.mechanism: Blocks effector T cell CNS entry
27327113.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight the role of myelin peptide-loaded APCs in myelin peptide-induced EAE and immune tolerance.
27327113.summary: In mice with EAE, a myelin protein given into the abdominal cavity blocked immune cells from entering the spinal cord and brain and prevented disease.

27633171.mechanism: Modulates immune cell phenotypes and immunoregulatory pathways
27633171.conclusion_quote: The presence of pronounced protective and immunomodulating effects of the probiotic E. faecium strain L-3 opens an opportunity of its application for the treatment of multiple sclerosis.
27633171.summary: In rats with EAE, a probiotic Enterococcus faecium strain and glatiramer acetate both reduced disease severity and shortened disease duration, working through different immune cell pathways.

27100937.mechanism: reverts microglia to a less reactive state
27100937.conclusion_quote: Together, our findings suggest that inflammation, but not demyelination, disrupts AIS integrity and that therapeutic intervention may protect and reverse this pathology.
27100937.summary: In mice with EAE, the axon initial segment, which starts nerve signals, was damaged by inflammation rather than demyelination. Treatment with didox reduced this damage and calmed microglia.

27144460.summary: This is a correction notice for a study of demyelination and axon damage in mice with MP4-induced EAE, not a new original study.

28078034.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes astrocyte-to-precursor conversion
28078034.conclusion_quote: We suggest that activated astrocyte could de-differentiate into OPCs and re-differentiate into mature oligodendrocytes, raising the possibility that astrocytes can be a potential source of OPCs in the adult demyelinated spinal cord.
28078034.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, spinal cord astrocytes were found to express markers of oligodendrocyte precursor cells during remission, suggesting they may help rebuild myelin.

26560636.mechanism: Inhibits myeloperoxidase, restoring blood-brain barrier integrity
26560636.conclusion_quote: These data indicate that inhibition of MPO by KYC restores blood-brain barrier integrity thereby limiting migration of myeloid cells into the CNS that drive EAE pathogenesis.
26560636.summary: Mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS, received a drug that blocks myeloperoxidase starting at peak disease. It reduced symptom severity and restored blood-brain barrier integrity.

27609273.conclusion_quote: Whether glial activation contributes to repair mechanisms or adversely affects the number of RGCs is currently unclear.
27609273.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found more microglia in the optic nerve and retina along with retinal ganglion cell loss at late stages.

26803641.conclusion_quote: This chapter outlines different methods employed in our labs to investigate the role of TLRs in EAE model.
26803641.summary: This methods chapter describes lab techniques for studying TLR immune sensors in mice with EAE, an animal model of MS. No treatment was tested.

27266875.conclusion_quote: Although the exact localization and relative intensity of IL-1β expression in EAE and MS is different, the staining pattern in both neuroinflammatory disorders is most consistent with the idea that the expression of IL-1β during lesion development is induced in the tissue rather than in the periphery.
27266875.summary: In monkeys with EAE and in human MS brain tissue, interleukin 1 beta was mainly produced within the brain itself rather than coming from the blood.

26943960.mechanism: Suppresses mTOR and HIF-1α, boosting Treg over Th17
26943960.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate that regulation of T cell metabolism represents a new therapeutic target for CNS autoimmune disorders.
26943960.summary: Metformin reduced harmful Th17 immune cells and raised protective Treg cells in mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS.

26857493.mechanism: removes CD30 signaling on CD4 T cells, reducing Th1 and Th17 cells
26857493.conclusion_quote: Thus, CD30 expression on CD4 T cells is critically involved in the pathogenesis of central nervous system autoimmunity.
26857493.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CD30 gene from immune T cells reduced disease and harmful Th1 and Th17 cells, showing CD30 drives central nervous system autoimmunity.

27373350.mechanism: Prevents loss of BDNF and NGF neurotrophins
27373350.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our findings indicated that CIG treatment suppressed disease severity of EAE partially through blocking downregulation of neurotrophic factor expression such as BDNF and NGF, suggesting that CIG may have beneficial effects for the treatment of demyelinating diseases such as MS.
27373350.summary: In mice with EAE, a cornel plant extract reduced disease severity and prevented loss of the nerve-supporting proteins BDNF and NGF in the spinal cord.

25630921.conclusion_quote: Depending on the selected inbred rat strain, the immunogen and adjuvant used, different disease courses and pathologies can be induced that mimic different aspects of MS.
25630921.summary: This methods chapter describes how to induce EAE, a rat model of MS, by immunizing different rat strains, with disease course depending on strain and immunogen.

27596241.mechanism: Removing Erk2 from neural cells reduces astrocyte-driven inflammation and gliosi
27596241.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that Erk2 activation in astrocytes plays a crucial role in aggravating demyelinating inflammation by inducing inflammatory mediators and gliosis.
27596241.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing the Erk2 gene from neural cells preserved myelin and motor function by reducing inflammation and gliosis.

29244457.mechanism: Blocks capsaicin-sensitive vagal afferent nerve signaling
29244457.conclusion_quote: The obtained results suggest that capsaicin-sensitive vagal afferents with NO-ergic mechanisms involvment take part in the development of pulmonary hyperhydration during experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
29244457.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, blocking vagus nerve sensory fibers with capsaicin normalized lung fluid balance and restored blood nitric oxide levels.

26857495.mechanism: Blocks CCR4 receptor, reducing Th1 and Th17 polarization
26857495.conclusion_quote: Therefore, CCR4 antagonists might be potential therapeutic agents for multiple sclerosis.
26857495.summary: Compound 22, a drug that blocks the CCR4 receptor, reduced disease severity in mice with EAE but had no effect in mice lacking CCR4.

26763437.mechanism: Induces Foxp3 regulatory T cells that suppress inflammation
26763437.conclusion_quote: Thus, defensins may represent candidates worth being further pursued for the therapy of multiple sclerosis.
26763437.summary: In mice with EAE, an injected defensin peptide reduced brain inflammation and clinical scores by boosting regulatory T cells, whether given before or after symptoms began.

27354217.mechanism: Loss increases M1 macrophages driving Th17 cell inflammation
27354217.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data indicate that AMPK controls the inflammatory disease by regulating the M1 phenotype-Th17 axis in an animal model of multiple sclerosis.
27354217.summary: Mice lacking the AMPKα1 gene had more severe experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), with more inflammation and demyelination in the brain and spinal cord.

27848954.mechanism: Describes oligodendrocyte damage without testing a treatment
27848954.conclusion_quote: We show that both in MS and in its animal model structural damage is initiated at the myelin sheaths and only later spreads to the oligodendrocyte cell body.
27848954.summary: In human MS lesions and an animal model of MS, researchers found that oligodendrocyte damage starts at the myelin coating before spreading to the cell body.

27158387.mechanism: RXR activation boosts regulatory T cells, suppresses Th17
27158387.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate IRX4204 treatment during EAE results in immune modulation and profound attenuation of disease severity.
27158387.summary: In mice with EAE, a retinoid X receptor agonist called IRX4204 reduced disease severity by calming immune cells that drive inflammation.

27040771.mechanism: Promotes oligodendrocyte differentiation and myelination via KOR activation
27040771.conclusion_quote: Our study suggests that targeting KOR might be an intriguing way to develop new MS therapies that may complement the existing immunosuppressive approaches.
27040771.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the kappa opioid receptor worsened disease, while activating it with agonists eased symptoms and boosted myelin repair by oligodendrocytes.

27664932.mechanism: Knockdown raises Foxp3 Treg cells via Foxo1 pathway
27664932.conclusion_quote: Together, our results provide evidence that during the development of EAE, microRNA 182 repressed Treg cells differentiation through the Foxo1 dependent pathway.
27664932.summary: In mice with EAE, lowering microRNA 182 increased regulatory T cells that calm the immune system, acting through the Foxo1 pathway.

27630002.mechanism: Not applicable: describes disease changes without treatment
27630002.conclusion_quote: Five to seven days after immunization, subtle decreases in the mitochondrial membrane potential and an increased reactive oxygen species burden in brain tissue were observed.
27630002.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, mitochondrial damage and oxidative stress in brain tissue appeared days before clinical symptoms, alongside a specific chemokine pattern.

28435673.conclusion_quote: The impossibility to harmonize all 4R's forms a major challenge when the model is applied in preclinical drug development.
28435673.summary: This review discusses a monkey model of MS, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, and finds that its animal welfare principles conflict with its clinical relevance.

27671624.conclusion_quote: These data strongly support the idea that AhR is necessary for the efficacy of laquinimod in EAE and that laquinimod may represent a first-in-class drug targeting AhR for the treatment of multiple sclerosis and other neurodegenerative diseases.
27671624.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug laquinimod reduced disease, inflammation, and nerve coating damage, but this benefit disappeared in mice lacking the AhR receptor.

26364732.mechanism: reduces spinal immune cell infiltration and myelin damage
26364732.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our study demonstrates for the first time that a preconditioning protocol of exercise improves clinical outcome and attenuates pathological hallmarks of EAE at chronic disease.
26364732.summary: In mice with EAE, a six-week exercise program before disease onset reduced immune cell entry into the spinal cord, myelin damage, and nerve fiber injury, and improved symptoms.

27469626.conclusion_quote: Surprisingly, refined EAE scoring failed to improve statistical outcome comparing the overall disease courses between two groups of mice.
27469626.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a more detailed disease scoring method did not make it easier to find statistically significant differences between groups.

26996108.mechanism: No treatment tested, measures orexin receptor mRNA changes
26996108.conclusion_quote: Elevation levels of OX1R and OX2R following EAE induction suggest that alteration in orexinergic system may involve in pathogenesis of multiple sclerosis.
26996108.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found higher levels of two orexin receptor genes in the hypothalamus, hinting the orexin system may contribute to the disease.

30189124.mechanism: Restores gut microbiota and modulates immune cells
30189124.conclusion_quote: The study demonstrates the ability of E. faecium L-3 to influence on the immune system in MS, directly and indirectly (through the correction of dysbiosis).
30189124.summary: In rats with EAE, a probiotic bacterium reduced disease severity nearly as well as glatiramer acetate, but combining them removed the benefit.

26636828.mechanism: shifts immune response toward selective autoantigen tolerance
26636828.conclusion_quote: Two-signal co-delivery of both autoantigen and secondary signal were deemed necessary for therapeutic efficacy against experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a murine model of MS.
26636828.summary: Researchers tested nanoparticles carrying both a disease antigen and an inhibitory signal in mice with EAE, finding that delivering both together was needed for therapeutic benefit.

27546286.mechanism: Tob1 regulates distinct gene programs in immune cells
27546286.conclusion_quote: In summary, our work pinpoints a multifaceted activity of Tob1 in both homeostasis and disease progression.
27546286.summary: Mice lacking the Tob1 gene were studied during EAE, showing Tob1 controls different gene programs in T and B cells before and after disease onset.

27194787.mechanism: induces regulatory B cells restoring Treg function
27194787.conclusion_quote: Hence, this evidence shows the importance of BTLA in activating Tregs to facilitate recovery from EAE.
27194787.summary: In mice with EAE, a myelin antigen fused to a reovirus protein, given after symptoms began, induced regulatory B cells that restored regulatory T cell function and eased disease.

27447115.mechanism: Induces arginase 1 macrophages that dampen T-cell activation
27447115.conclusion_quote: Therefore, our studies revealed a critical role of macrophages in spermidine-mediated treatment on EAE and provided novel information for better management of MS.
27447115.summary: In mice with EAE, spermidine reduced disease by inducing macrophages that calm the immune attack on the nervous system.

26828924.mechanism: Removing proton sensor reduces Th1 and Th17 expansion
26828924.conclusion_quote: Our studies suggest that OGR1 plays a key role in regulating T cell responses during autoimmunity.
26828924.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the OGR1 proton sensor caused milder disease and fewer inflammatory T cells in the nervous system.

27122964.conclusion_quote: Th17-induced transfer EAE recapitulates pathologies observed in MS-associated optic neuritis, namely, monocular episodes of vision loss, optic nerve inflammation, and geographic retinal ganglion cell (RGC) degeneration.
27122964.summary: In mice with EAE, transferring Th17 immune cells caused repeated vision loss, optic nerve inflammation, and permanent loss of retinal nerve cells, unlike Th1 cells.

27217214.mechanism: Activates A2A receptor, cutting lymphocyte proliferation and inflammatory cytoki
27217214.conclusion_quote: Our findings strongly suggest that A2AR is a potential therapeutic target for MS and provide insight into the mechanism of action of A2AR agonists, which may offer a therapeutic option for this disease.
27217214.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a drug that activates the adenosine A2A receptor reduced immune cell infiltration and inflammation, which slowed disease progression.

27165523.mechanism: Blocks pathogenic T cell migration into CNS
27165523.conclusion_quote: Artesunate reduces the severity of EAE by inhibiting migration of pathogenic T cells to the CNS.
27165523.summary: In mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS, artesunate given daily reduced disease severity by limiting immune cells entering the brain and spinal cord.

27797811.mechanism: Reduces T cell driven inflammation, IFN-gamma and IL17
27797811.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that IL4I1 modulates inflammation by regulating T cell expansion, thereby permitting the formation of a favourable environment in the central nervous system tissue for remyelination.
27797811.summary: In mice with brain lesions and with EAE, a recombinant IL4I1 protein calmed T cell inflammation, improved myelin repair, protected nerves, and helped paralysed mice recover.

27039370.mechanism: Loss of both genes impairs T cell migration
27039370.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrates that expression of EFNB1 and EFNB2 is implicated in Th cell differentiation and migration to inflammatory sites in both EAE and MS.
27039370.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting ephrinB1 and ephrinB2 from T cells reduced disease severity and impaired the ability of these cells to migrate into the central nervous system.

26985768.mechanism: Removing CCR5 reduces immune cell infiltration and demyelination
26985768.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that CCR5 is likely participating in demyelination in the spinal cord the MS development, and that it could serve as an effective therapeutic target for the treatment of MS.
26985768.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the CCR5 gene reduced paralysis, immune cell infiltration, inflammation and loss of myelin in the spinal cord.

27444966.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes expression only
27444966.conclusion_quote: We finally demonstrate that macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) is a major factor controlling RAE-1 expression in microglia.
27444966.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the immune signal RAE-1 rose in the spinal cord, mainly in microglia and macrophages, and tracked cell growth.

interventions: Teklad Global Soy Protein-Free Extruded Rodent Diet (irradiated diet)
27133811.mechanism: Diet processing method alters disease severity in mice
27133811.conclusion_quote: Therefore, just altering the source of food (lab chow) can have marked effects on disease severity and outcome.
27133811.summary: In mice with EAE and a virus-induced seizure model, irradiated lab chow led to more severe disease and seizures than autoclaved chow.

27110779.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that the epigenetic modulation of oligodendrocyte identity is highly conserved across species.
27110779.summary: In human stem cells grown into oligodendrocytes, the cells that make myelin, researchers found that repressive histone marks build up during development, similar to mice.

27958388.mechanism: Loss of MKP-2 impairs dendritic cell antigen presentation
27958388.conclusion_quote: While MKP-2 also modulates macrophage activation, our study suggests that MKP-2 is essential to the pathogenic response of EAE, and it acts mainly via regulating the important antigen presenting DC function and T cell activation.
27958388.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the MKP-2 gene reduced disease severity by lowering immune cell infiltration and impairing dendritic cell and T cell function.

26464215.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the immunological and toxicological changes by the difference in MOG35-55 properties modulate EAE induction, and MOG35-55 which affects MMP-9 activity and IL-6 levels may be the most effective EAE-inducing antigen.
26464215.summary: Researchers compared three commercial sources of the MOG35-55 peptide used to induce MS-like disease in animals with EAE, finding that peptide properties changed how often disease developed.

26728379.mechanism: Reduces T-cell subsets and inflammatory cytokine secretion
26728379.conclusion_quote: HQGP relieve the inflammation of EAE via reducing the number of T cell subsets and inhibiting the secretion of inflammatory cytokines.
26728379.summary: In mice with EAE, a plant-derived glycoprotein called HQGP delayed disease onset, reduced symptoms, and calmed harmful immune cells and inflammatory signals.

27183623.mechanism: Deleting Tbx21 or Rorc in IL-17 producing cells
27183623.conclusion_quote: These results show that neither the single Th17 subset, nor its progeny, is solely responsible for immunopathology or autoimmunity.
27183623.summary: In mice with EAE and colitis, deleting Tbx21 or Rorc from Th17 cells changed cell types but did not reduce disease, showing no single cell type drives inflammation.

27388634.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease course
27388634.conclusion_quote: This indicates that recurrent episodes of inflammation in the CNS, as well as age, contribute to progressive neurological disease.
27388634.summary: In mice with EAE, older animals developed progressive disease from the start, while younger mice had relapses first, showing that age and repeated inflammation drive disability.

26631080.mechanism: Viral infection lowers Olig2 expression in progenitor cells
26631080.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that direct infection of OPCs by TMEV may inhibit remyelination during the chronic phase of TMEV-induced demyelinating disease.
26631080.summary: In mouse progenitor cells grown in a dish, the Theiler's virus lowered Olig2, a protein needed for cell growth, which may block nerve insulation repair.

26260496.conclusion_quote: Results show a clear shift from adaptive to innate immunity from early to late TMEV-IDD, indicating that adaptive and innate immune pathways are likely involved in the development and progression of the disease to different extents.
26260496.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus that develop demyelinating disease, the immune response shifts from adaptive early to innate immune activity later in the disease.

27269472.conclusion_quote: This is the first report describing the localisation of TMEV VP1 in infected cells, and the antibodies produced provide a valuable tool for investigating the poorly understood mechanisms underlying the early steps of picornavirus assembly.
27269472.summary: Researchers made antibodies against a Theiler's virus capsid protein and found it sits in the cytoplasm near the nucleus, alongside the host protein Hsp90, in infected cells.

27480121.mechanism: Not applicable: describes Wnt signaling in disease
27480121.conclusion_quote: This study raises the possibility that enhancement of Wnt signaling may support neurogenic processes to cope with neuronal deficits upon immune-mediated neuroinflammation.
27480121.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS animal model, inflammation switched on Wnt signaling in the hippocampus, boosting new brain cell formation that may help repair neuronal damage.

27423192.mechanism: Describes gene expression changes, no treatment tested
27423192.conclusion_quote: Expression of these genes suggested that APCs resembling alternatively activated macrophages are involved during the first wave of neuroinflammation and can be directly associated with the disease progress.
27423192.summary: In mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS, researchers found that immune cells that present antigens changed gene activity, with three genes peaking during early disease.

27396678.mechanism: Not applicable, diagnostic virus detection assay
27396678.conclusion_quote: This duplex assay provides a useful tool for routine health monitoring and screening of contaminated biological materials of these two viruses.
27396678.summary: Researchers built a new PCR test that detects and distinguishes two rodent viruses, TMEV and RTV, in lab animal samples, finding more positives than standard testing.

26784021.mechanism: No treatment tested, assessment method only
26784021.conclusion_quote: These results provide an improved workflow for interpreting the outcome of EAE from a neurological point of view, with the eventual goal of dissecting neurodegeneration and evaluating neuroprotective drugs in EAE for application in MS.
26784021.summary: In the EAE animal model of MS, researchers showed that rotarod motor tests and spinal cord lesion analysis can better measure disease severity and nerve damage.

26709219.mechanism: inhibits T-bet regulated genes, reduces IFN-γ production
26709219.conclusion_quote: Therefore, BBR3378 may be a unique inhibitor of T-bet regulated genes and may have potential as a therapeutic intervention in human autoimmune disease.
26709219.summary: In mice with EAE, a mitoxantrone analog called BBR3378 suppressed the inflammatory signal IFN-γ and Th1 cell activity, improving paralysis and relapsing disease.

27088566.conclusion_quote: It is suggested that cuprizone which is a Cu(2+) chelating agent causes impairment of electron transport chain (complex IV) and antioxidant system (SOD) in mitochondria leading to decreased ATP production and increased ROS formation.
27088566.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone to cause demyelination, brain mitochondria were damaged, producing less energy and more harmful reactive oxygen molecules.

25955415.mechanism: not applicable, describes a cell differentiation protocol
25955415.conclusion_quote: Here we describe a standardized, defined protocol that reliably directs the differentiation of miPSCs to generate high yields of OPCs that are capable of maturing into oligodendrocytes.
25955415.summary: This methods paper describes a standard recipe for turning mouse stem cells into oligodendrocyte precursor cells, which could later help repair myelin, but no disease model or treatment was tested.

30042956.mechanism: Iron particles label immune cells for MRI
30042956.conclusion_quote: In summary, we show that resting immune cells in the healthy mouse liver, spleen, and bone marrow can be prelabeled with iron oxide nanoparticles.
30042956.summary: In mice with EAE, iron particles injected before disease labeled immune cells in the spleen and bone marrow, and MRI detected these cells in the brain.

27456702.mechanism: Modulates microglial activation and innate immunity
27456702.conclusion_quote: Our data show, for the first time, that fingolimod is protective in ALS mice and that its beneficial effects are accompanied by a modulation of microglial activation and innate immunity.
27456702.summary: In mice with ALS, fingolimod started after symptoms appeared improved motor symptoms, extended survival, and altered brain inflammation genes.

28003234.conclusion_quote: We report a case of superficial spreading malignant melanoma occurring after fingolimod therapy in the USA.
28003234.summary: This case report describes a patient in the USA who developed superficial spreading malignant melanoma after taking fingolimod for multiple sclerosis.

25727376.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes bladder function changes
25727376.conclusion_quote: This EAE model induces detrusor overactivity in close relationship to neurological impairment.
25727376.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, bladder pressure and urination changes grew worse as neurological symptoms increased.

27833805.conclusion_quote: The presence of inflammation, confirmed with histology, presents difficulties in isolating the sensitivity and specificity of these MR methods to demyelination using this model.
27833805.summary: Mice given cuprizone, a model of demyelination, were scanned across the whole brain with advanced MRI, revealing changes in several regions, though inflammation complicated interpretation.

26919831.mechanism: increases oligodendrocyte genes Olig1 and Olig2
26919831.conclusion_quote: The effects of BSYSC on reducing demyelination and promoting remyelination might be associated with the increase of Olig1 and Olig2.
26919831.summary: Bushen Yisui Capsule, a Chinese herbal medicine, improved symptoms and myelin repair in mice with EAE, an MS model, possibly by raising Olig1 and Olig2 levels.

26921310.mechanism: Grb2 loss reduces T cell proliferation
26921310.conclusion_quote: In summary, Grb2-deficient T cells show defects in T cell development, increased Th1 and Th17 cell differentiation capacities, and impaired proliferation after activation by dendritic cells, which likely reduce the clinical symptoms of EAE.
26921310.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Grb2 gene in T cells made the disease milder, mainly by reducing T cell proliferation after activation.

27513991.mechanism: Inhibits calpain, sparing oligodendrocytes and preventing axonal breakdown
27513991.conclusion_quote: Calpain inhibition may represent an ideal candidate therapy for the preservation of vision in clinical ON.
27513991.summary: In mice with EAE, a daily oral calpain inhibitor called SNJ 1945 preserved vision, retinal nerve cells and their axons, and reduced paralysis.

26892877.conclusion_quote: Overall, the TMEV model provides a unique platform to study virus and host factors in ictogenesis and epileptogenesis.
26892877.summary: In mice infected with a virus, researchers compared brain inflammation and nerve damage across mouse and virus strains, finding damage markers best predicted which mice developed seizures.

26944297.mechanism: Promotes production of oligodendrocyte lineage precursor cells
26944297.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that auraptene promotes the production of oligodendrocyte lineage precursor cells in an animal model of demyelination and may be useful for individuals with demyelinating diseases.
26944297.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, the citrus compound auraptene increased cells that can become myelin-making oligodendrocytes. Myelin protein levels did not change.

27126523.mechanism: Neurite outgrowth-promoting natural human antibody protects axons
27126523.conclusion_quote: This study confirms that a fully human recombinant neurite outgrowth-promoting monoclonal IgM is therapeutic in a model of progressive MS using multiple reparative readouts.
27126523.summary: In mice with a progressive form of MS, a manufactured human antibody given after onset preserved motor function, protected nerve fibers, and kept more nerve cells functional.

27832210.mechanism: No treatment tested, strain comparison only
27832210.conclusion_quote: Collectively, the results indicate that the strain specificities in efficacy of several mechanisms controlling (auto)reactive CD4+ lymphocyte expansion/differentiation into the cells with pathogenic phenotype and migration of the latter to the SC contribute to AO rat resistance to EAE.
27832210.summary: In rats with EAE, researchers compared GM-CSF producing T cells between a strain resistant to the disease and one susceptible to it, finding fewer such cells in the resistant strain.

25959295.mechanism: High fat and cholesterol diet raises blood cholesterol levels
25959295.conclusion_quote: The results suggest that down-regulation of cholesterol biosynthesis is a transcriptional marker for demyelination, quantitative loss of myelin-specific lipids, but not cholesterol occurs late in chronic demyelination, and serum hypercholesterolemia exhibited no significant effect on TMEV infection.
25959295.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a Paigen diet high in fat and cholesterol raised blood cholesterol but did not change nerve damage or disease course.

27725632.mechanism: Deleting Tiam1 or Rac1 weakens Th17 IL-17A production
27725632.conclusion_quote: Thus, our findings highlight a regulatory pathway of Tiam1/Rac1 in Th17 cells and suggest that it may be a therapeutic target in multiple sclerosis.
27725632.summary: In mice with EAE, removing Tiam1 or Rac1 from immune cells weakened harmful Th17 cells and reduced disease, and a Rac1-targeting drug also helped.

27639434.mechanism: Heats cervical lymph nodes to reduce immune activity
27639434.conclusion_quote: Therefore, FUS treatment of cervical lymph nodes in rats with EAE resulted in a significant reduction in EAE score.
27639434.summary: Focused ultrasound heating of neck lymph nodes in rats with EAE, started at symptom onset, reduced their disease scores in this pilot study.

26831924.mechanism: Deleting RGS10 reduces T-cell responses and EAE severity
26831924.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrate a critical role for RGS10 in mediating autoimmune disease through regulation of T lymphocyte function.
26831924.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the RGS10 gene produced milder disease with fewer immune cells in the nervous system and weaker T-cell responses.

26978386.mechanism: Inactivates Dicer, lowering microRNA levels and boosting viral replication
26978386.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, cellular microRNAs appear to exert little influence on Theiler's virus fitness.
26978386.summary: In mouse fibroblast cells, switching off the Dicer enzyme lowered microRNAs and boosted vesicular stomatitis virus but not Theiler's virus, a virus used to model MS.

27397072.mechanism: reduces brain inflammatory cytokine and enzyme levels
27397072.conclusion_quote: In the present study we have demonstrated that alpha-mangostin (α-MG), a natural xanthone purified from mangosteen pericarp, reduced brain levels of pro-inflammatory cytokine interleukin-6 (IL-6), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) and 18 kDa translocator protein (TSPO) in an animal model of peripheral LPS-induced neuroinflammation.
27397072.summary: In mice given the bacterial toxin LPS to trigger brain inflammation, alpha-mangostin, a compound from mangosteen fruit, lowered brain levels of inflammatory markers IL-6 and COX-2.

27671734.mechanism: Removing M1 receptor speeds oligodendrocyte remyelination, protecting axons
27671734.conclusion_quote: Together our findings demonstrate that accelerated remyelination supports axonal integrity and neuronal function after inflammatory demyelination.
27671734.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the M1 muscarinic receptor from oligodendrocytes sped myelin repair, preventing nerve loss and improving movement recovery.

27117087.mechanism: Functional S1P1 receptor antagonist reduces glial activation and amyloid
27117087.conclusion_quote: Together, these data suggest a potential therapeutic role for fingolimod in AD.
27117087.summary: In a mouse model of Alzheimer's disease (5xFAD), fingolimod reduced amyloid plaques and inflammatory markers such as GFAP and activated microglia.

27942581.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes B cell repertoires
27942581.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that B cells in mELT actively participate in CNS autoimmunity, which may be relevant to mELT in MS and ELT in other chronic inflammatory conditions.
27942581.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found B cells in meningeal lymphoid clusters mutate and multiply locally, suggesting they drive CNS inflammation.

28119561.mechanism: Enhances microglial clearance of myelin debris
28119561.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, these results demonstrate for the first time that EA enhances myelin debris removal from activated microglia after demyelination, and promotes remyelination.
28119561.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause myelin damage, electroacupuncture improved behavior and helped microglia clear debris, supporting myelin regrowth.

27872279.mechanism: Removing Mas receptor increases macrophage inflammation
27872279.conclusion_quote: In summary, we identified the Mas axis as an important factor in macrophage function during inflammation of the central nervous and vascular system in vivo.
27872279.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the Mas receptor worsened disease and increased immune cell buildup in the spinal cord and spleen.

26993973.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte progenitor differentiation toward myelinating cells
26993973.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that T3 was effective in improving remyelination when administered during acute phase and might direct progenitor lineage toward oligodendrocytes.
26993973.summary: In rats with cuprizone-induced demyelination, thyroid hormone triiodothyronine injections improved myelin repair in the brain by helping progenitor cells mature into myelin-making oligodendrocytes.

27117475.conclusion_quote: These results provide proof-of-concept for the potential utility of a remyelinating approach in the treatment of NMO.
27117475.summary: In a mouse model of neuromyelitis optica, the approved drug clobetasol promoted new myelin repair and reduced myelin loss, even when given after damage began.

25549830.conclusion_quote: Here, we describe in detail the necessary methodological steps to visualize (auto)immune processes in living rodent tissue.
25549830.summary: This methods paper explains how to use a laser microscope to watch immune cells attack the spinal cord lining in living rats and mice with EAE, a model of MS.

26686462.mechanism: Describes semaphorin expression changes, no treatment tested
26686462.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that sema3A and sema7A are involved in the pathogenesis of EAE, in the modulation of the immune response and in the neurodegeneration that take place in the CNS.
26686462.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found semaphorin 3A rises in the brain but falls in immune cells, while semaphorin 7A rises in both.

26590329.conclusion_quote: This immunophenotype, determined for the first time, among cells isolated from neonates might be useful for the identification of NPC population aiming at the development of transplantation protocols.
26590329.summary: Neural precursor cells from newborn mouse brains were profiled by flow cytometry, showing CD24, CD44 and CD133 present and CD15, CD184 and CD49d absent.

27397084.mechanism: Deleting GCN2 impairs Treg migration toward CCL2
27397084.conclusion_quote: These data suggest an important contribution of the T cell stress response to the resolution of autoimmune neuroinflammation.
27397084.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the stress sensor GCN2 from T cells delayed recovery from inflammation and reduced regulatory T cells reaching the central nervous system.

27212623.mechanism: Blocks CCL2 binding to glycosaminoglycans, stopping chemokine signalling
27212623.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate a promising potential for future therapeutic development.
27212623.summary: In mice with EAE and zymosan-induced peritonitis, a modified CCL2 decoy protein blocked inflammation, cut cell infiltration and demyelination, and reduced clinical scores.

26869217.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
26869217.conclusion_quote: We propose that the CSE model may be useful for understanding the mechanism associating inflammation and psychosis, with applications for drug discovery in that context.
26869217.summary: In mice given cuprizone, a demyelinating diet, researchers measured behavior across several domains to study links between inflammation and psychosis.

27560502.mechanism: silences CD8 T cell response to viral vector antigen
27560502.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, vector silencing may have the adverse consequence of reducing the tumor antigen-specific CD8 T cell response, as demonstrated by our findings in the GL261-quad cassette model.
27560502.summary: In mice with melanoma and glioma, blocking the immune response to a viral vector during vaccination did not help against melanoma and lowered tumor targeting immune cells in glioma.

27682997.mechanism: Lumican loss boosts TH17 cytokines and reduces apoptosis
27682997.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results suggest that Lum negatively regulates encephalitic TH17 cells, implicating a potential therapeutic pathway in TH17 cell mediated autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.
27682997.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the lumican gene made TH17 immune cells more harmful, causing earlier and more severe disease with higher IL-17 and IL-21 production.

27791347.mechanism: Selectively blocks JAK3 kinase, reducing gamma-c cytokine signaling
27791347.conclusion_quote: Thus, JAK3-selective inhibition differentiates from pan-JAK or JAK1 inhibition in various immune cellular responses, which could potentially translate to advantageous clinical outcomes in inflammatory and autoimmune diseases.
27791347.summary: A drug that selectively blocks JAK3 reduced disease in mice with EAE, an MS model, and in arthritic rats while sparing some anti-inflammatory signals.

27742544.mechanism: Foxo3 induces Eomes, driving pathogenic Th1 cell differentiation
27742544.conclusion_quote: Thus, the Foxo3-Eomes pathway is central to achieve the complete specialized gene program required for pathogenic Th1 cell differentiation and development of neuroinflammation.
27742544.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Foxo3 gene reduced pathogenic T helper cell production of inflammatory signals and lowered disease susceptibility, acting through Eomes.

27396526.conclusion_quote: Mast cell-T cell co-culture experiments and selective mast cell reconstitution of the meninges of mast cell-deficient mice reveal that resident meningeal mast cells are an early source of caspase-1-dependent IL-1β that licenses Th cells to produce GM-CSF and become encephalitogenic.
27396526.summary: In mice with EAE, immune cells called mast cells in the brain and spinal cord coverings help T cells make GM-CSF and become able to cause inflammation.

26510556.mechanism: Not applicable, diagnostic imaging method for detecting myelin loss
26510556.conclusion_quote: The presented method offers a new platform for the possible future development of an in vivo, real-time, non-invasive, rapid imaging diagnostic tool of spinal cord myelin loss-derived pathologies.
26510556.summary: This study tested a new imaging method that detects myelin loss in spinal cord sections from mice with EAE without staining, correctly identifying 90.4% of demyelinated areas compared with immunofluorescence.

27296315.mechanism: Reduces Bax expression, lowering neuronal caspase-6 activation
27296315.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that laquinimod can directly downregulate neuronal apoptosis pathways relevant for axonal degeneration in addition to its known effects on astrocytes and microglia in the CNS.
27296315.summary: In cultured brain neurons, the drug laquinimod lowered levels of the cell-death protein Bax and reduced harmful caspase-6 activation after DNA damage.

26823492.mechanism: Kills melanoma cells, draws in CD8 T cells
26823492.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these findings demonstrate that picornavirus substrains can be used to rationally design virus hybrids that promote antitumor responses and add to the known strategies identified by us and others to further enhance the therapeutic potential of vectors used to treat cancer.
26823492.summary: In mice with B16 melanoma, an engineered picornavirus injected into tumors killed cancer cells and drew immune T cells into the tumor. This study does not concern multiple sclerosis.

26752157.conclusion_quote: These findings reveal that reciprocal interactions between NSCs and NK cells regulate neurorepair.
26752157.summary: In mice with EAE and in human MS brain tissue, researchers found natural killer immune cells gathered near brain stem cells, which supported them and limited brain repair.

33579126.mechanism: Lowers cytokines, leaves regulatory T cells unchanged
33579126.conclusion_quote: Altogether these results demonstrated that infection with S. venezuelensis was not able to modify EAE progression in Lewis rats.
33579126.summary: In Lewis rats with EAE, a prior Strongyloides worm infection lowered some immune signals but did not change disease severity or progression.

27533119.mechanism: Pushes immune cells toward pro-inflammatory cytokine production
27533119.conclusion_quote: Together these findings provide evidence that elevations in systemic Klk6 can bias the immune system towards pro-inflammatory responses capable of exacerbating the development of neuroinflammation and paralytic neurological deficits.
27533119.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, giving extra recombinant Klk6 protein early made the disease start sooner and become more severe.

27126514.conclusion_quote: This work suggests different functional roles for these cells in CNS injury and repair and shows that such repair pathways can be switched on in infiltrating myeloid cells in pro-inflammatory environments.
27126514.summary: In mice with EAE and spinal cord injury, researchers found the repair protein arginase 1 is made only by immune cells that enter the nervous system, not by resident microglia.

27766282.mechanism: Inhibits DHODH, induces gut CD39+ regulatory T cells
27766282.conclusion_quote: Our results identify specific GALT-derived CD39 + Treg cells as a mechanism of action that may contribute to the efficacy of teriflunomide during CNS inflammatory demyelination and as an oral therapeutic in relapsing multiple sclerosis.
27766282.summary: In mice, oral teriflunomide increased gut regulatory T cells that protected against experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis when transferred to other mice with the disease.

27467829.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrate that DTI measures of the spinal cord contribute to strengthening the association between neuroradiological markers and clinical disability, and support the use of DTI measures in spinal cord imaging in MS patients.
27467829.summary: In mice with a virus-triggered model of MS, spinal cord diffusion MRI measures tracked worsening disability and may serve as biomarkers.

27670590.mechanism: PROCR restrains Th17 differentiation and pathogenic gene expression
27670590.conclusion_quote: PROCR thus does not globally inhibit Th17 responses but could be targeted to selectively inhibit proinflammatory Th17 cells.
27670590.summary: In mice with EAE, removing PROCR from T cells worsened disease and increased Th17 cells, showing PROCR normally restrains harmful inflammation.

27334140.conclusion_quote: These data indicate that demyelination-induced impairment of neurons and network activity within the TC system may underlie clinical symptoms observed in demyelinating diseases, corroborating human findings that disease progression is significantly correlated with microstructural tissue damage of the TC system.
27334140.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, brain slices showed reduced nerve cell firing and weaker connections in the auditory thalamocortical network, which may explain MS symptoms.

27613697.mechanism: Removes S6K2, shifting Th17 and Treg cell differentiation
27613697.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that S6K2 is dispensable for Th17-driven autoimmunity and highlight how distinct experimental conditions can produce significantly different results in T cell differentiation.
27613697.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the S6K2 gene did not change disease score or Th17 cell development, although its effects on T cells varied by culture medium.

27568030.mechanism: No treatment tested, only genetic association analysis
27568030.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis indicates that the ACE I/D polymorphism is not associated with susceptibility to MS in Europeans of Slavic origin.
27568030.summary: This meta-analysis of four human studies in European people of Slavic origin found that a gene variant in ACE was not linked to higher risk of multiple sclerosis.

27516465.mechanism: Inhibits autotaxin, lowering lysophosphatidic acid (LPA) production
27516465.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the present study demonstrates the anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties of a novel inhibitor of autotaxin that may serve as a therapeutic option for IBD, MS, and pain associated with inflammatory states.
27516465.summary: An oral drug that blocks the enzyme autotaxin reduced disease activity in mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, and in a mouse colitis model.

27438086.mechanism: Less cytokine output from effector T cells
27438086.conclusion_quote: Together, these data highlight the importance of Vav1 adaptor functions in the production of inflammatory cytokines by effector T cells and in the susceptibility to neuroinflammation.
27438086.summary: In knock-in mice carrying a natural Vav1 gene variant, mice with EAE showed less disease and reduced inflammatory cytokine production by effector T cells.

26687980.mechanism: antibodies mask EphrinB3, letting progenitor cells mature
26687980.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that EphrinB3 could be a target for therapies aiming at promoting remyelination in demyelinating disease.
26687980.summary: In rats with induced myelin damage, antibodies that block EphrinB3 helped myelin regrow, and they helped progenitor cells mature in lab tests using MS lesion extracts.

27037192.mechanism: Lacking channel reduces T cell GM-CSF output
27037192.conclusion_quote: These data provide evidence for T-type channels in immune cells and their potential role in shaping the autoimmune response.
27037192.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CaV3.1 calcium channel from T cells made mice resistant to disease and reduced their inflammatory GM-CSF production.

27321391.mechanism: induces regulatory T cells through myelin peptide tolerisation
27321391.conclusion_quote: Together, these experiments provide evidence demonstrating that EAE can be prevented by the inverse vaccination with MOG+VitD even in the presence of a disease-aggravating infectious agent.
27321391.summary: In mice with EAE that were also infected with Candida albicans, vaccination with myelin peptide and vitamin D prevented disease by boosting regulatory T cells.

27297771.mechanism: Removes negative regulator of type I interferon
27297771.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results indicate that OASL1 deficiency suppresses the development of MS-like autoimmunity and suggest that negative regulators of IFN-I could be good therapeutic targets for treating MS in humans.
27297771.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, deleting the OASL1 gene reduced disease development, with fewer immune cells and less inflammation in the brain and spinal cord.

26431358.mechanism: Blocks SEMA4D binding to its receptors
