26431358.conclusion_quote: This work describes the generation and characterization of VX15/2503, including in vitro functional testing, epitope mapping, and an in vivo demonstration of efficacy in an animal model of rheumatoid arthritis.
26431358.summary: Researchers made a humanized antibody, VX15/2503, that blocks SEMA4D and showed benefit in mice with rheumatoid arthritis, not multiple sclerosis.

26868429.conclusion_quote: The present study suggests a weak association between HMOX2 rs1051308 polymorphism and the risk to develop MS in Spanish Caucasian men and a trend towards association between the HMOX1 rs2071746A and MS risk.
26868429.summary: Genetic association study in 292 Spanish MS patients and 533 controls finds a weak link between an HMOX2 gene variant and MS risk in men.

27657535.mechanism: Gene knockout removes Prr7, testing T cell signalling
27657535.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our work shows that loss of Prr7 does not result in a major immune system phenotype and suggests that Prr7 has a dispensable function for TCR signalling.
27657535.summary: Mice lacking the Prr7 gene had normal T cell development and immune responses, including during experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a mouse model of MS.

27500074.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes iron and myelin gene changes
27500074.conclusion_quote: The findings may help understand interrelationships of iron and myelin in more common conditions such as hemochromatosis, multiple sclerosis and various psychiatric disorders.
27500074.summary: In iron-overloaded mice and human brain gene data, researchers found iron alters myelin-related gene activity, linking rare and common brain diseases without testing any treatment.

27811936.mechanism: Deletes TG2 enzyme needed for Th17 cell differentiation
27811936.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that TG2-mediated Th17 cell differentiation is not required for the pathogenesis of DSS-induced acute colitis.
27811936.summary: In mice with DSS-induced colitis, a bowel inflammation model, removing the TG2 enzyme did not change colon damage but raised death rates.

27591257.mechanism: Deleting endothelial NRP1 suppresses IFN-gamma STAT1-CXCL10 signaling
27591257.conclusion_quote: Our data identify a new molecular mechanism of brain microvascular endothelial inflammatory response through NRP1-IFNγ crosstalk that could be a potential target for intervention of endothelial cell dysfunction in neuroinflammatory diseases.
27591257.summary: In mice with EAE, removing NRP1 from blood vessel cells lessened nerve damage and inflammation, reducing myelin loss and immune cell entry into the brain.

27503211.mechanism: induces TLR2 tolerance via low-dose ligand exposure
27503211.conclusion_quote: Overall, these results suggest that inducing TLR tolerance may offer a new approach to treating CNS autoimmune diseases such as MS.
27503211.summary: In mice with adoptive transfer EAE, low-level doses of TLR2 ligands induced immune tolerance and reduced disease, lowering inflammatory macrophages and Th17 cells.

26763608.mechanism: No treatment tested, characterizes cell properties
26763608.conclusion_quote: Thus, we have established that the development of human oligodendroglia membrane properties closely resemble those found in rodent cells and have generated a platform to enable the impact of human neurodegenerative disease-causing mutations on oligodendrocyte maturation to be studied.
26763608.summary: Researchers grew human oligodendrocytes from stem cells and found they mature like rodent cells, and cells from ALS patients with a C9ORF72 mutation matured normally.

26901216.mechanism: No treatment tested, viral pathogenesis only
26901216.conclusion_quote: Overall, our results provide a strong basis on which the mechanisms underlying Saffold virus induced neuropathogenesis can be further studied and, hence, facilitating new information about its pathogenesis.
26901216.summary: In mice lacking interferon receptors, researchers studied how Saffold virus infects the spinal cord and brain, finding the infection does not persist. This virus study does not address multiple sclerosis directly.

interventions: apoptotic T cell-induced tolerogenic dendritic cells
26111522.mechanism: Inhibits development of CD4+ effector memory T cells
26111522.summary: Injecting dendritic immune cells treated with dying cells into mice with EAE blocked development of harmful memory T cells and prevented disease.

26796539.mechanism: Reduces inflammation independently of heme oxygenase-1 pathway
26796539.conclusion_quote: These results thus indicate that IVIG exerts anti-inflammatory effects independent of HO-1 pathway.
26796539.summary: In mice with EAE, IVIG reduced inflammation and protected against disease, but this worked without boosting the HO-1 protective pathway.

26683597.conclusion_quote: Increased expression of CgA and CLU in reactive astrocytes in MS white matter lesions supports a role for these molecules as neuro-inflammatory mediators and their potential as CSF markers of active pathological processes in MS patients.
26683597.summary: Brain tissue from people with MS and marmosets with EAE showed higher levels of CgA and CLU proteins in damaged white matter, mainly in astrocytes near blood vessels.

27623324.mechanism: not applicable, compares tissue processing methods
27623324.conclusion_quote: Therefore, we conclude that manual homogenization is a superior approach to isolate activated T cells from the mouse brain.
27623324.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, a manual homogenization method recovered more activated immune T cells from the brain than an enzyme digestion method.

27435215.mechanism: Blocks CEACAM1 on B cells, reducing aggregate formation
27435215.conclusion_quote: Overall, these data identify CEACAM1 as a clinically highly interesting target in MS pathogenesis and open new therapeutic avenues for the treatment of the disease.
27435215.summary: Antibodies that block the CEACAM1 protein reduced B cell clumping in cells from MS patients and lessened established disease in mice with an MS-like condition.

26831084.mechanism: Increases TTP mRNA stability, dampening proinflammatory mediator production
26831084.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that increased systemic levels of TTP, secondary to increased stability of its mRNA throughout the body, can be protective against inflammatory disease in certain models and might be viewed as an attractive therapeutic target for the treatment of human inflammatory diseases.
26831084.summary: In mice engineered to stabilize tristetraprolin mRNA, the protein rose and mice resisted experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model of MS, with less inflammation.

27370228.mechanism: reduces immune cell infiltration and BBB disruption
27370228.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that ZnT3 gene deletion inhibits the clinical features and neuropathological changes associated with EAE.
27370228.summary: In mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, deleting the ZnT3 zinc transporter gene reduced clinical signs, spinal cord inflammation, demyelination, and motor deficits.

26399519.mechanism: Suppresses macrophage nitric oxide and lymphocyte proliferation
26399519.conclusion_quote: We can conclude that ABL has an in vivo immunomodulatory effect reducing the innate and adaptive responses.
26399519.summary: In Wistar rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, oral mushroom lectin reduced disease incidence and the severity of clinical signs.

27720716.mechanism: neutralizes soluble Sema4D, reducing TNF-alpha production
27720716.conclusion_quote: These results suggested a critical pathogenic engagement of Sema4D produced by γδT cells in the development of MRONJ.
27720716.summary: In a mouse model of jaw bone necrosis linked to medications, blocking Sema4D with an antibody reduced disease onset and TNF-alpha levels.

26040501.mechanism: Reduces dendritic cell integrin and CLEC12A expression
26040501.conclusion_quote: These results indicate a protective role of Apigenin against the neurodegenerative effects resulting from the entry of DC stimulated pathogenic T cells into the CNS thus implicating a potential therapy for neuroinflammatory disease.
26040501.summary: In mice with EAE, the natural plant flavonoid apigenin reduced disease severity and relapses, lowered immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord, and limited nerve damage.

27217485.mechanism: Deleting c-Rel reduces regulatory T cells, accelerating diabetes
27217485.conclusion_quote: The results suggest that c-Rel-dependent Treg cell function is critical in suppressing early-onset autoimmune diabetogenesis in NOD mice.
27217485.summary: In mice without the c-Rel gene, regulatory immune cells drop and diabetes starts sooner, a model of autoimmune diabetes rather than multiple sclerosis.

27489081.mechanism: activates LXR receptor, suppressing NF-κB pathway and SUMOylation
27489081.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that LXR-mediated inflammatory gene repression correlates to the suppression of NF-κB pathway and SUMOylation.
27489081.summary: In human endothelial cells exposed to an inflammatory lipid, a liver X receptor agonist reduced IL-8 inflammatory signaling, suggesting anti-inflammatory effects relevant to atherosclerosis rather than MS.

26523849.mechanism: Suppresses T and B cell proliferation
26523849.conclusion_quote: Together, we present a simple and fast derivation method to generate MSCs from hESCs, which possess potent immunomodulatory properties in vitro and in vivo and may serve as a novel and ideal candidate for MSC-based therapies.
26523849.summary: Immunomodulating cells made from human embryonic stem cells reduced autoimmune disease in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

27183575.conclusion_quote: Our findings implicate public TCR in skewing repertoire response during autoimmunity and suggest that subsets of public TCR sequences may serve as disease-specific biomarkers or influence disease susceptibility or progression.
27183575.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers sequenced millions of T-cell receptors and found that widely shared receptors were preferentially used during disease.

27799546.mechanism: Imaging agent labels innate immune cells
27799546.conclusion_quote: Our results show that noninvasive molecular imaging of innate immune responses can serve as an imaging biomarker of disease activity in autoimmune-mediated neuroinflammation with potential clinical applications in a wide range of inflammatory diseases.
27799546.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, iron oxide nanoparticle MRI scans detected innate immune cell activity that tracked disease severity better than standard gadolinium imaging.

27139491.mechanism: IL-1β from infiltrating neutrophils and macrophages drives endothelial cytokine
27139491.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that an IL-1β-dependent paracrine loop between infiltrated neutrophils/MDMs and ECs drives neuroinflammation.
27139491.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the IL-1β cytokine made mice resistant to disease, showing that immune cells entering the spinal cord drive inflammation through this signal.

26648339.mechanism: Deleting AMACR shifts T-cell proliferation and cytokine balance
26648339.conclusion_quote: Our data show that AMACR is regulated in immune cells during EAE, but it is not a suitable target for the treatment of MS due to its opposing effects.
26648339.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the AMACR gene in immune cells gave opposing effects on T cells that canceled out, leaving disease course largely unchanged.

27115494.conclusion_quote: Our data provide evidence that increased axonal ribosome content in pathological axons is at least partly due to glia-to-axon transfer of ribosomes, and that demyelination in the PNS and in the CNS is one of the triggers capable to initiate this process.
27115494.summary: In mice with EAE, rats with a drug-induced nerve demyelination, and MS patient brains, damaged nerve fibers contained more ribosomes, likely passed from nearby support cells.

27022743.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes antibody-driven disease mechanism
27022743.conclusion_quote: Jointly, these observations highlight Ab-mediated opsonization of endogenous CNS auto-antigen as a novel disease- and/or relapse-triggering mechanism in CNS demyelinating disorders.
27022743.summary: In transgenic mice with EAE, antibodies against the myelin protein MOG triggered spontaneous disease by helping immune cells attack myelin, though no treatment was tested.

26911613.conclusion_quote: This study establishes a correlation between TLR-3 and TLR-9 expression with the development of EAE.
26911613.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, early interferon gamma rose while TLR3 and TLR9 immune sensors fell, and these changes depended on myelin peptide immunization.

26957351.mechanism: liposomes deliver glucocorticoid to inflamed tissues
26957351.conclusion_quote: This significant superiority of our liposome based steroidal nano-drug administered weekly compared with daily injections of free methylprednisolone hemisuccinate in suppressing murine lupus indicates this glucocorticoid nano-drug formulation may be a good candidate for the treatment of human SLE.
26957351.summary: In mice with lupus (MRL lpr/lpr strain), a liposome-wrapped steroid given weekly reduced antibodies and kidney damage and extended survival better than daily free methylprednisolone.

27580304.mechanism: Inhibits cyclin-dependent kinases, halting precursor cell cycling
27580304.conclusion_quote: The therapeutic effects of FLA on CPZ-exposed mice may be related to its ability of cell cycle inhibition.
27580304.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone to damage myelin, the drug flavopiridol reduced excess glial cells, protected mature oligodendrocytes and myelin, and improved spatial memory.

26906225.mechanism: neutralizes TNF cytokine driving inflammation and barrier damage
26906225.conclusion_quote: Sustained TNF production by infiltrating macrophages associated with progressive EAE exacerbates disease severity by promoting inflammation and disruption of BBB integrity, thereby counteracting establishment of an anti-inflammatory environment required for disease remission.
26906225.summary: In mice with progressive EAE, an antibody blocking TNF during acute disease reduced disability, deaths, inflammation, and blood brain barrier leakage.

27894396.mechanism: Limits microglia activation and lowers CCL2 CCL3 chemokines
27894396.conclusion_quote: According to this results, we conclude that EA is a suitable therapeutic agent for moderation brain damages in neuro-inflammatory diseases.
27894396.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause brain inflammation, ellagic acid reduced activated microglia and lowered inflammatory chemokines, suggesting protection against brain damage.

27412414.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, LCV infection induces a variety of changes in B cells that underlies the conversion of destructive processing of the immunodominant MOG40-48 epitope into productive processing and cross-presentation to strongly autoaggressive CTLs.
27412414.summary: In marmoset and rhesus monkey models of MS, a virus related to EBV changed how B cells processed a myelin protein, activating harmful immune cells.

27714696.mechanism: Deletion of galectin-3 gene impairs microglial tuning and remyelination
27714696.conclusion_quote: Therefore, Gal-3 influences remyelination by mechanisms involving the tuning of microglial cells, modulation of MMP activity, and changes in myelin architecture.
27714696.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing the galectin-3 gene made remyelination less efficient, with defective myelin wrapping and altered microglial responses compared with normal mice.

27566541.mechanism: removes T cell Coronin 1A, reducing autoimmune response
27566541.conclusion_quote: In summary, our findings provide formal proof of the predominant T cell-intrinsic role of Coronin 1A.
27566541.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Coronin 1A only in T cells made the mice largely resistant to autoimmune disease, mirroring whole body knockout results.

26493273.conclusion_quote: We conclude that a significant increase in DNase and proteolytic activities of antibodies may be considered the earliest statistically significant marker of MOG-induced EAE in mice.
26493273.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, antibodies able to cut DNA and proteins rose early in disease, alongside changes in immune cells and blood stem cells.

26747000.mechanism: reduces immune cell entry and brain inflammation
26747000.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that IFNβ exerts a protective effect against ischemic stroke through its anti-inflammatory properties and suggest that IFNβ is a potential therapeutic agent, targeting the reperfusion damage subsequent to the treatment with tissue plasminogen activator.
26747000.summary: In a mouse model of stroke, interferon-beta reduced brain damage and neurological deficits by calming inflammation. This study does not model multiple sclerosis.

27491786.conclusion_quote: This study highlights the possibility of trans-neuronal degeneration as one mechanism of secondary neuronal damage in MS.
27491786.summary: In two MS animal models, researchers found thalamus damage, and spinal cord inflammation in EAE was linked to nerve cell loss in a thalamus relay area.

26863192.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate that the leptomeninges represent a checkpoint at which activated T cells are licensed to enter the CNS parenchyma and non-activated T cells are preferentially released into the CSF, from where they can reach areas of antigen availability and tissue damage.
26863192.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, immune T cells moved from the brain's outer membranes into spinal fluid, then reattached and entered brain tissue.

26990978.mechanism: blocks immune cell entry into spinal cord
26990978.conclusion_quote: We observed that I-IFN treated ENMO rats had spinal cord lesions with fewer T cells, macrophages/activated microglia and activated neutrophils, and less astrocyte damage than their vehicle treated counterparts, suggesting beneficial effects of I-IFN.
26990978.summary: In rats with an experimental model of neuromyelitis optica, interferon treatment started at symptom onset reduced immune cell infiltration and astrocyte damage in the spinal cord.

27084211.conclusion_quote: Although present only in a minor subgroup, seroprevalence of anti-NF reactivity was significantly more frequent in patients with PMS than in those with RRMS, but was also occasionally found in healthy controls.
27084211.summary: Blood tests of 83 progressive and 159 relapsing MS patients and 50 healthy people found anti neurofascin antibodies more often in progressive MS.

27325573.mechanism: Destabilizes sperm membranes, releasing acrosome contents
27325573.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the destabilization of the plasma membrane and the release of the acrosomal content with LL and TX before ICSI improve the rate of embryonic development, without affecting the quality of the embryos produced by this technique.
27325573.summary: In cattle, treating frozen sperm with lysolecithin or Triton X-100 before egg injection improved early embryo development. This is not a multiple sclerosis study.

26785841.mechanism: Raises anti-inflammatory IL-10 and regulatory T cells
26785841.conclusion_quote: Acclimatization to mild hypoxia incites a number of endogenous adaptations that induces an anti-inflammatory milieu.
26785841.summary: In mice with EAE, three weeks of breathing mild low oxygen reduced spinal cord inflammation and increased anti-inflammatory IL-10 and regulatory T cells.

26791341.mechanism: Activates presynaptic mGlu2/3 receptors, reducing excess glutamate release
26791341.conclusion_quote: The mGlu3 -preferring autoreceptors could represent a target for new pharmacological approaches for treating demyelinating diseases.
26791341.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug LY379268 restored normal glutamate release in the spinal cord but not in the cortex.

interventions: Epicutaneous (EC) immunization with type II collagen (COLL II)
26922557.mechanism: induces suppressor T cells that reduce inflammation
26922557.conclusion_quote: Maneuver of EC immunization with a protein antigen that induces suppressor cells to inhibit inflammatory responses may become an attractive, noninvasive, needle-free therapeutic method for different clinical situations.
26922557.summary: In mice with arthritis induced by collagen, skin patching with collagen triggered suppressor T cells that lessened joint disease.

26659901.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these results suggest that in vivo PET imaging of system xc(-) could become a valuable tool for the diagnosis and treatment evaluation of MS.
26659901.summary: In rats with EAE, a PET scan tracer for a glutamate transporter showed higher activity in the spinal cord at 14 days, matching symptoms and inflammation.

26700769.mechanism: Blocks Th17 cell rolling on inflamed vessels
26700769.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate that CD43 is a major E-selectin ligand in Th17 cells that functions independent of PSGL-1, and they suggest that CD43 may hold promise as a therapeutic target to modulate Th17 cell recruitment.
26700769.summary: In mice with EAE, genetically removing the CD43 gene reduced Th17 immune cell entry into the spinal cord and protected the mice from disease.

27724971.conclusion_quote: Our data describe in detail the expression of the Nogo receptor complex within the autoimmune inflammatory foci and suggest a possible immune action for NgR apart from the established inhibitory one on axonal growth.
27724971.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers mapped where the Nogo receptor complex appears in inflamed spinal cord areas, finding it on immune cells called macrophages.

26772776.mechanism: Anti-inflammatory action independent of classical cannabinoid receptors reduces
26772776.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, CBD may represent a promising novel treatment for managing autoimmune myocarditis and possibly other autoimmune disorders and organ transplantation.
26772776.summary: In mice with autoimmune heart inflammation, cannabidiol reduced immune cell infiltration, heart scarring, and heart dysfunction.

27835940.conclusion_quote: We generated a complete catalog of variants in TH mice using the data from whole genome sequencing.
27835940.summary: In TALLYHO mice, a model of obesity and type 2 diabetes, researchers sequenced the whole genome to catalog genetic variants. The study does not involve multiple sclerosis.

27257344.mechanism: Blocks lysophosphatidylcholine-induced caveolin-1 expression and adhesion molecu
27257344.conclusion_quote: These results strongly suggest lysophosphatidylcholine derived from oxidized low-density lipoprotein contributes to atherosclerotic events by upregulating caveolin-1 expression, resulting in induction of adhesion molecules.
27257344.summary: In cultured endothelial cells, quercetin and a metabolite reduced caveolin-1 and adhesion molecule increases caused by oxidized cholesterol particles, a study of atherosclerosis rather than MS.

26747276.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes CXCL12 chemokine expression
26747276.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight the post-CNS-inflammation role of CXCL12 in augmenting the endogenous myelin/neuronal repair capacity in MS-like disease, likely via CXCL12/CXCR4 autocrine signaling.
26747276.summary: In mice with EAE that spontaneously recovered, CXCL12 levels and progenitor cells that make it rose in brain areas linked to repair.

27250711.mechanism: boosts innate IFN-alpha/beta production limiting viral replication
27250711.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates that the expression of viral non-structural genes in mice inhibits initial viral replication and suppresses sustaining pathogenic anti-viral immune responses to broad viral determinants.
27250711.summary: In mice with Theiler's virus model of MS, transgenic expression of viral nonstructural genes reduced early viral replication and milder disease, but chronic viral loads rose.

27930320.mechanism: testosterone signaling via androgen receptor favors astrocyte recruitment and ol
27930320.conclusion_quote: Thus, testosterone favors astrocyte recruitment and spontaneous oligodendrocyte-mediated remyelination.
27930320.summary: In male mice with lysolecithin-induced spinal cord demyelination, removing the testes or blocking androgen receptor signaling reduced astrocyte recruitment and oligodendrocyte-driven myelin repair.

26678296.conclusion_quote: The present data confirm that an unknown viral infection causes an immune response in experimental guinea pigs leading to seroconversion against GDVII and that guinea pigs from a commercial breeder are the source of the infection.
26678296.summary: Researchers found guinea pigs in one animal facility carried antibodies against a mouse Theiler's virus strain, suggesting an unknown infection spread from a commercial breeder.

26818526.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease process only
26818526.conclusion_quote: This study clearly illustrates the significance of brain-intrinsic degenerative cascades for immune cell recruitment and MS lesion formation.
26818526.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage forebrain myelin, then immunized with MOG peptide, nerve degeneration drew many immune cells into the forebrain.

27171265.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the findings of this study revealed that intraventricular injections of MSCs is a feasible method to elicit a paracrine effect in the oligodendrogenic niche of the SVZ, which is prone to respond to the factors secreted into the CSF and therefore promoting oligodendrogenesis and functional remyelination.
27171265.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, injecting bone marrow stem cells into the brain's fluid-filled ventricles recruited progenitor cells, increased myelin, and improved nerve signal transmission.

27699230.mechanism: Cells boost remyelination factors and reduce gliosis
27699230.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our results show that DUOC-01 accelerates brain remyelination by multiple mechanisms and could be beneficial in treating demyelinating conditions.
27699230.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced brain demyelination, a cord blood monocyte-derived cell therapy product sped up myelin repair more than unprocessed cord blood monocytes did.

27613805.mechanism: Blocks IL-6 signaling to restore myelin repair
27613805.conclusion_quote: This study provides the first direct evidence, to our knowledge, that social experience influences remyelination via modulation of IL-6 expression.
27613805.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice, social isolation impaired myelin repair, and blocking the inflammatory protein IL-6 restored remyelination, while adding IL-6 worsened it.

26593872.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, intravenous injection of 10 nm AgNPs to pregnant mice resulted in notable silver accumulation in maternal liver, spleen and VYS, and may have affected embryonic growth.
26593872.summary: In pregnant mice, intravenous silver nanoparticles built up in the liver, spleen and yolk sac and may have affected early embryo growth. This paper does not study multiple sclerosis.

27266503.mechanism: Overexpressed mutant PNPLA3 increases ER stress and apoptosis in liver cells
27266503.conclusion_quote: PNPLA3 may be involved in palmitic acid-induced apoptosis mediated by hepatocyte ER stress through regulating LPC metabolism.
27266503.summary: In HepG2 liver cells, overexpressing the mutant PNPLA3 gene increased fat-induced cell death, but this study does not address multiple sclerosis.

25992667.conclusion_quote: We show that increasing the inspired oxygen concentration identifies deoxyhemoglobin-based hypointensities in vivo.
25992667.summary: In mice with EAE, breathing pure oxygen during spinal cord MRI showed that many dark spots come from deoxygenated blood, not iron or demyelination.

25665584.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes T cell changes
25665584.conclusion_quote: Thus, our study confirms the involvement of multiple sclerosis risk genes in the pathophysiology of the animal model and sheds light on additional disease-relevant inflammatory networks.
25665584.summary: In an animal model of MS called EAE, researchers mapped how CD4 T cells change in the inflamed central nervous system, confirming several MS risk genes.

26531695.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that the TMEV model may be useful in investigating pain and cognitive impairments in MS.
26531695.summary: In mice infected with a virus that models MS, prior social stress increased pain behavior and impaired memory, though stress did not consistently affect disease course.

26531689.mechanism: Suppresses dendritic cell maturation and Th1 cytokine production
26531689.conclusion_quote: Taken together, chrysin exerts anti-inflammatory and immune suppressive effects, and suggests a possible therapeutic application of chrysin in MS.
26531689.summary: A plant flavonoid called chrysin reduced immune dendritic cells in human samples and eased inflammation and nerve damage in mice with EAE, an MS model.

25737584.mechanism: No treatment tested in this commentary
25737584.conclusion_quote: A study by Huang et al. in this issue of Science Signaling highlights key roles for the mitogen-activated protein kinase p38α and the phosphatase MK1 in mediating interleukin-17-dependent pathology in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a mouse model of multiple sclerosis.
25737584.summary: This commentary describes a study in mice with EAE showing that the enzyme p38α and phosphatase MK1 drive interleukin 17 related damage.

25766071.mechanism: Enhances integrated stress response, protecting oligodendrocytes from inflammati
25766071.conclusion_quote: Our results provide support for a MS therapy that enhances the integrated stress response to protect oligodendrocytes against the inflammatory CNS environment.
25766071.summary: In mice with EAE, the FDA-approved drug guanabenz protected myelin-making cells, eased paralysis symptoms, and reduced relapses.

26516320.conclusion_quote: Liver damage occurs in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
26516320.summary: In male Lewis rats with EAE, a rat model of MS, researchers found liver damage that accompanied higher death rates, but no treatment was tested.

26413432.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that activated macrophages/microglia of gray matter are less susceptible to cell death induction.
26413432.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found fewer dying macrophages and microglia in gray matter than in white matter of the spinal cord.

26347600.conclusion_quote: To date neutrophils have not been appreciated as a driver of MS, but more recently based largely on strong EAE data this view is being reevaluated by some investigators in the field.
26347600.summary: This review summarizes how interferon gamma calms inflammation in mice with EAE, a model of MS, mainly by limiting neutrophil immune cells entering the brain and spinal cord.

26383267.mechanism: Blocks LINGO-1, activating AKT/mTOR to promote myelin growth
26383267.conclusion_quote: Our research demonstrates that LINGO-1 antagonism may be an effective approach to the treatment of the cognitive impairment of multiple sclerosis patients.
26383267.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody blocking LINGO-1 improved learning and memory and partly restored myelin in the brain's parahippocampal cortex.

25037702.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes presynaptic glutamate release changes
25037702.conclusion_quote: The present are the first pieces of evidence unraveling the molecular mechanisms of frontal cortex neuronal dysfunction in EAE and, possibly, MS.
25037702.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found that brain nerve endings in the frontal cortex release less glutamate, a chemical messenger, during the disease.

26079949.mechanism: Deletes BRP-39 gene, tests its role
26079949.conclusion_quote: These results do not support a role of BRP-39 in the pathogenesis of EAE.
26079949.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the gene for BRP39, a mouse version of CHI3L1, did not change disease course, onset, or immune responses.

26616302.mechanism: Induces SOCS3, blocks Th1 and Th17 cell differentiation
26616302.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings demonstrate that Ba has significant potential as a novel anti-inflammatory agent for therapy of autoimmune diseases such as MS.
26616302.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the plant compound baicalin reduced disease severity and inflammation, acting partly through the SOCS3 signaling pathway.

26511651.mechanism: Reduces CNS chemokines, limiting immune cell recruitment
26511651.conclusion_quote: We conclude that NPCs ameliorated EAE potentially by modulating the levels of chemokines expressed in the inflamed CNS, thus resulting in the impaired recruitment of immune cells.
26511651.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, transplanted neural precursor cells under the skin eased symptoms and reduced immune cell buildup in the spinal cord.

25796192.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes B cell activity in CNS
25796192.conclusion_quote: These data imply the development of autonomous B cell-mediated autoimmunity in the CNS in EAE - a concept that might also apply to MS itself.
25796192.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, B cell clusters formed in the central nervous system and showed ongoing activity, with no treatment tested.

26093163.mechanism: Lowers chemokines, limiting immune cell recruitment into CNS
26093163.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data indicate that MAT may be an effective immunomodulatory therapeutic approach for MS/EAE by countering the immune cell recruitment mechanisms.
26093163.summary: In animals with EAE, the herbal compound matrine reduced chemokines CCL2 and CXCL10 and their receptors, which lessened disease severity and immune cell entry into the central nervous system.

25662914.mechanism: TNF increases CXCL12 expression in astrocytes
25662914.conclusion_quote: These results contribute to a view that TNF produced within the CNS plays a protective role in neuroinflammation.
25662914.summary: In rats with EAE, TNF and CXCL12 levels rose together in the nervous system, and TNF boosted CXCL12 production in lab-grown astrocytes.

25868328.conclusion_quote: The manifestation of clinical signs of EAE has been found to be in correlation with the levels of GAP-43 proteolysis both in the homogenate of the spinal cord and on the spinal cord slices.
25868328.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, levels of cleaved growth protein GAP43 in the spinal cord matched the severity of disease symptoms.

25744931.conclusion_quote: This suggest that MTR measures of brain tissue can give significant differences between control mice and EAE mice not caused by demyelination, inflammation or iron deposition, and may not be useful surrogate markers for demyelination in the MOG1-125 mouse model.
25744931.summary: In mice with EAE, MRI magnetization transfer ratio did not track myelin loss, inflammation or iron, suggesting it may not reliably detect demyelination.

25871629.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that these metabolic changes may represent sensitive markers for cuprizone induced demyelination, axonal injury and inflammation.
25871629.summary: In mice fed the toxin cuprizone, a brain scanning method tracked chemical changes in the corpus callosum during demyelination and natural repair, without testing any treatment.

25670003.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
25670003.conclusion_quote: Thus, our study provides experimental evidence for a direct causal link between CNS autoimmunity and disruption of the homeostatic balance of the uterine cycle often observed in women with MS.
25670003.summary: In female mice with EAE, a model of MS, the estrous cycle became significantly shorter, mainly because the luteal phase shortened.

25795599.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes hippocampal changes in disease
25795599.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that in an animal model of MS hippocampal function becomes compromised as the disease progresses.
25795599.summary: In mice with EAE, an animal model of MS, the brain's memory hub called the hippocampus lost function as disease progressed, while basic neuron properties and some memory tasks stayed normal.

25959684.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that both extracellular and intracellular epitopes of PLP contribute to the pathogenesis of MP4-induced EAE already in the setting of intact myelin.
25959684.summary: In mice with MP4 induced EAE, a model of MS, antibodies against both outer and inner parts of the myelin protein PLP damaged myelin when transferred to other mice.

26359290.mechanism: Loss of CD226 impairs regulatory T cell suppression
26359290.conclusion_quote: Therefore, by combining human and mouse analyses we show that CD226 exhibits an important role in the activation of regulatory T cells, with its genetically imposed dysregulation impairing regulatory T cell function.
26359290.summary: Using human cells from MS patients and healthy gene carriers, plus Cd226-deficient mice with EAE, the study found that CD226 loss impairs regulatory T cells and worsens disease.

25647234.mechanism: inhibits cell replication through receptor-mediated mechanism
25647234.conclusion_quote: These data are the first to demonstrate that exposure to OGF initiated at the time of established disease can reverse the course of RR-EAE and reduce neuropathological deficits.
25647234.summary: In mice with relapsing-remitting EAE, a natural peptide called OGF given after disease began reduced symptoms, relapses, and nerve damage, and lengthened remissions.

25595039.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease pathology
25595039.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that morphological abnormalities of myelin and axonal organelles play important role on the pathogenesis of axonal injury in demyelinating diseases.
25595039.summary: Researchers used electron microscopy to examine nerve fibers and their myelin coating in mice with cuprizone or EAE and in shiverer mice, plus human MS brain tissue.

26157006.conclusion_quote: Our work provides an innovative experimental platform that may be pivotal for the comprehension of key mechanisms responsible for the accumulation of irreversible brain damage and for the development of innovative therapies to reduce disability in EAE/MS.
26157006.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, brain scans during forepaw touch showed the cortex reorganizes during relapse and chronic phases, with less balanced activity between hemispheres.

26053248.conclusion_quote: According to our results, apoptosis was mainly of mitochondrial origin mediated by both caspase-3- and apoptosis inducing factor-mediated mechanisms.
26053248.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that causes demyelination, the thymus shrank within one week, mainly from mitochondrial cell death of CD4 and CD8 double positive T cells.

26648720.mechanism: Antioxidant fatty acid reduces lipid oxidation and demyelination
26648720.conclusion_quote: We propose that novel formulations of natural antioxidants such as Nano-PSO may be considered for the treatment of patients suffering from demyelinating diseases.
26648720.summary: In mice with EAE, a nanodroplet form of pomegranate seed oil reduced demyelination and brain lipid oxidation more than regular oil, at lower doses.

26161070.conclusion_quote: We review the experimental studies addressing behavioral symptoms in EAE, and propose the study of neuron-glia interaction as a powerful but still poorly explored tool to investigate the burden of microglia in mood alterations associated to MS.
26161070.summary: This review article summarizes earlier animal studies of mood and behavior changes in mice with EAE, a model of MS, and suggests studying microglia and neuron interactions.

25747279.mechanism: blocks Nav1.8 sodium channels in neurons
25747279.conclusion_quote: These preclinical proof-of-concept data suggest that PF-01247324, its derivatives, or other Nav1.8-selective blockers merit further study for providing symptomatic therapy for cerebellar dysfunction in MS and related disorders.
25747279.summary: In mice with MS-like disease, oral PF-01247324, a Nav1.8 channel blocker, improved motor coordination and cerebellar symptoms compared with vehicle-treated controls.

26026273.mechanism: induces oral tolerance to myelin antigens
26026273.conclusion_quote: Obtained results indicate that application of such recombinant cells can be an attractive method of oral tolerance induction.
26026273.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model of MS, feeding Lactococcus lactis bacteria that produce myelin proteins reduced symptoms only at the higher dose.

26068104.mechanism: promotes apoptosis of pathogenic T cells, reduces Th1/Th17 cells
26068104.conclusion_quote: Our data demonstrate that rhPDCD5 ameliorates the autoimmune CNS disease by inhibiting Th1/Th17 differentiation and inducing apoptosis of predominantly pathogenic T cells.
26068104.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, a recombinant human PDCD5 protein given before or after symptom onset reduced inflammatory T cells and eased disease.

26523867.mechanism: Myeloid Nr4a1 loss boosts macrophage norepinephrine, TH deletion blocks it
26523867.conclusion_quote: Our data reveal a new role for macrophages in neuroinflammation and identify Nr4a1 as a key regulator of catecholamine production by macrophages.
26523867.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the Nr4a1 gene in myeloid cells increased norepinephrine and worsened disease, while deleting tyrosine hydroxylase protected the mice.

25510644.mechanism: Reduces immune infiltration, demyelination and motor neuron loss
25510644.conclusion_quote: These findings provide evidence that voluntary exercise results in reduced and attenuated disability, reductions in autoimmune cell infiltration, and preservation of axons and motor neurons in the lumbar spinal cord of mice with EAE.
25510644.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, voluntary running-wheel exercise delayed disease onset, lessened disability, and preserved nerve fibers and motor neurons.

26631473.mechanism: Removes ER chaperone BiP from myelinating cells
26631473.conclusion_quote: These studies demonstrate that BiP is critical for myelinating cell survival and contributes to the protective response of oligodendrocyte against inflammatory demyelination.
26631473.summary: In mice, deleting the BiP protein from myelin-forming cells caused tremors, paralysis and myelin loss, and partial loss made EAE, a model of MS, worse.

25686105.mechanism: Blocks NLRP3 inflammasome activation, reducing IL-1β production
25686105.conclusion_quote: MCC950 is thus a potential therapeutic for NLRP3-associated syndromes, including autoinflammatory and autoimmune diseases, and a tool for further study of the NLRP3 inflammasome in human health and disease.
25686105.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the drug MCC950 blocked an inflammation-driving protein complex and reduced disease severity.

26099498.conclusion_quote: It appears that the autoimmune reaction against CNS tissue is "remotely controlled" by the gut microbiota.
26099498.summary: This review summarizes mouse studies showing germ free mice are protected from EAE, suggesting gut microbiota remotely controls MS like autoimmune disease.

25701681.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes T cell metabolism
25701681.conclusion_quote: Such aspects, once clarified, may open new opportunities for a therapeutic metabolic modulation of MS disorder.
25701681.summary: This study examined energy metabolism and oxidative stress responses in CD4 T cells from people with relapsing remitting multiple sclerosis, without testing any treatment.

26088203.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that the effect of an acute E. coli infection on the course of MS is less pronounced than suspected and underline the need for adequate models to test the role of systemic infections in the pathogenesis of MS.
26088203.summary: In rats with EAE, a systemic E. coli infection did not change when symptoms started, how severe they were, or nerve damage in the optic nerve.

26041928.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates the development of a novel animal model that recapitulates elements of the microenvironment of the MS plaque and reveals an important role for T cells and peripheral monocytes in impairing endogenous remyelination in vivo.
26041928.summary: In mice given cuprizone to strip myelin, transferring immune T cells that attack myelin impaired natural repair, with monocytes also playing a role.

25801841.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes nerve growth factor expression.
25801841.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest the induction of NGF represents an adaptive response against immune-mediated neuroinflammation in the DRG and SC that likely contributes to the EAE attenuation.
25801841.summary: In Lewis rats with EAE, a model of MS, nerve growth factor levels rose in spinal nerve and spinal cord tissue as the disease improved.

26511327.conclusion_quote: Inter-molecular epitope spreading to neurofascin correlates with disease severity in MOG-EAE is dependent on extensive demyelination and is influenced by non-MHC genes.
26511327.summary: In rats with EAE induced by myelin protein MOG, immune attack spread to the nerve protein neurofascin when demyelination was extensive, and genes outside the MHC region influenced it.

25780928.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or gene change tested
25780928.conclusion_quote: We conclude, that acute autoimmune inflammation in EAE does not alter neurogenesis, at least at the stage of DCX-expressing NPC.
25780928.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, showed a temporary rise in a luciferase light signal likely caused by a leaky blood brain barrier, while neurogenesis stayed unchanged.

25738751.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that spontaneous expression of interferon-β-inducible genes in peripheral blood mononuclear cells from untreated multiple sclerosis patients and treatment with interferon-β are associated with reduced myelin basic protein-induced T-cell responses.
25738751.summary: In blood cells from people with MS, higher interferon-induced gene activity and interferon-beta treatment were linked to weaker immune T-cell responses to myelin basic protein.

26668819.mechanism: Loss of CXCR2 in oligodendrocytes speeds myelin repair
26668819.conclusion_quote: Using 2 independent demyelination/remyelination models, our data document enhanced myelin repair in Cxcr2-cKO mice, consistent with the data obtained from radiation chimerism studies of germline CXCR2.
26668819.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced and lysophosphatidylcholine-induced demyelination, deleting CXCR2 from oligodendrocyte lineage cells enhanced myelin repair.

26703877.conclusion_quote: High levels of antiviral ISG15 and PKR proteins in the spinal cord of C57BL/6 mice might block virus replication and play an important role in the resistance to TMEV-IDD.
26703877.summary: In mice infected with a virus that causes demyelinating disease, resistant mice had higher levels of antiviral proteins ISG15 and PKR in the spinal cord than susceptible mice.

25779966.conclusion_quote: Overall, these data suggest that maternal immune activation with Poly I:C during mid-pregnancy increases anxiety- and depressive-like behaviors, and the clinical symptoms of EAE in a sex-dependent manner in non-EAE or EAE-induced offspring.
25779966.summary: In mice with EAE, an immune challenge given to mothers during pregnancy increased anxiety and depressive behaviors in male offspring and worsened disease in both sexes.

26173779.mechanism: removing microglial Hv1 channel reduces NOX-dependent ROS production
26173779.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that the Hv1 proton channel is required for cuprizone-induced microglial oxidative damage and subsequent demyelination.
26173779.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice modeling demyelination, mice lacking the microglial Hv1 proton channel had less myelin loss, fewer motor problems, and reduced oxidative damage.

26349986.mechanism: blocks miR-155 in T cells during reactivation
26349986.conclusion_quote: These results imply that miR-155 supports re-activation of encephalitogenic CD4(+) T cells.
26349986.summary: In rats with EAE, blocking the microRNA miR-155 in immune T cells during reactivation reduced the inflammatory signals IFN-γ and IL-17.

25867716.conclusion_quote: This procedure is important not only for studying the normal events involved in the remyelination process, but also as a pre-clinical tool for screening candidate remyelination-promoting therapeutics.
25867716.summary: In mice, injecting the detergent lysolecithin into spinal cord white matter causes myelin loss that later repairs, offering a quick, low cost model for testing remyelination therapies.

26216115.mechanism: induces oral tolerance to myelin antigens
26216115.conclusion_quote: We found that feeding animals with preparations containing myelin antigens can reduce EAE symptoms, which may indicate oral tolerance induction, but the obtained results also underline the importance of dose of the orally given antigens, because of the possibility of enhancement of the inflammatory process in the CNS.
26216115.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, feeding pig spinal cord hydrolysate reduced clinical symptoms, but the highest dose increased spinal cord inflammation.

25843560.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the results of this work show the cuprizone/Lewis rat model demyelination as an attractive paradigm for studying the correlation between white matter abnormalities and behaviour.
25843560.summary: In Lewis rats fed cuprizone to induce demyelination, researchers found reduced exploration, anxiety, motor impairment and raised TNF-alpha and corticosterone levels.

25697397.mechanism: CerS2 loss lowers neutrophil CXCR2 and migration
25697397.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our data strongly indicate that G-CSF-induced CXCR2 expression is regulated in a CerS2-dependent manner and that CerS2 thereby promotes the migration of neutrophils, thus, contributing to inflammation and the development of EAE and MS.
25697397.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the CerS2 gene delayed symptom onset by reducing neutrophil migration into the brain and spinal cord.

25904788.mechanism: Promotes microglia M2 polarization and remyelination
25904788.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest a new homeobox protein-dependent mechanism for driving microglia M2 polarization and identify MSX3 as an attractive therapeutic approach for preventing inflammation-induced demyelination and promoting remyelination.
25904788.summary: In mice with EAE, boosting the MSX3 gene in brain immune cells called microglia shifted them toward a repair state, reduced inflammation, and helped restore the myelin coating of nerves.

25580822.conclusion_quote: We suggest that if the initiating cause is poorly understood, then curing MS is unlikely.
25580822.summary: This viewpoint argues MS may start with oligodendrocyte degeneration rather than autoimmunity, and suggests proteomics and the cuprizone mouse model could help study it.

26067431.mechanism: Overexpressed Klotho boosts spontaneous remyelination after demyelination
26067431.conclusion_quote: Thus, increasing Klotho expression should be considered as a therapy for enhancing remyelination in the brains of individuals with multiple sclerosis.
26067431.summary: In transgenic mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, boosting Klotho levels roughly doubled spontaneous remyelination of the corpus callosum but did not change EAE clinical scores.

26207625.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes cell fusion
26207625.conclusion_quote: This novel finding expands the repertoire of neurons that can form heterokaryons with bone marrow-derived cells in the central nervous system, albeit in low numbers, possibly leading to a novel therapy for spinal cord motor neurons or other neurons that are compromised in the central nervous system.
26207625.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, bone marrow cells fused with spinal cord neurons, forming cells with two nuclei mostly near inflamed areas.

26378076.mechanism: Binds T cells, suppresses TH17 cell differentiation
26378076.conclusion_quote: Together, we propose the existence of a novel B7-H1-mediated immune-regulatory pathway in T cells, which selectively limits murine and human TH17 cell responses and might be therapeutically exploited to control TH17-mediated autoimmunity.
26378076.summary: In mice with EAE and human T cells from MS patients, a protein drug blocked harmful TH17 immune cells and reduced disease severity.

25909084.mechanism: disrupts GluR2-GAPDH complex, reducing glutamate neurotoxicity
25909084.conclusion_quote: The GluR2 -GAPDH complex represents a novel therapeutic target for the development of medications for MS that work through a different mechanism than existing treatments.
25909084.summary: In mice with EAE, a peptide that disrupts a protein complex called GluR2-GAPDH improved movement, protected nerve cells, and reduced myelin damage.

26155956.mechanism: Describes metabolic changes across disease stages
26155956.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate the sensitivity of this metabolomics approach for distinguishing between different disease states.
26155956.summary: Researchers used urine and blood metabolomics to track disease stages in mice with relapsing EAE, finding plasma changes distinguished active and silent disease.

25691330.conclusion_quote: A continued goal in this field remains the identification of a convenient biomarker that accurately predicts IFN-β treatment non-responsiveness in individual RRMS patients.
25691330.summary: A review of interferon beta treatment in relapsing multiple sclerosis, explaining why some patients do not respond and the need for a test to predict this.

25846048.mechanism: Binds CRMP2 and reduces its phosphorylation, limiting neurodegeneration
25846048.conclusion_quote: Together, these results demonstrate that LKE reduces neurodegeneration in a chronic EAE model of MS, which could have translation potential for treatment of progressive forms of MS.
25846048.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a synthetic lanthionine derivative added to their food reduced nerve damage and improved clinical signs.

25362566.mechanism: Represses IL6, restoring Th17 and Treg balance
25362566.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data indicate an important role for miR26a in maintaining the Th17 and Treg cell balance in MS that involves repression of IL6 expression.
25362566.summary: In mice with EAE, boosting the microRNA miR26a reduced inflammatory Th17 cytokines and produced milder disease, while blocking it worsened disease.

25658938.summary: This record is a correction notice for an earlier rat and macaque study of myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein, not a new experiment.

25568116.mechanism: removing Itk reduces T-cell activation and CNS entry
25568116.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that signaling by Itk promotes autoimmunity and CNS inflammation, suggesting that it may be a viable target for treatment of MS.
25568116.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Itk gene from T cells reduced disease severity and limited immune cells entering the brain and spinal cord.

24753465.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, ICAM-1 expression can be visualized with in vivo molecular MRI during EAE, and provides an early tracer of disease activity.
24753465.summary: Researchers used MRI with iron particles that bind an inflammation marker on blood vessels to spot early disease activity in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

26426258.conclusion_quote: Therefore, the gene pathway analysis lead to the hypothesis that altered cleavage of APP in neurons in the preclinical phase of EAE leads to the enhanced production of APP intracellular domain (AICD), which in turn acts as a transcriptional regulator and thereby initiates an apoptotic signaling cascade via up-regulation of the target gene p53.
26426258.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, researchers found early gene changes in retinal nerve cells linked to APP processing and p53, possibly driving nerve cell death.

25194637.conclusion_quote: Thus, either vitamin D itself or a heretofore-unknown metabolite is needed for the development of a component of the immune system necessary for development of EAE.
25194637.summary: This review covers vitamin D enzymes and sunlight effects in mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, suggesting vitamin D or an unknown metabolite drives disease.

25913734.mechanism: deletes FGF receptor signaling in oligodendrocyte lineage cells
25913734.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that while cell-autonomous FGF signaling is redundant during recovery of acute demyelinated lesions, it facilitates regenerative processes in chronic demyelination.
25913734.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing FGF receptors from myelin-making cells did not affect acute repair but slowed myelin recovery in chronic damage.

25853624.mechanism: Boosts microglial phagocytosis and clearance of myelin debris
25853624.conclusion_quote: These data identify activated microglia as the major producers of protective IFNβ at the peak of EAE and as orchestrators of IFNβ-induced clearance of myelin debris.
25853624.summary: In mice with EAE and brain tissue slices, activated microglia were found to produce protective IFNβ, which helped these immune cells clear myelin debris.

26995952.conclusion_quote: The significance of the complex changes in the composition of the intestinal microbiota, indicating long-lasting dysbiosis in rats during the development of EAE is discussing.
26995952.summary: In rats with experimental allergic encephalomyelitis, a model of multiple sclerosis, symptomatic animals had gut bacteria shifted toward harmful types, while asymptomatic rats had more Faecalibacterium prausnitzii.

26561550.mechanism: Blocks CaMK4 in T cells, curbing Th17 cell expansion
26561550.conclusion_quote: These results highlight the promise of cell-targeted inhibition of molecules involved in the pathogenesis of autoimmunity as a means of advancing the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
26561550.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug delivered by nanogel to CD4 T cells reduced disease and blocked Th17 cell development without killing the T cells.

25310756.mechanism: Suppresses T-cell proliferation and dendritic cell maturation
25310756.conclusion_quote: Collectively, we show that WJ-MSCs have trophic support properties and effectively modulate immune cell functioning both in vitro and in the EAE model, suggesting WJ-MSC may hold promise for MS therapy.
25310756.summary: In rats with EAE, an MS model, human umbilical cord stem cells calmed immune cells and temporarily reduced disease symptoms, though the benefit did not last.

26280015.mechanism: Blocking MIF restores steroid response in T cells
26280015.conclusion_quote: Our data establish MIF as a key molecule in resistance of pathogenic CD4(+) T cells to GC treatment in EAE and as a potential target to enhance the effectiveness of steroid treatment in neuroinflammatory disorders.
26280015.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the MIF gene made dexamethasone steroid treatment work much better, suggesting MIF drives resistance to steroids.

25108214.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that maternal immune activation during late gestation predispose the offspring to increased neuroinflammation and potentiate the autoimmune response and clinical manifestation of EAE.
25108214.summary: In mice with EAE, prenatal exposure to bacterial LPS during late pregnancy worsened disease severity and increased neuroinflammation in the adult offspring.

25494298.mechanism: Diagnostic imaging probe, not a treatment
25494298.conclusion_quote: MPO-Gd specifically reveals lesions with inflammatory monocytes and neutrophils, which actively secrete MPO.
25494298.summary: Researchers tested a new MRI contrast agent that targets myeloperoxidase in mice with EAE, finding it detected early and hidden inflammation in the brain better than standard contrast.

26616879.mechanism: adjuvant that increases inflammation and oxidative stress during induction
26616879.conclusion_quote: When PT was used, EAE turned into remitting-relapsing form and worsen the clinical symptoms.
26616879.summary: In Lewis rats with EAE, adding pertussis toxin during disease induction changed the illness into a relapsing remitting form with worse symptoms and more inflammation.

25879435.conclusion_quote: We developed a novel therapeutic antibody targeting CXCL13-mediated signaling pathway for the treatment of autoimmune disorders.
25879435.summary: An antibody that blocks the CXCL13 signal reduced disease in mice with passively induced EAE and disrupted B cell movement into immune tissue.

26277686.conclusion_quote: By suppressing inflammation and oxidative stress, combined treatment with lenalidomide and nanoceria can reduce demyelination and associated neurological symptoms in EAE mice.
26277686.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, combining lenalidomide with nanoceria nearly eliminated symptoms and reduced myelin damage more than either treatment alone.

26340909.mechanism: Gene loss reduces pathogenic lymphocyte recall responses
26340909.conclusion_quote: Thus, modulation of KS may become a treatment for neuroimmunological diseases.
26340909.summary: In mice lacking the GlcNAc6ST1 gene, which reduces keratan sulfate, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis was milder and immune responses were weaker.

25944743.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes KLF4 expression
25944743.conclusion_quote: Collectively, we postulate that autoimmune T cells and macrophages activate KLF4 and subsequently do not proliferate or exhibit phenotypic switching from M1 to M2 macrophages, respectively.
25944743.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found the protein KLF4 rose in the spinal cord and appeared in immune cells and astrocytes, without testing any treatment.

26616873.mechanism: reduces infiltrating immune cells and monocytes in brain
26616873.conclusion_quote: LA significantly reduces inflammation in a focal cortical model of MS.
26616873.summary: In mice with a focal cortical form of EAE, lipoic acid treatment reduced immune cells that drive brain inflammation, suggesting it could help control cortical MS lesions.

25972178.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that, in polarized autoreactive effector T cells, miRNA synthesis is inhibited in response to dysregulated RISC assembly, allowing these cells to maintain a highly specific proinflammatory program.
25972178.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found that key proteins that help control microRNAs were abnormally reduced in brain cells and T cells.

25658316.summary: This is a correction notice for an earlier study on the IκBNS protein and mice with EAE, and it reports no new findings.

26025060.mechanism: Dampens Th1/Th17 inflammation, preserves BDNF and CNP expression
26025060.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that TGP could be a potential therapeutic agent for MS.
26025060.summary: In mice with EAE, a peony-derived extract reduced disease severity and progression, lowered harmful immune cell activity, and preserved nerve-supporting proteins.

25917100.mechanism: Inhibits Th1 differentiation, promotes Th2 differentiation
25917100.conclusion_quote: These pattern recognition-independent actions of CRP directly on T cells highlights the potential for this soluble pattern recognition receptor to act as a tonic regulator of immunity, shaping global adaptive immune responses during both homeostasis and disease.
25917100.summary: In mice with EAE, human C-reactive protein acted directly on T cells, reducing harmful Th1 responses and lowering disease severity.

25969836.mechanism: Candida infection before immunization increases encephalitogenic cytokines
25969836.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that C. albicans infection before EAE induction aggravates EAE, and possibly MS, mainly by CNS dissemination and local induction of encephalitogenic cytokines.
25969836.summary: Mice with EAE that were first infected with the fungus Candida albicans had worse symptoms, more weight loss, and higher inflammatory cytokines in the nervous system.

26302995.mechanism: Loss of CD14 boosts lymphocyte crossing of endothelium
26302995.conclusion_quote: The results demonstrate an important role of CD14 in migration of lymphocytes, and strengthen the importance of innate immune receptors in adaptive immune disorders, such as multiple sclerosis.
26302995.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CD14 immune receptor made disease worse and let more immune cells, called lymphocytes, cross the blood-brain barrier.

26559850.mechanism: Reduces Th1 and Th17 cell CNS infiltration
26559850.conclusion_quote: Simvastatin treatment promotes EAE clinical amelioration by inhibiting T cell proliferation and CNS infiltration by pathogenic Th1 and Th17 cells.
26559850.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, given simvastatin had milder symptoms, fewer immune cells entering the central nervous system, and fewer Th1 and Th17 inflammatory cells.

26884985.mechanism: inhibits PI3K delta, reducing Th1 and Th17 cells
26884985.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our studies demonstrate that inhibition of PI3Kδ may serve as novel therapy to suppress neuroinflammation seen during EAE.
26884985.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the selective PI3K delta inhibitor IC87114 reduced clinical symptoms, central nervous system inflammation, and harmful immune cell and cytokine levels.

25769878.conclusion_quote: Microscopic findings suggest that two patterns can be distinguished at disease onset: an initial phase characterized by muscle mitochondrial alterations, and a second phase dominated by a histological muscle pattern of clearly neurogenic origin.
25769878.summary: In rats with EAE, an MS animal model, researchers examined leg muscles at disease onset and second relapse, finding early mitochondrial damage and later muscle changes caused by nerve damage.

26273684.conclusion_quote: Prion-like aggregation of MBP following chronic demyelination may result from an aberrant lipid composition accompanying this pathological status.
26273684.summary: In mice with chronic demyelination from cuprizone or EAE, myelin basic protein formed clumps in cells, possibly linked to abnormal myelin lipids. No treatment was tested.

25619397.mechanism: Parasite-derived galectin boosts B cells and autoantibody production
25619397.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that galectin isolated from a gastrointestinal parasite can deliver a harmful effect to EAE contrary to its beneficial effect on inflammatory bowel disease.
25619397.summary: In mice with EAE, a parasite galectin prevented recovery, causing lasting nerve damage and more harmful antibodies.

25142403.mechanism: silences RORγt transcription factor in T cells
25142403.conclusion_quote: Thus, RORγt is unlikely to be a more effective therapeutic target for ameliorating pathogenicity of encephalitogenic CD4 T cells.
25142403.summary: In mice with EAE, knocking down the RORγt gene in myelin-reactive immune T cells did not significantly reduce disease severity.

25773147.mechanism: Modulates autophagy and apoptosis proteins, reducing inflammation and demyelinat
25773147.conclusion_quote: Thus, 1,25(OH)2D3 may represent a promising new MS treatment.
25773147.summary: In mice with EAE, an active form of vitamin D slowed disease, reduced spinal cord inflammation, demyelination and nerve cell loss, and shifted autophagy and cell survival proteins.

26336737.mechanism: administered cytokine alters later immune response to spinal cord antigen
26336737.conclusion_quote: It was shown that in rats after administration of IL-1beta on 1st and on 4th week of life EAE is more severe than corresponding control groups of rats.
26336737.summary: In rats with experimental allergic encephalomyelitis, giving interleukin-1beta in the first or fourth week of life made the later disease more severe than in untreated controls.

25762107.mechanism: Inhibits Th1 Th17 differentiation and induces T-cell apoptosis
25762107.conclusion_quote: Our findings implicate kirenol as a useful agent for the treatment of MS.
25762107.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the natural compound kirenol delayed disease onset, reduced symptom scores, and lowered harmful Th1 and Th17 immune cells.

26658811.conclusion_quote: Our results complement our previous ultrastructural studies of B6 EAE models and suggest that B6 mice immunized with different antigens constitute useful instruments to study the diverse histopathological aspects of MS.
26658811.summary: In mice with EAE triggered by the MP4 antigen, damage to myelin and nerve fibers grew worse over time, with the largest lesions in the chronic stage.

25810397.mechanism: Binds HSP90β and blocks interstitial leukocyte migration
25810397.conclusion_quote: In summary, vibsanin B is a novel lead compound that preferentially targets HSP90β and inhibits interstitial leukocyte migration, offering a promising drug lead for treating inflammation-associated diseases.
25810397.summary: In mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS, the plant compound vibsanin B reduced immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord.

25813705.mechanism: Reduces inflammation and nestin expression, and increases oligodendrocyte number
25813705.conclusion_quote: These findings give a new insight into the mechanism of how nicotine functions to attenuate EAE.
25813705.summary: In animals with EAE, nicotine reduced inflammation and nestin expression in the spinal cord, partly restored ependymal cell growth, and increased oligodendrocyte numbers.

26246144.mechanism: Loss of PTEN makes antigen presenting cells regulatory
26246144.conclusion_quote: These observations support the notion that activation of the PI3K signaling cascade promotes regulatory APC properties and suppresses pathogenic T cell polarization, thereby reducing the clinical symptoms and pathology of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
26246144.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the PTEN gene in immune antigen presenting cells made them less inflammatory, reducing Th17 immune cells and protecting mice from paralysis and damage.

25535034.mechanism: Loss reduces T-cell proliferation and Th1/Th17 inflammatory responses
25535034.conclusion_quote: In summary, our findings suggest that GNMT is involved in the pathogenesis of EAE and plays a crucial role in the regulation of CD4(+) T-cell functions.
25535034.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the GNMT gene reduced disease severity, lowered inflammatory immune cell activity, and spared more spinal cord tissue from damage.

26176030.mechanism: removing inhibitory receptor increases immune cell infiltration
26176030.conclusion_quote: These observations suggest that DCIR is an important negative regulator of the immune system, and Dcir(–/–) mice should be useful for analyzing the roles of DCIR in an array of autoimmune diseases.
26176030.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the DCIR gene made disease worse, with more spinal cord demyelination and more immune cells entering the spinal cord.

26340869.mechanism: Antioxidant effect relieving mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress
26340869.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest the toxic effects of cuprizone on mitochondria and an antioxidant capacity of quetiapine, by which this antipsychotic relieves the cuprizone-induced mitochondrial dysfunction in brain cells.
26340869.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that damages myelin, quetiapine eased brain energy and oxidative stress changes, suggesting antioxidant protection.

26477735.mechanism: Suppresses RORγt and T-bet transcription factors
26477735.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data indicate that DHCA may be a potential candidate as an agent for the control of Th17 and Th1-mediated inflammatory diseases.
26477735.summary: A synthetic plant-derived compound, DHCA, reduced harmful immune cells and inflammatory signals in the spinal cord and eased symptoms in mice with EAE.

25619542.mechanism: No treatment tested, only describes complement activity
25619542.conclusion_quote: These data show that complement is activated in the central nervous system in the model and suggest that it is a suitable candidate for exploring whether anti-complement agents might be of benefit in MS.
25619542.summary: In mice with chronic relapsing EAE, a model of MS, researchers found that complement immune proteins were active in the spinal cord during relapses and progression but not remission.

26141738.conclusion_quote: We described here for the first time the mRNA expression of several genes in WM astrocytes in a mouse model of multiple sclerosis.
26141738.summary: Researchers profiled genes in white matter astrocytes from mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, and found high levels of the enzyme SULT1A1 that may block estrogen effects.

25269720.mechanism: No treatment or genetic change tested
25269720.conclusion_quote: Characteristics of canine EAE models were very similar to canine NE, suggesting that canine EAE can be a disease model for NE in dogs.
25269720.summary: In dogs, immunization with brain tissue produced an immune disease resembling canine necrotizing encephalitis, suggesting it could serve as a model for that condition.

26329786.mechanism: Inhibits microglia activation and MAPK signaling, promoting remyelination
26329786.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our results demonstrate that GRA-modulated microglia suppresses EAE through inhibiting microglia activation-mediated CNS inflammation, and promoting neuroprotective effect of microglia, which represents a potential therapeutic strategy for MS and maybe other neuroinflammatory diseases associated with microglia activation.
26329786.summary: In mice with EAE, the compound 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid calmed microglia, reduced brain inflammation, and promoted myelin repair.

25721617.mechanism: inhibits T-cell proliferation and cytokine production
25721617.conclusion_quote: Diazepam has a direct inhibitory effect on the proliferation and activation of T lymphocytes isolated from the main lymphoid organ involved in disease onset and this could be one of the mechanisms that contribute to the beneficial effect previously observed with diazepam in vivo during EAE development.
25721617.summary: In rats with EAE, diazepam applied directly to immune cells from lymph nodes reduced their growth and inflammatory signals without killing the cells.

26785366.mechanism: blocks overactive glutamate receptors that damage oligodendrocytes
26785366.conclusion_quote: The results reveal that glutamate receptor antagonists have a positive effect on the expression of mRNA MBP and glycoproteins MAG and MOG but not on myelin ultrastructure.
26785366.summary: Blocking NMDA glutamate receptors with amantadine or memantine reduced neurological symptoms in rats with EAE, an MS model, but did not repair myelin structure.

25528476.mechanism: Suppresses Th1 and Th17 cells via dendritic cells
25528476.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, icariin ameliorates EAE and this was associated with suppressed Th1 and Th17 cell differentiation.
25528476.summary: In mice with EAE, the plant compound icariin reduced brain inflammation and harmful Th1 and Th17 immune cells, improving disease scores and recovery.

25753260.mechanism: TSLP loss reduces Th1 and T-cell activation
25753260.conclusion_quote: In summary, these data demonstrate that expression of, and immune activation by, TSLP contributes significantly to the immunopathology of EAE.
25753260.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the TSLP gene delayed disease onset and reduced harmful T cell activity, showing TSLP drives the disease.

26617835.mechanism: Transplanted olfactory cells reach lesions and improve neurological function
26617835.conclusion_quote: OEC transplantation could exert beneficial effects in the treatment of EAE, no matter which the cells were transplanted through the vena caudalis or into the lateral cerebral ventricle.
26617835.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, transplanted olfactory ensheathing cells improved neurological scores and body weight and reached brain lesions, though tissue staining showed no clear change.

26213713.mechanism: Deleting HIF-1α in glia and myeloid cells
26213713.conclusion_quote: Overall, our data indicate that despite dramatic upregulation of HIF-1 α in astrocytes and myeloid cells in EAE, HIF-1 α expression in these two cell types is not required for the development of inflammatory demyelination.
26213713.summary: In mice with EAE, removing HIF-1α from astrocytes and immune myeloid cells did not lessen symptoms, inflammation, or demyelination, and blocking its breakdown did not worsen disease.

26637427.conclusion_quote: Our study shows that auto-sensitization of humans with brain tissue can induce a disease, which closely reflects the pathology of MS, but that the mechanisms leading to demyelination and tissue injury differ from those, generally implicated in the pathophysiology of MS through studies in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
26637427.summary: Autopsy tissue from a person who developed an MS like disease after repeated brain cell injections showed MS type damage with antibodies and CD8 T cells, but few CD4 T cells.

25041171.mechanism: No treatment tested, descriptive study only
25041171.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that local meningeal T and plasma cell infiltration contributes to the pathogenesis of SCD in marmosets with EAE.
25041171.summary: In marmosets with EAE, a model of MS, meninges near subpial cortical demyelination had more T cells and plasma cells, suggesting these cells help drive that damage.

25223373.mechanism: Inhibits ROCK II, dampening TLR and cytokine signaling
25223373.conclusion_quote: This study highlights the therapeutic potential of FaD-1 as a ROCK inhibitor for the treatment of human autoimmune diseases with both inflammatory and autoimmune components.
25223373.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug FaD-1 reduced nerve damage, demyelination and spinal cord inflammation and improved neurological symptoms.

26478898.mechanism: Inhibits integrin alpha4 expression, distinct from NRF2 activation
26478898.conclusion_quote: Our results offer an alternative mechanism for the efficacy of dimethyl fumarate in multiple sclerosis.
26478898.summary: In mice with EAE and in human T cells, dimethyl fumarate lowered integrin alpha4 on lymphocytes, suggesting a second way the drug may work in MS.

26130320.mechanism: Rebalances T cells toward regulatory, less inflammatory responses
26130320.conclusion_quote: For the first time, we report that melatonin protects against EAE by controlling peripheral and central T effector/regulatory responses, effects that might be partially mediated by CD44.
